title: Data Center Day Engineer
description:
Serverfarm is a leading developer and operator of data centers with over 750+ locations and key customer relationships in 45 countries. We're revolutionizing how data centers operate across North America, Western Europe, and Israel, serving the world's leading technology and hyperscale companies. With Manulife Investment Management's acquisition in 2023 and our award-winning InCommand platform we're positioned for explosive growth as AI adoption and cloud migration drive unprecedented demand for data center capacity.

A career at Serverfarm means being at the forefront of digital infrastructure innovation, where your work directly impacts how the world's data is managed and secured. As we target 4x growth over the next four years, you'll have unprecedented opportunities to take on new challenges, develop cutting-edge skills, and grow your career across our expanding global operations.

Join our team of innovators and help shape the future of sustainable data centers while building a career without boundaries.

The Data Centre Day Engineer (AMS) is responsible for the safe, reliable, and efficient operation of critical facilities infrastructure within the data centre. Working as part of the Engineering team, the role ensures maximum availability of electrical and mechanical systems through planned maintenance, monitoring, fault response, and contractor management.

The Day Engineer plays a key role in maintaining uptime by supporting daily operations, coordinating maintenance activities, responding to incidents, and ensuring compliance with operational, safety, and regulatory standards.

  • Participate in construction and commissioning activities as directed by site management

Job Description:

At Regions, the Digital Experience Design Accessibility Analyst is part of a experience design (XD) team with a clear purpose: we drive user-centered design for the betterment of our customers and our business groups. This role will work as an active partner on inclusive, cross-functional teams throughout the digital product lifecycle to ensure that usability and accessibility are integrated and balance meeting human needs and mitigating risk.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Provides expert accessibility and usability feedback in the areas of design (UX/UI), development, and testing to teams
  • Engages in quality audits and assist with remediation roadmaps
  • Functions as a subject matter expert on accessibility, staying ahead of trends in disability advocacy, universal and inclusive design, and web standards.
  • Collaborates with designers to review designs ensuring that accessibility is baked into the product before development starts
  • Assists developers in addressing accessibility challenges by delivering specifications and providing functional prototypes of solutions
  • Works with product teams to provide manual and automated reviews, diagnose issues and recommend solutions
  • Facilitates and encourages collaboration and transparency across disciplines
  • Assists in the development of training and education materials
  • Evaluates third party tool and assist in implementation of new tools

This position is exempt from timekeeping requirements under the Fair Labor Standards Act and is not eligible for overtime pay.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in relevant field and six (6) years experience performing accessibility testing
  • Or High School Diploma or GED and ten (10) years of related post-secondary education and/or experience in performing accessibility testing

Skills and Competencies

  • Ability to collaborate productively both independently and with diverse teams
  • Ability to hand-code HTML, CSS and JavaScript - inspect the code, analyze the violations, remediate in the browser's rendered code, and retest
  • Ability to interpret and ensure compliance with applicable rules, regulations, and industry guidance
  • Ability to recommend technical solutions for several technology stacks, for example, mobile, React (single-page applications), dotnet, etc.
  • Ability to mentor others in methods and techniques for addressing accessibility barriers on web applications and mobile devices and in a variety of forums
  • Advanced soft skills and mastery of working with teams with varied levels of understanding of inclusive design or accessibility
  • Consumer-centric; empathetic toward the customer with the ability to put oneself in their shoes
  • Demonstrated confidence using a range of assistive technologies, including JAWS, NVDA, iOS VoiceOver, Android Talkback, etc.
  • Excellent communication, problem-solving, and analytical skills
  • Experienced working in an agile environment
  • In depth understanding of ADA standards, including edge cases

This position is intended to be onsite, now or in the near future. Associates will have regular work hours, including full days in the office three or more days a week. The manager will set the work schedule for this position, including in-office expectations. Regions will not provide relocation assistance for this position, and relocation would be at your expense. title: Pricing Architect
description:
About the Role

We're an early-stage AI-powered pricing optimization SaaS startup helping B2B companies turn pricing from a static exercise into a continuously improving, data-driven system. Our platform spans the full pricing lifecycle — from packaging and price architecture to deal execution and sales coaching — and we're growing fast.

We're looking for a Pricing Architect based in Amsterdam to own high-impact pricing engagements with our customers end-to-end. This is a senior, client-facing role at the intersection of commercial strategy, AI, and SaaS monetization. You'll work directly with C-suite stakeholders and cross-functional teams to design and deliver pricing strategies that drive real revenue outcomes.

What You'll Do

  • Lead customer pricing engagements independently — from initial discovery through to a live pricing and proposition model.

  • Design segmentation frameworks, packaging structures, price metrics, and monetization logic tailored to each customer's business context.

  • Apply advanced pricing methods including willingness-to-pay analysis, price elasticity modeling, discount architecture, and usage-based or consumption pricing.

  • Present findings and recommendations confidently to C-level executives and cross-functional stakeholders.

  • Leverage AI and GenAI/LLM tools actively in your day-to-day work to accelerate analysis and insight generation.

  • Use data (spreadsheets, SQL) to dig into pricing analysis and support evidence-based recommendations.

  • Coach and mentor colleagues, sharing pricing expertise across the team.

What We're Looking For

Must-haves:

  • 5–7+ years of experience in pricing, commercial strategy, or revenue management — from a Tier 1 strategy consulting background or a pricing/revenue role within a tech or SaaS company.

  • Deep expertise in pricing and commercial value creation: segmentation, packaging, price metrics, discounting, and willingness-to-pay methodologies.

  • Strong client-facing skills; comfortable owning engagements and building credibility with C-level and cross-functional audiences.

  • Genuine enthusiasm for AI and confidence in steering AI-driven work (no need to build models yourself).

  • Hands-on use of GenAI/LLM tools in your current workflow.

  • Solid data skills — proficient with spreadsheets and SQL for pricing analysis.

  • Professional fluency in English.

  • Must be authorized to work in the Netherlands — visa sponsorship is not available.

Nice to have:

  • Experience coaching or mentoring junior team members.

  • Background in SaaS monetization models (usage-based, seat-based, hybrid, outcome-based).

Compensation & Benefits

  • Competitive salary commensurate with experience.

  • Meaningful equity through an Employee Stock Option Plan (ESOP).

Location

This is an on-site role based in Amsterdam, Netherlands. Candidates must be based in or willing to relocate to Amsterdam. No visa sponsorship is available — you must already be authorized to work in the Netherlands.

title: Head of AI Research
description:
About the Role

We are a seed-stage deeptech startup building an advanced materials acceleration platform that combines physics-informed AI, robotics, and real-world experimental data to dramatically shorten the timeline for discovering new materials — particularly for the energy sector. We are seeking a Head of AI Research to define and lead our AI-for-Materials research agenda.

This is a senior leadership role sitting at the intersection of machine learning, physics, chemistry, and automated experimentation. You will shape the scientific vision that translates cutting-edge research insight into reliable, end-to-end discovery pipelines — and build the world-class team to execute it.

Location: Berlin, Germany (on-site). Visa sponsorship is not available — candidates must be eligible to work in Germany without employer sponsorship.

What You'll Do

  • Define and champion the research thesis for AI-native materials discovery; set high-impact research bets and long-horizon strategy.

  • Identify where existing ML paradigms fall short for physical matter and specify what needs to be invented instead.

  • Lead development of a Materials World Model that bridges experiments, simulations, and learned representations.

  • Collaborate closely with Programs, Hardware & Automation, and Software Architecture teams to embed research into end-to-end autonomous discovery loops.

  • Ensure models stay grounded in physical reality and experimental feedback — not just abstract data.

  • Balance ambitious long-horizon research goals with near-term deliverables and milestones.

  • Build, hire, mentor, and challenge a multi-disciplinary team of senior ML researchers and scientists.

  • Foster a culture of deep thinking, honest evaluation, scientific taste, and intellectual courage.

  • Influence the broader scientific community through collaborations and a clear, opinionated point of view on future directions.

What We're Looking For

Required:

  • Advanced degree (PhD strongly preferred) in machine learning, physics, chemistry, or a closely related field.

  • 7+ years of machine learning research experience, including demonstrated leadership of senior individual contributors or head-of-team responsibility.

  • Deep expertise in physics-informed machine learning, representation learning, or foundation models applied to materials science or related physical domains.

  • Proven ability to build end-to-end discovery pipelines that integrate experiments, simulations, and models.

  • Track record of setting and influencing a research agenda — defining thesis, prioritizing under uncertainty, and making irreversible bets.

  • Strong intuition for physical systems, chemistry, and their constraints.

  • Excellent cross-disciplinary communication skills; ability to influence technical and non-technical stakeholders and external collaborators.

  • Fluency in English; additional languages are a plus.

  • Eligibility to work in Germany without employer visa sponsorship.

Nice to Have:

  • Background in scientific ML areas such as equivariant neural networks, generative models for molecules/materials, or multi-fidelity modeling.

  • Experience in automated or autonomous laboratory environments.

  • Familiarity with the energy materials landscape (e.g., batteries, catalysts, photovoltaics).

  • Prior experience at a research institution, national laboratory, or deeptech startup.

Compensation & Benefits

Compensation details are not publicly listed for this role. A competitive package commensurate with the seniority and strategic importance of this position will be discussed during the interview process.

Location

This is a full-time, on-site role based in Berlin, Germany. Candidates must be willing and eligible to work in Berlin without employer-sponsored visa support.

title: Grupo QuintoAndar | Information Security Manager - GRC
description:
About Grupo QuintoAndar

We are Grupo QuintoAndar, the largest real estate ecosystem in Latin America. Guided by a shared purpose of helping people love where they live, we have a diversified portfolio of brands and solutions across different countries in Latin America, covering all phases of the housing journey. We also have a Technology Hub in Portugal. We develop technology and innovation to transform and enhance the overall living experience.

With the support of a world-class team of investors and advisors, including Kaszek, Qualcomm, General Atlantic, and SoftBank, Grupo QuintoAndar is currently valued at over USD 5.1 billion and continues to grow year over year.

Here, you will work with top professionals in the market, in an environment that breathes innovation, collaboration, and high performance. To learn more about our story, visit: .


Location & Remote Work

Our technology team operates under a "remote-first" model, which means we work from home and can live anywhere in Brazil. We also offer the option of working from our São Paulo offices or partner coworking spaces, up to twice a week.

About the Position

We are looking for a leader to take on the role of Manager of Information Security, GRC. Your mission will be to define the area's vision, structure our practices, and lead the transformation: shifting the perception that GRC is merely an operational and bureaucratic function to making it a dynamic, strategic enabler focused on real business risk.

This is not a position for managing spreadsheets. As the GRC leader within the Cybersecurity structure, you will work side-by-side with the CISO and others leadership to safely enable critical projects. We seek someone with technical capability, execution skills, and strategic vision, able to drive projects end-to-end and ensure that security governance makes our business faster, more scalable, and resilient.

You must have proven experience in GRC leadership that goes beyond regulatory compliance and paper-based frameworks, understanding control architectures and the technological nuances of an agile, cloud-native environment (Cloud, AI, Data). You will be primarily responsible for accountability regarding cyber risk, guiding the company through complex scenarios.

The Manager of GRC will report directly to the CISO and will be responsible for managing the investment, the internal team, and the third-party (3P) partners supporting the GRC operation.

Main Responsibilities

  • GRC Leadership & Strategy: Develop and lead the GRC strategy, building and executing roadmap in full alignment with the company's business objectives, budget, and risk appetite.
  • Strategic PMO & Business Enabler: Act as the strategic PMO for Cybersecurity, prioritizing the project portfolio alongside the CISO. More than managing risks, you will be the leader who enables projects from the cross company areas, ensuring security keeps pace with the speed of the business.
  • Security Service Channel & Portfolio: Own the company's security service channel and security portfolio, acting as the primary intake and coordination point for security requests and initiatives, ensuring visibility and prioritization across the security program.
  • Information Security Governance & Artificial Intelligence: Lead the Information Security Governance model. Take the lead in AI governance, establishing guidelines, controls, and policies to ensure the safe, ethical, and compliant use of new technologies across the company.
  • IAM Governance: Lead IAM Governance projects, ensuring identity and access management controls and processes are aligned with the company's risk and SOX compliance requirements.
  • People Management & Development (EM): Lead, inspire, and develop a high-performance team of GRC specialists, promoting engagement, autonomy, and technical excellence.
  • Operationalized Risk Management: Lead the end-to-end cyber risk management program (identification, treatment, monitoring, and remediation plans), with strong ability to financially quantify cyber risk using methodologies such as FAIR (Factor Analysis of Information Risk).
  • Third-Party Risk Management (TPRM) & Cyber Resilience: Lead third-party risk management and cyber resilience programs, ensuring the extended supply chain and critical vendors meet the company's security and compliance standards.
  • Continuous Compliance: Ensure compliance with regulations (e.g., LGPD, SOx, GDPR) and frameworks, acting as the company's voice to respond to and negotiate with internal and external audits and regulatory bodies, implementing a Continuous Compliance model.
  • Committees & Metrics (KPIs/KRIs): Act as a member of the Information Security Committee, defining and reporting strategic, tactical, and operational indicators, risk metrics, and maturity evolution to executive leadership and supporting the preparation of materials for these forums.
  • Culture & Awareness: Lead the corporate security awareness strategy, transforming the human factor into the first line of defense through engaging programs and metrics that prove a reduction in behavioral risk.
  • Policies (ISP): Structure, simplify, review, and maintain the framework of policies, standards, procedures, and processes related to Information Security.
  • Partnership & Focal Point: Act as the primary focal point and business partner for GRC topics with Technology, Engineering, Product, Legal, Privacy, Finance, Compliance, Internal Audit, and business leaders. Identify opportunities to build practical, structural processes that mitigate risks.

Requirements

  • 10+ years of experience in Information Security GRC, with at least 5 years in leadership and team management roles within complex, dynamic, and multinational corporate environments (preferably tech companies, scale-ups, or the financial sector).
  • Proven experience reporting to, presenting to, and influencing executives and stakeholders.
  • Experience managing security demand intake and portfolio prioritization, ideally leveraging ITSM practices.
  • Deep mastery and critical vision in structuring frameworks and standards such as NIST CSF 2.0, ISO 27001/27002, CIS Controls, privacy methodologies, and ISO 31000.
  • Exceptional ability to translate technical cyber risks (e.g., cloud vulnerabilities) into financial and operational impacts using methodologies such as FAIR.
  • Experience designing and operationalizing security KPI/KRI frameworks and maturity models for executive reporting.
  • Experience sponsoring governance for critical incident response and cyber crisis management.
  • Direct experience engaging with regulators and external auditors during compliance reviews.
  • Experience designing vendor risk assessment methodologies and TPRM programs.
  • Practical experience in AI Governance, including the definition of guidelines, controls, and policies for the safe, ethical, and compliant use of AI within the company.
  • Experience leading IAM Governance initiatives, ensuring identity and access management controls and processes are aligned with the company's risk and compliance requirements.
  • Experience supporting SOX compliance programs, including IT General Controls (ITGC).
  • Experience designing and running security awareness and behavior change programs.
  • GRC Engineering mindset: ability to use automation and AI to solve GRC problems at scale (e.g., automated evidence collection, continuous controls monitoring, risk quantification), reducing manual and bureaucratic work.
  • Fluency in Portuguese and advanced/fluent English (essential for interactions, reading global standards, and leading international teams/suppliers).

Nice to have

  • Certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CRISC, or ISO 27001 Lead Auditor will be considered a differential.

Benefits

  • Competitive salary
  • Profit sharing
  • Meal allowance
  • Health insurance
  • Dental plan
  • Life insurance
  • Childcare subsidy and Atypical Parenthood subsidy
  • Wellhub
  • Home office allowance
  • Employee assistance program (mental health, social, legal, and financial support)
  • Extended parental leave
  • Day off on birthday, Mother’s Day, and Father’s Day
  • Benefits Club (discounts on everyday services)
  • Discounts at educational institutions
  • Reading kit for children – PlayKids

Diversity & Inclusion at Grupo QuintoAndar

We value diversity and want everyone to feel welcome here, regardless of their age, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, ethnicity, origin, disability, religion, or any other characteristic. All our job openings are open to all individuals!

You'll notice there are some diversity questions in the application form. For affirmative action roles, this information may be used to verify your alignment with the target audience for the opportunity. In such cases, it may be used for elimination purposes. For non-affirmative action roles, this data will be used anonymously, exclusively to monitor and improve our inclusion practices in the hiring process, and will have no impact on your application.

Privacy and Data Protection

The Grupo QuintoAndar operates in compliance with privacy and data protection laws, including, but not limited to, the Brazilian General Personal Data Protection Law (LGPD) (Law No. 13,709/2018), and ensures the security of your data. To learn more, please access our Privacy Notice for Candidates. For questions or to exercise your rights as a data subject, please contact us through our Service Channel.

About the Role

In this role, you will own the end-to-end RMA coordination process—managing defective parts, working directly with vendors, and ensuring timely processing of incoming and outgoing returns.

  • Track and manage RMA inventory, including physical transfers between departments

  • Monitor outstanding RMA cases with vendors and drive follow-ups to closure

  • Partner with vendors on special part requests, failure analysis requests (FAR), and urgent escalations

  • Manage day-to-day RMA receiving activities and ensure accurate system updates

  • Maintain real-time tracking of tickets, workflows, and open issues

  • Ensure RMAs are processed within defined service-level agreements (SLAs)

  • Generate and maintain daily productivity and workflow reports

  • Support Customer Service with RMA authorization and case processing as needed

  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Operations, Customer Support, Quality, and Engineering teams

  • Maintain and update RMA process documentation; create new SOPs as needed

  • Continuously review and improve RMA workflows and operational processes

You

  • Have experience in RMA coordination, logistics, supply chain, or similar operational role

  • Are highly organized with strong attention to detail and follow-through

  • Can manage multiple workflows and prioritize effectively in a fast-paced environment

  • Are comfortable working directly with vendors and internal stakeholders

  • Have strong written and verbal communication skills

  • Are data-driven and capable of tracking metrics, reporting, and process performance

  • Can work cross-functionally and drive accountability across teams

  • Are proactive in identifying issues and pushing them to resolution

  • Are adaptable and flexible with changing priorities

  • Maintain a structured and process-oriented approach to work

Nice to Have

  • 2+ years of experience in RMA operations, supply chain, or hardware logistics

  • Experience working with server hardware, power supplies, or data center components

  • Familiarity with ERP systems (e.g., NetSuite), ticketing tools (e.g., Zendesk, Jira), or inventory systems

  • Understanding of failure analysis processes and vendor return workflows

  • Experience in process improvement or SOP documentation

  • Basic knowledge of hardware components and repair workflows

Salary Range Information

This is an hourly role, eligible for overtime. The hourly rate for this position has been set based on market data and other factors. The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

  • No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

  • Please always verify communications:
    • Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address.
    • Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com.

  • Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

  • What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

Data Privacy

To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit .

description:
Position Summary: Provides guests with excellent service while maintaining, an efficient and effective operation in all areas of guest services and the front office area. Thoroughly welcoming and assisting all guests, balances and reconciles daily accounting records, completes necessary paperwork, performs cash and credit transactions for incoming revenue, handles guest inquiries and complaints, fields incoming calls and directs appropriately. Monitors third party review sites and responds to guest comments.

Pay Rate: $16 per hour

Essential Position Responsibilities:

Oversees daily operation of the front desk area and maintains a welcoming presence as the “first impression” for many guests, fellow associates and vendors. Maintains a welcoming presence to the property and in the front office area, especially when in view of guests. Immediately acknowledge guests, requests, and questions.

Observes the company’s “10-4” rule for all guests (Within 10 feet of physical proximity to a guest, make eye contact and acknowledge their presence by nodding and smiling. Within 4 feet of physical proximity to a guest, verbally acknowledge them, this can be by simply saying “Hello, how are you today?”.

Is neat and clean in appearance, wears proper uniform, name/ID badge, correct department footwear, and a smile.

Provides excellent customer service that goes “above and beyond” the expectations of Waterpark guests. Conducts themselves in a professional, courteous manner at all times. Immediately addresses all guest requests and follows through to ensure resolution and 100% satisfaction.

Immediately addresses all guest requests or complaints and follows through to ensure resolution and 100% satisfaction.

Answer phone calls and assist guests with inquiries, reservations and general information.

Follows proper cash and credit card handling procedures. Accurately completes required paperwork and cash out procedures. Completes ticket reconciliation and tracking form daily.

Practices excellent communication skills, shares information to other shifts and to management through use of the daily logbook or other approved channels. Communicates all necessary information to current or future guests to ensure maximum satisfaction and revenue potential.

Has a thorough understanding of all systems used at the front office, including POS System, the phone system, and intercom and paging system. Ensures the hotel equipment, such as fax machines, copiers and the PMS system are maintained properly and secured.

Has thorough understanding of all emergency plans, safety and operating procedures/standards-especially with regard to handling guests and maintaining service if an emergency or other issue arises.

Well informed and confident in ability to appropriately handle missing child alert.

Follows procedure and reports all incidents or injuries to supervisor immediately.

Provides input and ideas on the operation of the front office, participates in training initiatives and skill development, and provides feedback to improve the department.

Completes any other task as requested by a supervisor, including the training new associates.

Position Specific Requirements, Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:

  • Must have aptitude with regard to cash counting and handling of cash and credit transactions.
  • Must have ability to pass any related competency or skills based training that is necessary for the department.
  • Must learn and be able to pass all tests on the POS.

Physical, Schedule and Work Requirements:

  • Availability to work on all shifts, during the normal operating hours of the waterpark
  • Availability to work during the entire season Memorial Day through Labor Day with minimal requests for extended periods of time off (any prior commitments must be addressed before start date)
  • Ability to stand for extended periods of time

title: Night Transport Planner
description:
As Transport Planner you will contribute to the success of the transport team, you will be responsible for completing and overseeing the day-to-day planning function of the transport operation. A highly motivated and driven individual, you will be experienced at working in a quick and fast-paced environment and be able to deal with day to day challenges in providing an effective transport plan.

Working on a shift pattern of Monday to Friday nights, 18.00-04.00

Key Duties of a Night Transport Planner:

  • Work with Transport and Warehouse teams, to create an efficient transport plan using the latest TMS
  • Subcontracting and planning orders from multiple sites across the UK
  • Planning daily workload of fleet: vehicles based on site and out bases
  • Reporting problems and dealing with issues and any queries that may arise
  • Planning collections per day on a time critical basis
  • Maintaining and exceeding agreed KPI’s
  • Proactively look for continuous improvements
  • Be able to make decisions under pressure and to a tight timescale
  • Have a flexible and adaptable approach to working in order to meet the requirements of the business particularly at peak periods during the year
  • Efficiently utilise the Culina Group network in support Stobart’s when volumes dictate.
  • Previous Transport Planning experience
  • Good geographical knowledge of the UK
  • Proficient in computer literacy including Microsoft Excel, Powerpoint, Work and Outlook
  • CPC Desirable but not required
  • Experience of planning 100+ tractor units across multiple depots
  • Excellent communication skills and ability to succeed in a pressurised environment
  • Customer focus on delivery performance
  • Commercially and Financially astute and driven to deliver exceptional results.
  • Experience of using a TMS system
  • Experience in an FMCG environment
  • Strong analytical and excel capability across standard formulas

As part of our drive to make Stobart a great place to work. We are proud to be an inclusive and diverse organisation where we are committed to employee development and recognising success for hard working performers.

Our dedicated learning and development programmes are open to every employee to give you the opportunity to shape your own future within logistics and continue to work in an environment where team culture thrives.

Our People are the driving force behind our success, which is why we offer a wide range of benefits which include:

  • Annual Leave – holiday entitlement of 20 days plus the normal bank holidays.
  • Pension scheme – we want colleagues to enjoy a comfortable retirements so we offer a great contribution of 5% employee and 3% employer
  • Life Assurance - x 2 your annual salary
  • Wellness – Via our Employee Assistance Programme we offer immediate access to a confidential telephone counselling and legal information service that operates 24 hours a days, 365 days a year
  • Eye Care Vouchers – We can provide you with substantial savings with free eye tests and discounts on prescription glasses
  • Reward & Recognition – We recognise that employees have gone the extra mile via Employee of the month and year, special recognition and long service awards.

If you meet the requirements for the above role and are looking for your next career opportunity please apply now and become a part of our #WinningTeam!

title: Brand Designer (all genders)
description:
Your role

We are looking for a creative, detail-oriented, and strategic Brand Designer to elevate Sunday Natural’s visual presence on Amazon and others Marketplaces. In this role, you will be our internal authority on Amazon visual best practices while ensuring our brand’s premium identity remains rock-solid across digital ad channels and physical product touchpoints.

You will be responsible for creating high-converting, "best-in-class" visual content; including gallery images, A+ Content, and video assets - that harmonizes Sunday Natural’s premium brand identity with Amazon’s conversion-driven ecosystem. We are looking for a designer who understands Amazon CRO (Conversion Rate Optimization), stays ahead of marketplace visual trends, and can strategically advise us on how to out-design competitors while respecting our visual identity.

  • Visual Asset Creation: Design and execute high-impact Amazon gallery images, Premium A+ Content, and Brand Stores that drive ‘the click’ and maximize conversion rates

  • Video Production & Editing: Create and optimize product and advertising videos that effectively communicate product benefits and brand story in a mobile-first environment

  • Premium Imagery: Deliver ‘best-in-class’ packshots and lifestyle imagery, ensuring meticulous attention to lighting, composition, and pixel-perfect execution

  • Design Language Stewardship: Define and evolve the AMZ-specific design language, ensuring all assets are ‘on-brand’ for Sunday Natural while adhering to Amazon’s technical requirements and best practices.

  • Continuous Optimization: Proactively research market trends and competitor designs to identify optimization opportunities. Use data insights to refine assets over time for peak performance.

Your profile

  • Amazon Creative Specialist: 2+ years of dedicated Amazon design experience. Expert in visual policies, mobile-first optimization, high-converting Packshots, Gallery Images, Premium A+ Content, and Brand Storefronts.

  • Performance Meets Brand Integrity: Proven track record of balancing high-conversion visual tactics (clear benefit hierarchies, callouts, visual hooks) with premium brand aesthetics, sleek typography, and pixel-perfect execution.

  • Market Trend & Brand Alignment: Proactive in researching best-in-class marketplace design trends, seamlessly translating core brand identities into competitive e-commerce environments.

  • Design & Prototyping Tools: Mastery of Adobe Creative Cloud (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign, After Effects) and Figma to produce high-impact static and video assets.

  • Value-Add Skills (Bonus): 3D rendering experience (Blender/KeyShot) or basic motion design capability.

  • Language Skills: Professional fluency in English required. German (B2) is a strong advantage for designing localized typography, visual hooks, and native copy layouts for Amazon.de.

What we offer

  • An appealing discount on all of our products – from essential oils to vitamins & nutrients

  • We offer 28 days of paid time off per year plus up to 5 days off between Christmas and New Year

  • The Urban Sports Club membership and either Swapfiets bike rental or a subsidy for the Deutschlandticket

  • We believe great things happen when we meet in person, which is why we embrace a hybrid model with one home office day per week – up to two depending on the area you are working in – and up to two weeks per year working from abroad

  • Receive various discounts of up to more than 50 percent on attractive brands such as Flaconi, Bosch, Apple or Expedia

  • You will be given real ownership and plenty of room for new initiatives, as well as the opportunity to contribute your expertise and implement your great ideas

  • Inviting office spaces with access to plenty of organic teas and superfoods from around the world

  • We like to celebrate each other! Regular tea & office parties, Christmas and summer feasts and various influencer events such as Women's Day

Apply with your CV and portfolio.

Sunday Natural emerged from a long-standing passion and research in the fields of health, healing, and personal growth. The lack of natural, high-quality products on the market was the original motivation for founding Sunday Natural in 2013. We aim to produce the products we ourselves would love to buy – as natural as possible, absolutely pure, free from any additives, and of the highest quality. In a strategic partnership with CVC, Sunday Natural is now one of Germany's most renowned quality manufacturers, with its own research and development department in Berlin. For the continuous improvement of our products, we collaborate with selected research institutes, scientists, therapists, farmers, and professional associations.

We take our ecological responsibility very seriously: that’s why the majority of our product range is vegan. We also take an innovative approach to packaging: most of our products are packaged in glass, making them almost entirely recyclable.

Our diverse team in Berlin consists of over 350 employees from more than 45 nationalities and continues to grow – but at a sustainable pace. Our goal is to foster a collaborative, supportive, and inclusive work environment with a diverse group of motivated, talented, and visionary team members.

We highly value equality of opportunity and inclusivity, and we would like to particularly encourage women and candidates from under-represented backgrounds to apply, even if you don’t match with 100% of the requirements.

title: Scientist, Pharmacokinetics Sample Analysis
description:
Job Description

Our company is a global health care leader with a diversified portfolio of prescription medicines, vaccines and animal health products. The difference between potential and achievement lies in the spark that fuels innovation and inventiveness; this is the space where our company has codified its legacy for over a century. Our company success is backed by ethical integrity, forward momentum, and an inspiring mission to achieve new milestones in global healthcare.

At our company, we are inspired by the belief that a research-driven enterprise dedicated to scientific excellence can create medicines that save and improve lives. Every employee is building on our proud legacy of scientific breakthrough. Our ability to impact the lives of patients worldwide depends on the integrity, creativity, humility and scientific acumen of our team. We are creating an organization that is inspired by invention and founded on a culture of respect and collaboration. At our company Research Labs (our Research & Development Division) Boston, you’ll have the opportunity to expand your knowledge and skills through collaboration with talented and dedicated colleagues while advancing your career.

The Pharmacokinetics, Dynamics, Metabolism and Bioanalytics (PDMB) group is seeking a dynamic, strategic thinking and collaborative Scientist to contribute to our company drug discovery and early clinical development efforts, with a focus on lab-based bioanalytical efforts for small molecules and peptides. This position will be based at our research labs in Boston, MA. Experience utilizing liquid-chromatography / mass spectrometry platforms to quantify small molecules and/or peptides from various in vitro and in vivo matrices is required. The ability to develop new bioanalytical methods, efficiently utilize data processing platforms and perform basic instrument maintenance is a plus. The position will allow for regular interaction with multi-disciplinary discovery project teams and subject matter experts from other functions within our Research & Development Division. The ideal candidate will possess the ability to innovate, independently execute and be fully accountable for their scientific deliverables. The candidate will have the opportunity to present their work at departmental meetings as well as promote our company science through publications and external presentations.

In this exciting position, your primary roles will include:

  • Utilize state-of-the-art liquid chromatography/mass spectrometry approaches to quantitate drug levels in various in vitro and in vivo matrices in support of PK and PK/PD efforts.

  • Analyze, review and utilize quantitative data to estimate pharmacokinetic parameters in support of multiple programs across various therapeutic areas.

  • Close collaboration with PDMB subject-matter experts in Boston (MA), South San Francisco (CA) and West Point (PA) aimed at efficiently supporting a dynamic and fast-paced research portfolio.

Education Minimum Requirement

  • Bachelor’s degree in biochemistry, chemistry, pharmacology, pharmaceutical sciences, biology, chemical engineering, biomedical engineering or related STEM field with 3+ years relevant postgrad laboratory experience or MS degree and 0+ years of experience.

Required Experience and Skills

  • Demonstrated experience utilizing liquid-chromatography / mass spectrometry (LC/MS) platforms to quantify small molecules and/or peptides from various in vitro and in vivo matrices

  • Working knowledge of traditional bioanalytical instrumentation and techniques (primarily LC/MS), including method development, optimization and general maintenance

  • Experience preparing samples from various in vitro and in vivo matrices for bioanalytical characterization including, but not limited to, protein precipitation, liquid/liquid extraction and solid-phase extraction techniques.

  • Strong interpersonal, communication, problem solving and collaborative qualities to deliver high-quality results in a fast-paced environment

Preferred Experience and Skills

  • Ability to design, interpret and troubleshoot experiments aimed at addressing complex questions.

  • Familiarity with electronic laboratory notebooks, Watson LIMS and related record-keeping approaches.

  • Experience working within a research-driven pharmaceutical company.

#EligibleforERP

Required Skills:

Bioanalysis, Biochemistry, Data Analysis, Data Visualization, Detail-Oriented, Drug Metabolism, Ethical Compliance, Good Laboratory Practices (GLPs), Liquid Chromatography-Mass Spectrometry (LC-MS), Pharmaceutical Sciences, Pharmacodynamics, Pharmacokinetics, Pharmacology, Pharmacotherapeutics, Sample Preparations, Small Molecules

title: Sr Advisory Solution Consultant– Security, Identity & Exposure Management (Armis) New York City Based
description:

In this role, you will serve as a trusted technical and business advisor, leading discovery, solution design, product demonstrations, proof-of-value engagements, and customer validation activities. You will work directly with security, identity, infrastructure, IT, risk, and executive stakeholders to connect technical capabilities to measurable business outcomes.

The ideal candidate has strong cybersecurity knowledge, practical enterprise networking experience, strong communication skills, and a proven ability to support complex enterprise sales cycles.

**Note must be based in NYC Metro Area**

Responsibilities

  • Partner with Sales to lead technical discovery, solution design, and customer validation.
  • Deliver compelling virtual and in-person technical demonstrations.
  • Deploy and support proof-of-value and proof-of-concept engagements.
  • Translate technical capabilities into business outcomes.
  • Serve as a trusted advisor during evaluations, competitive situations, and executive discussions.
  • Develop customer-facing documentation, technical summaries, and solution narratives.
  • Lead technical training sessions based on customer use cases and POV findings.
  • Support marketing events, conferences, webinars, and speaking engagements.
  • Collaborate with Product, Enablement, Marketing, Customer Success, and Support teams to share field insights and improve execution.
  • Travel as required, typically 25–50%, depending on region and business needs.

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in Solution Consulting, Sales Engineering, Pre-Sales Engineering, Solutions Architecture, or a related technical role.
  • 5+ years of customer-facing technical, pre-sales, or customer support experience.
  • Experience supporting complex cybersecurity, SaaS, or enterprise platform sales cycles with enterprise customers.
  • Strong understanding of cybersecurity concepts, identity and access, governance and risk, and security operations.
  • Required strong working knowledge of enterprise networking concepts, including routing, switching, VLANs, subnetting, firewalls, DNS, NAT, and network segmentation.

Preferred Experience

What Success Looks Like

  • Quickly becomes productive and adds value to active sales pursuits.
  • Delivery of high-quality demos, POVs, and POCs that advance pipelines.
  • Build trusted-advisor relationships with customers and Sales partners.
  • Demonstrates strong technical credibility across complex opportunities.
  • Connects technical solutions to measurable business outcomes.

title: VP of Donation Development and Family Services
description:
Donor Network West’s mission is to save and heal lives through organ and tissue donation for transplantation and research.
At Donor Network West, we're looking for people who embody our core values: passion, excellence, equity and inclusion, and relationships. We welcome diverse perspectives and foster an environment of collaboration and service.

POSITION SUMMARY
The Vice President of Donation Development and Family Services (VPDDFS) is responsible for
the management, oversight, performance, fiscal management, strategic planning, staffing, and
regulatory compliance of the Donation Development and Family Services departments. These
departments include partner and hospital relationship management and development, donor
approach and authorization, and donor family aftercare services. The VPDDFS will engage
leadership, front-line staff, and others around a well-articulated strategy to increase DNWest’s
donation development efforts, which ultimately leads to top-quartile authorization and
conversion rates of potential donors.

In collaboration with the Chief Operating Officer (COO) and DNWest clinical leadership, the
VPDDFS will create and sustain hospital and partner relations strategies, Family Services team
operational effectiveness, and oversight of DNWest’s Donor Aftercare operations by leading
continuous process improvement and accountability. This position is responsible for developing
and formulating short and long-term strategies and overarching programs designed to improve
DNWest’s competitive position with external stakeholders. As a part of the Executive
Leadership Team, the VPDDFS participates in organizational strategic planning and budgeting
processes
ESSENTIAL JOB DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES
The essential functions and qualifications listed are typical examples of work performed by positions
in this job classification and general required qualifications. They are not designed to contain or be
interpreted as a comprehensive inventory of all duties, tasks, responsibilities and qualifications.
Employees may perform other duties as assigned. Reasonable accommodations may be made to
enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Donation System Development

  • Responsible for overarching system-wide and mission-critical efforts to build positive hospital & partner donation environments.
  • Provides leadership, appropriate resources, and strategic direction to the development and implementation of key hospital and partner strategies tailored to the needs of each organization and that will support process improvement and accountability to results.
  • Responsible for increasing authorization and conversion rates above the expected outcomes for DNWest by working in partnership with executive and senior leadership, directors, and staff to develop a cogent, self-sustaining growth strategy that is consistent with the mission, vision and values of the organization.
  • Focuses DNWest’s practice on known best practices to improve hospital services performance metrics.
    • Implements measurement of adherence to known best practices; incorporates the metrics of that measurement into the hospital dashboards.
      • Establishes, implements, and monitors key performance indicators, metrics, and monthly/annual goals for departments.
      • Initiates corrective actions when indicators, metrics, and goals are not compliant with established targets.
      • Develops a vision for DNWest’s operational response to referrals by managing oversight and ensuring implementation of an effective, service-driven response.
      • Reviews data pertaining to authorization, conversion and referral rates for DNWest’s hospitals and partners, and makes recommendations for system improvements.
      • Analyzes hospital metrics and reports to the COO.
      • Works with leadership to analyze individual and aggregate regional hospital performance and directs recommended improvement strategies.
      • Routinely engages high-level hospital leaders and physicians to support and improve donation processes and metrics.
      • Evaluates hospital need for in-house DNWest staff resources and works with leadership to position DNWest staff members in hospitals.
      • Tracks and monitors face to face meetings of DNWest leadership with hospital leadership in key donor potential hospitals.
      • Collaborates with leadership to ensure all Donation Development community events are executed with positive outcomes.
      • Responsible for effective delivery of educational programs necessary to sustain collaborative relationships with hospital champions, physicians, and nurses.
      • Develops, implements, and improves systems for tracking and reporting hospital development activities, outcomes, and customer satisfaction related to hospital demographics, professional education services, and DNWest’s organ, eye, and tissue donor potential.
      • Collaborates with Organ and Tissue operations to improve donation outcomes.
      • Engages in the development, implementation, and updates of DNWest’s policies and procedures as they relate to the authorization and donation processes

    • Family Services and Aftercare

  • Provides leadership, appropriate resources, and strategic direction to the development and implementation of activities and practices that ensure that DNWest provides excellent family care before, during, and after the donation discussion.
  • Focuses DNWest practice on known best practices to improve authorization rates.
  • Ensures that DNWest provides quality aftercare to organ and tissue donor families; monitors and evaluates services provided and incorporates best practices on an ongoing basis.
  • Directs activities that monitor the effectiveness of the Family Services and Aftercare programs to maintain consistently high standards of the organization, to ensure excellent services to donor families, and meet desired targets for authorization rates. Reviews data pertaining to authorization rates for organ and tissue donation and makes recommendations for system improvements when necessary; data pertaining to individual and organizational authorization rates will be analyzed and reported to the COO.
  • Collaborates with leadership to deliver consistency in DNWest messaging of the donation conversation with donor families and donor hospitals.
  • Reviews accurate and up to date individual authorization statistics and donor and referral activity to ensure the quality of practice and level of service in relation to DNWest’s expected goals.
  • Works with Tissue Operations leadership to review authorization data and practices. Provides recommendations for process improvement to attain organizational targets and ensure consistency of practice.
  • Reviews feedback from donor families and utilize the information to improve processes and systems; shares information with COO and clinical and tissue leadership.
  • Collaborates with other department leadership at DNWest with the goal of optimizing services to donor families and enhancing authorization and conversion outcomes.
  • Engages in the development, implementation, and updates of DNWest’s policies and procedure as they relate to the authorization and donation processes.

    • Staff and Management Development

  • Creates and develops staffing models that ensures adequate staffing levels to promote high and efficient performance.
  • Creates and oversees the design of department leadership structure and roles; actively mentors and coaches leadership staff to ensure program and staff operations meet goals and objectives.
  • Oversees the development of effective recruiting and hiring practices, training leadership to effectively staff their organizations.
  • Oversees all management of assigned staff towards the accomplishment of DNWest’s mission, including recruitment and selection; scheduling and job assignment; training and development; counseling and coaching; correction and disciplinary action; appraisal and recognition; and recommending salary, and promotional actions in accord with existing policies and procedures.
  • Creates a vision that inspires staff to do their best work and promotes success and accountability for results while honoring the organization’s commitment to teamwork, integrity, passion, and excellence.

    • Program Operational Management

  • As a member of the Executive Leadership Team, participates in organizational visioning, strategic planning, and budgeting.
  • Leads multi-functional teams to plan and execute Donation Development, Family Services, and Aftercare projects according to goals, budgets, and timelines to achieve objectives.
  • Works with Clinical Skills and Practices, Learning and Development, and Quality Systems to identify occurrence trending and performance improvement opportunities within functional responsibilities.
  • Maintains professional relationships and rapport with management, medical, nursing, and ancillary staff within and outside the organization.
  • Participates in an operational call schedule when directed by the COO.
  • Attends required board meetings, staff meetings, academies and training programs, and or in-services deemed necessary by the COO.
  • Cultivates and grows external stakeholder relationships and engagement by supporting DNWest’s brand, ensuring responsive service delivery, and enhancing our reputation as a trusted partner.
  • Ensures compliance with all current federal, state, and/or local laws and regulations including Food and Drug Administration (FDA), Centers for Medicaid and Medicare Services (CMS), and United Network for Organ Sharing (UNOS).
  • Meets accrediting organizations’ standards, American Association of Tissue Banks (AATB) and Eye Bank Association of America (EBAA), and Donor Network West’s Policies and Procedures (P&P).

    • Leadership Skills Expectations

  • Possess highly developed interpersonal skills and respectful communication ability with all hospital staff, the public, families, and colleagues.
  • Ability to communicate and model successful behavior to staff. Strong interpersonal and diplomacy skills are required, especially evidence of active listening and supportive recognition and respect for differing viewpoints.
  • Conveys a sense of urgency when appropriate; persists in the face of obstacles; strives for excellence and drives to outcomes that reflect meeting or exceeding a standard of excellence.
  • Ability to manage a diverse team of experts overseeing several projects simultaneously on time and budget with the highest level of professionalism and integrity.
  • Ability to leverage internal resources across organizational boundaries to meet departmental goals/needs.
  • Possess strong strategic thinking ability and project management skills.
  • Adept at the analysis of data, metrics, statistical reports, and data presentation
  • Brings extensive experience in business administration, budgeting, and strategic planning
  • Ability to present in front of large and small groups.
  • Possess and/or develops a detailed knowledge of applicable regulations and standards including but not limited to those established by Federal Drugs Administration (FDA), United Network of Organ Sharing (UNOS), American Association of Tissue Banks (AATB), and the State of California.
  • Ability to leverage information technology to develop, manage, maintain, and grow donation development.
  • Ability to read and interpret documents such as procedures, standards, regulations, protocols, validations, guidance, etc.

    • DONOR NETWORK WEST MANAGEMENT EXPECTATIONS

  • Builds meaning and purpose for the team by demonstrating the vision, mission, and values of DNWest.
  • Achieves strategic initiatives through employees by communicating job expectations, planning, monitoring, and appraising job results. Provides accurate feedback and recognition in a timely manner.
  • Foresees challenges, is proactive, and uses sound judgement and best practices when solving problems and making decisions.
  • Conducts work professionally and collaboratively and provide excellent customer service.
  • Positively adapts to change, supports new initiatives, and is creative/innovative.
  • Demonstrates emotional intelligence by having respectful interactions that bring about productive communication.
  • Retains team members and demonstrates appreciation through customized recognition and development.
  • Partners with employees to create professional and personal growth opportunities for staff.
  • Ensures a safe, secure, legal, and professional work environment and administers consistent corrective measures or performance improvement plans when appropriate.
  • Adheres to DNWest’s policies, code of conduct, and leads by example.

    • EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE

  • Required: Bachelor of Arts or Science Degree
  • Preferred: Master’s Degree in Business Administration, Public Health, or Hospital Administration
  • Preferred: Valid RN license, valid registered nursing license
  • Preferred: Minimum 10 years of progressive program and staff management experience
  • Preferred: Minimum 3 - 5 years of executive management experience within an organ procurement organization (OPO)
  • Required: valid driver’s license and registered vehicle with insurance meeting California minimum requirements
    • Donor Network West takes a market-based approach to pay. All candidates' starting pay will be determined based on job-related skills, experience, qualifications and interview performance.

    Our job listings’ compensation ranges include location-based differentials but may not be reflective of a candidate’s final base salary. Location differentials are determined by an employee’s home address, associated market data provided by government reporting and processed by Payroll.

    If selected, Donor Network West’s Recruiting & Compensation Team will provide further detail!

    Salary data provided by third party sites do not accurately reflect our pay structure.

title: Construction Project Manager (Data Center)
description:
Join the Team!

Is technology your passion? Do you want to work with smart, forward-thinking individuals? Do you want to grow in a career you love?

At Align, our professionals are the key to our success. We don’t just hire talent, we invest in exceptional people who are forward-thinking, results-driven, and passionate about what they do. We’re a group of tech-savvy professionals who are motivated by making an impact. Our culture is one of unbounded opportunity that celebrates the passions, skills and ideas of our team—work hard, play hard, be smart!

We believe great communities lead to great companies. That’s why we offer a dynamic workplace where you feel inspired, engaged and innovative. We offer professionals opportunities to train in the leading technologies, make an impact within the industry and acquire valuable new skills whether on client sites or in one of our regional offices.

Position Overview

We are seeking an experienced Construction Manager to oversee the fit-out of hyperscale data center white space within colocation environments. This role is responsible for managing all aspects of tenant fit-out construction, including coordination of trades, sequencing of work, quality control, and delivery of mission-critical infrastructure.

The ideal candidate has strong construction management experience in data centers, with a solid understanding of white space infrastructure such as containment systems, overhead conveyance (including ladder racks and cable tray systems), structural support frameworks, and cooling components (HVAC). Familiarity with structured cabling systems (low voltage and fiber) is a plus.

  • This is a full-time salaried position offering competitive compensation, comprehensive benefits, paid time off, paid training and performance-based bonuses.
  • This position is based in the Atlanta metro area and will work onsite for local data center projects. Approximately 50% travel outside of the Georgia area should be expected at times.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead on-site construction management for data center white space fit-out projects
  • Oversee installation of:
    • Hot aisle / cold aisle containment systems
    • Overhead cable tray systems and ladder rack conveyance
    • Structural support systems for cabinets, racks, cable trays, and electrical power distribution infrastructure
    • Cooling infrastructure, including HVAC units
    • Power distribution from PDU down to cabinet level
  • Manage trade contractors and ensure proper sequencing of work (e.g., structural supports → overhead conveyance → electrical distribution → cabling → containment) to maintain schedule and avoid conflicts
  • Coordinate with general contractors, subcontractors, and client stakeholders
  • Enforce quality control (QC) processes to ensure installations meet design specifications, load requirements, and industry standards
  • Monitor project schedule, budget, and progress; proactively identify and resolve risks/issues
  • Ensure compliance with safety standards and site protocols
  • Review construction drawings, submittals, RFIs, and shop drawings related to supports and overhead systems
  • Verify proper installation tolerances, anchoring, and support systems for overhead infrastructure
  • Support commissioning and handover processes

Required Qualifications

  • 5-10+ years of construction management experience, preferably in mission-critical or data center environments
  • Proven experience managing white space fit-out / tenant improvement projects in colocation or hyperscale data centers
  • Strong understanding of construction sequencing, trade coordination, and site management
  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple subcontractors and deliver projects on schedule
  • Strong knowledge of QA/QC processes, including inspection of support systems and overhead installations
  • Project Management skills including scheduling and budgeting
  • Candidate must have strong problem-solving and decision-making skills
  • Strong stakeholder and client communication

Preferred Qualifications

  • Familiarity with low voltage cabling (LVC) and/or fiber optic infrastructure within data centers
  • Procore experience is strongly preferred
  • Working knowledge of structured cabling systems, pathways, and routing within overhead conveyance systems
  • RCDD-level knowledge or experience with structured cabling design standards (e.g., setting or enforcing standards)
  • Experience coordinating structural support systems with electrical and mechanical trades
  • Experience in commissioning or turnover of data center white space environments

To support a fair, consistent, and high-quality hiring experience, some interviews may be recorded. These recordings help our team focus fully on the conversation at hand, rather than note-taking, and allow us to better evaluate and improve our recruitment process. Recordings are used solely for internal purposes such as training, quality assurance, and process improvement. Candidates will be informed in advance and asked to provide consent before any recording takes place.

Align is a premier global provider of technology infrastructure solutions.

Align specializes in designing and deploying technology infrastructure solutions from the data center to the desktop as well as providing managed IT services for clients.

Our professional services team, which includes Data Center Solutions, provide strategic consulting, design, project management, engineering, implementation and support. Our best-in-class Managed Services team provides IT services and cybersecurity advisory for clients within the Alternative Investment industry. Align is a Microsoft Tier 1 Cloud Solutions Provider (CSP) and Gold Partner.

Our client centric approach and passion for driving IT innovation has enabled us to provide tailored solutions and business transformations for over three decades. Leading firms have relied on Align to provide forward-thinking technology strategies that support their current and future business needs.

Our teams have flawless track records of delivering technical solutions and have established long-standing relationships with an impressive client list of both Global 1000 and SMB clients. We work across a diverse list of industries including financial services, life sciences (pharmaceutical and health care), retail, technology, media and telecommunications.

For more information, visit: www.align.com

title: Crossing Guard
description:
Pacifica Christian High School – Crossing Guard (Full-Time)

Pacifica Christian High School is seeking a reliable and mission-aligned Crossing Guard to help students, families, and staff cross safely at intersections adjacent to our Santa Monica campus, and to support a safe, welcoming campus throughout the school day.

This is an excellent opportunity to serve students and families while becoming part of a vibrant and purpose-driven school community.


Position Overview

The Crossing Guard is responsible for safely directing student and pedestrian traffic at assigned crosswalks near campus during morning arrival and afternoon dismissal, and for providing general campus supervision and safety support during the school day. This role is highly visible and sets the tone for the school day — ideal candidates are dependable, punctual, attentive to their surroundings, and enjoy greeting high school students and families in a positive and professional manner.

  • Monday–Friday, full-time (approximately 7:00 AM – 4:00 PM)

  • Consistent, punctual, and reliable
  • Ability to interact positively with students, families, staff, and neighbors
  • Prior crossing guard, campus supervision, or public safety experience preferred

title: Technical Co-Founder
description:
About the Role

A Berlin-based pre-seed AI SaaS startup is looking for a Technical Co-Founder to join as the third member of the founding team. The company is building an AI-powered platform that automates the end-to-end lifecycle of public procurement participation — from tender discovery and requirements analysis through to compliant concept and proposal generation — targeting the DACH region. This role carries full technical ownership and a direct impact on product direction, architecture, and go-to-market traction.

The platform is built on LLMs, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and NLP, and must be fully GDPR-compliant, hosted in EU cloud environments. Incorporation is in preparation and a public funding application is currently in progress.

What You'll Do

  • Design and own the overall system architecture, with a focus on GDPR-compliant EU cloud infrastructure (e.g., AWS Bedrock, Vertex AI — Frankfurt region).

  • Build the core AI engine that generates complete, compelling proposal concepts from structured company data.

  • Develop and maintain a reference database for past projects, certificates, and CVs, and integrate them dynamically into generated concepts.

  • Implement entity resolution, reliability scoring, and confidence quantification across data pipelines.

  • Work deeply in AI/ML (LLMs, RAG, NLP) and/or broadly across full-stack product engineering — depending on your strengths.

  • Set technical priorities collaboratively within a small founding team.

  • Contribute to business strategy during the pre-seed phase alongside the other co-founders.

What We're Looking For

Must-haves (dealbreakers):

  • 5+ years of experience in product/engineering roles delivering AI-powered software with LLM, NLP, and/or RAG capabilities.

  • Hands-on experience with GDPR-compliant architecture in EU cloud environments (data handling for NLP/LLM workloads).

  • Prior experience as a technical founder or technical lead who has built an AI-first product from zero with end-to-end ownership.

Required:

  • Strong, production-grade full-stack development skills for AI-enabled products.

  • Practical experience integrating LLMs, RAG pipelines, and NLP into real products.

  • Genuine founder mentality — you want to help build a company, not just work through tickets.

  • Willingness to join as a technical co-founder with equity as the primary compensation during the pre-seed phase.

  • German language proficiency (the product operates in the DACH regulatory context: VgV, HOAI, etc.).

Strongly preferred:

  • Experience with enterprise data pipelines and secure data handling in EU cloud environments (DSGVO/GDPR context).

  • Familiarity with German public procurement law or the architectural/planning office domain.

  • Pragmatic, ship-first working style — you iterate quickly and avoid over-engineering.

Compensation & Equity

  • Equity: 15–20% co-founder equity stake.

  • Vesting: Standard four-year vesting schedule with a one-year cliff.

Location

title: Senior Staff Inbound Product Manager, Value AI Products
description:
What you get to do in this role:

  • Own product strategy for AI Value tooling, a suite of agents that turns customer telemetry into conversation-ready value insights for sellers and customer success teams — currently reaching ~11,000 sales and customer success users
  • Drive prompt engineering, code reviews and AI product development across Value Melody's analysis modes (value realization, benchmarking, license intelligence, business outcome mapping, and exec-facing narrative generation), balancing model quality, cost per run, and user trust
  • Set and communicate product priorities across a cross-functional pod (data science, engineering, documentation/service desk) and build consensus without formal authority over every function involved
  • Own outcomes end-to-end, regardless of role or org boundaries — from roadmap definition through launch readiness and post-launch iteration
  • Translate ambiguous or fast-moving stakeholder input (field feedback, executive asks, governance requirements) into clear product requirements and a prioritized roadmap
  • Integrate usability testing, field/citizen-developer feedback, and competitive/market signal into product decisions to improve adoption and satisfaction
  • Communicate complex AI/product tradeoffs in plain language to audiences ranging from engineers to sales leadership to the executive sponsor
  • Develop multi-mode communications (briefings, demo guides, exec summaries) tailored to distinct audiences — field sellers, technical teams, and leadership
  • Represent the product in cross-org forums, building influence with peer product teams and adjacent programs (e.g., the broader value engine ecosystem) without direct reporting lines into them
  • Function as team lead and informal mentor to more junior product owners

To be successful in this role you have:

  • 8+ years of software product management experience, including direct ownership of an AI/ML or LLM-powered product in production
  • Flexibility and curiosity - ability and willingness to learn new architecture stacks, and see how AI tooling needs to adjust to take advantage of new capabilities - while weighing tradeoffs
  • Scientific mindset - changing tech landscape, there is no roadmap for best practices in AI development you get to write it - learn, unlearn and re-learn constantly
  • Hands-on experience with prompt engineering and iterating on AI agent behavior based on real usage data, not just theoretical design
  • Strong prioritization discipline — ability to sequence a roadmap under real resourcing constraints and defend tradeoffs to leadership
  • Experience defining product requirements from ambiguous, cross-functional input and converting them into a shippable roadmap
  • Deep curiosity about customer/seller needs, with a track record of using usage and outcome data (not just survey feedback) to drive product decisions
  • Comfort operating in a fast-moving, still-maturing product area, including translating technical AI constraints (cost, latency, model behavior) into business-facing decisions
  • Ability to lead without authority — influencing engineering, data science, and documentation partners toward a shared roadmap
  • Experience communicating to executive stakeholders, including building narrative and materials for non-technical leadership audiences
