title: Associate Clinical Director - Complex Care
description:
About Private Health Management

Private Health Management guides patients and families through the chaos and complexity of serious medical care, for cancer and beyond. As an independent advocate and trusted partner during healthcare's most challenging moments, our team of experts works alongside physicians to orchestrate the best treatment, advocacy, and support to deliver measurably better outcomes.

Everyone deserves great care. We make sure they get it.

About the role

As an Associate Clinical Director at PHM, you’ll help patients in their deepest moment of need to challenge the status quo and go beyond the standard of care to achieve the best possible health outcomes.

Working from your home office, you’ll serve as the lead clinician and engagement manager collaborating with team members through our process to uncover opportunities to improve your client’s care. Team members may include additional clinicians, PhD scientists who mine the medical literature to identify data-supported care options, and care coordinators who manage care-related logistics. You will utilize your clinical expertise and curiosity along with your tenacious problem-solving skills to ascertain the key issues that must be addressed, identify and engage with top experts, and guide patients to optimized care plans. In collaboration with your personal care team colleagues, you will explore specialized diagnostics to better define the underlying mechanisms and array of treatment options beyond the current standard of care.

Cutting through the barriers inherent to our chaotic healthcare system, you enable patients to access an unrivaled level of personalized care and attention while guiding them to the best possible treatment plan available.

What You’ll Accomplish

  • Building Strong Client Relationships. You’ll become the trusted guiding hand through a client's healthcare journey by managing complex medical issues, coordinating their care, facilitating best diagnostic and therapeutic treatment options available world-wide, and navigating being their guide to the healthcare system
  • Demonstrating Strong Clinical Acumen. You’ll offer high level clinical management and education to clients and families in a caring, compassionate manner.
  • Bring Together the Best Minds:
    • Work closely with clinical and research team members at PHM to identify latest therapies and deliver comprehensive information on medical conditions, medications, treatments, and clinical trials
    • Articulating needs for collaboration with external care providers, interdisciplinary team resources, and internal team rounding
    • Networking with key opinion leaders to invite collaboration and build relationships that facilitate our ability to help our clients achieve best care
    • Managing other clinical staff as it relates to a particular case or service line

What you bring to the table:

  • Active NP or PA license in your state of residence, with active board certification in at least one state. These are "no exceptions" requirements.
  • A “Do what it takes to get the job done” attitude
  • 5+ years of APP clinical experience managing complex medical issues in a multi-disciplinary environment where careful assessment and critical thinking are required
  • Exceptional client-facing skills including: Executive written & verbal communication, impeccable attention to detail and organization, and a highly professional demeanor under pressure.
  • An insatiable clinical curiosity. You’re never satisfied by “the obvious answer” you think creatively, solve complex problems, and work successfully with others.
  • Technically savvy and feel comfortable navigating various tech platforms to efficiently document your work and communicate with your colleagues

Read what current Team Members say about working at PHM!

Compensation: The target base salary for this position is $140,000

This base salary is only a part of a total compensation package that also includes: bonus, equity, health/dental/vision benefits, 401k with match, PTO and other benefits. Individual pay may vary from the target range as a number of factors including market forces, experience, location, disparities in market data and other relevant business considerations may all factor into final compensation.

Next steps

Private Health Management is a remote company with employees around the United States. We’re committed to providing you with the best possible interview experience and opportunities to spend meaningful time getting to know our company, mission, and wonderful teammates in our fully remote interviews. If your application is selected for interviews, you’ll hear from a member of our recruiting team to schedule next steps. Interviews will also include: the hiring manager, peers, and often an executive from the department. We have lots of questions for you, but we’re also excited to answer your questions about us. We appreciate your help in achieving an interview process that allows us to truly know each other and welcome your feedback and requests on how we can make this a reality for yourself & future candidates.

Have a quick question about the role? Email careers@privatehealth.com or simply apply here.

Anticipated Pay Range
$135,000—$140,000 USD

title: Senior Managing Landscape Architect
description:
Title: Senior Managing / Principal Landscape Architect

Reports to: Anna Spooner

Location: California – San Francisco/Other in CA

Job Type: Regular Full-Time



What’s the Opportunity?

Anchor QEA is seeking a Senior Managing Landscape Architect to help lead and grow our landscape architecture practice in California. This is a senior leadership role for a California-licensed landscape architect who brings strong technical expertise, proven business development experience, and the ability to win and lead complex, multidisciplinary work.


This position offers the opportunity to join a growing firm with a strong foundation in restoration, resilience, and development. Working alongside Anchor QEA’s multidisciplinary teams of landscape architects, engineers, planners, scientists, natural resource specialists, permitting professionals, and construction managers, the Senior Managing / Principal Landscape Architect will help expand our design leadership and market presence in California.


The successful candidate will be a strategic, client-facing leader who can identify opportunities, build relationships, develop competitive proposals, and help secure landscape architecture and integrated multidisciplinary work. This person will also provide senior leadership for projects involving public access design, shoreline resilience, habitat restoration, parks and recreation, climate adaptation, and multi-benefit infrastructure.


This is an opportunity to help build something: to shape the direction of landscape architecture at Anchor QEA, grow a practice area, mentor staff, strengthen client relationships, and deliver meaningful projects that improve ecological function, public access, community resilience, and environmental outcomes throughout California.



Responsibilities:

Practice Area Growth

  • Support the growth and strategic direction of Anchor QEA’s landscape architecture practice in California.
  • Serve as a senior client-facing leader for landscape architecture, restoration, resilience, public access, parks, recreation, and climate adaptation work.
  • Mentor and develop junior and mid-level staff and help identify future staffing needs for the growing practice.
  • Collaborate with Anchor QEA leadership on market strategy, business planning, staffing, teaming, and long-term practice growth.

Business Development:

  • Identify, pursue, and help win competitive landscape architecture and multidisciplinary consulting opportunities.
  • Develop and lead client engagement strategies, pursuit planning, proposal development, interviews, scopes of work, fee estimates, and teaming approaches.
  • Build and maintain relationships with public agencies, ports, municipalities, special districts, regulatory agencies, community organizations, and consultant teaming partners.
  • Represent Anchor QEA externally with clients, agencies, professional organizations, strategic partners, and stakeholders.

Project Execution

  • Serve as project director, senior technical lead, or project manager on complex projects.
  • Lead multidisciplinary teams that include landscape architects, engineers, planners, scientists, permitting specialists, restoration practitioners, designers, and subconsultants.
  • Provide senior design leadership and mentorship from early planning and visioning through design development, permitting support, construction documents, and implementation.
  • Guide design strategy for shoreline resilience, habitat restoration, public access, recreation, planting, irrigation, grading coordination, materials, site furnishings, and constructability.
  • Oversee the preparation of high-quality plans, graphics, reports, presentations, construction documents, specifications, cost estimates, and technical details.
  • Facilitate and lead meetings with clients, agencies, Tribes, stakeholders, community members, and project teams.
  • Provide senior review, quality assurance, and technical guidance for landscape architecture deliverables.
  • Support construction administration and implementation of landscape architecture elements.



What Are We Looking For?

Ideal candidates will have the following:

  • Master’s or bachelor’s degree in Landscape Architecture from an accredited institution.
  • Licensed Landscape Architect in California.
  • 15 or more years of relevant professional experience in landscape architecture focused on the integration of restoration, resiliency and human use, with substantial experience in California.
  • Demonstrated success capturing new work, developing client relationships, leading proposals, and contributing to business growth, with a focus on federal, state and local clients.

title: RN Cath Lab PRN
description:
• Experienced Cath Lab RN PRN

  • Call required

As a Registered Nurse at Santa Rosa Medical Center, you’ll play a vital role in doing what you do best - providing quality care to our patients.

Job Summary

The Registered Nurse (RN) provides patient-centered care through the nursing process of assessment, diagnosis, planning, implementation, and evaluation. This role is responsible for coordinating and delivering high-quality care based on established clinical protocols and physician/provider orders. The RN collaborates with physicians, nurses, and other healthcare professionals to ensure effective patient care and desired outcomes, while maintaining a supportive and compassionate environment for patients and their families.

Essential Functions

  • Coordinates and delivers high-quality, patient-centered care in accordance with organizational policies, protocols, and the nursing process.
  • Conducts thorough patient assessments and documents findings accurately, reporting changes in condition to the appropriate care team members.
  • Utilizes knowledge of human growth and development to provide age-appropriate care and education.
  • Administers prescribed medications, monitors for side effects, and documents administration in accordance with standards of practice.
  • Assists physicians during procedures within the scope of documented competency and skill level.
  • Collaborates with the healthcare team to develop, implement, and evaluate individualized care plans based on patient assessments and needs.
  • Responds to medical emergencies and participates in life-saving interventions, such as CPR and code team activities, as appropriate.
  • Advocates for the rights and needs of patients, ensuring their voices are heard and respected in care planning and delivery.
  • Provides patient and family education on medical conditions, treatment plans, and post-discharge care, ensuring understanding and adherence to instructions.
  • Implements and adheres to infection control protocols to prevent the spread of healthcare-associated infections.
  • Monitors and operates medical equipment (e.g., IV pumps, monitors, ventilators) as needed for patient care and safety.
  • Promotes patient safety by adhering to National Patient Safety Goals and maintaining a clean, safe environment for patients and staff.
  • Participates in audits, chart reviews, and compliance checks to ensure adherence to standards of practice and regulatory requirements.
  • Demonstrates responsible decision-making in planning, delegating, and providing care based on patient needs and organizational policies.
  • Documents patient care and education thoroughly and promptly in the medical record.
  • Engages in professional development to maintain clinical competency and understanding of current nursing standards and regulations.
  • Participates in performance improvement initiatives, including data collection and process development, to enhance patient outcomes and care delivery.
  • Cath Lab RN:
    • Pre-Procedure:
      • Reviews medical history, assesses patient's overall health, and prepares them for the procedure.
      • Intravenous (IV) Line Initiation: Starts and maintains an IV line for medication administration.
      • Administers medications as prescribed by the physician.
      • Educates patients and families about the procedure and what to expect.
      • Verifies that surgical consents have been signed.
    • During the Procedure:
      • Assists the Cardiologist during the catheterization process.
      • Closely monitors the patient's vital signs, hemodynamic data, and sedation levels.
      • Ensures proper functioning of equipment and supplies.
      • Manages potential complications and responding to emergencies.
    • Post-Procedure:
      • Continues to monitor the patient's vital signs and overall condition after the procedure.
      • Administers post-procedure medications as needed.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.
  • Maintains regular and reliable attendance.
  • Complies with all policies and standards.

Qualifications

  • 0-2 years of experience in a clinical nursing role or student clinical rotations in an acute care setting required

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

  • Strong knowledge of the nursing process and clinical nursing practices.
  • Ability to perform thorough patient assessments and communicate findings effectively.
  • Proficient in administering medications and monitoring for side effects.
  • Effective communication and interpersonal skills to collaborate with interdisciplinary teams.
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail in documenting patient care.
  • Knowledge of safety standards, infection control, and quality improvement initiatives.

Licenses and Certifications

  • RN - Registered Nurse - State Licensure and/or Compact State Licensure required
  • BCLS - Basic Life Support required
  • ACLS - Advanced Cardiac Life Support preferred
  • PALS - Pediatric Advanced Life Support preferred
  • NRP - Neonatal Resuscitation preferred
  • Refer to facility or unit-specific guidelines for additional requirements.

We know it’s not just about finding a job. It’s about finding a place where you are respected, valued and where your work is purposeful and fulfilling. A place where your talent is recognized, professional development is encouraged and career advancement is possible.

Santa Rosa Medical Center is a full-service, 129-bed hospital located in Milton, Florida. Our main focus is ensuring optimal patient care through the use of advanced technology, innovative medical and surgical treatments, and staff knowledge and experience. We strive to provide a positive healthcare experience for our patients and employees.

Santa Rosa County has a variety of activities that has something for everyone. Spend the day on one of our Emerald Coast beaches or go kayaking along the Blackwater River. Being minutes from Pensacola city offers an array of dining and nightlife options. This area has everything you’re looking for.

Santa Rosa Medical Center is accredited by the The Joint Commission. Our services include an accredited Sleep Disorders Center by the American Academy of Sleep Medicine. The Women's Place is accredited in mammography by the American College of Radiology. The Center for Surgical Weight Loss at Santa Rosa Medical Center has received recognition from The Metabolic and Bariatric Surgery Accreditation and Quality Improvement.

title: Laboratory Scientist, Genetic Toxicology (On-site)
description:
Job Description

Laboratory Scientist, Genetic Toxicology

We are seeking a laboratory scientist to join the Genetic Toxicology group within Non-clinical Drug Safety. This individual will be part of a high performing group and primarily responsible for the conduct of in vitro genotoxicity studies in mammalian cells (e.g., in vitro micronucleus), under both screening and Good Laboratory Practice (GLP) conditions, in support of drug discovery and development.

Primary Responsibilities:

-In this role, the scientist will work with mammalian cell cultures or isolated samples from in vivo studies to perform routine and non-routine genetic toxicology assays.

-Responsibilities will include maintaining laboratory equipment in accordance with GLP, maintenance of cell cultures, manual microscopic analysis of fixed cells for the presence of micronuclei

-The individual will work in close collaboration with other scientists within the genetic toxicology group and other functional areas within Non-clinical Drug Safety.

-The individual will have a range of practical laboratory skills required in a cell biology lab and demonstrated expertise in working with in vitro cell cultures.

-Experience with in vitro micronucleus assay/chromosome aberration assay would be an advantage along with experience working in accordance with GLP standards .

-The individual will be expected to work in a team, be flexible with rapidly changing work assignments/schedules and

priorities, demonstrate problem-solving skills, and the ability to communicate effectively both verbally and in writing.

Education Requirements:

Bachelor of Science or MS degree (Biology, Cellular & Molecular biology, Chemistry, Biochemistry or related sciences) plus at least 3 years of relevant experience

Must-haves:

Excellent verbal and written communication skills

Demonstrated laboratory skills in cellular/molecular biology including in vitro cell culture techniques.

Preferred experience with Genetic Toxicology assay design and conduct, such as in vitro micronucleus assay .

Ability to successfully collaborate among a range of diverse scientific backgrounds, with the ability to

adapt, work in a matrix environment, and often meet tight timelines

Self-driven and accountable for own learning

Required Skills:

Assay, Biomarker Identification, Cell-Based Assays, Cell Cultures, Detail-Oriented, Experimentation, High-Throughput Screening, In Vitro Assays, Laboratory Techniques, Mammalian Cell, Mammalian Cell Culture, Microscopic Examination, Molecular Biology, Molecular Microbiology, Primary Cell Culture, Sample Processing, Scientific Writing, Teamwork, Technology Development, Toxicology

Genotoxicity

title: Level 2 DC Installer
description:
National Power, LLC is seeking a safety-conscious Level 2 DC Installer to join our critical infrastructure team. Under the general direction of the CI Manager/Project Manager and guidance of a Lead Installer, the Level 2 DC Installer assists with the installation, maintenance, testing, and commissioning of Direct Current (DC) power systems, including batteries, rectifiers, inverters, and associated cabling. This role supports essential infrastructure such as telecommunications networks, data centers, and utility facilities. The installer will perform work on active DC power systems while adhering to company safety standards, quality requirements, and customer expectations.

Due to the critical nature of the work and potential impact on customer operations, employees may be required to successfully complete a probationary period demonstrating competency in essential job functions.

Key Responsibilities

  • Follow all safety procedures and maintain strong site awareness while working in DC power environments.
  • Understand and apply Telcordia and National Power standards, terminology, and work practices.
  • Read and interpret playbooks, layouts, electrical diagrams, schematics, and manufacturer documentation.
  • Demonstrate basic electrical knowledge, including DC/AC concepts, circuits, resistance, and current flow.
  • Identify battery types, manufacturers, cable sizes, lug types, and DC power equipment components.
  • Use testing equipment such as voltmeters and amp clamps to perform troubleshooting and verification.
  • Install, route, pull, label, lace, lug, and terminate cables using industry-standard methods.
  • Perform H-tapping, cable lacing, fiber guide installation, and firestopping activities.
  • Install, stack, strap, and prepare batteries for deployment in DC power systems.
  • Assist with project preparation and execution, including infrastructure installation and equipment mounting.
  • Install and configure DC power infrastructure, including bays, battery racks, BDFBs, power plants, rectifiers, inverters, converters, and related equipment.
  • Work independently with limited supervision while maintaining quality workmanship and adherence to standards.
  • Recognize workplace hazards and follow all safety requirements associated with DC power systems.
  • Develop technical proficiency through hands-on experience, with an expected progression period of 3-5 years to reach advanced competency.
  • Maintain accurate documentation of work performed, materials utilized, and site conditions
  • Communicate effectively with Lead Installers, Project Managers, and customer representatives throughout project execution
  • Follow all Environmental Health and Safety (EHS) guidelines, company policies, and industry’s best practices
  • Perform additional duties as assigned by management
Qualifications Required
  • High School Diploma or GED
  • Minimum of 2 years of experience installing DC power equipment or performing related electrical work
  • Minimum of 2 years of experience with:
    • Adding or removing wiring and connections on DC power equipment
    • Installing, removing, or replacing telecom batteries
  • Ability to safely use hand tools, power tools, and electrical testing equipment
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to safety
  • Valid driver's license with an acceptable driving record
  • Ability and willingness to travel extensively
Preferred
  • Experience in telecommunications, data center, utility, or critical infrastructure environments
  • OSHA 10 or OSHA 30 Certification
  • CPR/First Aid Certification
  • NFPA 70E Electrical Safety Training
  • Experience performing equipment testing and system turn-up activities

Physical Requirements
  • Consistently lift and carry at least 40 pounds
  • Safely maneuver, install, or remove batteries weighing up to 750 pounds using proper lifting methods and equipment
  • Push or pull cables weighing up to 60 pounds
  • Ability to stand, walk, bend, kneel, crouch, squat, and climb ladders for extended periods
  • Work on ladders up to 8 feet in height for prolonged periods
  • Frequently reach above, below, and at shoulder level
  • Frequently bend, twist, stoop, crouch, and squat
  • Ability to work in confined spaces, battery rooms, telecom facilities, and equipment shelters
  • Ability to wear required personal protective equipment (PPE), including hard hats, gloves, safety glasses, steel-toed boots, and arc-flash protective equipment
  • Adequate vision and hearing to safely perform essential job functions
Work Environment & Travel
  • Travel approximately 50%+ depending on customer sites & locations throughout designated service areas
  • Ability to workday shifts, night shifts, weekends, holidays, and varying schedules as required by project demands
  • Work in telecommunications central offices, cable facilities, data centers, and outdoor environments
  • Exposure to moderate noise levels and varying weather conditions, temperatures, and site environments
  • Overnight travel may be required depending on project location and customer requirements
Compensation & Benefits

Salary Range: $25.00 - $30.00 per hour

Compensation is based on:
  • Relevant industry experience
  • Technical knowledge and skills
  • Certifications and training
  • Geographic location
Benefits
  • Medical, Dental, Vision, Life, and Disability Insurance
  • 401(k) with Company Match
  • Paid Time Off and Paid Holidays
  • Training and Certification Opportunities
  • Career Advancement Opportunities
Additional Information
  • Criminal background check, pre-employment drug screen, and Motor Vehicle Report (MVR) review required
  • Overtime and weekend work may be necessary to meet project deadlines
  • This position requires flexibility to travel and work at various customer locations

title: Packaging Designer (all genders)
description:
Your role

We are looking for an experienced Packaging Designer to join our creative team and work closely with other designers, the Photo Studio, Product Development, Marketing and the Lead of Design.

In this role, you will be responsible for developing, maintaining and executing Sunday Natural’s packaging design across different product categories and international markets. You will make sure that our corporate identity, values, vision and mission are consistently translated into high-quality packaging solutions.

This is a mid to senior-level position for a proactive, hands-on designer with strong critical thinking skills, excellent technical knowledge in print production and the ability to take full ownership of projects from concept to final print-ready artwork. We are looking for someone who can work independently, solve problems before they become blockers and deliver flawless final artwork with a high level of accuracy.

You will:

  • Design and care for packaging across different product categories and international markets

  • Develop packaging concepts that are aligned with Sunday Natural’s corporate identity and brand standards

  • Own packaging projects from briefing to final print-ready artwork

  • Prepare flawless final artwork and production files for print, ensuring technical accuracy and consistency

  • Conduct pre- and post-production quality checks

  • Review and improve existing packaging layouts, systems and workflows

  • Collaborate with internal departments to conceptualise and execute creative solutions that can be translated across different packaging formats and media platforms

  • Work closely with suppliers, printers and internal stakeholders to ensure high-quality production results

  • Guide and advise fellow employees in both the creative and technical process to foster stronger working relationships and solutions

  • Submit creative deliverables within the agreed deadline

  • Produce mockups and visualizations of packaging for internal presentations, website use and production alignment

  • Proactively identify design, production or workflow issues and propose practical solutions

  • Creatively seek out AI solutions and implement them into the workflow where relevant

Your profile

  • You have a degree in Graphic Design, Packaging Design, Visual Communication, Media Design or an equivalent qualification

  • You have a minimum of 5 years of professional experience in Graphic Design, Packaging Design or a similar field

  • You bring a strong portfolio of successful packaging projects that have been produced and published in the past

  • You have excellent knowledge of packaging design, print production, materials, finishes, dielines and final artwork preparation

  • You work flawlessly with Adobe Creative Suite, especially InDesign, Illustrator and Photoshop

  • You are highly experienced in preparing print-ready files and understand how to avoid technical mistakes before production

  • You are confident working with printers, suppliers and production partners

  • You are proactive, hands-on and able to take ownership of projects from start to finish

  • You have strong creative, organizational, problem-solving and time-management skills

  • You have a sharp eye for detail and a high standard for quality and consistency

  • You are able to work independently while also being a strong team player

  • You communicate clearly and professionally with designers, stakeholders and external partners

  • You work well with tight deadlines in a team environment

  • You are engaged with AI solutions and already exploring or implementing new technologies to accelerate your workflow

  • You keep informed about the latest trends, materials, packaging innovations and design forecast

  • You are available to travel and follow print production within Europe

What we offer

  • An appealing discount on all of our products – from essential oils to vitamins & nutrients

  • We offer 28 days of paid time off per year plus up to 5 days off between Christmas and New Year

  • The Urban Sports Club membership and either Swapfiets bike rental or a subsidy for the Deutschlandticket

  • We believe great things happen when we meet in person, which is why we embrace a hybrid model with one home office day per week – up to two depending on the area you are working in – and up to two weeks per year working from abroad

  • Receive various discounts of up to more than 50 percent on attractive brands such as Flaconi, Bosch, Apple or Expedia

  • You will be given real ownership and plenty of room for new initiatives, as well as the opportunity to contribute your expertise and implement your great ideas

  • Inviting office spaces with access to plenty of organic teas and superfoods from around the world

  • We like to celebrate each other! Regular tea & office parties, Christmas and summer feasts and various influencer events such as Women's Day

Apply with your CV and portfolio.

Sunday Natural emerged from a long-standing passion and research in the fields of health, healing, and personal growth. The lack of natural, high-quality products on the market was the original motivation for founding Sunday Natural in 2013. We aim to produce the products we ourselves would love to buy – as natural as possible, absolutely pure, free from any additives, and of the highest quality. In a strategic partnership with CVC, Sunday Natural is now one of Germany's most renowned quality manufacturers, with its own research and development department in Berlin. For the continuous improvement of our products, we collaborate with selected research institutes, scientists, therapists, farmers, and professional associations.

We take our ecological responsibility very seriously: that’s why the majority of our product range is vegan. We also take an innovative approach to packaging: most of our products are packaged in glass, making them almost entirely recyclable.

Our diverse team in Berlin consists of over 350 employees from more than 45 nationalities and continues to grow – but at a sustainable pace. Our goal is to foster a collaborative, supportive, and inclusive work environment with a diverse group of motivated, talented, and visionary team members.

We highly value equality of opportunity and inclusivity, and we would like to particularly encourage women and candidates from under-represented backgrounds to apply, even if you don’t match with 100% of the requirements.

description:
About Suno

We're building the world's first creative entertainment platform, where the entire world can feel the joy and fulfillment of making music. Music is for everyone: Our users include everyone from grandmothers creating songs for their loved ones, to Grammy winners using Suno Studio, our power tool, to make the most popular hits in the world.

Building the future of entertainment requires ambition. The pace is fast, the problems are hard, and the work demands ownership and intensity. For the right people, it’s incredibly rewarding: a chance to shape a new medium, work with a small team that cares deeply about quality, make music, drink too much coffee, and build something that millions of people use to express themselves in ways that were never before possible.

Suno is the fastest growing consumer entertainment company and the leader in AI music. We are backed by leading investors including Bond Capital, Menlo Ventures, Lightspeed Venture Partners, IVP, Forerunner, Union Square Ventures, Alkeon, Quiet, Matrix Partners, Schroders Capital and, NVentures (venture arm of NVIDIA).

About the Role

We’re looking for a Lead Security Engineer to help build the security foundation. This is a hands-on role: you’ll set technical direction for security across our product and infrastructure, go deep in the code and the cloud yourself, and help shape the team that grows around you.

What You’ll Do

  • Own security architecture and the roadmap across our product and cloud environments, threat-modeling to focus effort where it matters most.

  • Elevate our AppSec practice: secure the SDLC, establish code-review guardrails, manage dependencies and secrets, and implement pre-production security testing.

  • Drive cloud security: IAM and least-privilege, account structure, network boundaries, and data-access controls.

  • Lead incident response. This role requires participation in an on-call rotation and acting as the senior responder during incidents.

  • Mentor and shape the security team and its operational processes.

What You’ll Need

  • 10+ years in security engineering, with deep expertise in at least two of AppSec, cloud/infrastructure security, and IR, and credibility in the third.

  • A builder: you’ve created security capabilities and set direction, not only operated established programs.

  • Strong cross-functional partnership skills — security should enable the business to build and operate safely.

  • Nice to have: Consumer product at scale, AI/ML abuse or model-security exposure, experience as an early or founding security hire.

title: Quality Assurance  Specialist
description:
What Makes a Honda, is Who makes a Honda
Honda has a clear vision for the future, and it’s a joyful one. We are looking for individuals with the skills, courage, persistence, and dreams that will help us reach our future-focused goals. At our core is innovation. Honda is constantly innovating and developing solutions to drive our business with record success. We strive to be a company that serves as a source of “power” that supports people around the world who are trying to do things based on their own initiative and that helps people expand their own potential. To this end, Honda strives to realize “the joy and freedom of mobility” by developing new technologies and an innovative approach to achieve a “zero environmental footprint.”

We are looking for qualified individuals with diverse backgrounds, experiences, continuous improvement values, and a strong work ethic to join our team.

If your goals and values align with Honda’s, we want you to join our team to Bring the Future!

Job Purpose

Representing TMP-O as the QMS Subject Matter Expert (SME), lead and manage department compliance by promoting and guaranteeing adherence to Quality Management System (QMS) requirements.

Key Accountabilities

• Develop best practice for QMS Unit and enhance Quality Management System knowledge to share with department associates to ensure comprehension and compliance
• Design, create and maintain a system with linkage to all our computer-based quality applications that reduce risks that could potentially compromise QMS system
• Set department documentation systems and requirements to maintain consistency with HDMA, North American (NA) and Global Quality Standards.
• Establish document systems for the QMS unit to assure required documents and records are controlled and retained.
• Communicate Quality Management System (QMS) activities and change points to enhance understanding and awareness for Department’s leadership
• Lead department internal reviews to assess production systems, processes, and requirements of the Quality Management System. (QMS) and initiate Best Practice Review
• Lead department activity to effectively execute internal and external audits. Interface with external Auditors representing both Dept and Plant
• Review internal and external (UTAC or other Honda companies) audit findings to understand system gaps and apply countermeasure to prevent similar failures.
• Lead collaborative problem solving and countermeasure activities to establish continuous improvement and Best Practice across TMP-O (ALMC-HPDC).
• Manage Department Record retention system in compliance with documented Master Record Control Ledger.
• Develop capability of self, colleagues, and team through training, mentoring, and sharing best practice

Qualifications, Experience, and Skills

• Bachelors or Associates Degree in a related field; or equivalent relevant job experience.
• 0-6 years of experience based on education
• Strong interpersonal and communication skills
• Dealing with conflict and empowerment to escalate (consensus building skills)
• Knowledge of QMS
• Demonstrated ability to work independently as well as within a team
• Demonstrated ability to respond immediately to production floor needs and requirements
• Basic computer skills
• Demonstrated knowledge of the SEQCDM guidelines / requirements within area of responsibility
• Ability to manage time and multi-task

KMRG, LLC (KMRG) is a federal services company that hires talented professionals to support Government agencies and the communities they serve. We are hiring a Federal Travel Specialist to join our team and provide remote travel-management support to the Federal Retirement Thrift Investment Board (FRTIB).
In this role, you will provide end-to-end support for official Government travel, including travel planning, authorizations, reservations, vouchers, approval workflows, reimbursement processing, reporting, training, and electronic travel-system support.

This position is a strong fit for someone with substantial federal travel-program experience who is organized, customer-focused, comfortable training users, and skilled at translating complex travel regulations into clear and practical guidance.

Applications will be reviewed as they are received. Apply today!

RESPONSIBILITIES
Federal Travel Planning & Authorizations
  • Assist employees with planning official Government travel and estimating anticipated travel costs
  • Help travelers identify airfare, lodging, meals and incidental expenses, rental vehicles, and other reimbursable expenses
  • Prepare, review, route, and monitor travel authorizations before official travel begins
  • Verify accounting codes, funding lines, supporting documentation, and required justifications

  • Support web-based reservation functions and apply knowledge of Global Distribution Systems

title: Motor Hanger / Rub Rail Technician
description:
Motor Hanger / Rub Rail Technician

$18 - $22 per hour, DOE

Position Summary

Sea Fox Boats is seeking a skilled and dependable Motor Hanger / Rub Rail Technician to join our production team. This position is responsible for installing outboard motors and associated rigging components, as well as installing and finishing rub rail systems on fiberglass boats.

The ideal candidate has strong mechanical ability, excellent attention to detail, and the ability to work efficiently while maintaining Sea Fox Boats' standards for quality, fit, finish, and safety. Marine, boat-building, rigging, or automotive mechanical experience is strongly preferred.

Key Responsibilities

Motor Hanging & Rigging

  • Install outboard motors on boats according to production specifications and manufacturer requirements.

  • Position and secure motors using proper lifting equipment and safe handling procedures.

  • Install motor mounting hardware, brackets, steering components, controls, cables, hoses, and related rigging components.

  • Route and secure wiring, rigging tubes, hydraulic lines, fuel lines, and other connections as required.

  • Verify proper motor alignment, mounting height, positioning, and overall installation.

  • Assist with connecting and routing electrical and mechanical systems associated with the outboard motor.

  • Inspect completed installations for proper fit, secure connections, and potential defects.

  • Use hand tools, power tools, torque wrenches, drills, and other production equipment safely and correctly.

  • Follow torque specifications and installation procedures to ensure proper and consistent assembly.

  • Identify and report damaged, missing, or incorrect components before installation.

  • Perform adjustments and corrections as needed to ensure the finished product meets quality standards.

Rub Rail Installation

  • Measure, cut, fit, and install rub rail systems on fiberglass boat hulls.

  • Properly position rub rail around the hull while maintaining consistent alignment and appearance.

  • Install rub rail using appropriate fasteners, adhesives, heat, and hand/power tools.

  • Make clean and accurate cuts at corners, joints, and termination points.

  • Ensure rub rail is securely attached and properly seated against the hull.

  • Inspect completed rub rail installations for gaps, waves, misalignment, loose sections, or other imperfections.

  • Perform necessary adjustments, repairs, and refinishing to achieve a clean, professional finish.

  • Protect finished fiberglass surfaces from damage during installation.

Quality & Production Responsibilities

  • Inspect work throughout the installation process to ensure quality standards are consistently met.

  • Complete work accurately and efficiently while maintaining production schedules.

  • Follow documented work instructions, blueprints, specifications, and supervisor direction.

  • Maintain a clean and organized workstation.

  • Properly care for tools, equipment, materials, and production boats.

  • Communicate shortages, quality concerns, damaged components, or production issues to the appropriate supervisor.

  • Work cooperatively with rigging, electrical, fiberglass, and other production departments to complete boats efficiently.

  • Perform rework or corrections when necessary to meet Sea Fox quality standards.

  • Follow all company safety policies and OSHA requirements.

Qualifications

  • Previous experience in boat building, marine rigging, outboard motor installation, rub rail installation, automotive mechanics, or a related field required.

  • Mechanical aptitude and ability to understand how mechanical systems work.

  • Ability to use hand tools and power tools safely and effectively.

  • Ability to read and follow measurements, specifications, diagrams, and work instructions.

  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality.

  • Good hand-eye coordination and ability to perform precise installation work.

  • Ability to troubleshoot basic mechanical and installation issues.

  • Ability to work independently while also functioning effectively as part of a production team.

  • Dependable attendance and a strong work ethic are required.

  • Previous fiberglass or marine manufacturing experience is a plus.

Physical Requirements

  • Must be able to stand, walk, bend, stoop, kneel, reach, and work in confined or awkward positions for extended periods.

  • Must be able to regularly lift, carry, push, and pull materials and equipment.

The Quality Control Incoming Inspector is responsible for performing visual and dimensional inspections of incoming components according to engineering drawings or specifications, utilizing a variety of inspection tools and equipment, while keeping accurate inspection data.

title: Director, Change Management
description:
Newmark’s platform and AI rollouts only succeed if they change how individual teams and whole offices actually work day to day. Getting that right takes more than training: it takes structured workflow research, change management grounded in behavioral science, and direct partnership with the people whose workflows are changing.

We’re hiring a Director, Change Management to help lead that work. This role will help in leading whole-office and team-level workflow transitions using workflow research and co-creation workshops. You’ll also be a direct contributor to enterprise strategy conversations, translating what you learn in the field into recommendations for where the firm should focus its workflow migration, change and technology investments.

You’ll also work closely with Newmark Consulting Group’s Behavior Science Studio lead to both win and deliver client business.

Essential Job Duties

Workflow Transition & Whole-Office Change Leadership

  • Lead end-to-end change management for whole-office transitions (e.g., Palo Alto) and team-level workflow migrations (Dallas, Denver, DC, etc.) from current-state diagnosis through go-live and sustainment.

  • Conduct structured workflow research — data synthesis and AI process mapping — to identify where new tools and platforms are redundant, where gaps exist in what is needed for future state, or where office leadership could improve how teams work with new tools.

  • Design and facilitate co-creation workshops that bring brokers, BOMs, and operations staff into the solution-design process.

  • Build reusable transition playbooks, project plans and toolkits so office- and team-level migrations can be run consistently across markets.

  • Partner with local BOMs and market leadership to sequence transitions and manage change fatigue across concurrent rollouts.

Enterprise AI Adoption & Enterprise Strategy Advisory

  • Represent change management and adoption in Enterprise AI team syncs, keeping rollout sequencing aligned with enterprise AI strategy.

  • Partner with Technology and Compliance stakeholders on AI policy communication during rollout and policy-change periods.

  • Help advise NCG Partner-level leadership on enterprise strategy, organizational development, and capability-development priorities.

NCG Behavior Science Studio

  • Work with NCG management consulting group to help clients change behavior a scale

  • Build pitch decks and proposals for consulting business development opportunities

What You bring:

  • 8–12 years of experience in organizational change management, applied behavioral science, or technology/platform adoption leadership at Director level.

  • A track record leading large-scale, multi-team or whole-site transitions (office moves, system migrations, org redesigns) — not just single-tool rollouts.

  • Skilled workshop facilitator; comfortable running co-creation sessions with frontline staff and building consensus among stakeholders with competing priorities.

  • Hands-on fluency with, or strong aptitude for quickly learning, AI tools such as Claude and Perplexity — able to credibly guide others through adoption.

  • Strong executive presence; experience advising senior or partner-level leadership on strategy and prioritization.

  • Background applying behavioral science — habit formation, defaults, friction reduction — to real-world workflow design is strongly preferred.

  • Change management certification (Prosci, ACMP, or equivalent) is a plus.

  • Experience in commercial real estate, professional services, or another relationship-driven enterprise is a plus.

Salary: $110,000 - $150,000 annually

The expected base salary for this position ranges from $110,000 to $150,000 annually. The actual base salary will be determined on an individualized basis taking into account a wide range of factors including, but not limited to, relevant skills, experience, education, and, where applicable, licenses or certifications held. In addition to base salary and a competitive benefits package, this position may be eligible for additional types of compensation including discretionary bonuses and other short- and long-term incentives (e.g., deferred cash, equity, etc.).

WORKING CONDITIONS: Normal working conditions with the absence of disagreeable elements

title: Generator Technician
description:
Summary
National Power is accepting applications to fill a Generator Service Technician opening in our Shelby, NC, market. Under the general direction of and reporting to the CISV Service Manager, the Generator Service Technician is responsible for maintenance and repair of generator sets and other electrical equipment.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities
Core duties and responsibilities include the following. Other duties may be assigned.

  1. Perform various types and levels of maintenance and repair on generators and parallel systems ranging from 5-5000kw. Troubleshooting and repair of Automatic Transfer Switches, to include bypass isolation, and closed transition types as well. Repairs will include performing preventative maintenance service (oil and filters), troubleshooting AC and DC circuits, removing and replacing any and all components as necessary, performing warranty work per manufacturer’s guidelines, performing start-up/commissioning on new generators and generator systems.
  2. Perform diesel or gaseous engine troubleshooting and repair to include but not limited to ignition components, injection systems, valve adjustments etc.
  3. Perform load bank testing on generator(s) to ensure units are in the proper operating conditions and meet applicable code requirements.
  4. Assist other technicians with large multi-person jobs, or troubleshooting complicated issues.
Education and Experience
  • HS Diploma required; Associate degree in an electrical/mechanical related field preferred.
  • Current Generac Power Systems certification preferred
  • US Air Force Electrical Power Production Specialist, US Navy Electrician’s Mate, or Generator and/or UPS field service technician preferred
Skills and Other Qualifications
  • Must have excellent communication skills and be able to give verbal/written reports of job status, repair recommendations, equipment/supplies needed.
  • Must be able to account for time spent on jobs and travel.
  • Must have an excellent driving record and have a valid driver’s license. The job WILL require driving long distances to job sites, and overnight stays in hotels 1-3 nights (but not limited to) a week may also be required. Company would cover costs of hotels and provides a meal allowance per company guidelines.
  • Must have good computer skills and be comfortable with Microsoft software to include Internet Explorer, Word, Excel, and Adobe (PDF’s).
  • The technician would work from home and would ensure proper vehicle maintenance is performed, required parts inventory is maintained, ensure security of Company property to include cell phone, laptop computer, specialty tools and any other item assigned.
  • Manages difficult or emotional customer situations; Responds promptly to customer needs; Solicits customer feedback to improve service; Responds to requests for service and assistance; Meets commitments.
  • Good problem-solving during emergency situations or situations with limited resources.
  • Training will be provided. The employee may be required to attend training courses in Milwaukee, Wisconsin in addition to other training as needed and required.
  • Demonstrates accuracy and thoroughness; Looks for ways to improve and promote quality; Applies feedback to improve performance; Monitors own work to ensure quality and safety.
Work Conditions:
  • The technician may be required to work in various weather conditions (heat, rain, snow, high humidity, etc.)
  • Frequently work near moving mechanical parts.
Physical Demands:
  • Lifting and carrying heavy objects, up to 75lbs, will be required.
  • Ascending or descending ladders, scaffolding, stairs, ramps and the like using feet/legs and/or hands/arms.
  • Seizing, holding, grasping, turning, or otherwise working with hand(s).
  • Entering text or data into a computer or other machine by means of a keyboard.
  • Pushing/pulling may involve use of hands/arms, feet/legs, and/or feet only done with one side of the body or both sides.
  • Moving about on hands and knees or hands and feet to enter restricted spaces.
  • Use of one or both feet or legs to move controls on machinery or equipment. Controls include, but are not limited to pedals, buttons, levers, and cranks.

title: Senior Director of Pre-College Pathways
description:
The University of Notre Dame, the leading Catholic global research University, offers undergraduate, graduate, and professional students the opportunity to pursue their academic endeavors in a scholarly community that is enriched by Catholic intellectual and cultural traditions. As the University advances the vision outlined in Notre Dame 2033: A Strategic Framework, the Undergraduate Enrollment team is seeking an innovative, mission-oriented, and strategic leader for the position of Senior Director of Pre-College Pathways.

The Undergraduate Enrollment Division works to open doors to a Notre Dame education, empowering students to pursue, discover, and share knowledge, truth, and faith as a powerful means for good. The division is committed to creating socioeconomic mobility for students from all pathways, increasing the global Catholic community on its campus, and ensuring that the Notre Dame undergraduate student body represents the gifts and experiences of the full human family.

Reporting to the Executive Director for Enrollment Management, this pivotal leadership role is responsible for architecting the strategic vision and providing direct leadership and oversight for two vital institutional assets: the Office of Pre-College Programs and the Notre Dame TRIO Programs.

The Office of Pre-College Programs delivers highly selective, rigorous academic and residential experiences for high-achieving high school students from across the globe, inviting them to engage with Notre Dame’s world-class faculty and distinctive Catholic mission. Complementing this global outreach, the Notre Dame TRIO Programs encompass federally funded initiatives (such as Upward Bound and Talent Search) deeply rooted in the local community, providing critical college-access resources, mentorship, and advocacy for first-generation and low-income students. Together under the Director's leadership, these departments will create a cohesive and powerful ecosystem that expands educational opportunity, drives socioeconomic mobility, and cultivates the next generation of mission-aligned leaders.

The successful candidate will be a visionary strategist, an exceptional communicator, and a master relationship-builder. They will be tasked with coordinating a comprehensive pathways strategy that ensures talented and mission-aligned pre-college and community students are inspired by, prepared for, and connected to higher education opportunities. By leveraging collaborative partnerships across the division, campus, and broader community, this leader will ensure a seamless and transformative journey from early academic outreach to enrollment readiness.

Specific responsibilities of the position include the following:

  • Strategic Pathway Management: Develop and coordinate a comprehensive strategic vision for the University's pre-college and access pathways, ensuring programs align with the University's mission and broader enrollment goals.
  • Divisional Leadership: Provide direct supervision, mentorship, and strategic direction to the Pre-College Programs team and the TRIO Programs team, ensuring their efforts are integrated, compliant, and mission-aligned.
  • Access and Outreach Strategy: Oversee the design and delivery of high-impact pre-college academic experiences and federally funded TRIO initiatives that articulate the value of higher education to both global and local student populations.
  • Programmatic Engagement: Lead the execution of world-class on-campus residential, virtual, and community-based initiatives that foster a deep sense of belonging, academic capability, and community for participating students.
  • Strategic Collaboration: Partner closely with Undergraduate Admissions and enrollment leadership to align early talent identification with future recruitment pipelines, utilizing data-informed insights to optimize program efficacy.
  • Cross-Functional Partnership: Collaborate with senior leadership, faculty across academic colleges and schools, local school districts, and community stakeholders to deliver a compelling experience for all students.
  • Innovation and Compliance: Stay abreast of federal regulations, youth protection guidelines, best practices, and emerging trends in college access and pre-college programming to ensure Notre Dame remains a leader in the field.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree
  • 5+ years of experience in higher education or a similar industry (specifically within college access, pre-college, or student success programming)

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master’s or Doctoral degree
  • Exceptional communication (written and oral), presentation, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to effectively influence and inspire multiple stakeholders.
  • Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and critical-thinking skills, with proven experience in developing and implementing data-driven strategies that have resulted in measurable improvements.
  • A strong understanding of college readiness frameworks, federal TRIO grant regulations, and enrollment management principles within a highly selective university environment.
  • Experience leading student access, youth programming, or academic-enrichment teams in a fast-paced, mission-driven organization.

Hiring Pay Range: Commensurate with experience

Application Deadline to Apply: August 24, 2026

Required Documents to Apply: Resume & Cover Letter

The University of Notre Dame seeks to attract, develop, and retain the highest quality faculty, staff and administration. The University is an Equal Opportunity Employer, and does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, national or ethnic origin, sex, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or age in employment. Moreover, Notre Dame prohibits discrimination against veterans or disabled qualified individuals, and complies with 41 CFR 60-741.5(a) and 41 CFR 60-300.5(a). title: Strategy & Operations – Product Growth

title: Recruiting Coordinator (Contractor)
description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Recruiting Coordinator at Anduril, you will play an integral role in helping our company grow & scale. From helping to handle daily recruiting activities to encouraging candidate relationships and experiences along the way, you will be pivotal in helping fuel the company for tomorrow's success. Often you will be providing prospective candidates & new hires with their first impression of Anduril.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Update candidate records and manage interview coordination requests in Greenhouse (ATS) and ModernLoop (scheduling tool)

  • Experience as a Recruiting Coordinator or in Recruiting (at a fast-paced, growing company)

  • Able to work efficiently and prioritize tasks in a dynamic environment
  • Relentless attention to detail and accuracy
  • Great team player but can also work well independently with limited guidance
  • Process-driven with strong habits and a passion for process improvement and efficiency
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills with an emphasis on providing good customer service and building strong relationships
  • Ability to remain composed and detail-oriented in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
    Positive attitude with a growth mindset
  • Willing to work in-person at Anduril's Quincy office, or other nearby satellite offices 4-5 days per week

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Experience using ATS applications; Greenhouse experience strongly preferred
  • Proven experience scheduling within Outlook
  • Familiarity with Slack
  • Experience using ModernLoop
  • Experience working with asynchronous and geographically diverse teams
US Hourly Range
$25.48—$33.65 USD

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

  • No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

  • Please always verify communications:
    • Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address.
    • Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com.

  • Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

  • What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

Data Privacy

To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit .

This third-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency. title: Campus Pastor - Hope
description:
Campus Pastor – Hope


Main Street Church | Hope, British Columbia

Main Street Church is looking for a relational, faith-filled leader to help establish and lead our new campus in Hope, BC.

Hope is a beautiful and growing community surrounded by mountains and rivers, with a strong sense of connection and tremendous ministry potential. We believe God has opened a significant door for us to establish a thriving, gospel-centred, Spirit-led presence in the heart of this community.

We have purchased a building that will become the home of our Hope campus.
More than a place for Sunday services, we envision it becoming a place where people experience community, find hope, encounter Jesus, and move toward wholeness. We see opportunities for worship gatherings, Alpha, recovery ministries, marriage and family support, prayer, care ministries, community partnerships, and much more.


The Opportunity

The Campus Pastor will have the opportunity to build something new while being fully supported and resourced by Main Street Church.

This isn’t about simply reproducing a Sunday service in another location. It’s about becoming part of the community, building genuine relationships, developing a healthy team, and living out the mission and values of Main Street Church in a way that serves the unique needs of Hope.

The Campus Pastor will be an extension of the leadership and ministry of Main Street Church in Chilliwack, BC. They will work closely with our Lead Pastor, Executive Team, staff, and ministry leaders while providing local leadership and pastoral presence in Hope.


The Role

The Campus Pastor will:

  • Build meaningful relationships throughout the Hope community.
  • Develop a strong pastoral presence within the church and community.
  • Gather, equip, and lead a healthy team of staff and volunteers.
  • Create a welcoming culture where people can belong before they believe.
  • Help establish and lead weekly worship gatherings.
  • Live out and champion the mission, vision, and values of Main Street Church.
  • Identify the needs of the community and develop ministries that respond to them.
  • Build relationships with local pastors, churches, organizations, and community leaders.
  • Provide pastoral care, prayer, discipleship, and leadership development.
  • Work closely with the Main Street Church team to ensure unity, alignment, and shared direction.
  • Help people take their next steps toward wholeness in Christ.


Who We’re Looking For

We’re looking for someone who:

  • Loves Jesus deeply and lives with spiritual maturity and integrity.
  • Loves people and genuinely enjoys building relationships.
  • Has a heart for the local church and the community of Hope.
  • Is a strong communicator, team builder, and developer of leaders.
  • Is entrepreneurial and excited about building something new.
  • Can lead with both faith and wisdom.
  • Is comfortable working collaboratively and being part of a larger church team.
  • Is willing to become part of the Hope community and invest in it for the long term.
  • Aligns fully with the beliefs, mission, vision, and values of Main Street Church.
  • Has relevant pastoral, ministry, or leadership experience.


Why This Opportunity Matters

We believe God has given us more than a building; He has given us an opportunity.

An opportunity to serve a community.
An opportunity to build relationships.
An opportunity to reach people who may never walk into a church on their own.
An opportunity to create a place where people can experience the presence, love, and transforming power of Jesus.

The right person won’t simply manage a campus. They will help build a community of faith that reflects the heart of Jesus and becomes a genuine blessing to Hope.


If you feel called to build, lead, serve, and take a faith-filled step into something new, we would love to hear from you.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer (TS/SCI Clearance Required)
description:
Forward Deployed Engineer (TS/SCI Clearance Required)

About Lumbra

Lumbra builds the vendor neutral operating system for agentic AI in high consequence environments. In our first ten months we won four fully competed prime contracts across the U.S. Government, every one of them deploying into classified spaces. We are live on JWICS. We were selected from a field of 200+ companies for a defense innovation challenge and won it. We beat two established defense primes on the same program and earned the follow-on, now in execution.

About the Role

Forward Deployed Engineers build and deploy Nebula inside customer environments. Nebula, our agentic harness, runs in classified environments across the Intelligence Community and the Department of Defense, and our field organization is structured as small teams embedded at a single customer site for the life of an engagement.

You work directly with analysts and operators to understand what they need, then implement it: connectors against undocumented data sources, agent and integration work against undocumented workflows, and debugging in environments where standard tooling is unavailable.

You report to the lead for your engagement and work alongside the Deployment Strategists on the same team.

This role is on client site 80 to 100% of the time in the National Capital Region. It is not eligible for remote or hybrid work.

How the Role Is Structured

We publish the time allocation because field engineering is not the same job as platform engineering:

  • ~65% engineering. Connector and integration development, MCP server construction, platform operation, and troubleshooting in air-gapped environments.

  • ~25% users. Demonstrations, training, and acting on analyst feedback directly rather than routing it through someone else.

  • ~10% feeding the product back. Documenting what you learn on site and getting it to core engineering.

What You'll Own

  • Working software in classified customer environments. You build it and you deploy it.

  • Integrations against customer data sources, including tool development, MCP server construction, and authentication.

  • Platform operation, so your team's workflows run reliably. You configure agents and workflows in partnership with the Deployment Strategist, who owns whether their output is mission correct.

  • The user relationship. You demonstrate the platform, deliver training, and act on feedback directly.

  • Troubleshooting in air-gapped environments where external registries, package managers, and standard debugging tools are unavailable.

  • Test coverage for error cases, network failures, and disconnected environment edge conditions.

  • The feedback loop to core engineering. Engagement learnings go back weekly, and they shape the roadmap.

You'll Work Alongside

CIA officers, MIT engineers, Special Operations combat veterans, and applied AI engineers from frontier labs including Anthropic and Google. You will make decisions that immediately affect national security. You will own part of a company early and when it matters.

What This Role Is Not

  • A deployment role that hands off to someone else for user interaction.

  • A domain or workflow role without production engineering responsibility.

  • A role that operates from fully specified requirements.

  • A remote engineering job with occasional site visits. You sit with your users.

Required Qualifications

  • 4 to 8 years of professional software engineering experience. Strong Python.

  • Experience building and operating reliable integrations, including authentication, rate limiting, and error recovery.

  • Working fluency in Kubernetes and containerized deployment.

  • Demonstrated experience working directly with non-technical users.

  • Willingness to work on client site 80 to 100% of the time in the National Capital Region, plus periodic CONUS and OCONUS travel to supported units.

  • U.S. citizenship and an active TS/SCI clearance.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience deploying software in air-gapped or SCIF environments, including disconnected package management and offline container registries.

  • Prior work with Intelligence Community or DoD tooling, data formats, or workflows in IL6+ environments.

  • Experience with agentic systems, LLM application development, or evaluation of non-deterministic systems.

  • Helm chart authoring, workflow orchestration such as Temporal, and graph databases for entity resolution.

  • Rancher, ArgoCD, or Harbor in restricted environments.

  • Experience with, or genuine willingness to learn, the J2 and intelligence processes your users work in: the intelligence cycle, all source fusion, and at J2 sites, JIPOE and the Joint Targeting Cycle and F2T2EA. You build against these workflows, so understanding them is an advantage.

  • Exposure to the intelligence tooling your users rely on, such as i2 Analyst's Notebook, MARS/MIDB, PROTON, ArcGIS Pro, TAC, FADE/MIST, VOLTRON, and OSINT platforms such as Babel Street, Maltego, Dataminr, or Recorded Future. A plus, not expected.

What We Offer

  • Health, dental, and vision insurance. 99% of your premiums covered, and 100% of your dependents' premiums.

  • Optional HSA plan. Lower premium, HSA eligible, fully portable, self directed or managed.

  • Health Reimbursement Account for qualified healthcare expenses.

  • Life insurance of $150,000 plus AD&D, 100% company paid.

  • 401(k) with a 100% match on the first 6%, immediately vested. No cliff, no waiting period. Yours from day one.

  • Wellhub Gold. Everything from Gold's Gym to Lifetime, fully covered, plus [solidcore], F45, and hundreds of other studios.

  • Unlimited PTO. Real time off, not accrual based. Take what you need, no counting required.

  • Every federal holiday, plus additional paid days off over the winter break.

  • Supportive leave of absence program, including time off for military service, medical events, and parental leave.

  • Breakfast, lunch, and endless snacks every day you are in the office.

  • Pre-tax commuter benefits.

  • Company phone plan. A new iPhone, fully company paid.

title: Data Governance Analyst
description:
As the Data Governance Analyst you reside at the intersection of privacy, ethics, confidentiality and colleague trust to manage the information flow of HR data. You will specialize in methods to support the integrity, efficiency, and availability of confidential HR data. The data governance analyst is responsible for developing and implementing data standards, guaranteeing metadata is captured correctly, and creating methods for monitoring and reporting any data incidents. They may also create and maintain common data dictionaries and the tools or methods that support data standards.

The Data Governance Analyst will analyze and oversee strategies designed to enhance data reliability and minimize redundancies. They will work closely with HR Risk and HR Technology, as well as HR SMEs, to develop data quality standards. The data governance analyst will create key performance indicators and supply colleagues and organizational management with performance results. They may also assist with data monitoring, provide organizational management with guidance on streamlining data management, and evaluate data governance matters in AI-enablement scenarios.

• Identify and resolve data quality issues and work with HR Technology on remediation; monitor data quality metrics and usage.
• Support metadata registration and lineage efforts, including DTR, STTM, API and vendor registrations as applicable.
• Provide additional HR data management and analysis support on key data governance domains, including colleague listening, AI-enablement, data privacy and transparency, and ethics. Maintain standards related to data lineage and all data related procedures.


Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, HR, information management, data analytics, risk management or related field.

  • Understanding of master data management best practices and procedures; basic understanding of ETL and data modeling tools
  • 2-5 years of related experience involving workforce data management and enterprise data governance processes

Preferred Qualifications
