title: Freelance Mobile App Tester (Remote, Ireland) | No Experience Required
description:
Are you based in Ireland and looking for flexible freelance work that fits around your studies, freelance projects, full-time job, or personal commitments?

Acclaro is currently recruiting Freelance Mobile App Testers across Ireland to help test an innovative financial services mobile application. This is a fully remote opportunity that allows you to work independently, complete short weekly assignments, and gain experience in app testing and quality assurance.

No previous software testing experience is necessary. We provide all training materials, step-by-step instructions, and project guidelines to help you succeed.

This project is especially well-suited for:

  • Freelancers looking for additional income
  • Students seeking flexible remote work
  • Independent contractors
  • Remote workers with spare availability
  • Digital professionals interested in app testing
  • Anyone comfortable using smartphones and following instructions

Over a project period of approximately 2 to 3 months, you'll receive regular testing tasks while becoming part of Acclaro's global freelance community supporting leading international brands.

About Acclaro

Acclaro combines cultural and language expertise with AI technology to help brands grow their global presence, connect with customers, and mean something to them. As a trusted partner to some of the world’s biggest brands and fastest-growing global companies, our mission is to harness the powerful combination of human expertise and cutting-edge technology. We focus on putting brands into the heads, hearts, and hands of people everywhere.

Our AI-powered business management and language platform ensures a faster time to market with measurable results, while our global team of language, country, and technology experts crafts localization strategies that empower our customers to succeed in any market.

What You'll Do

As a Freelance Functional App Tester, you will evaluate a financial management mobile application from an end-user perspective and help ensure it functions correctly across real-world environments.

Your Responsibilities

  • Execute assigned mobile app testing scenarios
  • Follow detailed testing instructions and workflows
  • Record your smartphone screen while completing test cases
  • Identify and document unexpected app behavior
  • Submit screen recordings and concise test reports
  • Report issues clearly and accurately in English
  • Complete assignments within project deadlines

Typical workload

You can expect:

  • Approximately 1 testing assignment per week
  • Around 30 minutes of work per assignment
  • Delivery required within 1 to 2 business days
  • Project duration of approximately 2 to 3 months

This role is designed to fit around other professional or academic commitments.

Project Details

Location: Remote (Ireland)

Contract Type: Freelance / Independent contractor

Project Duration: Approximately 2–3 months

Workload: Around 30 minutes per weekly assignment

Requirements

To participate, applicants must meet all of the following requirements.

1. Banking Requirement (Mandatory)

To ensure a realistic testing environment:

  • You must have an active personal bank account with a bank operating in Ireland.
  • You must be willing to log into the application using your own bank account during testing activities.

2. Mobile Device Requirement

You must own a smartphone running:

  • iOS 18 or later, or
  • Android 7 or later

This is a mandatory technical requirement for our secure testing environment.

3. Irish Mobile Number

You must have:

  • an active mobile phone number registered in Ireland.

4. Technical Skills

You should be comfortable:

  • Installing and using mobile applications
  • Following detailed step-by-step instructions
  • Identifying unexpected mobile app behavior
  • Recording your smartphone screen
  • Submitting reports accurately and on time

No previous experience in software testing, QA testing, user acceptance testing (UAT), or mobile application testing is required.

5. Remote Working Requirements

Applicants must have:

  • Reliable high-speed internet access
  • Their own smartphone device
  • A quiet environment for independent work
  • The ability to complete assignments within the requested timeframe

Application Process

If you're looking for a flexible remote freelance opportunity and meet the requirements above, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply today to join Acclaro's growing global network of freelance specialists and contribute to the testing of innovative financial technology solutions.

Early applications are encouraged as project onboarding will begin shortly.

Benefits

  • Flexible Remote Work: Work from anywhere, managing your own hours around project deadlines.
  • Long-Term Collaboration Opportunities: We aim to build lasting partnerships with our freelance linguists; successful candidates will become part of our preferred talent pool for ongoing, periodic project assignments.
  • Cutting-Edge Tech: Gain experience working with advanced localization workflows, AI-driven translation tools, and global brand content.
  • Elite Projects: Build your portfolio by working on software utilized by millions of global users daily.

title: Senior Software Engineer, Full Stack
description:
hatch I.T. is partnering with Kinstead to find a Senior Software Engineer, Full Stack. See details below:

About The Role

Kinstead is hiring a Senior Software Engineer to build and own core product functionality across the stack.

You’ll design and implement the systems that power reliable clinical and operational workflows, from backend services and APIs to the frontend experiences that clinicians use every day. You’ll work on everything from application logic and asynchronous processing to user-facing features, collaborating closely with the rest of the engineering team to ship complete product capabilities.

We care deeply about reliability, correctness, and building software that behaves predictably under real-world conditions. Many of their most interesting engineering problems involve workflow design, state management, integrations, and ensuring complex systems remain understandable as they grow.

You do not need prior healthcare or FHIR experience. We care more about strong engineering fundamentals, sound technical judgment, and the ability to ramp quickly on a complex domain.

You’ll work closely with the CTO on system design while maintaining ownership of implementation, production quality, and the long-term health of the systems you build.

About the Company

Kinstead is building the AI-native operating system for independent healthcare, enabling nurse practitioners to launch and run their own clinics. They replace the fragmented, manual infrastructure behind healthcare with a single, intelligent system so clinicians can spend their time on care, not paperwork.This creates a new model of care, one where clinicians practice on their terms and patients get consistent, community-rooted care. They’re backed by Wisdom Ventures and founders and executives from Pomelo Care, Flatiron Health, Roivant, and PathAI on their mission to deliver better care.

What You'll Do:

  • Build and own product features across the stack using Python, Django, React, and Next.js
  • Design and implement the systems behind clinical and operational workflows, including scheduling, messaging, and practice operations
  • Build APIs, application logic, and integrations with clinical and third-party systems
  • Collaborate with engineers, designers, and clinical stakeholders to turn complex workflows into intuitive software
  • Debug and resolve production issues across the frontend, backend, and infrastructure
  • Design systems that remain reliable, maintainable, and predictable as the product grows
  • Contribute to system design, technical planning, architecture discussions, and code reviews

    • Requirements:

  • 5+ years building production web applications
  • Strong backend engineering experience with a modern server-side language or framework (Python, Go, Kotlin, TypeScript, Java, C#, or similar)
  • Comfortable building product features across the stack, including React/Next.js
  • Strong engineering judgment and debugging skills
  • Comfortable owning features from design through production
  • Comfortable using AI development tools while maintaining ownership of the systems you build
  • Ability to commute to Kinstead’s Columbus Circle office 3x week

    • Nice to have:

  • Experience building workflow-driven or stateful systems
  • Experience with React and Next.js
  • Experience with Kubernetes or distributed systems
  • Experience with healthcare, FHIR, or other regulated software
  • Experience working at an early-stage startup

    • Tech Stack:

  • Python (Django, async-first with django-ninja and Channels), Next.js, PostgreSQL (with pgvector), Redis, WebSockets, asynchronous background jobs, workflow state machines, and clinical integrations using Medplum and FHIR.
  • Our services run on AWS and Kubernetes, and we rely on Terraform for IaC and Datadog for APM and infrastructure monitoring.
  • We maintain automated testing and deployment pipelines using Github Actions and integrate with AI providers including Google (Vertex AI), Anthropic (AWS Bedrock), and OpenAI.

title: Loan Coordinator
description:
Loan Coordinator (Mortgage Operations & Lender Liaison) – Remote

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring a Loan Coordinator / Lender Liaison to ensure loan files move efficiently from submission through closing.

This role serves as the primary bridge between internal teams and lending partners, keeping loan files organized, coordinating documentation, tracking progress, and ensuring every deadline is met. If you’re experienced in mortgage operations and thrive in a fast-paced, detail-oriented environment, this role is a great fit.

What You’ll Do

Lender Communication

  • Serve as the primary point of contact with lending partners.
  • Maintain regular communication throughout the loan lifecycle.
  • Follow up on outstanding lender requests and documentation.
  • Escalate issues proactively to prevent funding or closing delays.

Loan Pipeline Management

  • Monitor active loan files from submission through closing.
  • Maintain accurate loan status updates and progress tracking.
  • Review loan reports and identify delays or missing documentation.
  • Keep stakeholders informed of loan progress and next steps.

Internal Coordination

  • Work with internal teams to gather required documentation.
  • Coordinate responses to underwriting conditions and lender requests.
  • Support timely submission of loan packages.
  • Ensure deadlines and timelines remain on track.

Documentation & File Management

  • Organize and maintain complete loan files.
  • Record correspondence and supporting documentation.
  • Maintain accurate CRM and loan management system records.
  • Verify file completeness before key milestones and closing.

Process Improvement

  • Identify workflow inefficiencies.
  • Recommend improvements to loan coordination processes.
  • Support standardized procedures for lender communication and pipeline management.

Required Experience & Skills

  • Experience in loan coordination, loan processing, mortgage operations, lender relations, or a similar role.
  • Strong understanding of the mortgage and lending process.
  • Experience managing loan files from submission through closing.
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.
  • Strong organizational and project management abilities.
  • Ability to manage multiple active loan files simultaneously.
  • Experience using CRM systems and Google Workspace.
  • High attention to detail and deadline management skills.
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment.
  • Reliable internet connection and availability for 30+ hours per week.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with DSCR, investment-property, or non-QM loans.
  • Experience supporting real estate investors.
  • Familiarity with Encompass, LendingPad, Jungo, Salesforce, or similar loan platforms.
  • Background in real estate operations or acquisitions.
  • Experience supporting U.S.-based mortgage lenders or brokers.

What a Typical Day Looks Like

  • Review active loan files and lender updates.
  • Follow up on outstanding conditions and documentation.
  • Coordinate with lenders, underwriters, and internal teams.
  • Update loan statuses and CRM records.
  • Track deadlines and resolve bottlenecks.
  • Ensure loan files are complete before closing.

In short: You’ll keep loan files organized, lenders informed, and closings on schedule from submission through funding.

What Success Looks Like

  • Loan files progress smoothly through the pipeline.
  • Deadlines and closing timelines are consistently met.
  • Accurate and organized loan documentation.
  • Strong communication with lenders and internal teams.
  • Reduced processing delays and bottlenecks.
  • High stakeholder satisfaction.

Interview Process

  1. Application Review
  2. Spark Hire Intro Video (3–5 minutes)
  3. Client Interview
  4. Offer & Onboarding

What Happens After You Apply

After submitting your application, you’ll receive an email invitation from Spark Hire to record a short 3–5 minute Intro Video. This is the first step in our hiring process and can be completed whenever it’s convenient for you.

Instead of multiple screening calls, you’ll have one opportunity to introduce yourself, discuss your mortgage operations experience, and highlight your background in loan coordination, lender communication, documentation management, and pipeline tracking. Your video will be reviewed before moving forward in the interview process.

You can record your video as many times as you’d like before submitting it—only your final version will be reviewed.

Please keep an eye on both your inbox and spam folder for your Spark Hire invitation after applying.

Apply Now

If you enjoy keeping loan files organized, coordinating with lenders, managing deadlines, and ensuring smooth loan closings, we’d love to hear from you. Apply today and help deliver an exceptional lending experience.

title: Senior Analyst, Activation
description:
Kepler executes engineered marketing, where every message and ad delivered helps create a more personalized and productive relationship between brands and their consumers. We do this by acting as clients’ agency of record, as their in-house team, or some hybrid of the two – and by harnessing data and technology across all paid digital media and data-driven CRM channels.
Kepler prides itself on being a great place to work. In fact, we’re proud to share that AdAge recognized Kepler among the Best Place to Work in 2022, validating our investment in our team and our clients.
  • We're transparent with our employees. You'll hear updates on company financials, how we're performing against bonus goals, and how we're responding to challenges we face.
  • We're growing. For you, that means unparalleled growth opportunities and a role in shaping the direction of the company.
  • We're fun. You'll work with and learn from the smartest people in the industry and have a blast doing it.

THE TEAM

Kepler’s Activation team is made up of forward-thinking media traders, with ad platform optimization expertise across biddable media channels (including social, SEM, video/Advanced TV, and programmatic DSP media: audio, DOOH, native, display, etc.) and a keen sense of macro marketing, data policy, and technology trends.

This team is not simply a trading desk - you are a strategic biddable media expert, who will be client-facing, partner-facing, and seen as an internal expert for brainstorming future-proof ad tech solutions that drive client value and solve/automate internal workflow challenges.

THE ROLE

As an Activation, Senior Analyst on our Activation team, you’ll support client relationships, oversee campaign execution, manage complex retail and digital media projects, and lead many aspects of program management and innovation. You’ll succeed in this role if you’re a natural leader, have exceptional communication and organizational skills, and are a creative problem solver with an instinct to use data to drive marketplace growth.

What You Will Do:

  • Lead hands-on-keys execution, pacing, and optimization across core biddable channels, with a primary focus on Programmatic DSPs (specifically DV360) and Paid Social (Meta), alongside video and retail media platforms.
  • Support your clients and vendors; track, escalate, and solve client issues related to media performance, inventory, and retail readiness.
  • Partner with clients to understand their business goals, e-commerce/marketing objectives, and competitive constraints within the retail media landscape.
  • Work closely with your Manager and other Kepler team members to design and execute sophisticated, full-funnel media programs that deliver breakthrough client results.
  • Execute and monitor all aspects of campaign setup, pacing, and optimization; measure performance using sophisticated data analysis and retail metrics (e.g., ROAS, New-to-Brand, glance views).
  • Contribute to weekly, monthly, and annual client insights and strategy reports; leverage data from Amazon Marketing Cloud (AMC) and other clean rooms to contribute to ongoing program analysis and closed-loop measurement.

Desired Skills and Experience:

  • 1–3+ years of hands-on-keys activation experience required, specifically with DV360 (or equivalent programmatic DSPs) and Meta Ads Manager. Experience with Display, Online Video (OLV), and Retail Media Networks (e.g., Amazon DSP) is a strong asset.
  • Strong interest and/or experience in client services, digital media, and e-commerce growth strategies.
  • Ability to “do what it takes” and manage a complex workload that spans program execution, continuous optimization, and client communications.
  • Strong analytical skills, and comfort with MS Excel, data analysis, and internet technologies. Familiarity with SQL or Amazon Marketing Cloud (AMC) is a significant advantage.
  • Excellent listening and communication skills with a strong ability to translate complex media metrics into actionable business insights for clients.
  • Ability to self-manage, juggle multiple priorities, and pay strong attention to detail in a fast-moving marketplace environment.
  • Ability to contribute to a fast-paced, entrepreneurial, collaborative team environment.

Transparency is fundamental to Kepler’s culture. Our compensation strategy is designed to attract, reward, and retain the talented employees that drive Kepler’s growth and success. title: Technical Product & Solutions Manager – Networks & Security
description:
Step into the innovative world of LG Electronics. As a global leader in technology, LG Electronics is dedicated to creating innovative solutions for a better life. Our brand promise, 'Life's Good', embodies our commitment to ensuring a happier life for all. We have a rich history spanning over six decades and a global presence in over 290 locations. Our diverse portfolio includes Home Appliance Solutions, Media Entertainment Solutions, Vehicle Solutions, and Eco Solutions. Our management philosophy, "Jeong-do Management," embodies our commitment to high ethical standards and transparent operations. Grounded in the principles of 'Customer-Value Creation' and 'People-Oriented Management', these values shape our corporate culture, fostering creativity, diversity, and integrity. At LG, we believe in the power of collective wisdom through an inclusive work environment. Join us and become a part of a company that is shaping the future of technology. At LG, we strive to make Life Good for Everyone.

Job Description
LG Electronics' Information Display Division is seeking a Technical Product & Solutions Manager – Networks & Security to join our rapidly growing Software Solutions business at our office in Lincolnshire, IL. This is an in-office position (5 days/week).


The Technical Product & Solutions Manager – Networks & Security will serve as LG's subject matter expert for enterprise networking, network administration, and information security as they relate to the deployment and integration of LG's digital signage hardware and cloud-based Remote Monitoring & Management (RMS) and Content Management System (CMS) software in Enterprise, Operational Technology (OT), Retail, Healthcare, Transportation, and Government environments.


This is not an internal IT position administering LG's internal infrastructure. Instead, you will represent LG while working directly with customers' IT, network engineering, network administration, and information security teams to ensure successful deployment, integration, security, and ongoing operation of LG commercial display solutions.
The ideal candidate combines strong product management capabilities with deep hands-on experience in enterprise networking, network administration, cybersecurity, customer-facing technical consulting, and solution architecture.


Principal Responsibilities
• Lead the networking and security integration of LG software solutions with customer IT and network infrastructure.
• Act as the primary networking and cybersecurity subject matter expert for enterprise customers, system integrators, and internal teams.
• Work directly with customer network administrators and network engineering teams to design, validate, and troubleshoot connectivity for LG digital signage deployments.
• Recommend cybersecurity best practices, network architecture standards, and security policies for customers deploying LG digital signage solutions.
• Author system and software requirements specifications related to networking, authentication, encryption, security, and compliance for Product Planning and R&D teams.
• Assist customers in debugging, troubleshooting, and resolving networking, communication, authentication, and security issues in production environments.
• Analyze and troubleshoot issues involving TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, routing, switching, VLANs, Wi-Fi, VPNs, firewalls, proxies, multicast traffic, and cloud connectivity.
• Maintain, administer, troubleshoot, and continuously improve LG's local lab and demonstration network environments, including switches, routers, wireless infrastructure, VLANs, firewalls, VPNs, and security controls used for product validation, interoperability testing, proof-of-concept activities, customer demonstrations, and engineering development.
• Design, implement, and document lab network architectures that accurately emulate customer enterprise environments to support testing, troubleshooting, security validation, and product development initiatives.
• Evaluate and deploy new networking and security technologies within the lab environment to support next-generation LG software and hardware solutions.
• Support customer security reviews, risk assessments, architecture reviews, and vendor security questionnaires.
• Strengthen LG's software business competitiveness through discovery of new technologies, proof-of-concept initiatives, and evaluation of emerging networking and cybersecurity solutions.
• Collaborate with Sales, Marketing, Product Planning, and R&D to develop next-generation secure software solutions that align with evolving industry networking and security standards.
• Build and maintain strong relationships with customers by understanding their business objectives, technical environments, and operational challenges.
• Generate proposals, presentations, technical documentation, and customer-facing materials that effectively communicate LG's networking and security capabilities and value proposition.
• Work closely with Sales and Business Development teams to ensure successful onboarding, deployment, and long-term customer success.
• Perform SWOT analysis of LG commercial display products and cloud SaaS solutions with respect to networking, security, device management, and enterprise integration capabilities.
• Monitor industry trends, competitive offerings, and emerging technologies in networking, cybersecurity, SaaS, OT, and IoT environments.
• Support customer onboarding, product demonstrations, technical training sessions, webinars, trade shows, and industry events.

Required Qualifications
• Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, Cybersecurity, or a related field.
• Minimum of 8 years of hands-on experience in enterprise network administration, network engineering, network architecture, network operations, or enterprise cybersecurity.
• Demonstrated experience designing, administering, troubleshooting, and securing enterprise network infrastructure.
• Hands-on experience administering enterprise network infrastructure including switches, routers, firewalls, wireless networks, VPNs, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, and network monitoring solutions.
• Experience building, maintaining, and troubleshooting test, development, or lab network environments used for validation, demonstrations, or engineering purposes.
• Direct experience with IAM, PKI, SSO, EDR/XDR, Authentication, Encryption, Certificate Management, MDM, or Device Provisioning.
• In-depth understanding of TCP/IP, UDP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, Routing and Switching, Multicast Networking, Wi-Fi Technologies, Firewalls, VPN Technologies, RESTful APIs, and Network Monitoring.

• Experience administering or supporting enterprise networking platforms from Cisco, Juniper, Aruba, HPE, Fortinet, Palo Alto, Meraki, or equivalent.
• Strong network troubleshooting skills including packet capture and protocol analysis using Wireshark, tcpdump, or equivalent.
• Ability to debug complex networking, communication, authentication, and cloud connectivity issues across distributed environments.
• Excellent verbal, written, presentation, and interpersonal communication skills.
• Strong analytical, technical, and problem-solving capabilities.
• Ability to communicate effectively with both highly technical stakeholders and executive audiences.
• Ability to travel domestically and internationally up to 10% of the time.


Preferred Qualifications
• Industrial OT and IoT cybersecurity experience.
• SaaS, PaaS, cloud infrastructure, and data orchestration experience.
• Experience supporting large-scale endpoint deployments and device management platforms.
• Experience with Zero Trust architectures and modern enterprise security frameworks.
• Professional certifications such as CCNA, CCNP, CISSP, CISM, Security+, Palo Alto, Fortinet, Aruba, or equivalent.
• Product management experience supporting enterprise software, cloud platforms, networking products, or cybersecurity solutions.

The Data Platform & Integration Engineer is responsible for building the firm's modern data warehouse and integration platform from the ground up. Reporting to the Manager, Enterprise Applications, this individual will own the design, implementation, and ongoing management of Snowflake as the enterprise data warehouse and MuleSoft as the enterprise integration platform while establishing the firm's overall data platform, governance, and lineage strategy.

Responsibilities

  • Own the firm's enterprise data platform and data lineage strategy, including cataloging and lineage tracking across Snowflake and MuleSoft-connected systems.

  • Develop scalable ELT/ETL pipelines and data models using Snowpipe, Streams and Tasks, dbt, and related technologies to support reporting and analytics needs.
  • Establish Snowflake security, governance, data masking, performance tuning, and cost optimization practices.
  • Lead the adoption and implementation of MuleSoft, designing APIs and integration flows that connect the firm's critical business applications.

  • Develop and enforce data governance policies while monitoring data quality, security, and reliability across the organization.

  • Own the technology roadmap for continued platform maturity and evaluate emerging technologies to support future growth.
  • Support enterprise applications, reporting, dashboards, analytics initiatives, and firmwide technology projects.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve platform and integration issues while serving as the primary escalation point for related technologies.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Information Systems, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 8+ years of experience in data engineering, systems integration, platform development, or related disciplines, including experience building enterprise data and integration environments from the ground up.
  • Strong proficiency in SQL and at least one programming or scripting language such as Python, Java, or DataWeave.
  • Demonstrated experience designing and implementing ETL/ELT pipelines, enterprise data models, and cloud-based data warehouse solutions.
  • Hands-on experience with Snowflake or comparable cloud data warehouse platforms such as Databricks, Redshift, or BigQuery, including administration, performance tuning, and role-based security.
  • Experience with enterprise integration or iPaaS platforms, ideally MuleSoft, including API design and development using REST, SOAP, and RAML/OAS specifications.
  • Strong understanding of API-led connectivity, reusable API design, integration architecture patterns, and application networks.
  • Experience with data governance, metadata management, data quality, data cataloging, and data lineage tools such as Snowflake Horizon Catalog, Atlan, Collibra, or Alation.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, Infrastructure as Code, event-driven architecture, and messaging technologies such as Apache Kafka.
  • Proven ability to independently lead technology initiatives from requirements gathering through architecture, implementation, deployment, and ongoing operational support.
  • Experience with legal technology platforms such as Fulcrum, Intapp, NetDocuments, Aderant, or Elite, or experience within a professional services or legal environment, is preferred.
  • Relevant technical certifications, such as Microsoft Certified: Azure Data Engineer Associate, are a plus.
  • Exceptional analytical, troubleshooting, problem-solving, communication, and organizational skills, with the ability to effectively communicate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.

title: Federal Travel Program Specialist
description:
Title: Federal Travel Program Specialist

Schedule: Full-time, Monday-Friday
Salary: $70,000-$85,000, commensurate with experience

KMRG, LLC (KMRG) is a federal services company that hires talented professionals to support Government agencies and the communities they serve. We are hiring a Federal Travel Program Specialist to join our team and provide remote travel-management support to the Federal Retirement Thrift Investment Board (FRTIB).
In this role, you will provide end-to-end support for official Government travel, including travel planning, authorizations, reservations, vouchers, approval workflows, reimbursement processing, reporting, training, and electronic travel-system support.

This position is a strong fit for someone with substantial federal travel-program experience who is organized, customer-focused, comfortable training users, and skilled at translating complex travel regulations into clear and practical guidance.

Applications will be reviewed as they are received. Apply today!

RESPONSIBILITIES
Federal Travel Planning & Authorizations
  • Assist employees with planning official Government travel and estimating anticipated travel costs
  • Help travelers identify airfare, lodging, meals and incidental expenses, rental vehicles, and other reimbursable expenses
  • Prepare, review, route, and monitor travel authorizations before official travel begins
  • Verify accounting codes, funding lines, supporting documentation, and required justifications
  • Ensure travel requests comply with the Federal Travel Regulation, GSA guidance, and Agency policies
  • Establish and maintain appropriate supervisory, budgetary, and financial approval paths
  • Resolve returned actions, routing errors, incomplete documentation, and approval delays
  • Provide additional coordination for international, VIP, and other high-visibility travel
Reservation & Booking Support
  • Assist travelers with airfare, lodging, and rental-car reservations
  • Make, modify, or cancel reservations electronically or through the appropriate Travel Management Center
  • Verify Government city-pair fares, lodging per diem limits, and applicable travel requirements
  • Determine the appropriate use of Individually Billed Accounts and Centrally Billed Accounts
  • Coordinate itinerary changes and cancellations resulting from mission or administrative needs
  • Support web-based reservation functions and apply knowledge of Global Distribution Systems
Travel Vouchers & Reimbursement
  • Prepare, review, route, and monitor travel vouchers and local vouchers
  • Compare vouchers against approved travel authorizations and supporting documentation
  • Review claimed expenses for accuracy, allowability, and regulatory compliance
  • Validate mileage, transit, parking, lodging, airfare, and other allowable travel expenses
  • Identify and resolve errors that could delay reimbursement
  • Support electronic processing of approved reimbursements through the financial-management system
Electronic Travel-System Support
  • Provide functional and technical support for E2 Solutions and associated travel systems
  • Assist users with travel authorizations, reservations, vouchers, reimbursements, and system navigation
  • Troubleshoot system errors, workflow issues, and travel-system integration problems
  • Create, configure, and maintain travel workflows and approval-routing paths
  • Administer protected user roles, permissions, and role-based access
  • Coach users on travel-system functions and proper travel-processing procedures
Go.gov Transition Support

  • Map existing authorization, voucher, approval, payment, and reporting workflows to Go.gov
  • Support system configuration, user-role administration, workflow validation, and readiness activities
  • Assist with system testing, issue resolution, and process adjustments
  • Help maintain uninterrupted travel operations throughout the transition
  • Support users before, during, and after Go.gov implementation
Training & Customer Support

  • Provide live virtual training sessions, webinars, and remote desk-side support
  • Develop or deliver short instructional modules for onboarding, system updates, policy changes, and refresher training

  • Explain Federal Travel Regulation and Agency requirements in clear, user-friendly language
  • Maintain responsive and professional customer support throughout each travel action

  • Extract and compile information from the electronic travel system and related systems
  • Prepare Government travel, travel-card, management, compliance, and audit-support reports
  • Review travel data for accuracy and completeness
  • Maintain supporting documentation and records in approved formats
  • Apply quality-control procedures to travel actions, workflows, reports, and deliverables
  • Support quarterly reporting, phase-in planning, and phase-out planning
  • Protect Government Furnished Information and Government Furnished Property
  • Perform related federal travel-management duties within the scope of the position

REQUIRED BACKGROUND
  • Minimum of 3 years of federal agency travel-program experience
  • Demonstrated experience processing federal travel authorizations and vouchers
  • Strong working knowledge of the Federal Travel Regulation
  • Experience using E2 Solutions or another federal electronic travel system
  • Experience assisting federal employees and approving officials with travel matters
  • Experience providing travel-policy guidance, customer support, or user training
  • Experience creating or maintaining travel workflows and approval-routing paths
  • Ability to interpret travel regulations and apply them to specific travel situations
  • Experience reviewing travel expenses, documentation, accounting information, and reimbursement requests
  • Ability to comply with Agency policies, procedures, privacy requirements, and operational protocols

PREFERRED BACKGROUND
  • Direct experience administering E2 Solutions
  • Experience supporting a federal agency travel office or travel program
  • Experience with Go.gov implementation, testing, configuration, training, or operations
  • Experience supporting international or high-visibility Government travel
  • Experience with Government travel cards, including Individually Billed Accounts and Centrally Billed Accounts
  • Experience extracting travel data and preparing Government reports
  • Existing favorably adjudicated federal background investigation eligible for reciprocity

LOCATION

  • Candidates located in the Eastern Time Zone are preferred

TRAVEL

CLEARANCE

  • The minimum acceptable investigation is a National Agency Check with Inquiries (NACI)

CLIENT

title: Test Automation Engineer Intern - Fall 2026
description:
About Redwood Materials

Redwood is localizing a global battery supply chain that seamlessly integrates recovery, reuse, and recycling — keeping critical minerals in circulation and driving the energy transition. Founded in 2017, we’re delivering low-cost and large-scale energy storage and producing battery materials in the U.S. for the first time, all from batteries we already have.

Test Automation Engineering Intern

Redwood Energy is building some of the fastest, lowest-cost energy storage in the U.S. from both new battery modules and second-life EV packs. Second-life hardware arrives with a history — different chemistries, capacities, and states of health — and every unit has to be proven safe and reliable before it ships. That proof comes from test: the automated systems that exercise the firmware and electronics inside our products and decide whether they're ready for the field.

Our test engineering team builds those systems — the test stands on the production floor, the hardware-in-the-loop benches that validate firmware releases, and the CI pipelines that tie them together. As a Test Automation Engineering Intern, you'll work alongside our engineers building the next generation of this test capability. You'll write Python that drives real instruments and real battery hardware, help bring up new test stands from the bench up, and debug failures where the root cause could live in the test code, the firmware, or the unit under test. This is a great opportunity to apply what you've learned in coursework to production test systems, with mentorship from experienced engineers along the way.

Responsibilities will include:

  • Test Automation: Write and maintain Python test automation for firmware and hardware validation, using pytest and our internal test frameworks.
  • Instrument Control: Develop drivers and tooling for programmable power supplies, electronic loads, data acquisition, and switching hardware over protocols like SCPI, CAN, and Modbus.
  • Test Stand Bring-Up: Help bring up new test stands — from fixtures and wiring through the software that sequences them — as we expand our validation capability.
  • System Debugging: Investigate real failures on real equipment, using CAN traces, instrument logs, and bench tools to determine whether the fault lies in the test code, the fixture, or the unit under test.
  • Continuous Integration: Add regression coverage to our CI pipelines so firmware changes are validated automatically rather than by hand.
  • Documentation & Process: Contribute to documentation and test processes that support taking test systems from prototype toward production.
  • You'll own a scoped project end to end and present your results to the engineering team at the close of the internship.

Desired Qualifications:

  • Background: Currently pursuing a BS or MS in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Mechatronics, or a related field.
  • Programming Foundations: Working proficiency in Python, including comfort reading and modifying a codebase you did not write.
  • Testing Experience: Experience writing automated tests with pytest or a comparable framework, from coursework, projects, or prior internships.
  • Version Control: Experience with Git and a pull-request-based development workflow.
  • EE Fundamentals: Solid grasp of circuit basics — voltage, current, resistance, and power, and how they relate — sufficient to predict what a measurement should read and recognize when it doesn't.
  • Hardware Fundamentals: Able to read a schematic, wiring diagram, or datasheet and act on it; hands-on experience working safely around energized equipment — power supplies, loads, or battery hardware — from lab work, projects, or prior internships.
  • Communication Protocols: Familiarity with CAN, Modbus, SCPI, or other instrument and industrial protocols is a plus, even if only from classwork or personal projects.
  • Linux: Familiarity with the Linux command line is a plus.
  • Curiosity & Rigor: A safety-conscious mindset, strong attention to detail, and eagerness to learn how production test systems are built. Prior industry or energy storage experience is not expected.

$41—$47.50 USD

  • Implement vision systems for robotic guidance, quality control and data collection.
  • Design systems to control processes, track factory performance and collaborate across teams to increase manufacturing efficiency in a data driven way.
  • Design user interfaces that make complex machines easy to use and troubleshoot.
  • Create electrical, pneumatic and fluid schematics for control panels.
  • Keep our factories safe by implementing ANSI/RIA15.06/OSHA compliant systems.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Computer Science/Engineering or another STEM field.
  • 1+ years’ experience in the design and commissioning of automation and controls systems for manufacturing (internships/co-ops can apply).

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

Hands on experience with at least one of the specific disciplines below and interest in learning the other areas you are not yet strong in:

Industrial Automation:

  • Automation Hardware: PLC’s, COTS Robots, servo motion, machine vision, distributed IO, pneumatic controls, etc.
  • Field Bus Networking protocols: EtherCAT, Profinet, Ethernet/IP, Modbus TCP/RTU, etc.
  • Machinery and processes: dispenser, pick and place, fastener installation, automated bonding, thermo-compression, soldering, ultrasonic welding, temperature & position control, injection molders, die casters, etc. and design for manufacturing.
  • Applied Statistical Process Control and other data tools (descriptive, inferential, regression, correlation) to improve manufacturing processes.
  • Safely testing and commissioning integrated systems

Software:

  • PLC programming, preferably Beckhoff TwinCAT structured text, state machines, applying Object Oriented Programming to mechanical assemblies, electrical systems, sensors, pneumatics/hydraulics, etc.
  • Robotics programming, preferably ABB Rapid.
  • HMI, SCADA, IoT (MQTT, OPC-UA), SQL, C#, .NET, Python.
  • Industrial machine vision, Cognex Vision Pro preferred, Halcon & OpenCV acceptable.

Electrical:

  • Electrical sizing of motors, cables, circuit protection, VFD’s, motor starters, various other motion systems.
  • Design of fail-safe electrical circuits using both safety logic controllers and safety-rated relays.
  • Hands-on experience troubleshooting industrial electrical systems using tools like multimeters, oscilloscopes, EMI probes.
  • Proficiency in understanding and creating electrical schematics and single line diagrams (EPLAN preferred).
  • Analog signal integrity and EMI reduction.
  • Hands-on experience designing and commissioning high quality electrical panels and electro-mechanical systems with appropriate safety considerations in mind.
  • Knowledge of NEC, NFPA, UL508A codes with ability to ensure compliance with control system safety standards.
  • Proven ability to solve complex problems with simple solutions and little supervision.
  • Excited by a fast-paced environment, strong desire and ability to learn quickly and adapt.
  • Excellent communication skills both written and verbal.

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

Must be willing to work extended hours and/or weekends as needed to meet mission critical deadlines.

COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:

Pay Range:
Level 1: $100,000.00 - $117,500.00
Level 2: $115,000.00 - $140,000.00

Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience.

Base salary is just one part of your total rewards package at SpaceX. You may also be eligible for long-term incentives, in the form of company stock or long-term cash awards, as well as potential discretionary bonuses and the ability to purchase additional stock at a discount through an Employee Stock Purchase Plan. title: Marketing Data Analyst (all genders)
description:
Your role

We are looking for a curious and insightful Marketing Data Analyst (all genders) to join our expanding Commercial Data Science team. You will play a pivotal role in shaping how we understand our customers and optimize our marketing efforts across marketing channels and countries.

In this role, you won’t just report numbers, you will be a strategic partner. You will connect the dots between acquisition and retention, using data to uncover narratives that drive efficiency and growth. If you are passionate about the intersection of data, marketing, and business impact, we would love to meet you.

  • Collaborate closely with Performance Marketing, CRM, and Influencer teams to align data insights with our acquisition and retention goals

  • Analyze complex datasets from ad platforms, such as Google, Meta, TikTok, web analytics (GA4), and internal order systems to refine targeting and budget allocation across channels and countries

  • Leverage dbt and BigQuery to ensure our marketing data models are robust, reliable, and ready for decision-making

  • Build intuitive dashboards with Tableau that provide stakeholders with clear and actionable insights

  • Design and analyze A/B tests and geo-lift studies and focus relentlessly on incremental lift, helping stakeholders understand what revenue we wouldn't have generated without a specific marketing touchpoint

  • Utilize, co-develop and validate our in-house Media Mix Models (MMM) to assess the holistic impact of our marketing spend and implement advanced analytical methods to optimize our marketing

Your profile

  • 3-5 years in data analytics with a focus on commercial or marketing topics

  • Strong SQL skills are essential - you are self-sufficient in querying and manipulating large datasets within cloud environments like BigQuery to answer complex business questions

  • You design intuitive dashboards and reports that guide the user and present data in a way that allows stakeholders to effortlessly draw the right conclusions and make informed decisions

  • You have a solid understanding of the D2C marketing mix, incl. Performance, CRM, and Influencer and the KPIs that drive them, such as CAC, CLV, MER, retention rates

  • You are proactive, thrive in fast-paced environments and are able to navigate shifting priorities and manage multiple projects with a solution-oriented mindset

  • You excel at translating complex data into clear business insights and feel comfortable engaging with stakeholders to refine ideas and strategies

What we offer

  • An appealing discount on all of our products – from essential oils to vitamins & nutrients

  • We offer 28 days of paid time off per year plus up to 5 days off between Christmas and New Year

  • The Urban Sports Club membership and either Swapfiets bike rental or a subsidy for the Deutschlandticket

  • We believe great things happen when we meet in person, which is why we embrace a hybrid model with one home office day per week – up to two depending on the area you are working in – and up to two weeks per year working from abroad

  • Receive various discounts of up to more than 50 percent on attractive brands such as Flaconi, Bosch, Apple or Expedia

  • You will be given real ownership and plenty of room for new initiatives, as well as the opportunity to contribute your expertise and implement your great ideas

  • Inviting office spaces with access to plenty of organic teas and superfoods from around the world

  • We like to celebrate each other! Regular tea & office parties, Christmas and summer feasts and various influencer events such as Women's Day

Apply with your CV and cover letter.

Sunday Natural emerged from a long-standing passion and research in the fields of health, healing, and personal growth. The lack of natural, high-quality products on the market was the original motivation for founding Sunday Natural in 2013. We aim to produce the products we ourselves would love to buy – as natural as possible, absolutely pure, free from any additives, and of the highest quality. In a strategic partnership with CVC, Sunday Natural is now one of Germany's most renowned quality manufacturers, with its own research and development department in Berlin. For the continuous improvement of our products, we collaborate with selected research institutes, scientists, therapists, farmers, and professional associations.

We take our ecological responsibility very seriously: that’s why the majority of our product range is vegan. We also take an innovative approach to packaging: most of our products are packaged in glass, making them almost entirely recyclable.

Our diverse team in Berlin consists of over 350 employees from more than 45 nationalities and continues to grow – but at a sustainable pace. Our goal is to foster a collaborative, supportive, and inclusive work environment with a diverse group of motivated, talented, and visionary team members.

We highly value equality of opportunity and inclusivity, and we would like to particularly encourage women and candidates from under-represented backgrounds to apply, even if you don’t match with 100% of the requirements.

description:
Intetics Inc., a global technology company providing custom software application development, distributed professional teams, software product quality assessment, and “all-things-digital” solutions, is seeking a highly skilled and experienced Senior AI-Native Engineer to join our dynamic team on a full-time basis.

Role Overview

Our partner ships AI-powered selling and sales intelligence products in a market that moves faster every day. We are focused on quality, functionality, and speed to delivery, and the engineers who thrive here don't treat AI tools as a productivity add-on — they've fundamentally changed how they work, using agentic development workflows to go from specification to production-ready code faster than they could before, without sacrificing correctness or quality.

This is not a role for someone who favors traditional software development, or is curious about AI-assisted development and plans to explore it. It's a role for someone who already works this way — who writes clear, machine-readable specifications that feed the agentic development system, uses agentic development tools as standard equipment, and applies genuine critical judgment to what these tools produce before it ships. You'll build systems and features that power real customer outcomes in a B2B SaaS platform at scale, and you'll do it inside a delivery model where human judgment is the differentiating input, not the bottleneck.

If you want to work on meaningful software with teammates who hold the bar high on both speed and craft, this role is for you.

What You'll Do

Agentic Development Systems

  • Lead the definition of spec and implementation standards for your feature area — write executable SDD/BDD specs that set the quality bar for your team, and keep them current as implementation evolves.
  • Use agentic coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, or equivalents) as standard equipment across the full SDLC, and drive adoption of AI-first development practices within your team.
  • Apply critical judgment to AI-generated code and agentic attestations before merge — assess correctness, edge cases, security implications, and alignment with the spec; your review is a real gate, not a formality.
  • Shape the team's agentic development norms: spec standards, attestation practices, and responsible AI tool use.
  • Act as an advocate for Agentic & Spec-Driven Development (SDD) — influence engineering practices, demonstrate real-world production delivery without manual coding bottlenecks, and align distributed teams around AI-first norms.

Feature Delivery

  • Lead the technical execution of complex features and cross-team systems, owning them end-to-end from spec through production.
  • Design, implement, and ship solutions that are reliable, maintainable, and built to perform in high-volume, high-availability SaaS environments.
  • Anticipate where complexity will compound — surface systemic risks early before they become problems for your team or your customers.

Code Quality & Review

  • Review AI-generated code and agentic attestations with the rigor the team depends on; catch what automation misses and raise the bar for what "good" looks like.
  • Orchestrate unit and integration test development that verifies real behavior, not just execution paths.
  • Contribute to and help define the team's technical standards across all facets of the AI SDLC.

Collaboration & Mentorship

  • Serve as a go-to technical voice on engineering practices within your team; mentor L1 and L2 engineers and make the people around you better.
  • Work closely with product managers, designers, and QA engineers to understand requirements and build the right thing, not just the specified thing.
  • Communicate clearly in writing — in specs, in code reviews, in async updates — to keep cross-functional and globally distributed teams aligned.
  • Participate in agile and team ceremonies, including Sprint Review, Program Reviews, and other technical presentations.

What Success Looks Like

  • You lead complex features from spec to production using agentic workflows, and can speak concretely to how that changed delivery speed and code quality.
  • Your specs are clear, your tests are meaningful, and your PRs tell a coherent story — your output is easy for teammates to review, extend, and maintain.
  • AI-generated code you've attested has not introduced regressions or security issues past your review; your attestation means something.
  • Junior engineers on your team are measurably better because of your mentorship and code review.
  • You anticipate where complexity will compound and surface it early — your team doesn't get surprised by problems you saw coming.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of experience developing enterprise or SaaS software in production environments.
  • Personal fluency with agentic coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, or equivalents) — you use these in your daily work and real delivery scenarios, not as an experiment.
  • Proven experience creating and using agentic development systems with genuine rigor — spec-first workflows, attestation practices, BDD/SDD — this is how we work, not a practice you're learning on the job.
  • Demonstrated track record of shipping complex features independently, end-to-end.
  • Proficiency in modern backend/full-stack technologies, with strong experience in Golang, PHP, or Node.js/TypeScript ecosystem, along with solid unit/integration testing skills.
  • Experience with RESTful API design and consumption.
  • Working knowledge of SQL and NoSQL data stores.
  • Experience producing and maintaining automated test suites (unit, integration, or end-to-end).
  • Experience working in Agile delivery environments with CI/CD pipelines.
  • Strong written communication skills; able to write clear specs, meaningful code review feedback, and async updates for a global team.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS or equivalent) and microservices architectures.
  • Familiarity with containerization, infrastructure-as-code, or observability tooling.
  • Experience developing or integrating with AI/ML features in a production SaaS product.
  • Background in B2B SaaS, CRM, or revenue technology.

title: Senior Buchhalter:in (all genders)
description:
Deine Rolle

Als Senior Buchhalter:in (all genders) suchen wir eine vielseitige und engagierte Persönlichkeit mit einem sehr guten Auge fürs Detail. Werde Teil unseres offenen und herzlichen 10-köpfigen Finance-Teams bei Sunday Natural und arbeite eng mit unserem Head of Accounting zusammen. Mit dem Wachstum unseres Accounting-Teams ist dies eine Senior-Rolle für jemanden, der/die echte Verantwortung für die tägliche Arbeit des Teams übernimmt und als erfahrene Ansprechperson für das Team fungiert.


Deine Aufgaben

  • Du verantwortest und pflegst die Hauptbuchhaltung und kontrollierst automatisch generierte Ausgangsrechnungen in unserem ERP-System Odoo

  • Du übernimmst federführend die Erstellung der Monatsabschlüsse, unterstützt beim Jahresabschluss nach HGB und stellst sicher, dass alle Bilanzabstimmungen, Abgrenzungen, aktive Rechnungsabgrenzungsposten und Rückstellungen korrekt, eigenständig und termingerecht erfolgen

  • Du bist verantwortlich für die Erstellung der Umsatzsteuervoranmeldungen und die Abstimmung mit externen Steuerberatern und Finanzbehörden

  • Du erstellst Intercompany-Rechnungen und -Zahlungen, stimmst diese ab und stellst damit eine ordnungsgemäße Intercompany-Buchhaltung sicher

  • Du unterstützt bei IFRS-relevanten Reporting-Themen und bringst deine Expertise beim weiteren Aufbau unserer Konzernkonsolidierung ein

  • Du bist erste Ansprechperson für das Accounting-Team bei fachlichen Fragen und führst regelmäßige inhaltliche Checks der vom Team vorbereiteten Buchungen durch und arbeitest aktiv mit funktionsübergreifenden Teams zusammen

Dein Profil

  • Du verfügst über eine Ausbildung, idealerweise in der Bilanzbuchhaltung, als Steuerfachangestellte:r oder hast ein kaufmännisches Studium abgeschlossen, sowie mindestens 5 Jahre Berufserfahrung im Accounting/Finance

  • Du hast fundierte Kenntnisse der handelsrechtlichen Rechnungslegung (HGB) sowie Erfahrung mit IFRS und sichere Anwenderkenntnisse in Excel und ERP-Systemen

  • Du arbeitest strukturiert, sorgfältig und proaktiv und kannst dich gut in ein bestehendes Team integrieren

  • Du hast großes Interesse an der Digitalisierung und Automatisierung unserer Finance-Prozesse

  • Idealerweise bringst du Erfahrung im Umgang mit internationalen Steuerthemen (z. B. UK, Polen, Schweiz, Tschechien) mit, auch die vorherige Erfahrung in einem D2C-Business ist von Vorteil

  • Du blühst in einem dynamischen Scale-up-Umfeld auf und lässt dich von den Herausforderungen eines wachsenden, international ausgerichteten Unternehmens motivieren

  • Du verfügst über Deutschkenntnisse auf C2 Niveau, sowie verhandlungssichere Englischkenntnisse (C1) und bist in Berlin oder Umgebung ansässig

Was wir bieten

  • Ein ansprechender Rabatt auf unsere gesamte Produktpalette – von den Aromen bis hin zu den Vital- & Nährstoffen

  • Wir bieten 28 Tage Urlaub sowie bis zu 5 extra Urlaubstage durch unsere Betriebsferien zwischen Weihnachten und Neujahr

  • Die Urban Sports Club Mitgliedschaft und Swapfiets Fahrräder zur kostenlosen Nutzung oder einen Zuschuss zum Deutschlandticket

  • Wir glauben, wir erreichen am meisten im persönlichen Austausch, daher arbeiten wir in einem hybriden Modell, das einen Home-Office-Tag pro Woche (bis zu zwei, abhängig von deiner Rolle) sowie die Option auf bis zu zwei Wochen Remote Work pro Jahr ermöglicht

  • Erhalte verschieden hohe Rabatte bis zu mehr als 50 Prozent auf bekannte Marken wie Flaconi, Bosch, Apple oder Expedia

  • Ownership und viel Raum für neue Initiativen sowie die Möglichkeit, dein Know-How einzubringen und deine eigenen Ideen in die Tat umzusetzen

  • Wir feiern gerne miteinander! Regelmäßige Tee- & Office-Parties, Weihnachts- und Sommerfeste und zahlreiche Influencer-Events wie zum Women's Day

Neugierig geworden? Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung!

Sunday Natural emerged from a long-standing passion and research in the fields of health, healing, and personal growth. The lack of natural, high-quality products on the market was the original motivation for founding Sunday Natural in 2013. We aim to produce the products we ourselves would love to buy – as natural as possible, absolutely pure, free from any additives, and of the highest quality. In a strategic partnership with CVC, Sunday Natural is now one of Germany's most renowned quality manufacturers, with its own research and development department in Berlin. For the continuous improvement of our products, we collaborate with selected research institutes, scientists, therapists, farmers, and professional associations.

We take our ecological responsibility very seriously: that’s why the majority of our product range is vegan. We also take an innovative approach to packaging: most of our products are packaged in glass, making them almost entirely recyclable.

Our diverse team in Berlin consists of over 350 employees from more than 45 nationalities and continues to grow – but at a sustainable pace. Our goal is to foster a collaborative, supportive, and inclusive work environment with a diverse group of motivated, talented, and visionary team members.

We highly value equality of opportunity and inclusivity, and we would like to particularly encourage women and candidates from under-represented backgrounds to apply, even if you don’t match with 100% of the requirements.

title: Strategic Researcher
description:
About Us

Macrae is a premier transatlantic legal search firm placing partners and groups at the world’s leading law firms. Our growth stems from a business model that is distinct in our industry and a culture that is collaborative, inclusive, and transparent. We strive to be the right long-term fit for everyone who joins, so we focus on hiring exceptional individuals to add immediate value to the firm through their unique talents and contributions.

About This Role

This is a hybrid position (2 to 3 days per week in the office) for a professional with documented research experience in a law firm market intelligence/business intelligence role, in a government-adjacent or highly regulated professional services firm, in government, or as a paralegal or legal talent sourcing professional with a focus on secondary research. This position is ideally located in DC

Strategic researchers gather data from secondary sources and distill their findings into actionable insights to meet our recruiters’ needs. Our researchers have deep experience in retrieving data and the ability to transform findings into tables, charts, action items, and longer reports. They are experienced in analytical frameworks and are agile, adaptive learners of new programs as needed to parse and present data. AI in particular is becoming a standard part of our secondary research and analysis toolkit, and our team utilizes AI to support their research.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Conduct research using information sources that target the legal and recruiting industries in the US and UK, and supplement with research from other sources
  • Deliver written research on ad hoc topics with reference to legal markets, specific law firms, and their clients.
  • Help develop and populate internal databases used in our search process including coding specific law firm practice areas and market specializations.
  • Complete targeted candidate searches and business development intelligence as requested from recruiters and staff.
  • Maintain and update shared internal information sources in Power BI and SharePoint.

Requirements and Qualifications

  • Experience: 3–5+ years in an intelligence/information function supporting a business in an information-intensive field is preferred. Experience in government law or general legal practice is highly desirable.
  • Domain Knowledge: Strong knowledge of secondary sources used by researchers in legal or professional services or in government (transactions, finance, dockets, industry rankings, legislation/regulation, legal industry news, government news sources, general business research).
  • Critical Thinking: A strong continuous-improvement mindset regarding what makes research quality excellent, and how to make it better.
  • Technical Skills: Demonstrated experience with Word templates and Excel features like formulas, pivot tables, and conditional formatting. Skills with Power BI, Visio, Tableau, PowerPoint, SharePoint, or other products often used for data presentation are highly desirable.
  • AI Fluency: Professional-level AI expertise (CoPilot, Gemini, ChatGPT, or Claude). Applicants should be prepared to discuss this experience during the interview process.

Applicants should be prepared to offer examples of their output and/or complete a case study to confirm that we have a shared understanding of abilities and expectations.

Recruiting and retaining extraordinary staff begins with building a platform that staff wish to join, coupled with attractive compensation and a comprehensive benefits package. Macrae believes our total package is among the most competitive in our industry. The expected salary range for this position is $100K-$130K commensurate with experience.

title: Power Platform Administrator
description:
Are you passionate about empowering teams with low-code solutions and AI-assisted tools in a safe and secure environment? As a Power Platform Administrator at Gas South, you will play a pivotal role on our Infrastructure team by managing and optimizing our Microsoft Power Platform environment and Microsoft 365 Copilot services. In this position, you will administer and monitor Power Platform applications (Power Apps, Power Automate, Power Virtual Agents) and emerging AI features like Copilot Studio/Agent 365, ensuring they operate smoothly, securely, and in alignment with enterprise policies. You will work closely with Security, IT Service Operations, and Leadership teams to implement standards, and with internal developers and business users to support innovation. We are seeking candidates who are detail-oriented, proactive, and collaborative, with a strong commitment to operational excellence. The ideal candidate has a blend of technical acumen in cloud platform administration and a service-oriented mindset, ready to help Gas South leverage next-generation tools safely and effectively.

Are You a Fit?

Additional Responsibilities

  • Administer the Power Platform Ecosystem: Oversee all Power Platform environments (Power Apps, Power Automate, Power BI integration) including environment provisioning, configuration, and maintenance. Manage tenant settings (e.g., data integration, capacity quotas, updates) to ensure platform health and performance.
  • Microsoft 365 Copilot Administration: Serve as the administrator for Microsoft 365 Copilot (Copilot and Agent in the Microsoft 365 Admin Center) and Copilot Studio (Power Platform Admin Center) within the organization. Configure and manage Copilot features and settings according to business needs and policy (enabling/disabling capabilities, managing authorized user access). Approve and operationalize Copilot agents created by business units, ensuring they meet security and compliance requirements before deployment. Manage and reduce Agent Sprawl across the environment.
  • Platform Support & Troubleshooting: Act as a Tier-III support resource for issues related to Power Platform applications and Copilot usage. Work with internal developers and “citizen developers” to resolve complex platform problems, performing root-cause analysis and engaging Microsoft support if needed.
  • Application Lifecycle Management (ALM): Coordinate solution deployment and upgrades across development, test, and production environments. Manage Power Platform application lifecycle processes (e.g., solution import/export, version control) to support safe and controlled rollout of new apps, flows, and AI agents.
  • User Enablement & Best Practices: Collaborate with development teams and business stakeholders to promote best practices in building low-code solutions and integrating Copilot features. Provide guidance or small-scale assistance (e.g., templates, example solutions) to help teams accelerate projects while following governance guidelines.
  • Monitoring & Optimization: Utilize admin center tools and analytics to track platform utilization, performance metrics, and licensing. Report trends and propose optimizations (e.g., adjusting capacity, consolidating resources) to enhance efficiency and user experience.
  • Documentation & Knowledge Sharing: Create and maintain documentation for platform configurations, administrative procedures, and usage guidelines. Contribute to the internal knowledge base and runbooks for Power Platform and Copilot administration.
  • Cross-Team Collaboration: Work closely with Identity and Access Management (Entra ID/Azure AD) administrators to ensure seamless integration of user provisioning and access controls. Partner with other members of the Infrastructure and Security teams to align platform settings with overall IT policies (such as data retention, incident response, and change management). Engage in regular change control processes for platform updates and communicate effectively with IT and business teams about any impacts.

Experience

  • 5+ years of IT experience, with at least 2-3 years focused on administering or supporting Microsoft Power Platform (Power Apps, Power Automate, etc.) in an enterprise environment.
  • Microsoft Fundamental certification(s) for Power Platforms and Copilot/Agent administration, such as the PL-900 (Power Platform Fundamentals) and the AB-900 (Copilot and Agent Administration).
  • Hands-on experience with Microsoft 365 Administration, including familiarity with Teams, SharePoint, or Exchange Online, and an understanding of how these services integrate with Power Platform and Copilot.
  • Strong knowledge of Azure AD (Entra ID) for managing users, groups, and application permissions, especially as it relates to Power Platform and Microsoft 365 services.
  • Proven ability to implement and enforce policies in technical platforms, working within frameworks established by security team and the business.
  • Experience monitoring and managing cloud service performance and capacity (usage analytics, license management, basic Azure or Power Platform monitoring).
  • Excellent troubleshooting and problem-solving skills, capable of diagnosing complex platform issues and driving them to resolution collaboratively.
  • Effective communication and documentation skills, with the ability to produce clear admin guides, reports, and updates for both technical teams and management.
  • A bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or related field (or equivalent work experience).

Preferred Experience

  • Advanced Microsoft Power Platform certification(s) such as the PL-200 (Power Platform Functional Consultant) and/or PL-600 (Power Platform Solution Architect).
  • Microsoft AI Builder certification(s) such as the AI-900/901 (Azure AI Fundamentals), AB-620 (AI Agent Builder Associate), and or AI-102 (Azure AI Engineer Associate).
  • ITIL Foundation certification or knowledge of IT Service Management best practices, indicating experience with structured change, incident, and problem management processes.
  • Familiarity with Microsoft 365 Copilot and AI technologies in a business context (e.g., previous involvement in deploying AI-driven solutions or virtual assistants) is a strong plus.
  • Experience collaborating on low-code Center of Excellence (CoE) initiatives or contributing to governance boards for new technology rollouts.
  • Exposure to PowerShell scripting or automation tools for administrative task automation within Microsoft 365 or Azure environments.
  • Continuous learning mindset, with a track record of staying updated on new Microsoft cloud features, security updates, and best practices.

Location Requirements

Atlanta, GA or Gainesville, FL (with flexibility for hybrid work arrangements as appropriate)

Physical Requirements

  • Ability to sit for extended periods at a desk or workstation, performing computer-based tasks and collaborating with team members via meetings or calls.
  • Ability to operate standard office IT equipment, including computers, keyboards, and conferencing tools, for prolonged periods.
  • Occasional requirement to connect or configure hardware (such as networking gear or peripheral devices) which may involve stooping, kneeling, or reaching.
  • Ability to travel to Gas South offices or data centers on occasion if necessary.
  • General ability to work in typical office conditions, including sustaining visual focus on screens and managing standard office environmental factors (lighting, climate control, etc.).

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Pay range is commensurate with education, experience, specialized skills or certifications, etc.

Gas South Base Pay Range
$98,106—$109,648 USD

Our Purpose and Culture

At Gas South, we approach each day knowing we have an opportunity to make a difference in people’s lives. That means helping our customers save money with everyday low rates and treating them with dignity, honesty and respect. It means supporting our employees in their personal and professional lives, and it means we want to make sure our success directly benefits the communities we serve by giving back 5% of profits to support children in need. Through partnerships with non-profits like United Way, Salvation Army, Junior Achievement, Bert’s Big Adventure and many others, we’re proud to help make a difference. title: Senior Full Stack Engineer
description:
About the Role

We're a product-focused AI platform and product studio based in Munich, helping hundreds of SMEs integrate AI into their core workflows. Our platform already serves a large and fast-growing user base, and we're scaling toward the next order of magnitude. We're looking for a Senior Full Stack Engineer to join our engineering team and own some of the hardest architectural challenges we face — from multi-terabyte data synchronisation to secure, high-throughput sandbox infrastructure.

This is a hybrid role based in Munich, Germany. No visa sponsorship is available — candidates must be authorised to work in Germany without employer sponsorship.

What You'll Do

  • Architect, build, and ship high-quality full-stack features using React and TypeScript, with a strong focus on long-term scalability and UX.

  • Design and implement systems to synchronise and index terabytes of client data while enforcing fine-grained permissions.

  • Build infrastructure to process millions of LLM calls per month with high reliability and security.

  • Implement scalable, secure code sandbox solutions capable of spawning thousands of sandboxes per day.

  • Create base infrastructure and tooling for fast custom integrations, enabling new systems to be connected in hours.

  • Collaborate on technical roadmaps and align on architectural decisions with the broader engineering team.

  • Debug production incidents, identify root causes, and implement durable fixes to keep the platform stable.

  • Mentor junior engineers and raise the bar across the codebase through constructive, thorough code reviews.

  • Continuously improve development processes, code quality standards, and overall team performance.

What We're Looking For

Required

  • 5+ years of professional experience with React and TypeScript (dealbreaker).

  • 7+ years of overall professional software engineering experience.

  • 2+ years of backend development experience with Node.js/Express or equivalent.

  • Proficiency with containerisation and orchestration using Kubernetes and Docker.

  • Hands-on experience with PostgreSQL, tRPC, and modern CI/CD pipelines.

  • Proven track record designing, scaling, and maintaining complex software architectures for high-growth products.

  • Experience operating at scale: large dataset synchronisation, high-volume API/LLM calls, secure multi-tenant systems.

  • Experience mentoring junior developers or leading a small development team.

  • Ability to own a product roadmap, drive technical decisions aligned with product goals, and collaborate effectively with product managers and designers.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in a cross-functional environment.

  • Authorised to work in Germany without employer visa sponsorship.

Nice to Have

  • Familiarity with AI platforms or AI workflow tooling.

  • Experience in the B2B SaaS or AI/ML industry.

Tech Stack

  • Frontend: React, TypeScript

Compensation & Benefits

  • Salary range: $70,000 – $90,000 per year

  • Join a close-knit, high-ownership engineering team where your architectural decisions have real impact

  • Work on an AI platform at meaningful scale with a growing SME customer base

This position is based in Munich, Germany and follows a hybrid working model. Candidates must be located in or willing to relocate to Munich. Visa sponsorship is not available.
