title: CGI Lead
location: New York, New York, United States
description:
Position Summary:

The CGI Supervisor is responsible for the technical and artistic quality of all 3D computer-generated content across production. Acting as the bridge between creative leadership, production teams, and 3D artists, this role defines technical workflows, oversees asset creation, lighting, rendering, and animation, and ensures the efficient execution of projects from concept through final delivery.

Working within HOME, Wellcom's AI-enabled production ecosystem, the CGI Supervisor leads multidisciplinary CGI teams while helping integrate emerging technologies that improve production efficiency, scalability, and quality. This role ensures all deliverables align with the client's creative vision, brand standards, and technical specifications.



Key Responsibilities:

Pipeline & Workflow Leadership

  • Define, maintain, and continuously optimize the CGI production pipeline to support efficient, scalable project delivery.
  • Collaborate with AI Developers, pipeline engineers, and production teams to implement workflow improvements and automation within HOME.
  • Identify opportunities to streamline rendering, asset management, and production processes through emerging technologies.
  • Ensure pipeline stability, consistency, and adherence to production standards across all CGI projects.

Team Leadership & Mentorship

  • Lead, mentor, and develop a multidisciplinary team of CGI artists, including modeling, texturing, rigging, animation, lighting, look development, FX, and rendering.
  • Assign work based on project priorities, artist expertise, and production schedules.
  • Foster a collaborative, innovative, and high-performing creative environment.
  • Support career development through coaching, feedback, and technical guidance.

Technical Direction & Problem Solving

  • Serve as the primary technical authority for complex CGI production challenges.
  • Troubleshoot issues involving modeling, lighting, rendering, simulations, shaders, and production workflows.
  • Work closely with technical teams to improve tools, optimize rendering performance, and reduce production bottlenecks.
  • Evaluate emerging technologies and recommend improvements to production capabilities.

Creative Direction & Quality Control

  • Oversee look development, lighting, materials, rendering, and overall visual quality across all CGI deliverables.
  • Conduct regular creative and technical reviews, providing constructive feedback to ensure consistency and excellence.
  • Maintain visual continuity across campaigns, assets, and production teams.
  • Ensure work meets client expectations, brand standards, and creative objectives.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner closely with Creative Directors, Senior Art Directors, Production Managers, AI Developers, and Compositing Supervisors throughout the production lifecycle.
  • Establish technical standards for seamless handoffs between CGI, compositing, photography, motion, and post-production teams.

title: Clinical Skills and Simulation Coordinator
description:
Six Nations Polytechnic (SNP) is a unique Indigenous Institute, recognized by community, government, and institutions of higher learning, as a Centre of Excellence for Indigenous Knowledge. SNP offers postsecondary, secondary, trades education and training. SNP has formal partnerships with nine publicly funded Ontario Universities and Colleges and collaborates with six Ontario-based Indigenous owned and controlled post-secondary Institutes.

For more information, visit

JOB PURPOSE

The Clinical Skills and Simulation Coordinator (Coordinator) is responsible for the effective operation, maintenance, and continuous improvement of the Practical Nursing (PN) and Personal Support Worker (PSW) clinical skills laboratory and simulation environments. The position ensures that laboratory, simulation, equipment, technology, and supply resources are available, functional, current, and aligned with curriculum requirements to support high-quality student learning experiences. Working collaboratively with faculty, academic partners, Information Services, and external vendors, the incumbent coordinates laboratory and simulation activities, manages specialized equipment and inventory, supports student skill development through supervised practice opportunities, and maintains simulation technologies and learning environments. The position contributes to the delivery of safe, consistent, and quality educational experiences that support student success.

The Coordinator is required to perform all duties consistent with the governance values and operating policies of Six Nations Polytechnic (SNP) while fostering positive relations with staff, students, stakeholders, and the community; contributing to a culturally supportive teaching, learning and work environment consistent with Hodinǫshǫ:nih/Rotinonhson:ni values of Ga’nigohi:yo:/Kanikoriio (Respect and the Good Mind).

KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES


Clinical Skills Lab Operations 20%

  • Coordinates the day-to-day operation of the clinical skills laboratory to ensure a safe, organized, and fully functional learning environment.
  • Maintains inventory of disposable and non-disposable supplies, equipment, and teaching resources.
  • Orders, receives, tracks, stores, and replenishes inventory; monitors equipment condition and lifecycle requirements; coordinates repairs, servicing, and replacement of laboratory equipment and manikins;
  • Ensures compliance with health and safety standards and infection prevention practices.
  • Other related duties, as required


Simulation Coordination and Technical Support 25%

  • Plans, prepares, sets up, operates, and supports simulation activities for the PN and PSW programs.
  • Maintains simulation software, audiovisual systems, manikins, and associated technologies; troubleshoots technical issues; collaborates with IT services and vendors to resolve equipment and software concerns;
  • Tests and updates simulation scenarios and equipment to ensure operational readiness and alignment with curriculum requirements.
  • Other related duties, as required


Laboratory and Student Practice Support 30%

  • Coordinates and prepares laboratories for scheduled classes and learning activities.
  • Oversees open practice lab sessions and supports students completing missed or make-up laboratory requirements.
  • Provides guidance within a non-instructional framework by directing students to appropriate learning resources, checklists, protocols, or course materials when skill performance concerns are identified.
  • Monitors student adherence to laboratory safety, equipment use, and established procedures
  • Other related duties, as required


Program Collaboration and Curriculum Alignment 15%

  • Collaborates with faculty, program coordinators, and academic partners to ensure laboratory and simulation resources support course outcomes and assessment requirements.
  • Liaises with Mohawk College regarding curriculum updates, simulation activities, skills requirements, equipment standards, and supply lists.
  • Participates in planning discussions related to laboratory improvements, new technologies, and evolving clinical practice standards.
  • Other related duties, as required


Vendor, Stakeholder, and Resource Coordination 5%

  • Researches and evaluates new equipment, simulation technologies, and instructional resources.
  • Obtain quotations, product information, and technical specifications from vendors. Coordinates equipment maintenance, warranty claims, repairs, and service agreements.
  • Maintains relationships with suppliers and external service providers to ensure cost-effective and timely procurement and support.
  • Other related duties, as required


Administration, Documentation, and Continuous Improvement 5%

  • Maintains records related to inventory, equipment maintenance, simulation activities, safety inspections, and resource utilization.
  • Develops and updates standard operating procedures, equipment manuals, and laboratory documentation.
  • Identifies opportunities to improve efficiency, student access, resource utilization, and simulation effectiveness.
  • Other related duties, as required

EDUCATIONAL KNOWLEDGE


Completion of a formal post-secondary/college program of one to two academic year(s) in Practical Nursing. Must be in good standing with CNO as a Registered Practical Nurse (or other nursing designation – RN or NP).

EXPERIENTIAL KNOWLEDGE / CULTURE AND LANGUAGE EXPERTISE


Over 5 years and including 7 years experience as an RPN in either clinical or education contexts. Prior experience working for an Indigenous organization is preferred.

Criminal Record Check


The successful candidate will be required to provide an original Criminal Background Check – Vulnerable Sector Screening that is satisfactory to Six Nations Polytechnic (SNP) prior to the first day of work at Six Nations Polytechnic, and an Offence Declaration that is satisfactory to SNP by their first day of employment at Six Nations Polytechnic.

At Six Nations Polytechnic, we are committed to diversity and inclusion as we continue and expand our efforts to become a more inclusive, safe and respectful workplace. Human Resources will accommodate any needs under the Ontario Human Rights Code (OHRC) and the Accessibility for Ontarians with Disabilities Act (AODA). Recruitment processes will be modified to remove barriers to accommodate those with disabilities, as may be requested.

Applicants from Six Nations and other Indigenous communities will be given preference to deliver programs and services in a First Nations community.

Must be able to lift up to 40 lbs.

Full Job description is available upon request.

title: NDT Level 2 Inspector / Non-Destructive Testing Technician Level II
description:
We are seeking a highly skilled and certified NDT Level 2 for Ultrasonic and Magnetic Particle Testing (UT/MT) Inspector to perform non-destructive testing and inspection activities across various projects. The successful candidate will be responsible for conducting comprehensive inspections using multiple NDT methods, ensuring compliance with industry standards, specifications, and safety protocols. This role requires strong technical expertise, attention to detail, and the ability to work independently in field environments while maintaining the highest quality standards.

Under Socotec Engineering Inc (SEI), the Level II technician will be assigned appropriate non-destructive test equipment for which he is responsible for maintaining. The Level II tech will go to assigned projects and perform required testing. Results will be reported to SEI. Projects will include a diverse range of types including commercial, residential, industrial, and transportation. Projects will be located in the NY Greater Metro Area however some travel may be required. The technician is responsible for maintaining hours and certifications required to perform testing.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Perform non-destructive testing inspections using Level II certified methods including Ultrasonic Testing (UT), Magnetic Particle Testing (MT), and Visual Testing (VT)
  • Liquid Penetrant Testing (PT) is optional
  • Conduct field testing and obtain representative samples for laboratory analysis and verification
  • Verify conformance of materials, components, and assemblies to project specifications, codes, and industry standards
  • Operate, calibrate, and maintain NDT inspection equipment in accordance with manufacturer guidelines and safety protocols
  • Interpret test results and prepare detailed inspection reports with accurate documentation of findings
  • Review and evaluate inspection data to identify defects, discontinuities, and non-conformances
  • Coordinate with project managers, engineers, and quality control personnel to resolve inspection issues
  • Ensure all inspection activities comply with applicable codes, standards (ASTM, ASME, AWS, etc.), and client requirements
  • Maintain inspection records, certifications, and calibration documentation
  • Participate in pre-inspection planning meetings and provide technical recommendations
  • Train and provide guidance to NDT Level I technicians as needed
  • Work with SEI’s Level III Technician to obtain company certification.
  • Adhere to all safety protocols and promote a culture of workplace safety

Certifications (Must Have):

CRITICAL REQUIREMENT: Candidates MUST be Certified Level II UT (Ultrasonic Testing) and MT (Magnetic Particle Testing) technicians. This is a mandatory, non-negotiable requirement.

  • Valid NDT Level II certification in Ultrasonic Testing (UT) - REQUIRED
  • Valid NDT Level II certification in Magnetic Particle Testing (MT) - REQUIRED
  • Valid NDT Level II certification in Liquid Penetrant Testing (PT)
  • Valid NDT Level II certification in Visual Testing (VT)
  • All certifications must be current and in accordance with SNT-TC-1A, ASNT CP-189, or equivalent standards

Education:

  • High school diploma or equivalent required
  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Materials Science, or related technical field preferred

Experience:

  • Minimum 5 years of hands-on experience in NDT inspection roles
  • Demonstrated experience performing inspections in industrial, construction, or manufacturing environments
  • Proven track record of quality inspection documentation and reporting
  • Experience with multiple NDT methods and inspection techniques

TECHNICAL SKILLS:

  • Proficiency in Ultrasonic Testing (UT) - thickness measurement, flaw detection, weld inspection
  • Expertise in Magnetic Particle Testing (MT) - wet/dry methods, fluorescent and visible particle techniques
  • Proficiency in Liquid Penetrant Testing (PT) - dye penetrant inspection methods
  • Visual Testing (VT) capabilities - direct visual inspection, remote visual inspection (RVI)
  • Knowledge of relevant codes and standards (ASME Section V, ASTM, AWS D1.1, API, etc.)
  • Ability to interpret technical drawings, specifications, and inspection procedures
  • Proficiency with inspection equipment including ultrasonic flaw detectors, magnetic yokes, black lights, and related tools
  • Strong understanding of material properties, welding processes, and fabrication techniques
  • Computer proficiency for inspection documentation and reporting software

ADDITIONAL CERTIFICATIONS (PREFERRED):

  • ACI Concrete Field Testing Technician - Grade I
  • ACI Concrete Field Testing Technician - Grade II
  • ICC (International Code Council) Special Inspector certifications:
  • Masonry Inspector
  • Steel Construction Inspector
  • Structural Bolting Inspector
  • Structural Welding Inspector
  • OSHA 10-Hour Construction Safety Certification
  • OSHA 30-Hour Construction Safety Certification

SAFETY REQUIREMENTS:

  • Strict adherence to OSHA safety regulations and company safety policies
  • Ability to properly use Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) including hard hats, safety glasses, steel-toed boots, respirators, and hearing protection
  • Knowledge of hazardous material handling and radiation safety (if applicable)
  • Completion of site-specific safety training as required
  • Ability to work safely in various environments including confined spaces, at heights, and in adverse weather conditions
  • Participation in safety meetings, hazard assessments, and incident reporting

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS:

  • Ability to lift and carry inspection equipment up to 50 pounds
  • Capability to work in various positions including standing, kneeling, climbing, and working in confined spaces
  • Willingness to work in indoor and outdoor environments under varying conditions
  • Ability to travel to project sites as required

WORKING CONDITIONS:

  • Field-based position with potential for exposure to construction sites, manufacturing facilities, and industrial environments
  • May require extended hours, weekend work, or shift work depending on project needs
  • Travel to various project sites throughout the New York metropolitan area, including the five boroughs and Long Island, may be required.

For more information, please visit www.socotec.us

Job Type: Full-Time

Hourly pay range: $35.00–$65.00 per hour, commensurate with experience and certifications.

Your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

title: Design Director - Unnanouced project | Directeur·trice Design - Projet non annoncé
description:
Are you ready to dive into the world of cutting-edge video game development? Headquartered in Montreal, Behaviour Interactive is at the forefront of the gaming industry, crafting unforgettable experiences across PC, console, and mobile platforms. We’re a dynamic, independent studio of over 1200 passionate employees, with studios in Toronto (Behaviour Toronto), Rotterdam (Behaviour Rotterdam) and in the UK (Behaviour UK–North & South). Our day to day revolves around two core business focuses: Services and Original Games. Our Services team collaborates with gaming and entertainment giants like Disney, Sony, Activision, and Nintendo, delivering exceptional work-for-hire development and pioneering immersive location-based entertainment (LBE). Meanwhile, our Original Games unit pushes our creative limits, with our signature IPs, including the iconic Dead by Daylight. Join us and be a part of the future of interactive entertainment!

At Behaviour Interactive, we believe in giving everyone a fair shot. We embrace a diverse and creative environment where everyone is celebrated. We value folks of all ages, sex, ethnicity, colour, ethnic or national origin, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, civil status, disability, or any other protected characteristics as per applicable law.

Working in close partnership with the Creative Director, the Design Director translates creative intent into player experiences and systems that are clear, deep, and engaging.

The Design Director sets the standard for design quality, structure, and communication, while also being deeply involved in feature prioritization, pacing, and mechanical cohesion. They play a key role in ensuring that the game delivers a complete and satisfying experience that meets the expectations of both players and external partners.

In this role you will:

  • Define and drive the vision in alignment with the Creative Director’s vision of the project.
  • Direct the design teams across different specialties, including missions, narrative, level design, and UX implementation.
  • Mediate between feature and content review requests from other disciplines and what the overall mission design can realistically support.
  • Evaluate design work at all stages of development to ensure clarity, balance, depth, and player comprehension.
  • Primary interface point for clients (Co-Dev/Publishers/Product Group) when talking about specific missions and related content.

    • What we're looking for:

  • Proven experience as a Design Director, Game Director or Associate Design Director on a successful PC/Console game.
  • Excellent collaboration skills and experience working closely with Narrative, Level Design, Art and Audio.
  • Experience in mission design is an asset, with a track record of delivering engaging narrative and gameplay-driven content.
  • Leadership and mentorship skills, with experience managing and developing teams of designers.
  • Passion for creating innovative player experiences and staying current with industry trends and best practices.

    • Dans ce rôle tu devras:

  • Être le principal point de contact pour les client·e·s (co-développement, éditeurs/trices, groupe produit) concernant les missions spécifiques et les contenus associés.

  • Excellentes aptitudes en collaboration et expérience de travail étroit avec les équipes de narration, de level design, d’art et d’audio;
  • Une expérience en conception de missions est un atout, avec un historique démontré de livraison de contenus narratifs et ludiques engageants;
  • Solides compétences en leadership et en mentorat, avec une expérience de gestion et de développement d’équipes de concepteur·rice·s;
  • Passion pour la création d’expériences de jeu innovantes et veille constante des tendances et meilleures pratiques de l’industrie.

    • En étroite collaboration avec la direction créative, la direction du design traduit l’intention créative en expériences de jeu et en systèmes clairs, profonds et engageants pour les joueur·euse·s.

    La direction du design établit les standards de qualité, de structure et de communication en matière de conception, tout en étant fortement impliquée dans la priorisation des fonctionnalités, le rythme de progression et la cohérence des mécaniques de jeu. Elle joue un rôle clé pour garantir que le jeu offre une expérience complète et satisfaisante, à la hauteur des attentes des joueur·euse·s comme des partenaires externes.

Basé à Montréal, Behaviour Interactif est un acteur majeur de l’industrie du jeu, créant des expériences inoubliables sur PC, console et mobile. On est un studio indépendant dynamique avec plus de 1200 employés passionnés, et on a des studios à Toronto (Behaviour Toronto), Rotterdam (Behaviour Rotterdam) et au Royaume-Uni (Behaviour UK–North & South). On se concentre sur deux grands axes : les Services et les Jeux Originaux. Notre équipe Services collabore avec des géants du jeu et du divertissement comme Disney, Sony, Activision et Nintendo, en offrant un développement sur commande de premier choix et en innovant dans le divertissement immersif en lieu fixe (LBE). Pendant ce temps, notre unité Jeux Originaux repousse les limites de notre créativité avec nos IPs emblématiques, comme le fameux Dead by Daylight. Rejoins-nous et fais partie de l'avenir du divertissement interactif !

title: Senior Program Budget Analyst (5498)

title: Product Manager | Functional Liquids Product Development (all genders)
description:
Your role

Join Sunday Natural and help us build one of our newest and most promising product categories.

As Product Manager | Functional Liquids Product Development (all genders), you will develop innovative liquid products such as functional beverages, juices, shots, liquid supplements, elixirs, ferments and tinctures. Together with our Category Manager, you will turn initial product ideas into scientifically sound, commercially viable and great-tasting products.

This is a hands-on product development role for someone who combines scientific curiosity with creativity, strong sensory judgement and solid project management skills. You will work directly on formulations and prototypes, collaborate with external manufacturers and guide your products through the entire development process until they are ready for market.

As our Fluids category is still growing, you will have the freedom to contribute your own ideas, identify emerging trends and actively shape the future of the portfolio.

Your responsibilities

  • You translate initial product concepts into concrete product briefs, feasibility assessments, formulations, cost calculations and development plans.

  • You develop and optimize liquid products such as functional beverages, juices, shots, liquid food supplements, elixirs, ferments and tinctures, working hands-on with our Category Manager on prototypes and sensory evaluation.

  • You ensure that every product combines scientific credibility, commercial viability and an outstanding taste experience.

  • You manage the full operational product development process from concept and formulation through sampling, testing, production preparation and market readiness, using structured stage-gate processes.

  • You act as the central point of contact for your products and coordinate external manufacturers, bottlers, suppliers and internal teams including Sourcing, Purchasing, Regulatory Affairs, Quality, Legal, Production Planning and Logistics.

  • You conduct market, competitor and trend analyses, attend relevant trade fairs and contribute new ideas for innovative products within the Fluids category.

Your profile

  • You have relevant professional experience in product development or product management within the food, beverage, food supplement, flavour or FMCG industry.

  • You have practical experience developing or optimising beverages, juices, shots, liquid supplements, fermented products or comparable liquid formulations, including sensory evaluation and taste adjustments.

  • You bring a scientific or technical background, for example in nutritional science, food science, food technology, pharmacy, chemistry or biology, or have gained comparable expertise through relevant training and experience.

  • You can confidently discuss ingredients, active substances, dosages and physiological mechanisms and critically assess the scientific relevance of product concepts.

  • You combine creativity and strong product intuition with analytical thinking, attention to detail and a solid understanding of calculations and product costs.

  • You are familiar with stage-gate or comparable product development processes, confidently manage cross-functional stakeholders and proactively drive projects forward in an entrepreneurial environment.

  • You are business fluent (C1) in both German and English.

What we offer

  • An appealing discount on all of our products – from essential oils to vitamins & nutrients

  • We offer 28 days of paid time off per year plus up to 5 days off between Christmas and New Year

  • The Urban Sports Club membership and either Swapfiets bike rental or a subsidy for the Deutschlandticket

  • We believe great things happen when we meet in person, which is why we embrace a hybrid model with one home office day per week – up to two depending on the area you are working in – and up to two weeks per year working from abroad

  • Receive various discounts of up to more than 50 percent on attractive brands such as Flaconi, Bosch, Apple or Expedia

  • You will be given real ownership and plenty of room for new initiatives, as well as the opportunity to contribute your expertise and implement your great ideas

  • We like to celebrate each other! Regular tea & office parties, Christmas and summer feasts and various influencer events such as Women's Day

We are looking forward to your application!

Sunday Natural emerged from a long-standing passion and research in the fields of health, healing, and personal growth. The lack of natural, high-quality products on the market was the original motivation for founding Sunday Natural in 2013. We aim to produce the products we ourselves would love to buy – as natural as possible, absolutely pure, free from any additives, and of the highest quality. In a strategic partnership with CVC, Sunday Natural is now one of Germany's most renowned quality manufacturers, with its own research and development department in Berlin. For the continuous improvement of our products, we collaborate with selected research institutes, scientists, therapists, farmers, and professional associations.

We take our ecological responsibility very seriously: that’s why the majority of our product range is vegan. We also take an innovative approach to packaging: most of our products are packaged in glass, making them almost entirely recyclable.

Our diverse team in Berlin consists of over 350 employees from more than 45 nationalities and continues to grow – but at a sustainable pace. Our goal is to foster a collaborative, supportive, and inclusive work environment with a diverse group of motivated, talented, and visionary team members.

We highly value equality of opportunity and inclusivity, and we would like to particularly encourage women and candidates from under-represented backgrounds to apply, even if you don’t match with 100% of the requirements.

title: Principal Full Stack Software Engineer
description:
Principal Full Stack Software Engineer
About JITX
JITX is revolutionizing circuit board design by making it code-first. Instead of dragging components around in a GUI, engineers write code—or have AI write it for them—to define their circuit boards. We're a ~12-person startup building tools that bring software engineering practices to hardware design.
The Role
We're looking for a principal engineer who can drive technical direction for significant product areas and own them end-to-end. You'll work across our stack—from user management systems to our core design application—making architectural decisions that shape how electrical engineers interact with our product for years to come.
As a principal engineer, you'll be expected to identify technical debt, propose solutions, and drive consensus around the right path forward. Your first major project will be reworking our user and license management system, which you'll architect and largely implement while coordinating with stakeholders across the company. As you ramp up and build context on our domain, you'll transition to working on critical core runtime components that power our circuit design engine.
Beyond your individual contributions, you'll raise the bar for engineering across the team—through code reviews, technical mentorship, and establishing patterns that others can follow.
What You'll Work On
User Management Platform
- TypeScript/React frontend
- Python application server
- Database backend currently in PostgreSQL
- Integration with modern auth solutions (WorkOS or similar)
Graphical User Interface Application
- Electron based React/TypeScript application
- Custom input handling and rendering (not traditional HTML elements)
- Advanced visualization using PixiJS, with potential migration to WebGL/
- Complex CSS/styling for polished UI/UX
Application Runtime & Architecture
- Algorithm-heavy runtime with complex computational geometry problems
- User-facing Python API for programmatic circuit board design
- Sophisticated architecture driving the application life cycle
- Opportunity to rearchitect core systems to leverage parallel computing and modern hardware capabilities
- Deep technical challenges requiring strong CS fundamentals and architectural vision
What We're Looking For
Must-haves:
- Extensive full stack experience with TypeScript/React and Python, with a track record of architectural decisions at scale
- Strong algorithmic problem-solving skills with understanding of complexity analysis, graph/tree data structures, and computational efficiency
- Ability to drive technical direction and follow through on architectural decisions across the stack
- Experience identifying technical debt, evaluating tradeoffs, and building consensus around solutions
- Self-directed work style with strong product sense and ability to unblock yourself and others
- Experience gathering requirements from stakeholders and translating them into technical solutions and system designs
- Track record of owning large, complex features from planning through production
- Ability to mentor and raise technical standards across a team through code reviews and establishing best practices
- Comfortable working with ambiguity in a startup environment
Nice-to-haves:
- Experience with graphics/visualization libraries (PixiJS, , WebGL)
- Background in developer tools or technical products
- MongoDB and PostgreSQL experience, or other databases
- Auth/identity management systems (WorkOS, Auth0, etc.)
- Polyglot programming experience—comfortable across multiple languages and paradigms
- Interest in hardware, electronics, or CAD tools
Who You Are
You're a veteran software engineer who's worked across multiple environments and knows that early-stage startups offer the best combination of impact and interesting problems to solve.
You have a nose for bottlenecks—you spot where things are getting stuck and jump in to help get features across the finish line. You're naturally curious about architecture, always tinkering to find proactive improvements that can ship quickly. You move fluidly across the codebase and the team, bringing speed without sacrificing quality.
Your algorithmic problem-solving is strong and you don't shy away from maths and logic. You're comfortable reasoning about complexity at various levels of abstraction, working with graph and tree structures, and finding elegant solutions to hard computational problems.
You're responsible with your craft. You plan, you test, you own large features end-to-end. You think about staging, reliability, and production-readiness from the start, not as an afterthought.
At a principal level, you're also a multiplier. You make the engineers around you better through thoughtful code reviews, clear technical communication, and by establishing patterns that scale beyond your own code. You know when to dive deep into implementation and when to step back and focus on architecture and direction.
You thrive when given ownership of a problem space. You're the person who asks "why are we building this?" before diving into "how should we build it?" You don't need your hand held, but you're not afraid to raise your hand when you need context or when you spot a problem with the plan.
Why JITX?
- Work on genuinely novel problems at the intersection of software and hardware
- Small team where your work has immediate, visible impact
- Help shape the future of how hardware gets designed
- Collaborate with a team that cares deeply about craft and elegant solutions

title: Procure-to-Pay Specialist (m/f/d)
description:

Our award-winning awareness platform triggers behavioural change by providing effective and engaging training and simulations on cybersecurity and data protection. Cybercrime is costing the world >$10 trillion annually and growing by 15% p.a. - we invite you to be part of the solution!

About the role

The Procure-to-Pay Specialist (m/f/d) is a critical operational role within the Procurement team at SoSafe, responsible for ensuring that every step of the procurement lifecycle, from purchase requisition to payment, runs efficiently, compliantly, and on time. In this role, you will be a key enabler of our day-to-day procurement operations, managing PR to PO issuing, supplier onboarding, contract administration, and supplier and stakeholder collaboration, while contributing to the continuous improvement of our procurement processes and systems.

Here's how you'll make a difference:

  • Own and manage the end-to-end PR-to-PO process, including the creation, review, and approval of purchase requisitions and purchase orders, ensuring accuracy, policy compliance, and timely execution across all business units.

  • Lead supplier onboarding as core day-to-day responsibilities, coordinating with Legal, Security, and IT as part of the due diligence process, and ensuring ongoing compliance with procurement workflows. Help with supplier contract negotiation as needed.

  • Manage the contract signature process, including finalising and distributing contracts where required.

  • Maintain all contracts, supplier records, master data, and system configurations in Spendesk Procurement, keeping the database accurate and up to date.

  • Review and match supplier invoices against purchase orders in close collaboration with the Accounts Payable team.

  • Provide stakeholder support throughout the PR-to-PO workflow, ensuring timely and accurate processing of purchase requisitions, purchase orders, and goods receipts.

  • Support internal stakeholders with placing equipment orders from preferred catalogue suppliers, ensuring timely delivery in line with business needs.

  • Prepare spend analysis reports and monitor supplier performance to support strategic procurement decisions.

What makes you a great fit:

  • 3+ years of experience in indirect procurement, with a strong focus on the full procure-to-pay cycle — from purchase requisition through to PO and payment. More experience is a plus.

  • Proven experience managing this end-to-end in a scaling or high-growth tech environment.

  • Strong sense of ownership: comfortable driving the process independently and seeing issues through to resolution rather than just flagging them.

  • Hands-on profile: you're equally comfortable owning day-to-day operational procurement tasks and contributing to strategic topics in a lean team setup.

  • Hands-on experience with a procurement platform or ERP system. Spendesk experience is a plus.

  • Experience with supplier onboarding as a must have. Experience with supplier negotiations is a plus.

  • Experience working with Jira or a similar ticketing system to manage and track cross-functional requests.

  • Experience working across all procurement categories, with a good understanding of hardware, software, marketing and professional services.

  • Strong attention to detail and comfort managing data and documentation.

  • Experience collaborating cross-functionally with Finance, Legal, Security and IT teams.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.

  • Structured, process-oriented mindset with a high degree of reliability.

  • Strong interest in and ideally practical experience using AI-driven tools to optimize procurement workflows, automate repetitive tasks, and drive operational excellence.

What we offer*

  • Work/Life balance: Flexible hours, 33 vacation days, and parental leave support

  • Wellbeing and financial support: Access to Open Up, Corporate Discounts, Wellbeing & Fitness Benefits

  • Connection & community: Virtual events, collaborative team activities, and opportunities for local meet-ups

  • And the list goes on: Tech equipment, referral bonuses, an individual development budget, dog-friendly HQ

*Perks and benefits listed above are for full-time employees and may vary slightly by office location. These are just a sample — you'll learn more during the interview process.

At SoSafe, we’re on a mission to make the digital world safer by addressing the human factor in cybersecurity. As one of the fastest-growing security awareness scale-ups worldwide, we leverage behavioural science and data-driven learning to empower people against cyber threats. Our Human Risk Management approach helps organisations turn their employees into their strongest line of defence.

title: Staff Software Engineer (Payments)
description:

GoFundMe is the world’s most powerful community for good, dedicated to helping people help each other. By uniting individuals and nonprofits in one place, GoFundMe makes it easy and safe for people to ask for help and support causes—for themselves and each other. Together, our community has raised more than $40 billion since 2010.

Join us! The GoFundMe team is seeking a Staff Software Engineer to join our Payments organization on the Payouts team, helping us build and scale next-generation payments infrastructure capable of handling billions of dollars in transactions.

You'll serve as a Staff IC on the team responsible for ledgering money movement and getting money out to the people who need it. You'll help bring more of our core payments capabilities in-house — reducing reliance on external vendors and fintech partners for compliance and control reasons — while designing and implementing the end-to-end product lifecycle for payout solutions, from ideation to launch and iteration.

This role is ideal for a seasoned technical leader who thrives on solving complex problems in payments, setting architectural direction, and leading by example through hands-on contributions.

  • Refine and execute GoFundMe's multi-year payments strategy to grow giving through innovative use cases, and bring more of our core payments capabilities in-house.
  • Design and implement the end-to-end product lifecycle for payout solutions, from ideation to launch and iteration.

  • Experience with GraphQL and relational databases such as MySQL or PostgreSQL.
  • Prior experience on a ledgering, payouts, or money-movement team at scale.

title: Distributed Systems Design Installation Agent (DS-DIA)
description:
** Security Clearance Required

Company Overview

Systems Technology Forum LTD (STF) is an established industry partner with a passion for exceptional performance and an unwavering commitment to our clients. As a premier provider of management, engineering, information technology, and logistics services, STF is committed to delivering high-quality systems engineering, technical and professional support services that meet and exceed deliverable requirements.

STF offers superior out-of-the-box solutions to end-to-end problems and customer-centric support to the United States Government, Military, Department of Defense (DoD), and other federal agencies.

Job Summary

Supports the planning, coordination, installation, integration, testing, and lifecycle support of U.S. Navy C5I systems aboard ships under construction and modernization at HII Newport News Shipbuilding. Serves as the technical liaison between Government representatives, shipyard personnel, engineering organizations, and installation teams to ensure complex shipboard systems are installed safely, efficiently, and in accordance with approved engineering and installation requirements.

Travel is not required. Telework is not supported.

Responsibilities and Duties

  • Provides onsite technical support for the installation, modernization, testing, and sustainment of Navy C5I systems aboard ships under construction, overhaul, and modernization.
  • Coordinates installation activities with HII Newport News Shipbuilding, Government representatives, engineering teams, and Alteration Installation Teams (AITs).
  • Reviews engineering drawings, Technical Instructions (TIs), installation packages, ship alteration records, and technical documentation to ensure installation readiness and compliance.
  • Conducts shipboard surveys to evaluate existing configurations, identify installation impacts, and develop technical recommendations.
  • Supports installation planning, equipment integration, system interoperability, and risk mitigation efforts throughout the installation lifecycle.
  • Troubleshoots complex electrical, electronic, and networked systems during installation, testing, and operational verification.
  • Performs system inspections, operational testing, validation, and acceptance activities to verify installation quality and technical compliance.
  • Identifies installation issues, evaluate technical impacts, and develop corrective action recommendations to minimize schedule delays and operational risk.
  • Prepares technical reports, installation status updates, survey findings, deficiency reports, and recommendations for Government review.
  • Provides technical guidance and mentorship to installation personnel and support teams during execution of complex shipboard installations.
  • Coordinates multiple installation efforts simultaneously while ensuring work is completed safely, efficiently, and in accordance with project schedules.
  • Recommends process improvements and installation best practices that improve efficiency, quality, and overall mission execution.
  • Supports Government meetings, planning conferences, production reviews, and technical discussions as required.

Qualifications and Skills

Required knowledge and years of experience

Possesses extensive experience supporting Navy shipboard electronics installations and has the technical expertise to troubleshoot, evaluate, and resolve complex installation challenges while ensuring schedule, quality, and mission requirements are achieved. Must have at least ten (10) years of experience supporting U.S. Navy Shipboard C5I or electronic systems installations. Must have a strong understanding of Navy installation processes and procedures. Must have knowledge of shipboard network integration and interoperability testing. Previous experience working within Newport News Shipbuilding or another major naval shipyard.

Education Requirements

Associate's degree in Electronics, Engineering Technology, Information Technology, or a related technical discipline preferred. Relevant military experience or equivalent technical experience may be substituted for formal education.

Certifications

Security+ Desired

Clearance Requirement

Top Secret

title: Global News Editor
description:
The mission of The New York Times is to seek the truth and help people understand the world. That means independent journalism is at the heart of all we do as a company. It’s why we have a world-renowned newsroom that sends journalists to report on the ground from nearly 160 countries. It’s why we focus deeply on how our readers will experience our journalism, from print to audio to a world-class digital and app destination. And it’s why our business strategy centers on making journalism so good that it’s worth paying for.

The New York Times is seeking an innovative senior Global News editor who will assign, edit and refine the daily International report. With an eye on breaking news and evolving storylines, you will have experience fleshing out the missing holes in the report and be unafraid to keep the overall report sharp, while also overseeing handoffs. We’re looking for a leader who understands that journalistic excellence and digital excellence are one and the same, and thinks deeply about the best form and format a story needs to have the most impact. You will constantly think about how to bring more people into our coverage and how we make our journalism more accessible.

This is an in-office position, based in New York City and includes regular attendance in the office four days each week. There may be some flexibility to work remotely per your departmental guidance.

Responsibilities:

  • Work closely with desk leaders and editors in all three newsrooms as well as teams such as Live and Audience to lead the global report in the moment and plan for the days that follow.
  • Elevate effective headlines and clear writing across the entire report.
  • Lead and inspire a team of direct reports, including editors and reporters
  • Champion the best way to tell the stories coming across our desks, creatively evaluating forms and formats.
  • Push strong promotion of stories on the homepage and other core Times platforms.
  • Identify and respond quickly to breaking news.
  • Handle edits of all sorts, including first edits and write-throughs as needed.
  • Assign edits to fellow staffers and monitor copy flow to the print hub on deadline.
  • Identify potential stories and anticipate coverage needs, communicating plans quickly and clearly.
  • Be flexible and nimble in anticipating potential problems, addressing unexpected issues and finding solutions.
  • Assist the weekend editor in preparing our weekend report.
  • Demonstrate support and understanding of our value of journalistic independence and a strong commitment to our mission to seek the truth and help people understand the world.

Basic qualifications:

  • 10+ years of experience writing and editing copy for news and enterprise, compelling headlines and captions, other display type and social copy
  • Experience and ability to multitask under deadline pressure
  • 3+ years of experience thinking about multiple story forms and formats
  • Demonstrated excellent news judgment
  • Leadership experience, including managing others with the ability to inspire and motivate others

Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience collaborating with visual journalists on news and enterprise
  • Demonstrated ability to quickly pick up new topics
  • A willingness to be nimble and flexible as the newsroom’s needs evolve
  • Professional judgment with respect to confidentiality
  • Being knowledgeable about Times style and applying it properly in different content types

REQ-020473

$180,000—$195,000 USD

title: Intern - Credit Risk
description:
Join a Challenger

At EQ, we're remaking banking so every Canadian gets ahead, every day. Serving nearly 4 million Canadians from coast to coast, we offer a wide variety of financial services from banking and lending, to trust and credit union solutions.

We've been at this since 1970, challenging the conventions of traditional banking with smarter, faster, and more connected financial experiences.

What's kept us moving? The people behind it all: challengers who ask better questions, push back on old assumptions, and look for a better way forward.

If you're driven to help reshape how banking works for Canadians and the businesses that power our economy, this could be your next big opportunity.

We can’t wait to get to know you!


Purpose of the Job

The Credit Risk Intern will report to the Senior Manager of Credit Risk and work closely with Credit Risk Analysts, Associates, and Managers. While this role does not carry decision making authority, the intern is accountable for producing accurate analysis, maintaining data integrity, and adhering to internal risk management and governance standards.

The work supported by this role contributes to understanding transaction-level and portfolio risk and supporting sound credit risk management practices across the Bank.

The Credit Risk Intern will support operational and transformation initiatives within the Credit Risk department, primarily:

  • Assist in the automation (through AI) of IFRS 9 controls/checks for audit purposes and
  • Assisting other Credit Risk teams (e.g. Retail Lending Quality Assurance) with the enablement of Artificial Intelligence (“AI”) tools in select functions.

The ideal candidate has a strong interest in process improvement and technology with a desire for exposure to a business/finance/risk environment.

The Core Responsibilities of the Job:

Electronic Document Organization and Solutioning

  • Electronic document organization (leveraging technology when possible)
  • Support solutioning for electronic document organization and automation
  • Assist with process improvements and procedures as well as documentation of such.

    • AI Enablement & Process Support

  • Support Credit Risk teams with the setup and adoption of AI tools within select functions, including organizing inputs, testing use cases, and documenting outputs.
  • Assist with identifying opportunities where AI tools can improve efficiency, documentation, or analysis within Credit Risk processes.
  • Support basic experimentation and learning related to AI-enabled workflows under guidance from Risk and Data partners.
  • Assist with process improvements and procedures as well as documentation of such.

    • Let's Talk About You!

  • Currently pursuing a Bachelor’s or Master degree in Management Information Systems (Library and Information Science), Systems Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.
  • 3M to 1 yr of exposure to Microsoft SharePoint and Microsoft PowerShell, Microsoft Power Automate, Python, and/or SQL.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and ability to think systematically in developing technological and process solutions.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Outlook and experience utilizing AI for organization and automation
  • Strong attention to detail.
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines.
  • Clear written and verbal communication skills.

    • Job Complexities/Thinking Challenges:

    The Credit Risk environment is dynamic and constantly evolving due to changes in market conditions, borrower behaviour, and regulatory expectations. This role requires curiosity, adaptability, and critical thinking to support analyses that inform risk decisions.

    As an intern, you will be exposed to real-world credit risk challenges and must be comfortable learning new concepts, asking questions, and balancing accuracy with tight timelines. Success in this role depends on attention to detail, a willingness to learn, and an ability to connect data insights to business and risk implications.

    ✨ Market leading RRSP match program

    🖥 Virtual events to connect with your fellow colleagues
    🎓 Professional development and comprehensive Career Development program
    💛 A fulfilling opportunity to join one of the top FinTechs and help create a new kind of banking experience
    The incumbent will be working hybrid and in office time will be spent working from EQ Bank’s additional office space located at 2200-25 Ontario Street, Toronto, ON.


    Equity, Diversity & Inclusion

    EQ is committed to building an inclusive, accessible environment where every employee feels valued, respected, and supported. We believe our organization is stronger — and our people thrive — when we honour and celebrate diverse experiences, identities, and perspectives. We’re equally committed to supporting your growth, both professionally and personally.

    We provide a barrier‑free recruitment process and work environment. If you require accommodations at any stage, we will work with you to ensure you can bring your best self to the process and beyond.

    As part of our recruitment process, EQ uses AI to help screen, assess, and/or select applicants for this position. All AI-enabled outputs are reviewed and validated by our talent team. All candidates considered for hire must successfully complete a criminal background check and credit check. While we appreciate every application, an EQ recruiter will contact only those whose skills and experience most closely match the requirements of the role.


    EQB Inc. (TSX: EQB) is the parent company of Equitable Bank, the country's seventh-largest Schedule I bank by assets, which operates EQ Bank, Canada's Challenger Bank™. EQB Inc. serves nearly 4 million Canadians and manages approximately $150 billion in combined assets under management and administration.

title: Building Engineer, Critical Data Centers

The Critical Data Center Building Engineer performs the day-to-day operation and maintenance of the Data Center facilities and equipment to keep building assets at the highest degree of care, value and reliability. Monitor the operation and make customer approved adjustments of chilled water systems, heat exchangers, CRAC Units, HVAC, electrical systems, emergency back-up systems, hot water systems, pumps, valves, filters and other mechanical and electrical equipment. Record readings and make recommendations for adjustments where necessary to assure proper operation of equipment.
Analyze the operation of various systems, determine the cause of any problems/malfunctions and take corrective action as required.
Prepare and maintain maintenance logs and reports. Maintain knowledge about preventive maintenance and work order software systems.
Coordinate contractor and management approvals for work orders that require the use of outside contractors. Maintain detailed logs of all work performed.
Perform all assigned work as to ensure the safety of the building's tenants and the continuous operation of the facility.
Maintain organized building files.
May be on-call after regular scheduled hours.
May perform other duties as assigned.

SKILLS, EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE:
High School diploma or General Education Degree (GED).
Minimum of 5 years previous critical data center operations engineering experience.
CFC Certified – Certification for handling refrigerants a plus.
Proficient computer and email skills.
Proficient with Building Automation Systems.
Must have the ability to complete required safety classes that pertain to specific job duties.
Familiarity with preventative maintenance and work order software systems.
Excellent communication skills.

title: Quality & Manufacturing Engineering
description:
At Meter, our brand reputation is built on product reliability and seamless execution. As a brand owner partnering with external JDMs, we do not just buy manufacturing capacity — we actively govern it. This hybrid Quality & Manufacturing Engineering role is the vital technical bridge between our internal R&D teams and our manufacturing partners. You will not be micromanaging assembly lines or designing fixtures from scratch; instead, you will own supplier governance. By establishing razor-sharp quality metrics, aligning internal engineering specs with vendor control plans, and turning the factory floor from a "black box" into a data-driven operation, you directly safeguard our brand's bottom line and ensure our products reach customers flawlessly and on time.

We are in a pivotal phase of growth that involves scaling new product introductions and executing high-stakes factory migrations — moving mature production lines from incumbent suppliers to new EMS facilities. A standard engineer who only checks boxes won’t suffice; we need an exceptional gatekeeper who can influence without authority, command the respect of our partners' engineering teams, and anticipate production risks before they cause delivery delays. The cost of a single quality escape or a botched factory migration is steep — it strains our internal R&D resources with firefighting and delays our future product roadmaps. By bringing your deep technical acumen, rigorous root-cause analysis, and vendor management expertise to Meter, you will unburden our design teams, build a robust quality culture across our supply chain, and serve as the ultimate guardian of our product integrity.

What success looks like

In your first six months at Meter, success means moving our external manufacturing relationships from a reactive footing to proactive, data-driven governance. You will have successfully embedded yourself as the definitive technical gatekeeper at our partner sites.

Specifically, you will be expected to drive and deliver the following three measurable results within your first 6 months:

  • Standardize JDM Quality Governance & Zero-Ambiguity Specs: You will establish the first baseline matrix for our JDM partners' First-Pass Yield and deploy a standardized reporting dashboard. By aligning 100% of Meter’s internal engineering specifications with the partner’s manufacturing Control Plans, you will eliminate all gray areas in cosmetic and functional quality expectations.

  • Execute a Flawless EMS Factory Migration: For our active production transfer projects, you will successfully manage the transition to the new EMS site with zero critical quality escapes to customers. You will ensure 100% replication and validation of critical tooling, fixtures, and testing stations, securing a successful site qualification audit on the first attempt.

  • Stabilize Post-Migration Line Performance: Within 4 to 6 weeks following the line qualification at the new EMS facility, you will drive their engineering teams to resolve early assembly bottlenecks, bringing the new line's First-Pass Yield up to match or exceed our historical production baseline.

What your day-to-day will look like

If you are looking for a desk job where you just read reports, this isn’t it. You won't be soldering components or writing code, but you will be the ultimate orchestrator of our manufacturing reality. You will be juggling the immediate needs of an active production line with the long-term quality strategy for our next-generation products.

Here is what a typical day looks like:

  • Own the Quality Baseline: You’ll be the pulse of our manufacturing quality, establishing the automated dashboards, FPY thresholds, and gating metrics that keep our JDM and EMS partners honest and aligned with Meter’s high standards.

  • Bridge the Gap with Manufacturing Partners: Act as our primary technical voice on the shop floor, translating complex internal R&D specifications into foolproof Control Plans and ensuring zero ambiguity in cosmetic and functional quality expectations.

  • Orchestrate Flawless Factory Migrations: Lead high-stakes production transfers from the front lines. You will oversee 100% replication of tooling, validate testing fixtures, and navigate the transition to new EMS facilities with zero critical quality escapes.

  • Drive Partner Accountability: You’ll lead quality and 8D reviews that demand rigor—smashing through lazy "operator error" excuses, deep-diving into root causes, and ensuring JDM teams deploy permanent, data-backed CAPAs.

  • The Ultimate Cross-Functional Collaborator: Work shoulder-to-shoulder with Meter’s internal teams, embedding manufacturing insights and DFX (DFM/DFA) principles into design reviews so our next-gen products scale seamlessly.

  • Get Into the Weeds: You’re never "too senior" to help. Whether it’s reviewing raw Gage R&R error logs, inspecting and signing off on a Limit Sample, or jumping on a late-night call to unblock a stalled NPI line, you’re ready to dive in.

Who you are

We are looking for a rare breed of engineer: someone who possesses the technical depth to challenge a factory director, the diplomacy to align cross-functional teams, and the operational grit to oversee complex factory migrations. You don't just want to build products; you want to master the systems that scale them.

Here is the profile of the exceptional person we are looking for:

  • The JDM Diplomat: You speak fluent "factory language." You have spent 5+ years navigating the unique dynamics of external manufacturing partners (JDM, ODM, or EMS). You know exactly how factories cut corners, how they hide yield drops, and most importantly, how to motivate their engineering teams to prioritize Meter’s products without having direct authority over them.

  • A Technical Auditor, Not a Checklist Checker: When a partner says an issue was just "operator error," your immediate instinct is to look at the PFMEA, the fixture design, and the raw error logs. You have a deep, practical grasp of core quality tools and you use them as strategic levers to enforce accountability, not as paperwork to file away.

  • Comfortable in the "Gray Area": You can take an ambiguous, high-level engineering specification from our internal R&D team and translate it into a foolproof, objective Control Plan for an operator on the assembly line. You hate ambiguity and proactively build the frameworks to eliminate it.

  • Data-Driven & Analytics-First: You don’t manage by "gut feeling" or take a vendor's word at face value. You live in the data. You are highly proficient in analyzing manufacturing metrics, plotting yield trends, and using data to pinpoint hidden risks on the shop floor before they manifest as costly field returns or shipment delays.

  • Hands-on and Present: You are not an "armchair engineer" who manages strictly via email. You are eager to roll up your sleeves, look at high-definition line feeds (or travel to the site when necessary), examine limit samples, and anchor yourself to the reality of the shop floor to protect Meter's brand integrity.

Why Meter?

The internet runs the world. Every purchase you make, video call you join, it's all packets flowing through networks. But those networks haven’t changed for decades. They’re brittle, complex, and surprisingly hard to set up in an enterprise space.

We started Meter to build better networks. We had to build everything from the ground-up: designing and building our own enterprise hardware, intuitive software, and streamlined operations to deliver great outcomes for our customers. Today, we build and deploy these networks at scale. Ambitious companies and enduring institutions like Bridgewater, Lyft, Reddit, rely on Meter to keep their thousands of employees and locations online and productive.

Our bet with Meter is simple: we will all use the internet more than we do today. We believe we have the definitive networking stack in place to enable business to do so as seamlessly and reliably as any modern utility.

title: Head of Recruiting Operations
description:
Who We Are

Verkada is transforming how organizations protect their people and places with an integrated, privacy-sensitive AI-powered platform that includes solutions for video security, access control, air quality sensors, alarms, intercoms, and visitor management.

We’ve got serious momentum in the market: more than 30,000 customers (including 100+ of the Fortune 500), a $5.8B valuation, more than $1 billion in annualized bookings, and backing from CapitalG, Sequoia Capital, General Catalyst, Felicis Ventures, Next47 and more. Physical AI is one of the most consequential technology shifts of our time, and Verkada is at the center of it.

You can look at all kinds of communities to see our platform’s impact in the world. It's the retailer that uses our agentic AI to deter theft before it happens. The warehouse that uses AI-powered alerts to make sure its team is protected on the floor with proper PPE. The school that’s alerted to a threat in real-time and triggers a lockdown in seconds, not minutes. We’re rapidly scaling this impact: today, more than 2 million Verkada devices are deployed across 170+ countries.

About the Role

At Verkada, recruiting is one of our greatest competitive advantages. As we continue to scale globally, we're looking for a Head of Recruiting Operations to build the systems, processes, and operating model that enable us to hire exceptional talent at scale.

Reporting directly to the VP of Sales Strategy & Operations, you'll lead the teams responsible for scaling Verkada's recruiting function and organization, including Recruiting Operations, Recruiting Coordinators, Recruiting Enablement, Recruiting Systems & Tools, and our Embedded Recruiting Strategy function.

Unlike traditional recruiting organizations, Verkada operates a decentralized recruiting model where recruiting teams are embedded within the business functions they support. You'll establish the operating model, governance, and shared ways of working that enable those teams to operate as one high-performing recruiting organization while partnering closely with Recruiting Leadership, Finance, People, and business leaders to drive hiring excellence across the company.

This is a highly visible leadership role at the intersection of recruiting operations, analytics, systems, and business strategy. You'll improve how we hire by building scalable recruiting programs, leveraging data to inform decisions, and creating the operational foundation that supports Verkada's continued growth.

We are committed to a thriving in-office culture. This role is based in our San Mateo headquarters and requires working onsite.

What You'll Do

  • Define and execute Verkada's Recruiting Strategy & Operations roadmap, building the operating model, governance, and processes that enable our recruiting organization to scale effectively.
  • Own the end-to-end recruiting operating model across Recruiting Operations, Embedded Recruiting Strategy, Recruiting Enablement, Recruiting Coordinators, and Recruiting Systems, ensuring consistent execution, accountability, and service delivery.
  • Build and continuously improve recruiting programs, interview processes, and operational workflows that create a consistent experience for recruiters, hiring managers, interviewers, and candidates.
  • Establish operational rigor through standardized recruiting processes, documentation, change management, and consistent execution across the recruiting organization.
  • Own executive recruiting dashboards and KPIs, delivering actionable insights on hiring performance, recruiter productivity, funnel health, quality of hire, capacity planning, and recruiting effectiveness.
  • Partner with Finance and business leaders to operationalize hiring plans through recruiting capacity planning, forecasting, and resource allocation.
  • Lead executive recruiting reviews, presenting hiring performance, organizational insights, and data-driven recommendations to senior leadership.
  • Evaluate, implement, and optimize recruiting technologies while ensuring strong systems governance, data integrity, workflow automation, and AI-enabled recruiting processes.
  • Own and continuously evolve Verkada's Quality of Hire framework, ensuring consistent adoption of structured interviewing, the Sales Performance Record (SPR), and post-hire hiring quality reviews across the recruiting organization.
  • Partner cross-functionally with Recruiting Leadership, Finance, Sales Strategy & Operations, Global People Operations, and Engineering to drive operational excellence across the recruiting organization.
  • Develop and coach a high-performing team while fostering a culture of analytical thinking, accountability, continuous improvement, and exceptional partnership.

What You Bring

  • 10+ years of experience leading Recruiting Operations, Recruiting Strategy, Talent Operations, or a related function within a high-growth organization.
  • Experience building and scaling Recruiting Operations functions with deep expertise in recruiting workflows, interview process design, operating models, governance, recruiting systems, capacity planning, and quality of hire.
  • Experience leading Recruiting Operations, Program Management, or Strategy teams while developing high-performing managers and individual contributors.
  • Proven success implementing scalable recruiting processes that improve recruiter effectiveness, hiring manager experience, candidate experience, and operational consistency.
  • Strong analytical skills with experience building executive dashboards, translating recruiting data into business insights, and influencing organizational decisions.
  • Experience implementing and optimizing ATS and recruiting technologies (e.g., Greenhouse, Workday), including automation and AI-enabled workflows.
  • Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence leaders across Recruiting, Finance, People, and the business.
  • A builder's mindset—you thrive in ambiguity, enjoy solving complex operational challenges, and continuously improve how organizations hire.

US Employee Benefits

Verkada is committed to fostering a workplace environment that prioritizes the holistic health and wellbeing of our employees and their families by offering comprehensive wellness perks, benefits, and resources. Our benefits and perks programs include, but are not limited to:

  • Healthcare programs that can be tailored to meet the personal health and financial well-being needs - Premiums are 100% covered for the employee under at least one plan and 80% for family premiums under all plans
  • Nationwide medical, vision and dental coverage
  • Health Saving Account (HSA) with annual employer contributions and Flexible Spending Account (FSA) with tax saving options
  • Expanded mental health support
  • Paid parental leave policy & fertility benefits
  • Time off to relax and recharge through our paid holidays, firmwide extended holidays, flexible PTO and personal sick time
  • Professional development stipend
  • Wellness/fitness benefits
  • Healthy lunches provided daily
  • Commuter benefits

Additional Information

  • You must be independently authorized to work in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment visa for this role, at this time.

Annual Pay Range

At Verkada, we want to attract and retain the best employees, and compensate them in a way that appropriately and fairly values their individual contribution to the company. With that in mind, we carefully consider a number of factors to determine the appropriate starting pay for an employee, including their primary work location and an assessment of a candidate's skills and experience, as well as market demands and internal parity. A Verkada employee may be eligible for additional forms of compensation, depending on their role, including sales incentives, discretionary bonuses, and/or equity in the company in the form of restricted stock units (RSUs)

$225,000—$275,000 USD

title: Senior Vice President / Managing Director, Legal Communications
description:
Who is Prosek?

We are entrepreneurial. Prosek is one of the largest independent communications and marketing firms in the U.S., with offices and strategic partners across the country and worldwide. We are specialized. Prosek provides unparalleled expertise with financial and professional services companies. We are people-centric. Our teams work together in a collegial atmosphere that breeds professional respect and friendship. We are award-winning. Join an "Army of Entrepreneurs" that was recently named a 2026 Global Agency of the Year by PRovoke Media.

Overview:

Prosek Partners is seeking a Senior Vice President or Managing Director to lead and grow our work with law firms and legal-sector clients. This senior leader will serve as a trusted advisor to firm leadership and practice heads, providing strategic communications counsel that strengthens the firm's reputation, advances business priorities, and elevates the visibility of the firm and its attorneys.

The ideal candidate brings deep experience advising law firms and legal organizations, along with expertise across adjacent sectors such as professional services, financial services, private markets, and corporate communications. They will lead senior client engagements, develop integrated communications strategies, drive new business, expand existing client relationships, and mentor a high-performing team.

What You’ll Be Doing:

  • Lead integrated strategic communications programs for law firms, legal-sector organizations, and other professional or financial services clients
  • Serve as a trusted advisor to managing partners, firm leadership, practice leaders, general counsel, and other senior executives
  • Develop and execute integrated communications strategies that support firm reputation, practice growth, executive visibility, talent priorities, and broader business objectives
  • Lead thought leadership and executive positioning programs for attorneys and senior leaders across priority practices and industries
  • Oversee proactive media relations strategies, leveraging strong relationships with legal, business, financial, and trade media
  • Identify timely opportunities to connect client expertise to breaking news, industry trends, regulatory developments, and market activity
  • Manage and grow executive-level client relationships, ensuring consistently strong counsel, service, and account performance
  • Drive organic account growth and lead new business development efforts, including prospecting, proposal development, and pitch leadership
  • Partner across Prosek’s integrated capabilities to bring clients a coordinated approach spanning media relations, crisis and issues management, digital, content, creative, and executive communications
  • Mentor and develop team members, creating a collaborative, entrepreneurial, and high-performance environment

What Makes You Qualified:

  • 15+ years of experience in strategic communications, public relations, corporate communications, or a related field
  • Significant experience advising law firms, legal organizations, or legal-sector clients
  • Strong understanding of the business of law, including the priorities and communications needs of managing partners, practice leaders, and senior attorneys
  • Expertise spanning professional services, financial services, private markets, corporate communications, or another relevant sector
  • Demonstrated ability to provide senior-level counsel on reputation management, executive positioning, thought leadership, media relations, and complex issues
  • Established relationships with legal, business, financial, and trade media
  • Proven success managing and expanding client relationships and contributing to new business growth
  • Strong leadership skills and experience developing senior and junior talent
  • Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills, with the executive presence to counsel senior stakeholders
  • Bachelor’s degree in communications, public relations, journalism, business, or a related field

What are the perks?

  • 401(k) employer match: There is no time like the present to prepare for your future!
  • Premium healthcare plans, including medical, dental and vision coverage: Your health comes first.
  • Hybrid work model: 3 days in the office, 2 days from home - Pick your own schedule.
  • 2 weeks of remote work per year: You do you!
  • Generous Paid Time Off (PTO) package, including birthday PTO: Take time to celebrate, recharge, and reset!
  • Custom career opportunities: Choose your own adventure!

Our Core Values:

  • Chemistry, Collaboration and Belonging: Our collegial culture inspires people with different perspectives and backgrounds to work towards common goals as we brainstorm, plan and execute on behalf of our clients and to build our business together.
  • Grit and Hustle: We work hard. We roll up our sleeves. We are not precious or pretentious. We do not take short cuts. Instead, we put in the work and do what it takes to get the job done.
  • The Excitement of New Challenges: We view challenges as opportunities and embrace them. They motivate us to learn and grow so that we can be the best versions of ourselves, for our clients and each other.
  • A Workplace with Humanity: We recognize the rigor and demand of our work. We also recognize that life inside and outside of Prosek can be stressful. We work very hard to run our business with a heavy dose of humanity and to make Prosek a safe place where people enjoy the work and each other.

Our Beliefs on Culture, Diversity & Belonging:

We are committed to building a diverse workforce reflecting and embracing diversity of all kinds – diversity of geography, cognitive diversity, race, ethnicity, age, gender identity, sexual orientation, political affiliation, socioeconomic backgrounds. We believe having teams that represent the broader communities where we live and work creates a culture that celebrates creativity, inclusiveness and teamwork and helps us offer our global clientele of mature and emerging businesses counsel that is dynamic, rich and nuanced.

The anticipated salary range for this position is $175,000-$275,000. An employee's salary is determined by a range of factors including but not limited to relevant experience, qualifications, skills, seniority, geographic location, performance, and business or organizational needs. The range listed is one component of Prosek's total compensation package for employees. Other rewards may include medical, dental and vision coverage, 401(k) matching, new business commission, paid time off, and other benefits.

Prosek Partners provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.
