Rather than repeating your background during multiple screening calls, you’ll tell your story once, allowing future interviews to focus on meaningful conversations.

description:

title: Principal Software Engineer
description:
MediaAlpha is a customer acquisition solutions provider powered by technology and data science. The company provides industry-leading solutions designed to reach consumers shopping within high-consideration categories such as property and casualty insurance, health insurance, life insurance, and more.

Hybrid role: 3 days/week in office

Role Overview

As a Principal Software Engineer at MediaAlpha, you will be a technical leader accountable at the ecosystem level. You own the architecture, health, and strategic technical direction across large and complex systems that span multiple teams—ensuring sound design, operational excellence, and alignment with business needs across the ecosystem. You will shape broad architecture, partner with engineering and business leaders to define roadmaps, and drive technical standards that the organization builds on.

Principal Engineers are hands-on technical leaders. You write code, make architectural decisions, and solve the hardest technical problems in the ecosystem. Your work sets the standard for engineering quality and shapes how systems evolve. The difference at this level is that your technical contributions have ecosystem-wide impact—you define the patterns, frameworks, and architectural direction that other engineers build within.

Everything we build, decide, and deliver is measured against four pillars: Fast, Flexible, Robust, and Transparent. Principal Engineers serve these pillars through architectural clarity that eliminates wasted motion, systems designed for change and adaptability, patterns and standards that ensure long-term health, and active ambassadorship that makes technical direction visible across the organization.

The ideal candidate is a masterful engineer who operates at ecosystem scope—driving technical strategy across teams and groups, shaping architecture that spans organizational boundaries, and developing senior technical leaders. You operate effectively across organizational boundaries, mentor and lead engineers throughout the organization, and drive technical excellence at ecosystem scale. We are an intentionally small organization, designed for agility, speed, collaboration, and workability, where Principal Engineers serve as the technical authorities and go-to leaders across multiple teams and groups.

Responsibilities

Ecosystem Architecture & Technical Ownership

  • Own large and complex systems end to end with accountability at the ecosystem level—ensuring sound requirements, design, architecture, coding, processes, and operations for holistically complete solutions
  • Shape broad architecture by leading projects involving multiple large components, complex libraries, or major pieces of application infrastructure, with multi-quarter strategic vision
  • Proactively monitor and maintain the health of all systems within your area of accountability, identifying and driving high-risk, long-term tradeoff decisions at the ecosystem level

Engineering Standards & Technical Strategy

  • Define new patterns and advanced methodologies that ensure all engineering work maintains standards for maintainability, scalability, security, reliability, privacy, and compliance at ecosystem scale
  • Partner with technical leaders to establish and evangelize standards for architecture, code quality, and system design across the engineering organization
  • Identify and proactively tackle system-wide and organizational technical debt, driving measurable improvements in platform health and engineering effectiveness

Leadership & Cross-Organizational Influence

  • Lead at the group level as a role model; actively mentor engineers throughout the organization and guide senior technical leaders in decision-making at the feature and component level
  • Develop senior technical leaders toward broader impact—growing their ability to own systems, set standards, and influence architecture beyond their immediate team
  • Engage cross-team and cross-organizational stakeholders to define strategy, principles, goals, and requirements that align technical direction with business needs
  • Represent groups and ecosystems to the broader company; be accountable for ecosystem infrastructure, design, and architecture and serve as the go-to technical authority across teams

Requirements

  • 10+ years experience in software development with a track record of increasing technical scope and organizational influence
  • Demonstrated ability to own and drive ecosystem-level technical initiatives spanning multiple teams and multiple quarters from conception through completion
  • Track record of defining architectural patterns, engineering standards, and frameworks that are adopted and referenced across an organization
  • Experience mentoring and developing engineers at multiple levels, including guiding senior technical decision-making
  • Proven ability to shape broad architecture and lead complex, multi-component projects that span organizational boundaries
  • Strong understanding of software engineering methodologies, system design, and architecture at the ecosystem level
  • Strong SQL skills and understanding of database and query optimizations
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to represent technical strategy and architectural direction to both engineering and business audiences
  • Ability to identify and drive high-risk, long-term tradeoff decisions with sound judgment and clear rationale
  • A self-starter, comfortable with ambiguity, who creates clarity and structure for others
  • B.S. in a technical discipline preferred; equivalent experience and a proven track record of results will be valued equally

The Bottom Line

The measure of a Principal Engineer’s success is the health and trajectory of the ecosystems they own.

The best Principal Engineers define the architectural direction that guides technical decisions across teams, set engineering standards that raise the bar for the entire organization, solve the problems no one else can, and develop the engineers around them into stronger technical leaders.

Compensation & Benefits

We are excited to offer a competitive base pay range of $200,000 to $350,000 per year for this position, based on experience and qualifications. But that's not all - as a valued member of our team, you will also have access to an array of top-notch benefits, including:

  • Annual bonus program and participation in our Restricted Stock Unit program
  • 100% Employer-paid health, dental, and vision insurance for you, your dependents, and spouse or registered domestic partner
  • 100% Employer paid long term disability, and life insurance
  • 401(k) retirement plan with matching contributions to help you plan for your future
  • Open Paid Time Off policy with a Brthday Hookie day off, 13 holiday, and 5 Recharge days
  • Professional development reimbursement along with a subscription to LinkedIn Learning
  • Cell Phone, Wellness, and Internet expense reimbursement, along with a subscription to the Calm App
  • 100% fully paid parental leave for team members up to 22 weeks for the primary caregiver and 12 weeks for the secondary caregiver
  • Dog-friendly offices (LA and AZ) along with a $300 pet adoption reimbursement

Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion

MediaAlpha is committed to fostering, cultivating, and maintaining a culture of diversity, equity, and inclusion. Our philosophy and actions are built on the premise that as an employer and citizens of our communities, we can create opportunities for lasting change.

Fair Chance

We are also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified applicants with disabilities and disabled veterans in our application process. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please contact us at peopleops@mediaalpha.com or (213) 316-6256.

title: Director Foreign Trade
description:
The Director of Foreign Trade is responsible for leading the organization's global trade compliance and customs strategy, ensuring adherence to import/export regulations while optimizing duty costs and enabling efficient international supply chain operations. This role provides strategic direction for trade programs, free trade agreement utilization, customs compliance, duty optimization, trade technology platforms, and cross-border operational excellence.

The Director serves as a trusted advisor to executive leadership, supply chain, procurement, manufacturing, logistics, finance, and legal teams, balancing compliance obligations with business objectives and growth initiatives. The position leads a team of foreign trade professionals and manages relationships with customs authorities, brokers, trade consultants, and external service providers.

Strategic Leadership

  • Develop and execute the organization's foreign trade and customs strategy.
  • Align trade compliance programs with corporate growth, sourcing, manufacturing, and logistics objectives.
  • Advise executive leadership on trade risks, tariffs, geopolitical developments, and international regulatory changes.
  • Lead trade-related initiatives supporting localization, nearshoring, global sourcing, and supply chain transformation.

Trade Compliance & Governance

  • Ensure compliance with all import, export, customs, sanctions, and trade regulations.
  • Establish and maintain policies, procedures, and internal controls governing international trade activities.
  • Oversee import/export classification, valuation, country of origin determinations, and customs documentation.
  • Direct internal and external compliance audits and implement corrective actions when required.

Customs & Duty Optimization

  • Lead programs to minimize trade costs while maintaining full regulatory compliance.
  • Maximize utilization of:
    • Free Trade Agreements (FTAs)
    • Foreign Trade Zones (FTZs)
    • Bonded Warehouses
    • Drawback Programs
    • Duty Suspension Programs
    • IMMEX/Maquiladora Programs
    • Other trade incentive programs
  • Identify opportunities for duty savings and tariff mitigation strategies.

Operational Oversight

  • Oversee import and export operations across multiple business units and legal entities.
  • Ensure efficient management of customs brokers, freight forwarders, and trade service providers.
  • Drive process standardization and operational excellence in cross-border transactions.
  • Monitor KPIs related to compliance, customs clearance performance, duty savings, and operational efficiency.

Risk Management

  • Assess emerging trade risks resulting from regulatory changes, tariff actions, sanctions, and supply chain disruptions.
  • Develop mitigation plans to address customs exposure and compliance vulnerabilities.
  • Support investigations, disclosures, and interactions with customs authorities when necessary.
  • Ensure effective business continuity planning for global trade activities.

Technology & Digital Transformation

  • Lead implementation and optimization of trade management systems and customs technologies.
  • Promote automation, data analytics, and AI-enabled solutions to improve trade compliance effectiveness.
  • Ensure integrity of trade master data supporting classification, origin, and compliance processes.

Stakeholder & Team Leadership

  • Build and lead a high-performing team of foreign trade professionals.
  • Develop talent, succession plans, and training programs within the trade function.
  • Partner with procurement, logistics, manufacturing, finance, legal, tax, and government affairs teams.
  • Represent the organization in dealings with customs authorities, trade associations, and external stakeholders.

Qualifications

Required

  • Bachelor's degree in International Business, Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Finance, Law, Business Administration, or related field.
  • 10+ years of progressive experience in global trade compliance, customs, import/export operations, or international logistics.
  • 5+ years of leadership experience managing trade compliance or customs organizations.
  • Deep knowledge of:
    • Customs regulations
    • International trade agreements
    • Import/export controls
    • Tariff classification
    • Country-of-origin determination
    • Duty optimization programs
  • Experience working with customs authorities and external trade partners.

Preferred

  • Master's degree (MBA, International Trade, Supply Chain, or related discipline).
  • Licensed Customs Broker or equivalent trade certification.
  • Experience in manufacturing, automotive, industrial, or global supply chain environments.
  • Expertise with trade automation platforms (SAP GTS, GTXXI, and similar systems).

Critical Competencies

  • Strategic Thinking
  • Executive Presence
  • Trade Compliance Expertise
  • Customs & Tariff Management
  • Risk Assessment & Mitigation
  • Global Supply Chain Knowledge
  • Financial Acumen
  • Stakeholder Management
  • Change Leadership
  • Process Improvement
  • Data Analytics & Trade Technology
  • Team Development & Coaching

Success Metrics

  • Zero material trade compliance violations
  • Duty and tariff savings achieved
  • Trade program utilization rates
  • Customs audit performance
  • Import/export process efficiency
  • Trade cost reduction
  • Customer and stakeholder satisfaction
  • Team engagement and talent development
  • Successful implementation of trade technology initiatives

International Bosch associates can apply.

title: Director, Global Employment Law
description:
Job Description

We are seeking a motivated and experienced lawyer specialized in Employment Law to join our Global Employment Law team to support the continued growth of the ServiceNow in the United States. The role will report to the Senior Director, Global Employment Law.

The position will be primarily responsible for providing legal counsel and partnership to the Global People Organization and other key internal stakeholders globally on employment law matters. This is a unique opportunity to play a pivotal role in ServiceNow’s expanding legal team and to work on challenging legal issues in an exciting, fast-paced environment.

What you get to do in this role:

  • Help us build a culture of high performance and great inclusion. Deliver business oriented, risk-based advice and counsel on the full range of employment law issues including: hiring, disciplinary actions, dismissals, employee relations issues, restructurings, compensation and benefits, leaves, global workforce innovation and culture, workplace investigations and employee relations, and employee privacy matters. Fully understanding the legal requirements is the starting point – treating people fairly and creating an amazing working environment is the end point
  • Partner with the Global People Organization to create and revise global and locally compliant policies and procedures consistent with our values
  • Partner with our Workplace Investigation Partners, Employee Relations, and Global People teams on internal employee investigations
  • Advise and collaborate with the Global People Organization to develop and implement global initiatives
  • Develop and deliver best in class employee related trainings
  • Manage employment claims and litigation matters across the globe
  • Partner and collaborate with other members of the Global Employment Law team on global projects and issues
  • Monitor and maintain knowledge of changes in employment laws and regulations and industry practices that impact the business and provide practical advice and support to the business regarding the same

Qualifications

  • Experience in leveraging and critically thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision-making, and problem-solving. This may include using AI-powered tools, automating workflows, analyzing AI-driven insights, or exploring AI’s potential impact on the function or industry.
  • A strong work ethic, exceptional judgment, and uncompromising integrity
  • A law degree with strong academic credentials
  • Good standing and current bar admission to practice law in a relevant jurisdiction
  • A minimum of 12+ years of relevant legal experience practicing employment law at a top law firm and/or in-house legal department of a multi-national company; high tech experience a plus. In-house experience at a global employer strongly desirable.
  • Employment legal experience across a variety of global jurisdictions, and a desire to develop and expand expertise
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, a good sense of humor, and a proven ability to build strong and deep working relationships with internal stakeholders over multiple geographical locations
  • Ability to understand complex issues, assess risk and provide concise business-focused legal and risk mitigation advice and counsel
  • A practical, proactive, collaborative and business-focused approach to problem solving with the ability to make sound decisions and exercise good judgement
  • Ability to work independently and under pressure and to handle multiple competing tasks simultaneously and thoroughly to closure in a fast-paced environment
  • Demonstrated a global mindset and sensitivity to all cultures

title: Platform Engineer - FedD180/FedD181
description:
EMPLOYER IS A CONTRACTOR FOR THE U.S. GOVERNMENT. THIS POSITION WILL REQUIRE AN ACTIVE SECRET CLEARANCE TO APPLY.

Defense Unicorns is seeking a Platform Engineer to join our platform team — a combined DevOps and Site Reliability Engineering team responsible for the development, maintenance, and reliability of a cloud-based platform environment. The ideal candidate is a strong problem-solver with hands-on experience in Kubernetes, cloud infrastructure, and CI/CD, and is motivated by building and improving the systems that other teams depend on.

In this role, you will work across infrastructure as code, automated deployments, identity and access management, monitoring, and CI/CD pipelines. You will serve as a bridge between application teams and the platform, advocating best practices and helping ensure that the platform is reliable, secure, and scalable. You should be comfortable operating in ambiguity, contributing to documentation and standards where they exist, and building them where they don’t.

Responsibilities

  • Build, maintain, and improve Kubernetes clusters and containerized application deployments across cloud environments (AWS, EKS, RKE2)
  • Develop and manage infrastructure as code (IaC) to provision and configure platform resources consistently and repeatably
  • Own and improve CI/CD pipelines, including GitLab CI configuration, runner deployments, and automated build and deployment workflows
  • Support identity and access management through tools such as Keycloak, including user onboarding, role configuration, and troubleshooting
  • Implement and maintain monitoring, alerting, and logging to ensure platform health and support incident investigation
  • Manage certificate lifecycle operations, including renewal of public certificates and related automation
  • Contribute to platform security posture through container security practices, Iron Bank image compliance, and support for ATO processes
  • Collaborate with application teams to troubleshoot deployment issues, broken pipelines, and platform integration problems

title: UX Writer (USA Remote)
description:
Turnitin is a pioneer in education technology with its roots in academic integrity, delivering flexible assessment solutions to higher education institutions, high schools, and graduate programs. With the broadest and deepest applications of AI for education, Turnitin is building innovative new products for the next decade of education. We are seeking an experienced researcher to help us increase our velocity in delivering knowledge, products, and capabilities that help educational institutions empower student outcomes with academic integrity. As a UX Researcher, you will be responsible for creating clear, user-centered product content and contributing to content decisions across the end-to-end product development process. You will collaborate closely with product and engineering partners as well as the cross-functional UX team.

To succeed in this role, you must have a solid foundation in UX and technical writing practices and be able to connect content decisions to user needs, product goals, and business outcomes. You thrive in a collaborative, fast-paced environment where requirements can change. Our environment requires good judgment, knowing when to move quickly with clear, practical content and when to spend more time exploring, testing, and aligning on the right content approach.

A day in the life:

The UX Writer will work closely with designers, researchers, product managers, and other stakeholders on a day-to-day basis. They will write, review, and refine product content across the user experience, from interface copy and onboarding to product guidance. They will use user experience outcomes, product context, and content principles to make complex experiences clearer, more consistent, and easier to use. They will work closely within the UX Writing team, where every work day is full of collaboration, curiosity, and shared commitment to creating meaningful product experiences.

Responsibilities:

  • Write clear, concise UX copy for product experiences, including UI text, error messages, and onboarding.
  • Create and improve user guidance and release notes
  • Collaborate with UX Designers and Product Managers throughout the design process, offering copy and content feedback from early concepts through delivery.
  • Apply UX writing principles, style guidance, accessibility considerations, and user research to your content decisions.
  • Explain the reasoning behind content choices to stakeholders clearly and confidently.
  • Manage project-level feedback loops with stakeholders and respond constructively to feedback.
  • Use Jira to track, prioritize, and deliver work within a structured sprint process.

Essential

  • Bachelor’s degree in English, Writing, Technical Communication, Human-Computer Interaction, UX Design, Linguistics, Communications, Education, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 2–7 years of industry experience in UX writing, technical writing, or related fields (e.g., education, communications, product management)
  • Proven experience writing and improving user-centred product content, including interface copy, guidance, onboarding, and other content that supports clear, usable product experiences
  • Strong writing skills, with excellent grammar, spelling, punctuation, and attention to detail.
  • Ability to balance multiple project work tracks across different product surfaces
  • Demonstrated ability to transform data-driven insights into actionable content recommendations that directly influence product decisions
  • Confident working with multiple stakeholders asking good questions and managing feedback.
  • Experience working with project tracking tools such as Jira and working in an Agile methodology setup.
  • A strong writing portfolio that demonstrates multiple methods and approaches to writing along with the tangible outcomes and impact of the work.

Desirable

  • Experience working with CMSs such as Zendesk and creating structured content using HTML markup.
  • Experience in writing for and around AI powered products.
  • Outstanding interpersonal skills, with a knack for building relationships and influencing cross-functional teams.
  • Proven track record of collaborating effectively in a diverse team environment.

The expected annual base salary range for this position is: $75,803/year to $126,338/year. This position is bonus eligible.

Actual compensation will be provided in writing at the time of offer, if extended, and is determined by work location and a range of other relevant factors, including but not limited to: experience, skills, degrees, licensures, certifications, and other job-related factors. Internal equity, market and organizational factors are also considered.

Total Rewards @ Turnitin
At Turnitin, we believe Total Rewards go far beyond pay. While salary, bonus, or commission are important, they’re only part of the value you receive in exchange for your work.

Beyond compensation, you’ll experience the intrinsic rewards of unleashing your potential and making a positive impact on global education. You’ll also thrive in a culture free of politics, surrounded by humble, inclusive, and collaborative teammates.

title: Founding Ecosystem Engineer
description:
About Pantheon

Pantheon WebOps Platform powers the open web, running more than 300,000 sites in the cloud for customers including Google, Princeton, Salesloft and Doctors Without Borders. Every day, thousands of developers and marketers create, iterate, and scale WordPress and Drupal sites to reach billions of people globally. Pantheon’s multitenant, container-based platform enables organizations to manage all of their websites from a single dashboard. Organizations including Clorox and the United Nations drive results through accelerated development and real-time publishing using Pantheon’s collaborative workflows.

The Role

This is a foundational role — the first engineer of its kind here, on a product early in its life. There is a large amount of ground to clear and no established playbook. You'll define the discipline as you build it.

The people implementing on our new platform — developers at agency partners in most cases, in-house teams at direct customers in others — are building design systems and websites and connecting those sites to third-party services: commerce platforms, identity providers, analytics, search, consent management, industry-specific backends. Your job is to make that work easier. Not by doing it for them — we provide the materials so clients can do it themselves. "Materials" is deliberately broad: documentation and guides, scripts, AI skills, connectors, reference implementations, and example widgets with integrations already built in (which are really just reference implementations in another form).

How the work arrives: our sales engineer learns that a client is about to implement against a particular system — say, BigCommerce. You, the SE, and the client then work out the list of materials that would make that implementation easier, and you build them. The one-off then becomes reusable: what you built for one client's BigCommerce integration is the starting kit for the next one.

The mix of writing versus coding will shift over time. Early on, it's probably more writing — guides and documentation — with the coding share growing as patterns repeat and reference implementations accumulate. We honestly don't know the long-run split, which is why we need someone genuinely strong at both.

What you'll do

  • Scope enablement needs per implementation. Work with the sales engineer and the client to identify what would make an upcoming implementation easier, and turn that into a concrete build list.
  • Write documentation and guides. Clear, tested, step-by-step material that a developer who has never talked to you can follow to a working result.
  • Build reference implementations and example widgets. Working examples with real integrations built in — the fastest way to show a client how something is done is to hand them a version that already does it.
  • Build connectors and adapters. Where a category is a long tail of vendors rather than one dominant player, build the flexible pattern plus worked examples rather than betting on a single vendor.
  • Build scripts and AI skills. Tooling — including agentic AI skills — that automates or accelerates the repetitive parts of implementation work.
  • Generalize from one-off to reusable. When a solution gets built for one client, capture it so the next client with the same need starts from a kit instead of from scratch.
  • Feed product. You'll see, before anyone else, which needs recur often enough to become real platform features. Make that case with evidence.

What you'll need

  • Strong full-stack engineering skills with real depth in the modern JavaScript ecosystem — Next.js and React specifically.
  • Experience integrating third-party systems: REST/GraphQL APIs, webhooks, OAuth/SAML authentication flows.
  • Writing ability that matches your engineering ability. Especially early, much of this job's output is written material — and it has to work for a developer you'll never meet.
  • Comfort building with AI tooling as a first-class part of the workflow, including agentic coding tools and building reusable AI skills.
  • Comfort with ambiguity and greenfield work. There is no existing library, no established process, and no one who has done this job here before. You'll need to decide what to build, in what order, with imperfect information.
  • Ability to work directly with client developers — at agencies and in-house — patient, clear, responsive.
  • A pragmatic, ship-it disposition. The materials need to be solid enough that clients trust them and fast enough that they exist when the implementation needs them.

What success looks like in the First 90 days

  • You've scoped and delivered enablement materials for several live implementations, working the SE-client-you triangle.
  • A client developer has completed an integration using your materials without hands-on help from you.
  • The beginnings of a reusable library exist: the first guides, reference implementations, and skills, organized so the next implementation starts from them.
  • The product team has received at least one evidence-backed recommendation about what should graduate from enablement material to platform feature.

What We Offer

We have all the usual perks and benefits but what we can really offer you is a fantastic work environment powered by an amazing team.

  • Industry competitive compensation and equity plan
  • Flexible time off, sick days, and 13 paid holidays
  • Comprehensive medical insurance including Health, Dental and Vision
  • Paid parental leave (plus fertility, adoption and other family planning benefits)
  • In-office workspace (San Francisco & Chicago)
  • Monthly allowance for wellness, reading and access to LinkedIn Learning for continued development
  • Events and activities both team-based and company wide that inspire, educate and cultivate

Compensation: Base Salary of $140,000 - 173,000 USD, plus bonus and equity

Pantheon complies with federal and local disability laws and makes reasonable accommodations for applicants and employees with disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation due to a disability for any part of the interview process, please contact talent@pantheon.io. title: Senior Staff DevOps Engineer — Data Discovery & AI Governance
description:

OneTrust’s mission is to enable innovation through the responsible use of data and AI. We believe that ensuring data is trusted shouldn’t slow teams down—it should accelerate what’s possible. OneTrust's mission is to enable innovation through the responsible use of data and AI. We believe that ensuring data is trusted shouldn't slow teams down—it should accelerate what's possible. This led us to develop the first technology platform for responsible data use in 2016. Today, with AI representing the latest and most impactful expansion of data yet, OneTrust is once again redefining what responsible innovation looks like. Trusted by thousands of organizations worldwide, OneTrust is shaping the future where trusted data becomes a transformative force for business and society.

The Challenge

We are hiring a Senior Staff DevOps Engineer to join our Detect & Discover (D&D) team. This team owns three product lines — Data Discovery, Privacy Automation, and AI Governance — serving thousands of enterprise customers across multi-cloud and on-premises environments.

In this role, you will lead the infrastructure strategy for our Kubernetes-based on-premises platform and cloud deployments. This includes architecting automated worker node deployments for Azure Marketplace, AWS Marketplace, and GCP; driving container-hardening initiatives to systematically eliminate CVEs; and ensuring the reliability, scalability, and security of our distributed scanning and classification platform. You will act as a technical leader, mentoring engineers and collaborating closely with product security, engineering squads, and customer-facing teams.

Your Mission

  • Kubernetes Platform Architecture: Architect and maintain production-grade Kubernetes platforms across cloud (AKS, EKS, GKE) and on-premises (K3s, microk8s) environments. Own the full lifecycle — cluster provisioning, upgrades, node pool management, and disaster recovery.
  • Deployment Automation & Marketplace Publishing: Develop and maintain automation using Helm, ARM templates, BICEP, Terraform, and CloudFormation to streamline worker node provisioning on Azure Marketplace, AWS Marketplace, and Reduce customer setup complexity so clients don't need advanced Kubernetes expertise on-site.
  • Container Hardening & Vulnerability Management: Lead our container-hardening program by adopting secure base images for distributed components including Kafka, PostgreSQL, Elasticsearch, Temporal and Vault. Own the systematic reduction of CVEs flagged by Vulnerability Scanners.
  • CI/CD & Release Engineering: Maintain and improve CI/CD pipelines ensuring zero-downtime deployments, automated rollbacks, and full auditability. Drive GitOps practices, Improve DevEx and infrastructure-as-code across the team.
  • Observability & Platform Reliability: Design monitoring, alerting, diagnostics, and self-healing capabilities using Datadog, Loki, Promtail. Ensure the platform is optimized for performance, logarithmic cost growth, and high-throughput scaling across thousands of tenant environments.
  • Incident Response & Production Support: Lead incident investigations, root cause analysis, and long-term remediation for production service interruptions. Participate in on-call rotation and drive systemic fixes to prevent recurrence.
  • Mentorship & Technical Leadership: Mentor engineers, drive DevOps best practices across teams, and raise the technical bar for infrastructure engineering quality.

You Are

  • A hands-on technical leader with strong analytical and problem-solving skills and a passion for high-quality infrastructure engineering.
  • Technically curious and self-motivated, able to self-teach new technologies and prioritize complex tasks in a fast-paced environment.
  • A collaborative partner who works seamlessly with security teams, software developers, and product managers to drive alignment on infrastructure standards.
  • Someone who thrives in ambiguous environments, takes ownership of complex technical challenges, and influences across teams without direct authority.
  • An encouraging mentor who enjoys upskilling engineers and continuously improving reliability, automation, and customer experience.

Your Experience Includes

  • Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.
  • Experience: 8+ years in DevOps, SRE, or Platform Engineering roles.
  • Container Orchestration: Expert knowledge of Kubernetes, Helm, Linux, Docker, and networking
  • Multi-Cloud Platforms: Strong working knowledge of Azure, AWS, and GCP, with specific depth in at least one.
  • Automation & Scripting: Proficiency in Go and/or Python, plus Bash/Shell scripting for infrastructure automation and integrations.
  • CI/CD & GitOps: Deep understanding of CI/CD pipelines (GitLab or similar), GitOps workflows, and infrastructure-as-code methodologies.
  • Databases & Messaging: Experience with PostgreSQL, Elasticsearch, and distributed messaging systems (Apache Kafka, NATS).
  • Security & Compliance: Experience with security scanning, container image hardening, and vulnerability remediation in enterprise environments.
  • Production Operations: Experience supporting enterprise production environments and handling customer escalations.
  • Methodologies: Prior experience working in Agile/Scrum enterprise software development.
  • Communication: Excellent verbal and written communication and technical leadership skills.

Extra Awesome

  • Experience building and publishing B2B enterprise software on Azure Marketplace, AWS Marketplace, or GCP Marketplace.
  • Proven experience with Chainguard or other minimal, hardened container distributions for software supply chain security.
  • Experience with on-premises enterprise software deployments (K3s, microk8s, airgapped environments).
  • Familiarity with Temporal workflow orchestration or similar durable execution frameworks.
  • Prior exposure to MLOps methodologies, including model versioning, pipeline auditability, and AI asset discovery.
  • Experience with service meshes, Kubernetes operators, and AI-assisted operations.

title: Senior Software Engineer - Backend
description:
Who We Are


At Perry Weather, we're at the forefront of providing innovative weather safety solutions. Thousands of users trust our fast-growing weather safety platform across various industries, including school districts, cities, universities, golf courses, professional sports, and more. Our cutting-edge software and connected hardware empower organizations to make rapid decisions when faced with weather disruptions, ensuring the safety of individuals and the smooth operation of activities/events.


The Opportunity


We're seeking a Senior Software Engineer with deep experience in C# .NET to help evolve and scale the backend services that power our platform. Our system connects with thousands of in-house designed weather stations and outdoor warning systems deployed across North America. We own the entire solution—hardware- and deliver mission-critical weather alerting that protects lives and simplifies operations. While your primary focus will be backend systems, all of our engineers work full-stack across web, mobile (React Native), and infrastructure. This is a highly impactful role on a small, fast-moving team where your work directly affects our customers and the future of our platform and company.


What You'll Do



  • Architect, implement, and maintain scalable backend services using C# .NET.

Requirements



  • 5+ years of experience building backend systems with C# .NET in a production environment.

  • Experience independently designing and delivering large-scale platform features or services.

  • Exposure to or interest in full-stack development and DevOps practices.

  • A mindset of extreme ownership—you take initiative, solve problems proactively, and drive systems forward.

  • Bonus: Experience with IoT, telemetry, or hardware-integrated software systems.


Benefits



  • Casual work environment. We’re located in the vibrant Dallas Oak Lawn neighborhood. As a note, our team is in office M-F!

  • Comprehensive benefits. We offer competitive health insurance plans, 401(k) with employer matching, and a suite of voluntary benefits.

  • Engaging culture. Monthly All-Hands, fun events like Office Olympics, lunch-and-learns, happy hours, and more.

  • Grow with us. We’re growing rapidly, and yet we have a massive amount of work and opportunity ahead. In this role, you’ll shape how quality and security are built into our engineering process from the ground up.

title: Director, Access Optimization Lead - Hepatology /Immunology
description:
Reporting to the Senior Director, Market Access Strategy, Hepatology/Immunology Portfolio Lead, the Director, Market Access Strategy – Access Optimization Lead serves as the enterprise market access leader for assigned brand(s) and indications. This role is responsible for shaping and leading the integrated market access strategy across payer, provider, patient access, pricing and contracting, trade and distribution, and health system channels to maximize brand performance and patient access.

This leader acts as the primary market access partner to the brand, serving as a core member of the Integrated Brand Commercialization Team (IBCT) and helping define the strategic choices required to win in a complex and evolving environment. The role is accountable for translating market dynamics, customer insights, competitive intelligence, reimbursement realities, and financial tradeoffs into a clear near-, mid-, and long-term access strategy for the brand.

The Director partners across pricing and contracting, account teams, patient experience, trade and distribution, access marketing, access analytics, HEOR / value evidence, finance, policy, medical, and brand teams to align on the integrated strategic plan and ensure execution against the most critical access priorities. Success in this role requires strong strategic leadership, deep market access expertise, and the ability to influence senior stakeholders across a matrixed organization.

This position is ideal for a strategic leader who can operate as a peer to brand leadership while bringing a distinct market access lens to brand strategy, launch planning, lifecycle management, and performance optimization.

Key Responsibilities

  • Serve as the market access strategy lead for assigned brand(s), accountable for the integrated access strategy across payer, provider, patient support, pricing/contracting, trade/distribution, and organized customer segments.
  • Act as the primary Market Access representative on the IBCT, shaping brand strategy and ensuring access considerations are embedded in core commercial decisions, launch plans, lifecycle planning, and performance discussions.
  • Develop and own the market access strategy, including strategic choices required to optimize access, brand growth, financial performance, and customer pull-through.
  • Lead the development of the brand’s access perspective within the integrated brand plan, annual operating plan, and long-range strategic planning.
  • Translate customer, competitor, policy, reimbursement, and market signals into actionable recommendations that evolve the value proposition, evidence needs, strategic priorities, and tactical plan.
  • Partner with pricing and contracting, analytics, HEOR, patient experience, account teams, and trade/channel teams to evaluate choiceful tradeoffs across investments, GTN implications, customer strategies, and launch/lifecycle priorities.
  • Lead cross-functional alignment around access strategy and ensure the broader market access matrix is coordinated against the most important business priorities.
  • Provide clear and timely access guidance to brand and senior leadership on competitive events, reimbursement changes, payer and provider dynamics, organized customer trends, and emerging risks/opportunities.
  • Inform the development of customer-facing resources, evidence communication, segment strategies, and field guidance to ensure the market access strategy is translated into meaningful action.
  • Support launch readiness and lifecycle optimization for new brands, new indications, and portfolio priorities.
  • Build strong relationships across the organization and serve as a trusted strategic advisor on market access issues.

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree
  • 5+ years of relevant experience in pharmaceutical / biotech market access, access strategy, payer marketing, reimbursement, pricing/contracting, brand strategy, or related commercial roles
  • Experience developing and leading market access strategies
  • Experience working across key access stakeholders, including payers, providers, health systems, organized customers, and channel partners
  • Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional strategy in a matrixed organization
  • Strong strategic thinking, communication, and influencing skills, including the ability to influence without authority

Preferred Qualifications

  • Advanced degree (e.g., MBA, MPH, MS, PharmD)
  • Experience supporting launches, relaunches, and/or new indication launches
  • Experience with Commercial, Medicare, Medicaid, hospital / IDN / health system, and organized customer strategy
  • Experience with 340B, site-of-care dynamics, and provider channel strategy
  • Demonstrated experience interpreting and developing market access strategies for major US market and reimbursement policy evolutions (e.g., MFN, IRA, benefit design changes)
  • Demonstrated ability to synthesize quantitative analysis and qualitative insight into strategic recommendations
  • Experience making tradeoff decisions across competing initiatives, finite budgets, and GTN / access investment considerations
  • Strong executive communication and presentation skills
  • Experience managing agencies, third-party vendors, and strategic projects



Work Arrangement
This role is hybrid. You will be expected to work both on-site and remotely in line with GSK’s Performance with Choice approach. Specific on-site expectations will be discussed during the interview process.

What we offer
You will join a team committed to collaboration, learning and meaningful impact. You will get exposure to senior leaders and cross-functional partners. You will have the opportunity to shape access strategy for important therapies and to grow your leadership and strategic skills.

Apply now
If this role speaks to you, we encourage you to apply. Share your experience and tell us how you would help more patients access care. We look forward to learning about you.

Seguro de Vida.

title: Backend Engineer

title: Machine Learning Engineer
description:
At Layup Parts, we're developing the technology that will build the future.

We're a manufacturing technology company replacing months of lead time with days, using proprietary software, automation, and advanced manufacturing systems built for speed. Our customers are inventing what's next, in aerospace, defense, robotics, and beyond. To keep up with them, manufacturing has to change. That's what we're building.

We're looking for a Machine Learning Engineer to train custom models using our internal data. This work spans design generation, cost estimation, evaluating the complexity and difficulty of a given design, and extracting structured data out of existing documentation. We're looking for someone who has trained custom models on large, parameter-rich datasets, ideally with a geometric or spatial component, and who is energized by problems in that space specifically.

What You'll Do

  • Train and iterate on custom ML models using Layup's internal manufacturing and design data
  • Build models that estimate cost and predict design complexity or manufacturing difficulty from part geometry
  • Develop models that generate or assist in generating new designs based on historical design data
  • Build pipelines to extract structured data (specs, dimensions, material callouts, etc.) from existing engineering documents and drawings
  • Evaluate and select modeling approaches suited to geometric, spatial, and other structured data, rather than text-based problems
  • Work closely with engineering and manufacturing teams to source, clean, and label internal datasets
  • Own model performance end-to-end, from data pipeline through training, evaluation, and deployment into internal tools
  • Continuously identify new opportunities where custom models could improve design, estimation, or manufacturing workflows

    • What We're Looking For

  • Experience training custom models beyond basic labeling or fine-tuning workflows
  • Experience with advanced object detection at minimum; data classification experience is a strong plus
  • Experience with geometry-based modeling is highly preferred
  • Experience working with large, parameter-rich datasets
  • Strongest fit is someone whose background is in structured, spatial, or geometric data problems rather than natural language or LLM-centric work

    • Bonus Points

  • Experience training geometry-specific models
  • CAD experience
  • Manufacturing experience

    • Equal Opportunity

    Layup is an equal-opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will be treated with respect and receive equal consideration for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, uniform service, Veteran status, age, or any other protected characteristic per federal, state, or local law, including those with a criminal history, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws, including the CA Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance.

    ITAR Requirements

    To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. title: Senior Staff Systems Engineer, GTM
description:
From Fivetran’s founding until now, our mission has remained the same: to make access to data as simple and reliable as electricity. With Fivetran, customer data arrives in their warehouses, canonical and ready to query, with no engineering or maintenance required. We’re proud that more organizations continue to leverage our technology every day to become truly data-driven.

About Us

Fivetran and dbt Labs are bringing together two industry-leading companies with a shared mission: helping organizations unlock the full value of their data. Together, we’re delivering the data infrastructure layer that helps organizations move, transform, and trust their data — from the moment data moves, through every transformation, to the context teams and AI systems rely on.

Fivetran helps organizations automate data movement across the systems, clouds, engines, and tools they rely on. dbt Labs pioneered analytics engineering, helping teams transform data into reliable, governed insights. Together, we support thousands of organizations as they build a trusted foundation for analytics, AI, and better business decisions.

As we bring our teams and technology together, we’re building on the strengths of both companies while continuing to deliver the products and experiences our customers know and trust. It’s an exciting time to join us: we’re creating a company with the scale, talent, and technology to help more organizations put their data to work with greater speed, confidence, and impact.
​
During this transition period, you may see references to both Fivetran and dbt Labs throughout our recruiting process as we integrate our teams, systems, and career sites.

About the Role

We’re looking for a Staff Systems Engineer, GTM, to help us evolve our Salesforce CRM to the next level to meet the needs of our rapidly scaling global business. You are a highly skilled Salesforce technology professional capable of working across all levels of the organization. You are adept at crafting, implementing, and evolving out-of-the-box and custom solutions that employ best practices for systems integration (API and IPaaS Solutions) across the SFDC ecosystem.

You will work closely with our current Revenue Excellence team and our cross-functional stakeholders in Marketing, Finance, Sales, Analytics, Product, Customer Success, and Engineering to ensure we leverage Salesforce as the organization's source of truth.

You’ll also be responsible for ensuring the technical excellence of your team and owned services, through design reviews, code reviews, and our approval process; contributing to architectural designs; and mentoring colleagues. This is a high-visibility role within the organization with an incredible opportunity to drive impact and value quickly.

This is a full-time, hybrid position based in our Oakland, CA, or Denver, CO offices or remotely in the US.

Technologies You’ll Use

Salesforce CRM, CPQ, Apex, JavaScript, Lightning Web Components (LWC), SOQL, Salesforce APIs, Python, HTML, Git, consuming and invoking web services utilizing WCF, REST, XML, JSON.

What You’ll Do

  • Project Lead: Define and drive the critical projects and technical strategy for Salesforce CRM and related systems, ensuring alignment with overall business objectives. Lead the design and implementation of scalable and secure solutions that integrate seamlessly with other enterprise systems.
  • Strategic Initiatives: Spearhead key strategic initiatives, such as process automation and data integration efforts, to enhance operational efficiency and business agility.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with key stakeholders and executives across the organization to identify and prioritize key projects, providing technical expertise and strategic insights.
  • Team Leadership and Development: Mentor and develop a team of engineers, fostering a culture of innovation and continuous improvement. Lead by example, promoting best coding, design, and system architecture practices.
  • Complex Problem Solving: Address high-impact, complex technical challenges, ensuring the reliability, performance, and scalability of Salesforce and its integrations.
  • Governance and Compliance: Establish and enforce governance frameworks, ensuring compliance with industry standards, data privacy regulations, and internal policies.
  • Thought Leadership: Contribute to the broader tech community by sharing best practices, participating in industry events, and publishing insights on Salesforce technology.
  • Ownership and Accountability: Own the Salesforce ecosystem fully, driving enhancements and optimizations to meet evolving business needs. Act as the primary point of contact for high-stakes projects and critical system issues.

Skills We’re Looking For

  • Extensive Salesforce Expertise: 5+ years of experience in Salesforce development and architecture, including deep knowledge of Apex, Visualforce, Lightning Web Components (LWC), SOQL, and Salesforce APIs. Demonstrated ability to design and implement complex, scalable solutions within the Salesforce ecosystem. 2nd Generation Managed Package experience is a plus.
  • Business Acumen and Cost Management: Strong understanding of business processes, particularly billing, revenue recognition, and order management. Ability to evaluate and compare alternative solutions based on cloud costs and performance implications, ensuring efficient and cost-effective technology investments. Skilled in communicating complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders and aligning technical initiatives with business objectives.
  • Strategic Vision and Execution: Experience in setting and executing strategic technical visions, particularly in the context of complex Salesforce implementations and integrations. Ability to align technology initiatives with business goals and drive transformative projects.
  • Leadership and Mentorship: Proven track record in leading and mentoring technical teams, with experience in upleveling engineers and fostering a culture of innovation, continuous learning, and technical excellence. Demonstrated ability to manage and lead geographically dispersed teams, effectively handling projects across time zones and cultural contexts. Skilled in ensuring effective communication and collaboration in a global team environment.
  • Enterprise-Level Systems Integration: Expertise in integrating Salesforce with other enterprise systems, utilizing APIs, middleware, and IPaaS solutions. Experience with event-driven architectures and managing data flows across multiple platforms.
  • Governance and Compliance: Demonstrated experience in establishing governance frameworks, ensuring compliance with industry standards, regulatory requirements (such as GDPR), data retention, and internal policies related to data security and privacy.
  • Complex Problem Solving: Proven ability to tackle complex technical challenges, particularly related to performance optimization, scalability, and system resilience. Experience in designing solutions that address high-volume data processing and integration challenges.
  • Advanced Certifications: Salesforce Developer I & II certifications are required; Salesforce System Architect and/or Salesforce CPQ Specialist Certification is highly preferred. Additional certifications, such as Salesforce Technical Architect or Application Architect, are a plus.
  • Agile and DevOps Expertise: Agile and DevOps Expertise: In-depth understanding of Agile methodologies, with experience leading Agile teams. Proficiency in Salesforce DevOps practices, including CI/CD pipelines, version control (Git), and automated testing frameworks. Hands-on experience using AI coding assistants and LLM-based tools to accelerate development, testing, and documentation workflows.
  • Autonomy and Adaptability: Comfortable operating independently with minimal oversight and adjusting quickly to shifting priorities, ambiguous requirements, and evolving project scope in a fast-moving environment.
  • Communication and Presentation Skills: Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to effectively present complex technical information to senior leadership and external stakeholders. Experience in technical writing and documentation.
  • Quality and Standards Oversight: Experience establishing and enforcing coding standards, best practices, and quality assurance processes. Focus on writing meaningful and comprehensive tests, including unit tests, integration tests, and end-to-end tests, to ensure the robustness and reliability of software. Responsible for conducting thorough code reviews and maintaining high-quality standards across all deliverables.
  • Ability to collaborate in a highly geographically dispersed team environment.

Optional Bonus Skills

  • Salesforce System Architect Certification
  • Proven experience developing programmatic components to extend Salesforce Enterprise Territory Management functionality.

title: Senior Data Solutions Consultant
description:
The Senior Data Solutions Consultant partners with cross-functional teams to design, build, and optimize scalable data solutions that support omnichannel marketing, analytics, and AI-enabled products for life sciences clients. This role collaborates closely with analytics, engineering, project management, and client stakeholders to transform complex datasets into reliable, production-ready data assets that drive measurable business outcomes. Success in this role requires expertise in Python, SQL, ETL development, enterprise data platforms, and modern business intelligence technologies.

What You'll Do

  • Design, develop, and optimize scalable ETL pipelines using Python and SQL to support analytics, reporting, AI solutions, and client deliverables.
  • Develop, maintain, and optimize enterprise data warehouse solutions, preferably in Snowflake, while ensuring data quality, reliability, scalability, and performance.
  • Collaborate with data analysts, project managers, business analysts, and client stakeholders to gather technical requirements, define solution architecture, and deliver measurable business outcomes.
  • Build analytics products including business intelligence dashboards, system integrations, data outputs, presentations, and AI-enabled solutions using platforms such as Power BI, Microsoft Fabric, and Tableau.
  • Standardize and improve engineering practices through reusable code, Git version control, documentation, SOP development, and scalable data engineering processes that support operational excellence.

Required:

  • 4–5 years of hands-on experience developing scalable data solutions, including at least 2 years designing and supporting ETL pipelines for analytics and reporting.
  • 2+ years of professional experience using Python and SQL to build, optimize, and maintain production-ready data pipelines and data models.
  • Experience working with clickstream datasets, enterprise data lakes, and modern cloud data warehouse platforms, preferably Snowflake, supporting analytics or marketing use cases.
  • Experience gathering technical requirements from business stakeholders and clients, translating business needs into production-ready data solutions and measurable deliverables.
  • Experience developing business intelligence solutions using Power BI, Microsoft Fabric, Tableau, or comparable visualization platforms, with examples of dashboards or reporting solutions delivered.

Desired:

  • Comfort and enthusiasm for using AI as a regular part of how work gets done.
  • Experience supporting healthcare, pharmaceutical, or life sciences data, analytics, or omnichannel marketing initiatives.
  • Experience designing relational database structures, dimensional models, and enterprise data architecture supporting scalable analytics platforms.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
  • Experience implementing Git-based development workflows, documentation standards, and reusable engineering practices across collaborative technical teams.

title: Lamination Cut and Grind
description:
Sea Fox Boat Company is an industry leading, saltwater fishing boat manufacturer who is looking for talented production installers that can aid in the manufacturing and construction of our boats.

About Sea Fox Boat Company

Sea Fox Boat Company is an industry-leading manufacturer of premium saltwater fishing boats. We are dedicated to craftsmanship, teamwork, and delivering exceptional quality through precision manufacturing and operational excellence. At Sea Fox, you’re more than just a number — you’re part of a family.

Position Summary

Sea Fox Boat Company is seeking a dependable and hardworking Cut & Grind Technician to support our boat manufacturing operations. This role is responsible for cutting, grinding, trimming, and preparing fiberglass components to meet production specifications. The ideal candidate thrives in a fast-paced manufacturing environment, works safely, and takes pride in producing quality work.

Key Responsibilities

  • Read and interpret blueprints and production drawings

  • Cut, grind, and trim fiberglass parts to specification

  • Use hole saws, sanders, grinders, and other hand and power tools

  • Accurately read and use a tape measure

  • Maintain production pace to ensure timely delivery of parts to the manufacturing line

  • Safely get on and off boat decks and hulls as required

  • Keep work areas and equipment clean and organized

  • Follow all safety procedures and housekeeping guidelines

  • Work professionally and cooperatively with team members

Physical Requirements

  • Ability to bend, stoop, squat, push, and pull throughout the shift

  • Ability to stand for extended periods

  • Ability to work in a covered warehouse environment with varying temperatures

  • Comfortable working on boat decks and hull surfaces

Qualifications

To be considered for this position, applicants must:

  • Successfully complete a drug screening and background check

  • Be comfortable operating power tools, hand tools, sanders, and grinders

  • Demonstrate the ability to use a hole saw

  • Accurately read a tape measure

  • Be dependable, safety-focused, and team-oriented

Previous fiberglass or boat manufacturing experience is a plus, but not required for motivated candidates willing to learn.

$18/hr-$23/hr training, then conversion to piece rate pay

title: Staff Detection & Response Engineer
description:
About Suno

We're building the world's first creative entertainment platform, where the entire world can feel the joy and fulfillment of making music. Music is for everyone: Our users include everyone from grandmothers creating songs for their loved ones, to Grammy winners using Suno Studio, our power tool, to make the most popular hits in the world.

Building the future of entertainment requires ambition. The pace is fast, the problems are hard, and the work demands ownership and intensity. For the right people, it’s incredibly rewarding: a chance to shape a new medium, work with a small team that cares deeply about quality, make music, drink too much coffee, and build something that millions of people use to express themselves in ways that were never before possible.

Suno is the fastest growing consumer entertainment company and the leader in AI music. We are backed by leading investors including Bond Capital, Menlo Ventures, Lightspeed Venture Partners, IVP, Forerunner, Union Square Ventures, Alkeon, Quiet, Matrix Partners, Schroders Capital and, NVentures (venture arm of NVIDIA).

About the Role

We’re looking for a Senior / Staff Detection & Response Engineer to design and own how we detect and respond to threats across our environment — the telemetry, the detections, the playbooks, and the on-call rotation. This is a hands-on senior role for an engineer who wants to build detection and response the right way from the ground up and own it end to end.

What You’ll Do

  • Design and build our detection and telemetry pipeline, including logging coverage, the detection stack, and the data that feeds it.

  • Write high-signal detections mapped to the threats that matter most, starting with the paths that lead to a breach: identity, access, the cloud control plane, and data exfiltration.

  • Build and own incident response — playbooks, on-call, live response, and post-incident reviews that make us better each time.

  • Partner with security and platform engineering to close telemetry gaps and instrument what isn’t yet visible.

  • Set the bar for detection-as-code and a metrics-driven approach to response.

  • Build detection for AI-specific abuse and threats and novel attack patterns as they emerge.

  • Leverage AI to augment yourself so you can focus on the critical work that only you can do.


What You’ll Need

  • 6+ years in detection and response, including building detection capability and setting direction — not only operating an established one.

  • Strong AWS-native detection depth (CloudTrail, GuardDuty, VPC/flow logs, and the broader ecosystem).

  • A detection-as-code, engineering-first mindset.

  • Calm, structured, and decisive in a live incident.

  • Interest in detecting emerging AI/ML abuse and threat patterns.

  • Nice to have: Consumer product at scale, experience as an early or founding detection hire, exposure to AI/ML abuse or platform-abuse signals.


Perks & Benefits for Full-Time Employees

  • Company Equity Package

  • 401(k) with 3% Employer Match & Roth 401(k)

  • Medical, Dental, & Vision Insurance (PPO w/ HSA & FSA options)

  • 11 Paid Holidays + Unlimited PTO & Sick Time

  • 16 Weeks of Paid Parental Leave

  • Creative Education Stipend

  • Generous Commuter Allowance

  • In-Office Lunch (5 days per week)

Additional Notes:

  • Applicants must be eligible to work in the US.

  • This role requires working onsite at one of our three offices.

Compensation

  • $230,000 to 330,000

title: Product Engineer (Full-Stack / Agentic AI)
description:

A fast-growing, Series A PropTech company building an AI-native operating system for short-term and holiday rental management across Europe is looking for a Product Engineer to join a lean, high-impact team. You'll design and ship agentic AI systems that observe, decide, and act on real-world property operations — with humans in the loop.

What You'll Do

  • Own features end-to-end, learning the business deeply enough to drive solutions independently.

  • Design and build agentic AI workflows for guest communication (chat and voice), operational decisions, and property management tasks.

  • Modernize legacy systems and redesign data structures to meet evolving product requirements.

  • Shadow real operational workflows to uncover inefficiencies, workarounds, and hidden steps.

  • Translate messy processes into clean, production-ready software.

  • Scope, ship, and iterate on problems rather than just executing predefined specs.

  • Collaborate with internal teams to align product and engineering direction.

What We're Looking For

Required:

  • Demonstrable engineering experience you can walk through during the hiring process.

  • Strong proficiency in TypeScript and React for full-stack development.

  • Familiarity with Express, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, and AWS.

  • Comfortable working in an agentic engineering style — running multiple agents, parallel terminals, and AI coding tools (e.g. Claude Code, Codex).

  • Strong product taste: attention to user experience down to interaction wording and messaging.

  • Ability to self-manage: plan work, communicate progress, and proactively flag blockers.

  • Track record of shipping quickly with sound judgment about acceptable risk.

  • Fluent spoken and written English.

  • Experience with Linear and Notion (or equivalent) for work tracking and documentation.

  • Willingness to relocate to Berlin, Germany and work from the office regularly.

Nice to Have:

  • Experience building agentic AI or AI agent systems.

  • Prior startup experience or a founder mentality.

  • Background in hospitality, PropTech, or short-term rental domains.

  • Strong product-minded approach with a track record of influencing product direction.

Please note: No visa sponsorship is available. Candidates must be eligible to work in Germany without sponsorship.

Compensation & Benefits

  • Salary range: $90,000 – $110,000 USD annually

  • Lean, accountable team focused on outcomes over process

  • High ownership and direct impact on a core product

  • Work at the cutting edge of applied AI in a real-world operational domain

Location

This role is on-site in Berlin, Germany. Candidates should be based in or willing to relocate to Berlin. The team also has presence in other German cities and Vienna, Austria.

title: Solution Consultant (f/m/d)
description:

If you’re ambitious, hands-on, and eager to challenge “the way things have always been done” – keep reading. 👇

  • Run workshops to understand their challenges and design smart solutions.

title: Senior Photo Editor
description:
At Vast, our mission is to contribute to a future where billions of people are living and thriving in space. Vast is developing next-generation space stations to ensure a continuous human presence in space for America and its allies, enabling advanced microgravity research and manufacturing, and unlocking a new space economy for government, corporate, and private customers. Using an incremental, hardware-rich and low-cost approach, Vast is rapidly developing its multi-module Haven Station. Haven Demo’s 2025 success made Vast the only operational commercial space station company to fly and operate its own spacecraft. Next, Haven-1 is expected to become the world’s first commercial space station when it launches, followed by additional Haven modules to enable permanent human presence by 2030. Our team is all-in, committed to executing our mission safely and on time. If you want to work with the most talented people on Earth furthering space exploration for humanity, come join us.

Vast is seeking a Senior Photo Editor to join its Media Production team on a fixed-term basis, reporting to the Senior Manager, Media Production. The ideal candidate is a technically precise, visually confident retoucher who can move fast without cutting corners, and who understands color and light well enough to make judgment calls, not just execute a brief. This is a high-leverage engagement: the work this person does in a short window will directly determine how consistent and premium Vast's photography looks going forward.

This is a hands-on, IC role for someone who can walk into an existing body of work, understand the visual direction, and both execute against it and help define it more clearly. You'll work through a real backlog of unedited production photography, and in parallel help formalize the color, light, and retouching standards the team uses so decisions don't have to be re-made from scratch on every shoot.

This is an in-person role based in Long Beach, CA and runs as a 60 day fixed-term position, with potential to extend.

Responsibilities

  • Clear the Backlog: Process existing unedited photography from past shoots to final, delivery-ready quality.
  • Post-Production & Workflow: Manage file handling from ingest to delivery (filenaming, packaging, archiving) and build reusable presets to streamline operations.
  • Define Visual Standards: Partner with the Media Production team to document and maintain consistent color, light, and retouching standards across all photography and photographers.
  • Support Live Production (as needed): Oversee capture-to-delivery for active shoots, including providing on-set Digitech support.
  • Photography (as needed): Execute product, hardware, portrait, or event photography as required, maintaining the same high quality standards.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 5+ years of professional experience as a photo retoucher or photo editor across commercial, brand, or editorial work.
  • Deep proficiency in Adobe Lightroom and Photoshop, CaptureOne, with strong command of color grading, light balancing, and high-end retouching technique.
  • Demonstrated ability to define or work within brand-level visual standards, not just execute a one-off brief.
  • Strong eye for consistency across a large volume of images, evidenced through a portfolio showing range and a clear point of view.
  • Able to work independently and move fast without sacrificing quality, this is a short engagement with real volume behind it.
  • Local to LA/Long Beach and available to be onsite..

Preferred Skills & Experience

  • Photography experience (product, hardware, portrait, or event) as a backup capability.
  • Experience shooting or editing for aerospace, tech, or other technical/industrial brands.
  • Experience building documented style guides or visual standards for a brand or production team.
Pay Range: California
$45—$64 USD

COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS

Base salary will vary depending on job-related knowledge, education, skills, experience, business needs, and market demand. Salary is just one component of our comprehensive compensation package. Full-time employees also receive company equity, as well as access to a full suite of compelling benefits and perks, including: medical, dental, and vision coverage for employees and dependents, generous paid time off; up to 20+ days of vacation for exempt staff and up to 10+ days of vacation for non-exempt staff with the ability to cash-out unused vacation annually, paid parental leave, short and long-term disability insurance, life insurance, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, ClassPass credits, personalized mental healthcare through Spring Health, and other discounts and perks. We also take pride in offering exceptional food perks, with snacks, drip coffee & onsite barista, cold drinks, and dinner meals remaining free of charge, and lunch subsidized as part of Vast’s ongoing commitment to providing high-quality meals for employees.

title: CNC Steel Processing Operator – Evening Shift
description:
CNC Steel Processing Operator – Evening Shift

Location: Richmond, VA
Job Type: Contract-to-Hire
Shift: Second Shift
Starting Pay: From $24.00 per hour (higher compensation may be available based on experience)
Shift Differential: Additional $3.00 per hour

Position Overview

We are seeking an experienced CNC Steel Processing Operator to join our second-shift manufacturing team. This position is responsible for operating CNC equipment used in structural steel fabrication while ensuring parts are produced accurately, safely, and according to production requirements.

The ideal candidate has experience in heavy manufacturing or structural steel fabrication and is comfortable working with automated machinery, fabrication drawings, and material handling equipment.

Primary Responsibilities

Machine Operation

  • Set up and operate CNC fabrication equipment, including plasma cutters, beam drill lines, and angle lines.
  • Process structural steel components according to production schedules and engineering requirements.
  • Monitor machine performance and make adjustments to maintain dimensional accuracy and product quality.
  • Perform minor programming edits or machine adjustments to accommodate changes in material size or thickness.

    • Production & Quality

    • Read and interpret fabrication drawings, blueprints, and work orders before beginning production.
    • Verify completed parts using precision measuring tools such as tape measures, calipers, and squares.
    • Maintain quality standards by checking dimensions and tolerances throughout the production process.

      • Material Handling

      • Load, position, and secure steel beams, plates, and other materials using overhead cranes, forklifts, rigging equipment, or other approved material handling devices.
      • Safely transport materials throughout the fabrication facility while following established procedures.

        • Equipment Care & Safety

      • Perform routine machine inspections and basic preventive maintenance.
      • Troubleshoot minor equipment issues and report repairs requiring additional support.
      • Keep work areas clean, organized, and free of hazards.
      • Follow OSHA regulations and all company safety policies while operating equipment.

Required Qualifications

  • High school diploma or GED required; technical school or trade school training is a plus.
  • Minimum of 2 years of CNC machine operating experience in structural steel fabrication or another heavy manufacturing environment.
  • Ability to read and understand structural steel shop drawings and fabrication blueprints.
  • Experience using precision measuring equipment, including tape measures, calipers, and layout squares.
  • Experience operating overhead cranes, forklifts, and rigging equipment is preferred.
  • Strong mechanical aptitude with excellent attention to detail.
  • Ability to work independently while contributing to a team-oriented production environment.
