title: Senior Application Security Consultant
description:
ABOUT KALLES GROUP:

Everyone deserves to be secure. Our mission at Kalles Group is to help secure the future for companies of all shapes and sizes.

While our expertise spans multiple disciplines, our method remains consistent: building trust and relationship with people -- whether you are a client, a consultant, or--in this case--a candidate.

No matter what role you come from--whether you're an executive or just starting your career-you can expect our highest level of attention and respect. We want to find the right fit for each role, but we also want you to find the right fit for your career.

We believe the best way to show you what our team is like is to treat you like you're already a part of it. We hope you'll consider joining our team of experienced professionals who are building their careers at Kalles Group—and having fun while doing it.

WHAT YOU WILL DO:

As a Senior Application Security Consultant, you will help our client strengthen application security by leading comprehensive security assessments across internally developed and third-party applications. Working closely with software engineers, architects, product teams, and security professionals, you will identify security risks early in the development lifecycle and help teams build secure solutions by design.

This role blends technical expertise with collaboration and innovation. You will establish and evolve security assessment methodologies, leverage automation and AI-enabled capabilities to improve assessment efficiency, and provide actionable guidance that enables engineering teams to reduce risk while maintaining development velocity. You will also contribute to secure design standards, threat modeling activities, and continuous improvement initiatives that elevate application security across the organization.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Perform comprehensive security assessments for internally developed and third-party applications
  • Partner with engineering, product, and architecture teams to identify security risks during application design and development
  • Conduct secure design reviews and provide security approval recommendations for new and existing solutions
  • Develop and enhance standardized security assessment methodologies, frameworks, and best practices
  • Utilize AI-enabled tools and automation to improve assessment efficiency, threat modeling, compliance validation, and software supply chain analysis
  • Document assessment findings and deliver practical, risk-based remediation recommendations
  • Validate remediation efforts and verify that identified security issues have been successfully addressed
  • Develop reusable secure design patterns and security guidance for engineering teams
  • Monitor emerging threats, vulnerabilities, and evolving application security practices
  • Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to embed security throughout the software development lifecycle
  • Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives within the organization's application security program

ABOUT YOU:

Your values:

    • Integrity: You believe in doing the right thing, even when it's uncomfortable, seemingly inefficient, or costly.
    • Purposefulness: You have a desire to serve others with your skillset and an openness to continuous learning and growth.
    • Ownership: You stick to your commitments, follow up with action, and seek clarity in communication & expectations.

YOUR EXPERIENCE:

Required Qualifications

  • 8+ years of experience in cybersecurity with significant hands-on experience performing application security assessments
  • Strong understanding of secure software development practices, secure design principles, and vulnerability management
  • Experience performing threat modeling and secure architecture reviews
  • Hands-on experience with application security testing technologies including SAST, DAST, SCA, and related security platforms
  • Experience assessing cloud-native applications running in AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform
  • Knowledge of APIs, modern application architectures, and secure software development methodologies
  • Experience developing security standards, assessment methodologies, or security review processes
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to influence engineering and product teams
  • Ability to prioritize security risk and communicate remediation strategies to both technical and business stakeholders
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Information Technology, or equivalent professional experience

Preferred Qualifications

  • Professional certifications such as CISSP, OSCP, CSSLP, CCSP, CISA, or similar
  • Experience applying AI or large language model (LLM) technologies to application security workflows
  • Experience building security automation or AI-assisted assessment capabilities
  • Experience working within a formal Design Review or Security Architecture review process
  • Experience with DevSecOps practices, CI/CD security integration, or developer security enablement
  • Experience mentoring engineers and promoting secure-by-design principles across development organizations

WHAT WE OFFER:

  • The annual salary range for this role is $110,000-$140,000.
  • We offer Medical, Dental, Vision plans, 401K with matching, and PTO for salaried employees.
  • Work/life balance – we know there’s more to life than work! We encourage our team to pursue other passions, get outside, and spend time with family. We work with clients and consultants to set expectations for a manageable workload.

LOCATION:

This role is on-site at our client location in Seattle, WA. At this time, we are only considering candidates who currently live in Seattle, WA.

HOW TO APPLY:

Please fill out the form below (including uploading your most recent resume) and we'll be in touch! We know imposter syndrome can be a barrier to many great applicants. We hope you'll still consider applying. That's why we've made the application process as short and simple as possible.

Even if you're not a fit for the role, you can expect to hear back from us! We want you to have the best experience as a candidate, so please feel free to share feedback at any stage of the process to talent@kallesgroup.com.

Kalles Group is an equal-opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of creed, nationality, race, ethnicity, disability, gender, or other protected class.

title: Maintenance Coordinator
description:
Position Summary

SALAM Islamic Center is seeking a dependable and experienced Maintenance Coordinator to oversee the general maintenance, safety, and upkeep of its locations. This position combines hands-on maintenance work with the coordination of vendors, contractors, inspections, repairs, and preventative maintenance.

The ideal candidate is organized, responsive, trustworthy, and able to prioritize facility needs within a part-time schedule while keeping leadership informed of urgent matters, ongoing work, and anticipated expenses.


Key Responsibilities

  • Conduct routine walkthroughs of SALAM’s locations and identify maintenance, repair, safety, and cleanliness concerns.
  • Complete basic repairs, including minor plumbing, electrical work, painting, furniture assembly, hardware replacement, and general facility upkeep.
  • Maintain and regularly update a list of open work orders, priorities, and completed projects.
  • Coordinate qualified vendors and contractors for work requiring specialized expertise or licensing.
  • Obtain estimates and approval before beginning significant repairs or making purchases.
  • Monitor heating and air-conditioning systems and coordinate service when needed.
  • Support fire, building, security, and other required inspections.
  • Regularly check doors, locks, lighting, restrooms, parking areas, landscaping, and other facility systems.
  • Respond promptly to urgent maintenance issues and communicate safety or operational concerns to leadership.
  • Maintain SALAM’s tools, equipment, supplies, warranties, manuals, and maintenance records.
  • Submit receipts, invoices, and supporting documentation for approved purchases.
  • Provide regular written updates on completed work, outstanding needs, vendor activity, and recommended next steps.
  • Assist with facility setup and support for major programs or events when needed.
  • Coordinate with SALAM staff to minimize disruption to prayers, school activities, tenants, programs, and community events.

Qualifications

  • Previous experience in facility maintenance, property management, construction, or a related field.
  • Ability to complete general repairs safely and correctly.
  • Strong organizational, communication, and follow-through skills.
  • Ability to prioritize work across multiple locations within a limited weekly schedule.
  • Ability to work independently while following SALAM’s approval and purchasing procedures.
  • Valid driver’s license and reliable transportation.
  • Ability to lift and move maintenance equipment and supplies as needed.
  • Professional and respectful when interacting with staff, community members, tenants, vendors, and volunteers.
  • Availability to respond to occasional urgent issues outside regular working hours.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience maintaining nonprofit, religious, educational, or community facilities.
  • Familiarity with basic HVAC, plumbing, electrical, security, and building systems.
  • Established relationships with qualified local vendors and contractors.
  • Knowledge of workplace and building safety requirements.

Schedule & Hours

Part-time position averaging approximately 16 hours per week. Hours may vary based on facility needs, with occasional evening or weekend availability.

Compensation

Fair compensation, commensurate with experience and qualifications.


Performance Expectations

Success in this position will be measured by the safety and condition of SALAM’s facilities, timely completion of priority work orders, preventative maintenance, responsible use of funds, accurate documentation, clear communication, and dependable follow-through across locations.

title: Director - Technical Program Management
description:
About Us

Rivian and Volkswagen Group Technologies is a joint venture between two industry leaders with a clear vision for automotive’s next chapter. From operating systems to zonal controllers to cloud and connectivity solutions, we’re addressing the challenges of electric vehicles through technology that will set the standards for software-defined vehicles around the world.

The road to the future is uncharted. By combining our expertise across connectivity, AI, security and more, we’ll map a new way forward. Working together, we’ll create a future that’s more connected, more intelligent, more sustainable for everyone.

Role Summary

As the Technical Program Management Director, you will work with all teams across the company to ensure the success of your program — from integration planning, timeline and risk management, resource management, and everything in between. Your role will evolve throughout the program, with the most common objective being to ensure the timely delivery of the program at cost and as an amazing product we all would be proud for our customers to own. You will play a critical role in ensuring any and all roadblocks are removed, everyone is on the same page, and we have clear direction throughout the program. You will act as the primary liaison to the leadership teams at the Volkswagen Group and will leverage your team to drive the overall successful implementation of the program. This role is located in our Palo Alto, CA office.

In practice, this means owning requirements and change-request governance for your package, refereeing cross-domain technical trade-offs between RVT and VWG engineering leads, and being the person VWG's program and engineering leads call first — not just at milestone reviews.

Responsibilities

Align on technical aspects for corresponding package:

description:

title: Engineer III - Full Stack Developer
description:
At Anaplan, we are a team of innovators focused on optimizing business decision-making through our leading AI-infused scenario planning and analysis platform so our customers can outpace their competition and the market.

What unites Anaplanners across teams and geographies is our collective commitment to our customers’ success and to our Winning Culture.

Our customers rank among the who’s who in the Fortune 50. Coca-Cola, LinkedIn, Adobe, LVMH and Bayer are just a few of the 2,400+ global companies who rely on our best-in-class platform.

Our Winning Culture is the engine that drives our teams of innovators. We champion diversity of thought and ideas, we behave like leaders regardless of title, we are committed to achieving ambitious goals, and we love celebrating our wins – big and small.

Supported by operating principles of being strategy-led, values-based and disciplined in execution, you’ll be inspired, connected, developed and rewarded here. Everything that makes you unique is welcome; join us and let’s build what’s next - together!

The Role

Anaplan is looking for a Full Stack Software Engineer to join our Experience Engineering workstream. You will be a founding member of a new team dedicated to building our world class User Experience. You will work alongside other talented engineers to build and ship award-winning planning technology, that is helping people and companies around the world every day to make better-informed plans and decisions.

We are looking for an exceptional and passionate Senior Engineer who believes in simplicity, agility, and performance. In this role, you will architect systems, build tools, and establish best practices that enable Anaplan to deliver a seamless, intuitive experience to all our customers.

Your Impact

  • Be part of a well-balanced, cross functional team, delivering exceptional software.
  • Be driven by the customer, everything you do is to solve a problem for our users or to enable us to solve problems for users more effectively/sustainably.
  • Working closely with product to deliver customer delighting experiences and platforms innovations.
  • Actively practice continuous integration and deployment and proactively contribute improvements to the way these are done.
  • Work within an agile development process and thrive in an environment that promotes high levels of autonomy and accountability.
  • Write tests at every level of the testing pyramid to ensure the quality of your work is good to go to production every time we build.
  • Apply your experience across the full stack as necessary. We recognise specialisms whilst valuing open-minded people who will step out of their comfort zone to complete their work and expand their skill set.
  • Good attention to detail - you will create applications which solve significant problems for our users, this drives you more so than anything.

Your Skills

  • Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to craft well-architected, scalable, and easy-to-maintain systems.
  • A robust toolkit of design pattern, and the ability to choose the right one to apply to each problem, making use of SOLID principles.
  • A track record of delivering complex solutions using JavaScript (ES2015+), HTML, and CSS.
  • Expertise with TypeScript and React.
  • Experience writing back-end services using a JVM language (e.g. Java, Kotlin, Spring Boot), or similar.
  • A good understanding of deployment tools and technologies, including Docker, Kubernetes, and Terraform.
  • Needs the capability to collaborate with and lead others, communicating ideas clearly, influence their thinking, or making difficult decisions in delicate situations, all while maintaining the integrity of the relationship.

We know that great talent comes from a variety of backgrounds, and we encourage you to apply even if your experience doesn't perfectly match every qualification on this list.

Languages and Technologies You’ll Work With

  • Front-End: React, TypeScript, CSS, Redux, Jest, Vite, Enzyme, Cypress.
  • Back-End: Java, Kotlin, Spring Framework, MySQL
  • Infrastructure & DevOps: Docker, Kubernetes, Jenkins, Git, Helm.

What We Offer

  • A role at the heart of our global growth strategy.
  • A team that embraces and respects diverse perspectives and isn't afraid to push boundaries.
  • The opportunity to build exceptional software, delighting our customers, and transforming the face of business strategy software.

Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity, Inclusion and Belonging (DEIB)

We believe attracting and retaining the best talent and fostering an inclusive culture strengthens our business. DEIB improves our workforce, enhances trust with our partners and customers, and drives business success. Build your career in a place where diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging aren’t just words on paper – this is what drives our innovation, it’s how we connect, and it contributes to what makes us a market leader. We believe in a hiring and working environment where all people are respected and valued, regardless of gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, age, neurodiversity, disability status, citizenship, or any other aspect which makes people unique. We hire you for who you are, and we want you to bring your authentic self to work every day!

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, perform essential job functions, and receive equitable benefits and all privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

Fraud Recruitment Disclaimer

It has come to our attention that fraudulent and fictitious job opportunities are being circulated on the Internet. Prospective candidates are being contacted by certain individuals, mainly through telephone calls, emails and correspondence, claiming they are representatives of Anaplan. The main purpose of these correspondences and announcements is to obtain privileged information from individuals.

Anaplan does not:

  • Extend offers to candidates without an extensive interview process with a member of our recruitment team and a hiring manager via video or in person.
  • Send job offers via email. All offers are first extended verbally by a member of our internal recruitment team whenever possible and then followed up via written communication.

All emails from Anaplan would come from an @anaplan.com email address. Should you have any doubts about the authenticity of an email, letter or telephone communication purportedly from, for, or on behalf of Anaplan, please send an email to people@anaplan.com before taking any further action in relation to the correspondence.

Candidate data processed during our recruitment activities is handled in accordance with our Candidate Privacy Notice. This may include the use of artificial intelligence or automated tools to assist our team in evaluating qualifications.

title: Director, People Business Partner
description:
About the Company
e.l.f. Beauty, Inc. stands with every eye, lip, face, paw and fin. Our deep commitment to clean, cruelty free beauty at an incredible value has fueled the success of our flagship brand e.l.f. Cosmetics since 2004 and driven our portfolio expansion. Today, our multi-brand portfolio includes e.l.f. Cosmetics, e.l.f. SKIN, Well People - clean beauty powered by plants, Naturium - high-performance, biocompatible, clinically-effective and accessible skin care, and our newest brand, rhode skin - developed by Hailey Rhode Bieber, a line of curated skincare essentials, formulated for a variety of skin types and needs with high performance ingredients, it’s a daily routine that nourishes your skin barrier over time
In our Fiscal year 26, we had net sales of $1.6 Billion and our business performance has been nothing short of extraordinary with 29 consecutive quarters of net sales growth. We are the #2 mass cosmetics brand in the US and are the fastest growing mass cosmetics brand among the top 5. Our total compensation philosophy offers every full-time new hire competitive pay and benefits, bonus eligibility (200% of target over the last seven fiscal years), equity, flexible time off, year-round half-day Fridays, and a hybrid 3 day in office, 2 day at home work environment. We believe the combination of our unique culture, total compensation, workplace flexibility and care for the team is unmatched across not just beauty but any industry.
Visit our Career Page to learn more about our team:

Position Summary

We are looking for a Director, People Business Partner who shows up as a bold disruptor with a kind heart, someone who brings sharp strategy and genuine warmth in equal measure, and who understands that the secret to our success in the marketplace starts with how deeply we invest in our e.l.f.z.

You will be a trusted advisor to e.l.f. Beauty leaders and business functions across the organization, an essential resource for leadership, people managers, and employees alike, helping drive impactful people operations, a differentiated employee experience, and a culture of belonging at every stage of the employee lifecycle. You will operate with Zero Distance, not from above or behind the business, but right inside it, embedding deeply within your client groups, translating their goals and challenges into people strategies that fuel growth, strengthen organizational health, and bring our culture to life in ways that are unmistakably e.l.f.

This position reports to the Chief Human Resources Officer and will be based out of our Oakland, CA HQ, with a hybrid working model.

Responsibilities:

  • Serve as the primary People partner to multiple business functions, building trusted, consultative relationships with senior leaders and their teams across e.l.f. Beauty's portfolio of brands
  • Cocreate the People Business Partner function with the CHRO at e.l.f. Beauty globally, sharing best practices, helping define the operating model and elevate the team
  • Lead a team of global People Partners across geographies, specifically EMEA, India and China through influence as the functional leader, collaborator and partner
  • Provide expert coaching and guidance on all aspects of the employee lifecycle including high performance teaming, organization & talent management, career pathing, leveling, compensation, inclusion and belonging and employee relations
  • Deliver global, high-impact people programs around organization and talent development, performance management, culture, team member engagement, and leadership development that are practical, scalable, and aligned to business priorities
  • Collaborate cross-functionally to support your client groups and partner with leadership on organizational design, workforce planning, and right-sizing efforts to build capable, agile teams
  • Partner with leaders to assess the capability, capacity, and development needs of their teams, and co-create plans that address gaps and unlock growth
  • Use people data and analytics to identify trends, surface risks, and shape proactive strategies, translating metrics like attrition, engagement, and promotion rates into compelling, actionable narratives for senior leaders
  • Act as the central point of contact for the People team between the business and Talent Acquisition, Total Rewards, Learning & Development and People Operations advocating for programs that reflect the real needs of our employees and managers
  • Counsel managers on employee relations matters; partner with Legal to investigate and resolve workplace issues with sound judgment and a consistent application of policy
  • Provide policy guidance and ensure ongoing compliance with federal, state, and local employment laws and regulations.

    • Requirements:

  • 15–20+ years of progressive HR experience, with significant depth as a Global People Business Partner supporting complex, fast-moving organizations — ideally in consumer goods, beauty, or a similarly high-growth, purpose-driven space
  • Passion for all things people-related and a genuine commitment to solving people problems in ways that are practical, human, and scalable
  • Deep expertise across the full HR landscape: talent management, organizational design, employee relations, total rewards and workforce planning
  • Proven experience with various HR technology platforms such as BambooHR, Culture Amp, Lattice, Lever, and ADP
  • High emotional intelligence, a warm and direct communication style, a coach at heart with the natural ability to build trust quickly with people at every level of an organization
  • Strong organizational skills, excellent follow-through, and the ability to manage multiple competing priorities without losing sight of the details that matter
  • A natural relationship builder who establishes credibility with leaders quickly and earns trust through expertise, empathy, and results
  • Strong analytical instincts comfortable using data to tell a story, identify a risk, or make a case to senior leadership
  • Exceptional communication skills, able to move fluidly between strategic conversations with executive stakeholders and meaningful one-on-one conversations with individual contributors
  • Intellectually curious with strong learning agility; you stay close to trends and best practices in the people space and bring those insights back to the business
  • Experience supporting HR through acquisitions, integrations, or significant organizational change is a strong plus
    • The base salary range for this role is listed above.
    Total compensation includes base salary, annual company-based performance bonus, and equity. Under e.l.f.’s annual bonus program, employees are eligible to earn up to 200% of their target bonus when company performance exceeds defined goals. In addition, e.l.f. provides a variety of other benefits to employees, including medical, dental, and vision insurance, a retirement savings plan, gender neutral parental leave, and unlimited paid time off. The amount of total compensation (including base salary) offered will be based on a wide range of factors, including geographic location, experience, specific skills, and qualifications.
    Compensation components are subject to change at the company’s discretion
    This job description is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed in this position. It also reflects the general details considered necessary to describe the principal functions of the job identified, and shall not be considered, as detailed description of all the work required inherent in the job. It is not an exhaustive list of responsibilities, and it is subject to changes and exceptions at the supervisors’ discretion.

title: Associate Director-Quality Assurance-Site Data Integrity
description:
At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it’s work worth doing. If you’re driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us.


Job Description

The Site Data Leader will have primary responsibility for data management activities within the site. This includes data integrity. He/she will be an advocate for data management across the manufacturing site and will chair the site data lead team.

The Site Data Leader will ensure that a robust Data Integrity Program exists within the site providing strong project management leadership to advance the site’s agenda. This requires interface with the Manufacturing & Quality (M&Q) Data Management organization, serving as a global data management subject matter expert to facilitate and drive improvements in M&Q data-related corporate quality standards, business processes, organizational design, and governance necessary for ongoing data integrity effectiveness.

This role will partner with functional area data experts to anticipate and resolve key data management and integrity issues while driving solutions that impact the site and align with corporate objectives. This role will leverage a deep understanding of GMP data flows (electronic and paper), the application of data management and integrity principles in operational processes, and Computer System Validation methodologies to ensure regulatory compliance, consistency, and sustainment.

This role will be responsible for ensuring the site’s data integrity training program facilitates the sustainment of its data integrity continuous improvement journey. The Site Data Leader will also be responsible for advancing data management standards to ensure consistency and consumability of data to drive process improvements.

Job Requirements

  • Experience in leading inspection readiness with effective results obtained through interaction/discussion with regulatory officials related to data integrity expertise in areas as necessary.

  • Demonstrated proficiency in planning and the ability to carry out tasks with a high degree of independence as well as being able to work in a team environment.

  • Strong project management and organizational skills are a must.

  • Demonstrated ability to interpret and apply standards to different situations by understanding site needs and applying good problem-solving skills.

  • Demonstrated ability to write technical documents, develop business presentations and effectively communicate concepts to a wide range of personnel including senior leadership.

  • Ability to influence and contribute to strategy and agenda in the area of data integrity.

  • Strong knowledge and technical expertise in areas of cGMPs, production practices, and quality systems.

  • Recognized understanding of regulations governing data integrity.

  • Ability to build relationships across dimensions of difference, ask questions & invite others to contribute.

  • Demonstrated business acumen.

  • Speak up with ideas as well as concerns and ensure the psychological safety of others.

  • Demonstrated learning agility and ability to think creatively; try new ideas and apply learnings.

  • Highly motivated, enthusiastic to learn and share ideas and solutions effectively with management and colleagues.

  • Strong collaboration with colleagues at all levels.

  • Demonstrated courage & integrity.

  • Demonstrated success in influencing without authority.

  • Ability to take initiative, to be assertive, to lead by example and to build high-quality relationships.

  • Highly flexible, adapting to changes in priorities, requirements and processes is required.

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in the sciences, engineering, or related field.

  • Fluency in English (Read / Write) is required.

  • Minimum of 5 years of experience in pharmaceutical manufacturing

  • Qualified applicants must be authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis. Lilly will not provide support for or sponsor work authorization or visas for this role, including but not limited to F-1 CPT, F-1 OPT, F-1 STEM OPT, J-1, H-1B, TN, O-1, E-3, H-1B1, or L-1.

Additional Preferences

  • Understanding and working knowledge of domestic and international data integrity regulations and other policies/regulations as applicable.

  • Understanding of IT system design, controls, and usage.

  • Ability to communicate effectively with all levels and functions in the organization.

  • Ability to work on multiple concurrent project initiative.

Other Requirements

  • Available to travel (domestic and international) on an average of <10%.

title: Cloud & Infrastructure Services Engineer
description:
Joining McNees Wallace & Nurick LLC means becoming part of a team that values your voice, your growth, and your impact on clients, colleagues, and the communities we serve. Since 1935, McNees has been a trusted, client-focused law firm delivering practical, results-driven legal solutions with integrity and a client-first philosophy. We are a full-service firm with more than 170 attorneys and 350 professionals, committed to excellence across a wide range of practice areas and industries.

At McNees, we are guided by our core values of authentic relationships, excellence, growth, and balance to foster collaboration and innovation. We support your success through mentorship, leadership development, and continuous learning opportunities. Our commitment to community runs deep, with a strong tradition of stewardship through pro bono work, charitable initiatives, and civic engagement. We also prioritize flexibility and well-being with a family-focused culture, reasonable revenue hour expectations, and technology that drives efficiency.

If you’re looking for an opportunity to do meaningful work with people who value integrity and collaboration, you’ll feel at home at McNees.

McNees, Wallace & Nurick is actively seeking a Cloud & Infrastructure Services Engineer to join our Information Technology department. At McNees, we believe our people are our greatest asset. We foster a culture of integrity, innovation, and collaboration - where your ideas matter, and your contributions make a real impact.

As a Cloud & Infrastructure Services Engineer, you will help shape and maintain the firm's modern hybrid technology environment, serving as a key contributor to cloud adoption, infrastructure modernization, security, and operational excellence. In this role, you'll have ownership of core platforms including Microsoft Azure, Microsoft 365, Active Directory, Intune, and Exchange while partnering closely with internal stakeholders, security teams, and managed service providers to ensure reliable, secure, and scalable technology services. If you enjoy solving complex infrastructure challenges, driving automation, and implementing innovative cloud solutions, we encourage you to apply.

Responsibilities

  • Administer, configure, and support the firm's Microsoft ecosystem, including Active Directory, Microsoft 365, Azure, Intune, Exchange, user provisioning, licensing, and tenant management.
  • Design, deploy, and manage secure and scalable Microsoft Azure environments, including virtual machines, networking, storage, application services, VPN connectivity, and related cloud resources.
  • Maintain and support hybrid infrastructure environments, including on-premises servers, DNS, DHCP, Group Policy, and directory services.
  • Develop and implement Infrastructure as Code (IaC) solutions using tools such as Terraform and ARM templates to streamline and automate deployments.
  • Monitor infrastructure performance, availability, and capacity using Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, Application Insights, and other observability tools.
  • Manage identity and access services through Microsoft Entra ID, including conditional access, multi-factor authentication, single sign-on, and security controls.
  • Design and support backup, disaster recovery, and business continuity solutions utilizing Azure Site Recovery, Azure Backup, Rubrik, and related technologies.
  • Implement cloud governance standards, resource management practices, and cost optimization initiatives across Azure environments.
  • Provide hands-on administration and troubleshooting of network infrastructure, including switches, access points, gateways, SD-WAN technologies, VPN services, and wireless networking platforms.
  • Serve as the primary internal liaison with managed service providers for infrastructure and network-related support, escalations, and issue resolution.
  • Partner with cybersecurity teams to strengthen infrastructure security, implement best practices, and remediate vulnerabilities across cloud and on-premises environments.
  • Create and maintain architecture documentation, operational procedures, technical standards, and disaster recovery plans.
  • Provide advanced Tier 2/3 support for complex infrastructure issues and collaborate with vendors and Microsoft support when needed.
  • Stay informed on emerging cloud technologies, platform enhancements, and industry best practices to continuously improve the firm's technology environment.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Information Systems, Computer Science, or a related field.
  • 5+ years of experience in systems administration, cloud engineering, or infrastructure engineering, including hands-on administration of Microsoft Azure, Microsoft 365, Intune, Exchange, and Active Directory environments.
  • Strong knowledge of Microsoft Azure services, including compute, storage, networking, identity, and security solutions.
  • Experience managing Windows Server and Linux environments across both cloud and on-premises infrastructure.
  • Proficiency with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools such as Terraform or ARM templates and experience with CI/CD pipelines, preferably Azure DevOps.
  • Strong understanding of networking concepts, including TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VPNs, firewalls, load balancing, SD-WAN, and enterprise networking technologies.
  • Experience with scripting and automation using PowerShell, Azure CLI, Python, Bash, or similar tools.
  • Knowledge of backup, disaster recovery, high-availability architectures, and business continuity planning.
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, communication, and technical documentation skills.
  • Experience supporting enterprise networking infrastructure, including Ubiquiti or comparable networking platforms, and collaborating with managed service providers (MSPs) in a co-managed IT environment.
  • Industry certifications are strongly preferred, including Azure Administrator Associate (AZ-104), Microsoft 365 Administrator Expert (MS-102), Identity and Access Administrator Associate (SC-300), Azure Solutions Architect Expert (AZ-305), Azure Network Engineer Associate (AZ-700), or equivalent credentials.
  • Experience working in a law firm or other professional services environment is preferred.
  • Familiarity with ITIL principles and experience using IT service management (ITSM) platforms or ticketing systems is preferred.

#LI-REMOTE

#LI-DNP

About McNees

Headquartered in Harrisburg, Pa., McNees operates offices across Pennsylvania, Maryland, Ohio, and Washington, D.C., giving our team a broad regional footprint and diverse opportunities for collaboration. We are ranked among the NLJ 500, Best Law Firms, and Best Lawyers, and nationally recognized for excellence in areas such as construction litigation and energy law.

Our attorneys deliver tailored strategies to businesses, individuals, and organizations across industries, including real estate, energy, healthcare, banking and finance, insurance, construction, and technology. We also have a strong presence in public sector law, advocating for clients in regulatory and legislative matters at all levels of government.

Our services span corporate law, real estate and construction, labor and employment, litigation, tax, intellectual property, energy and environmental, estate planning, and public sector law, complemented by affiliated businesses like Apollo Communications (strategic marketing and PR), Keystone Municipal Solutions (municipal consulting), and Pine Street Land Company (title and settlement services).

McNees offers an engaging work environment, robust opportunities for professional development, challenging and rewarding career paths, and competitive compensation. McNees is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to any trait protected by law.

title: Commercial Refrigeration Lead Technician
description:
Yellowstone Local is proud to represent TDI Refrigeration, an industry leader in commercial and industrial refrigeration and HVACR services.

You know how to solve the problems others cannot, lead from the field, and deliver work that keeps critical systems running.

What’s in It for You?

  • Pay: $60.00 to $65.00 per hour

  • Field-based role serving the Aurora, CO area

  • Leadership responsibility without direct supervisory duties

  • Opportunities to mentor technicians and strengthen your technical leadership skills

  • Exposure to advanced commercial and industrial refrigeration, HVACR, electrical, plumbing, and mechanical systems

  • Company vehicle use for field operations, subject to company policies

  • Ongoing training and development around emerging technologies, industry standards, and best practices

  • Varied work that includes troubleshooting, service, repairs, project support, commissioning, and high-profile customer accounts

  • Schedule flexibility based on customer and operational needs

Why You’ll Love It Here

  • You will be trusted to take ownership of difficult service calls and complex technical problems from diagnosis through completion.

  • You will work alongside experienced service and construction leaders who value accuracy, accountability, and strong field performance.

  • You will have the opportunity to guide and mentor service technicians while continuing to grow your own technical expertise.

  • You will help shape service quality, safety, efficiency, and customer satisfaction across the operation.

  • You will join a team that takes pride in high standards, reliable workmanship, and getting the job done right.

Your New Role

  • Diagnose, service, maintain, and repair commercial and industrial HVACR and refrigeration equipment.

  • Work with electrical systems, plumbing, machinery, controls, and other specialized equipment related to company operations.

  • Help the field supervisor coordinate service technicians, projects, workloads, priorities, and deadlines.

  • Provide field guidance, technical training, mentoring, and support to technicians as needed.

  • Manage and maintain high-profile customer accounts while delivering responsive, professional service.

  • Troubleshoot complex equipment malfunctions, system failures, and operational issues.

  • Identify root causes and develop effective repair solutions that reduce downtime and improve system performance.

  • Perform inspections and quality assurance checks to confirm repairs and installations meet company standards, industry codes, and customer expectations.

  • Serve as a primary customer contact for technical questions, service updates, concerns, and issue resolution.

  • Complete service reports, work orders, site logs, equipment documentation, and other required paperwork accurately and on time.

  • Support service and construction managers with the documentation needed for projects, commissioning, warranty submissions, and customer records.

  • Review service performance, productivity metrics, and key performance indicators to identify opportunities for improvement.

  • Follow and enforce safety regulations, hazard controls, risk mitigation procedures, and accident-prevention practices.

  • Safely work around propane, ammonia, synthetic refrigerants, cleaners, and other materials used in refrigeration operations.

  • Manage tools, equipment, parts, materials, and labor resources efficiently.

  • Order and replenish parts and materials accurately while coordinating with the service manager and field supervisor.

  • Support start-up, commissioning, warranty, and project closeout activities.

  • Drive a company vehicle and maintain a safe, acceptable driving record.

  • Perform field work that may involve high noise levels, extended periods of standing, walking, sitting, lifting, carrying, reaching, pushing, and pulling.

  • Occasionally lift and move up to 50 pounds, with reasonable accommodations available for qualified individuals with disabilities.

  • Work a flexible schedule as needed to meet customer needs.

  • Perform additional duties related to TDI Refrigeration operations and company programs.

Hiring Expectations: Apply today, complete a quick phone screening, and get ready for an interview with our team to discuss your goals and experience.

  • Minimum 5 years of experience as a Service Technician, HVAC Technician, Refrigeration Technician, or Industrial Refrigeration Technician

  • Trade school education or equivalent hands-on experience in HVACR, refrigeration, mechanical systems, or a related field

  • Advanced experience in diagnosing, servicing, maintaining, and repairing commercial or industrial refrigeration and HVAC systems

  • Universal EPA Section 608 Certification

  • HAZWOPER Certification

  • RETA CIRO Certification (Refrigeration) or NATE Certification (HVAC)

  • Ability to obtain or maintain additional certifications required for start-up, commissioning, and warranty work

  • Strong knowledge of commercial refrigeration, industrial refrigeration, HVACR systems, electrical systems, controls, plumbing, and mechanical equipment

  • Working knowledge of industry safety regulations, mechanical codes, refrigeration standards, and service best practices

  • Experience using diagnostic tools, technical manuals, service software, and equipment documentation

  • Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and root-cause problem-solving skills

  • Leadership experience with the ability to train, guide, and mentor field technicians

  • Strong verbal and written communication skills

  • Excellent customer service and account management skills

  • Ability to organize multiple priorities and complete work accurately in a fast-paced field environment

  • Ability to complete detailed service reports, work orders, project documentation, and site records

  • Valid driver's license with an excellent driving record

  • Ability to participate in the company's DMV Pull Notice Program

  • Ability to work a flexible schedule based on service demands and customer needs

Please review the following job description:

The Head of Business Data is the executive leader for the quality of Technology, Data & Operations (TD&O) data and for how that data is used across the business unit. This role carries end-to-end responsibility for TD&O data, from authoritative source through certification and lineage to consumption, including business data governance, data management, reporting, and analytics.

This leader owns TD&O's adherence to the enterprise data governance policy: data ownership and accountability, business data stewardship, the inventory of data-critical business processes, critical data element identification and quality measurement, and the resolution of data issues and sub-issues. The role is accountable to governance requirements established by the Chief Data Governance Officer and partners with the Business Unit/Corporate Functions CDOs, the Chief Divisional Technology, Data, and Operations Officer, and division leaders to execute the business strategy in alignment with the enterprise data strategy. This is a critical role — TD&O's ability to run and modernize its operations depends on data the business unit can trust.

The leader also directs TD&O's use of that data to deliver management insight into performance and operations, including an advanced and nimble analytics capability that turns TD&O data into rapid, decision-grade insight, and the innovation agenda that comes with it across analytics, data science, and modeling. Making TD&O data ready for AI and agentic use is central to the role: certified, well-governed data is the precondition for AI consumption, in adherence with all related data management and AI governance requirements.

This is a senior leadership role. The Head of Business Data leads the TD&O data organization, including hiring, team development, delivery culture, and cross-functional execution, and represents TD&O in executive forums and senior committees, partnering, negotiating, and influencing across technology and business teams.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES
Following is a summary of the essential functions for this job. Other duties may be performed, both major and minor, which are not mentioned below. Specific activities may change from time to time.
1. Develop and execute the business unit/corporate functions (BU/CF) data & analytics strategy and roadmap. This includes coordination with the Chief Business Execution & Risk Officer, BU/CF CDO, and the Chief Divisional Technology, Data, and Operations Officer to align the strategy with the business vision and priorities.
2. Partner across C-Level executive business leaders to transform the business through cultivating data driven decision-making and enabling data analytics to re-engineer processes to grow and sustain the business.
3. Coordinate with the Chief Data Governance Officer to align BU/CF roadmap to data governance priorities, roadmap, and risk/regulatory commitments.
4. Provide regular updates to C-Level BU/CF executives and business unit committees regarding progress across key business initiatives and data risk in relation to appetite.
5. Drive accountability within the BU/CF for data ownership and sound data management practices including partnering with business leaders to resolve open data issues and sub-issues.
6. Own and maintain the BU/CF inventory of data critical business process and partner with process owners to drive adherence to governance requirements.
7. Oversee the business data stewards and partner across the company to implement and sustain data governance requirements across data critical processes and critical data elements.
8. Oversee implementation of the enterprise data strategy within the BU/CF and partner with business leaders to drive modernization efforts, AI enablement, and consumption of data from governed data sources.
9. Manage and execute innovation across data analytics, data science (AI/ML), reporting and modeling.
10. Partner with the AI & Data Office to define the target state tools, solutions, and capabilities to execute on the business strategy.
11. Partner across Truist to achieve the business unit data strategy and roadmap objectives, while bringing best in class industry practices to improve people, process and technology.
12. Accountable to manage the business analytics, data science, data stewards and reporting teams that can span 50-200 teammates.
13. Maintain knowledge of emerging industry practices and technologies while bringing those new practices to Truist.

QUALIFICATIONS
Required Qualifications:
The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
1. Undergraduate degree in either computer science, information systems, analytics, data engineering, finance or equivalent degree
2. Fifteen years of data management experience inclusive of driving enterprise data strategy, data execution, data engineering or software delivery
3. Expert problem solving skills and being able to define detailed strategies
4. Experience in financial services or payments industry
5. Experience in meeting regulatory obligations and operating in a highly regulatory environment
6. Experience partnering with C-Level executives to accomplish business objectives.

Preferred Qualifications:

. Expert in solution designs based upon business requirements

2. Experience in building financial services data strategy

3. Experience in leading business data governance across processes and solutions.

4. Experience in data architecture, solution architecture and/or designing enterprise business processes.

5. Skills demonstrated in data engineering, computer engineering, data transformation (ETL), digital transformation and cloud computing

6. DAMA CDMP certification (Practitioner or Master level).

7. Experience standing up a data product / data mesh operating model with federated governance.

8. Experience making data AI- and agentic-ready in a regulated setting, including adherence to all related data management, model, and AI governance requirements.

9. Experience owning data end-to-end, from authoritative source through certification, lineage, quality measurement, and consumption. This includes operational data such as application inventories, configuration management, entitlements, and incident and change records.

10. Experience building advanced and nimble business analytics capabilities that deliver rapid, decision-grade insight to executive leadership and support regulatory and board reporting.

The annual base salary for this position is $230,000 to $280,000

title: Senior Software Engineer (Full Stack)
description:
Position Description:

At ServiceTrade, you’ll build technology that matters — for your career, your team, and the thousands of commercial contractors who rely on our platform every day. We’re on a mission to partner with commercial trades to deliver technology that enhances technician productivity, improves customer experiences, and drives scalable growth.

We’re looking for a Senior Software Engineer (Full Stack) who’s excited to make an impact. In this role, you will be responsible for expanding our core product by designing and constructing powerful new capabilities on top of our existing application ecosystem. You will bridge the gap between user experience and backend infrastructure, taking total ownership of these new initiatives from architectural integration to deployment.

Why ServiceTrade:

You’ll belong here from the start.

We bring together kind, curious people with diverse perspectives and trust them with meaningful work. You’ll have ownership, clarity, and support to solve real problems, make a visible impact for our customers, and continue growing as your role evolves.

On the Engineering team, you’ll have the opportunity to write clean, high-performance code, ensure new features seamlessly integrate with our current systems, and collaborate closely with product and design to execute our expanding roadmap.

About You:

You've spent years building complex full-stack applications and love taking features end-to-end—from initial architecture to cloud deployment. You think in systems, bringing deep expertise in JavaScript/TypeScript, React, PHP, and APIs to integrate new capabilities into existing platforms. You're forward-thinking, using AI tools like Cursor or Copilot to move faster without sacrificing quality. Above all, you take total ownership and effortlessly bridge the gap between product vision and backend execution.

Key Responsibilities and Activities:

  • New Feature Delivery: Design, build, test, and deploy robust, scalable, and secure full-stack features that integrate seamlessly with our existing platform architecture.
  • Architecture & Integration: Lead the architectural design of new components and microservices, ensuring they align with existing systems while optimizing for speed, scalability, and uptime.
  • API Development: Build and maintain secure, high-throughput RESTful APIs to support new front-end capabilities.
  • Frontend Excellence: Create intuitive and responsive user interfaces that deliver exceptional user experiences across all devices.
  • Code Quality & Mentorship: Advocate for engineering best practices by conducting thorough code reviews and writing comprehensive unit/integration tests.
  • DevOps & CI/CD: Maintain and improve CI/CD deployment pipelines, infrastructure-as-code, and cloud monitoring systems for new feature releases.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Product Managers, UX/UI Designers, and data teams to align technical roadmaps with business objectives.
  • Quality Ownership: Own the quality of delivered code by creating appropriate unit, component, and integration automated tests where needed.

Knowledge and Skills:

Required Qualifications

  • Experience: 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a proven track record of shipping production-grade full-stack features within existing codebases.
  • Frontend Stack: Mastery of modern JavaScript/TypeScript and frameworks like React.js (preferred), Vue.js, or Angular, along with HTML5, CSS3/SASS, and state management.
  • Backend Stack: Strong expertise in PHP (preferred), Node.js, Python (Django/FastAPI), or similar, alongside asynchronous, event-driven programming.
  • Databases: Deep knowledge of relational (PostgreSQL, MySQL) and non-relational (MongoDB, DynamoDB, Redis) databases, including schema design and query optimization.
  • Cloud & DevOps: Experience with AWS, GCP, or Azure, Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD tools (GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab).
  • System Design & Problem Solving: Strong analytical skills with a deep understanding of software design patterns, microservices, and security best practices (OWASP Top 10).
  • Communication: Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
  • AI Acceleration: Experience using generative AI development tools like Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, or Copilot, for greater productivity.
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with serverless architectures and cloud-native scaling strategies.
  • Experience migrating or refactoring legacy system components during new feature implementation.
  • Active contributions to open-source projects or a strong portfolio of personal engineering projects.
  • Experience working in an Agile/Scrum environment with rapid, iterative release cycles.
  • Experience building form based survey style systems.
  • Some experience with mobile application development.

A few things you’ll want to know:

What does ServiceTrade do?

ServiceTrade is a best-in-class field service management platform that helps commercial fire protection and mechanical service contractors build efficient and growing businesses. With more than a decade of innovation and 1500 customers, ServiceTrade streamlines operations from the field to the office, boosts technician productivity, and enhances the end-customer experience.

Ok, so why should I care about that?

Our customers do essential work — often behind the scenes — and our software helps them do it better. They’re smart, hardworking people, and we take pride in helping them grow their businesses, earn more revenue, employ more skilled workers, and deliver greater value to their own customers. When you work at ServiceTrade, your impact extends beyond our walls, supporting communities and markets you might never have thought about — and making work that truly matters every day.

What kind of working environment do you have?

We’re a growing business focused on building with intention and operating with purpose. You’ll have meaningful responsibility and the trust to do your best work from the start. We encourage calculated risks and bold experimentation, while providing opportunities to learn, grow, and turn today’s lessons into tomorrow’s breakthroughs—all in service of big ambitions and real customer impact.

Learn more about our culture and values on our About Us page.

What kind of benefits do you offer?

  • Medical through Cigna, PPO and HDHP options, including a Health Savings Account with company contributions Dental and Vision through Unum
  • Flexible Spending Account and Dependant Care Account
  • Company-paid Life insurance, STD and LTD
  • Voluntary benefits including Supplemental Life Insurance, Critical Illness, Accident and Pet Insurance
  • 401(k) with up to 3% employer match and NO vesting period
  • Flexible PTO policy
  • 10 company holidays
  • Parental Leave
  • Paid Time Off for Volunteering
  • Employee Reimbursement Program to use for well-being, technology and/or professional development

Want to know more?

Go ahead and apply! Let’s get to know each other.

title: RN
description:
Registered Nurse (RN) – Substance Use Disorder Treatment

Renewal Falls Recovery Center
Cedar Falls, Iowa
Full-Time | Three 12-Hour Shifts
Day Shift: 6:00 a.m. – 6:00 p.m. | Night Shift: 6:00 p.m. – 6:00 a.m.


JOIN A MISSION THAT CHANGES LIVES!

Are you a compassionate and skilled Registered Nurse looking for an opportunity to make a meaningful difference?

Renewal Falls Recovery Center is seeking Registered Nurses (RNs) to join our growing team in Cedar Falls, Iowa. In this role, you’ll provide hands-on nursing care to individuals receiving treatment for substance use disorders while working alongside a collaborative team of medical, clinical, and behavioral health professionals.

This is more than a nursing job. It’s an opportunity to help individuals stabilize, heal, and take meaningful steps toward long-term recovery.


ABOUT US

Renewal Falls Recovery Center, in partnership with Ascension Recovery Services, is committed to expanding access to high-quality substance use disorder treatment in Iowa.

Our team provides compassionate, evidence-based care in a structured treatment environment designed to support individuals throughout the recovery process.


WHY YOU SHOULD JOIN US

Meaningful Work: Make a direct impact in the lives of individuals beginning their recovery journey.

Three-Day Workweek: Full-time RNs work three 12-hour shifts, giving you greater flexibility outside of work.

Collaborative Team: Work alongside physicians, nurse practitioners, therapists, recovery support professionals, and behavioral health leaders.

Specialized Experience: Build valuable experience in addiction medicine, behavioral health, withdrawal management, and residential treatment.

Competitive Benefits: Receive competitive compensation, comprehensive health and welfare benefits, and opportunities for professional growth.


WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Provide compassionate, patient-centered nursing care to adults receiving substance use disorder treatment.
  • Administer medications and treatments in accordance with provider orders and established nursing standards.
  • Complete nursing assessments and monitor patients for changes in physical, behavioral, and psychiatric condition.
  • Monitor and support patients experiencing withdrawal and communicate changes in condition to medical providers.
  • Collaborate with physicians, nurse practitioners, pharmacists, and the interdisciplinary treatment team to coordinate patient care.
  • Complete nursing components of new patient admissions, including assessments, medication reconciliation, provider orders, and orientation.
  • Maintain accurate medication administration records (MARs) and follow medication-management and controlled-substance procedures.
  • Document assessments, interventions, patient responses, and provider communications accurately and timely in the electronic medical record.
  • Educate patients regarding medications, treatment, health conditions, withdrawal symptoms, and recovery.
  • Respond appropriately to medical and psychiatric emergencies.
  • Coordinate laboratory services, pharmacy needs, outside medical appointments, and hospital transfers when necessary.
  • Participate in treatment and discharge planning to support continuity of care.
  • Maintain patient confidentiality and appropriate professional boundaries.
  • Follow organizational policies, infection-control practices, regulatory requirements, and accreditation standards.
  • Support additional nursing responsibilities and projects as needed.


WHO YOU ARE

You are a dependable and compassionate RN who believes people deserve dignity, respect, and excellent care throughout the recovery process.

You are comfortable working in a fast-paced behavioral health environment, communicate well with an interdisciplinary team, and can balance clinical judgment with empathy and professionalism.


REQUIREMENTS

  • Current and unrestricted Registered Nurse (RN) license in Iowa required.
  • Graduate of an accredited nursing program.
  • BSN preferred.
  • Two or more years of nursing experience preferred.
  • Behavioral health, substance use disorder treatment, detoxification, residential treatment, psychiatric, or acute-care experience strongly preferred.
  • Current CPR/BLS certification or ability to obtain required certification within 30 days of hire.
  • Ability to work three 12-hour shifts, including the assigned day or night schedule.


WORK CONDITIONS & PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

This position works in an inpatient behavioral health treatment environment and may involve exposure to infectious conditions, patients experiencing withdrawal, emotional distress, or behavioral escalation.

The position requires frequent standing, walking, sitting, bending, and repetitive movements. Team members must be able to lift or move up to 10 pounds regularly and up to 50 pounds occasionally, with or without reasonable accommodation.


READY TO MAKE A DIFFERENCE?

Join Renewal Falls Recovery Center and become part of a team committed to expanding access to treatment and helping individuals build healthier lives in recovery.


Apply today and help us bring hope, healing, and high-quality substance use disorder treatment to Cedar Falls and the surrounding community.


BENEFITS

  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance
  • Company-paid basic life insurance
  • Company-paid short-term disability
  • 401(k) retirement plan
  • Paid time off
  • Paid holidays
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • Professional development and career growth opportunities


Equal Employment Opportunity

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

title: Compositing Artist
location: New York, New York, United States
description:
Position Summary:

The Compositing Artist is responsible for creating the final seamless image by integrating live-action footage with computer-generated (CG) elements, matte paintings, visual effects, and digital enhancements. As the final stage of the CGI production pipeline, this role combines artistic vision with technical precision to produce photorealistic, high-quality visuals that meet creative and client expectations.

Working within HOME, Wellcom's AI-enabled production ecosystem, the Compositing Artist collaborates closely with CGI artists, lighting artists, supervisors, and production teams to ensure consistency across every deliverable. This role leverages emerging technologies and efficient production workflows while maintaining the highest standards of visual quality and technical accuracy.



Key Responsibilities:

2D/3D Integration

  • Seamlessly integrate multi-pass CGI renders (including AOVs such as beauty, specular, reflection, depth, shadow, and utility passes) with live-action footage.
  • Ensure continuity in lighting, shadows, reflections, perspective, and atmosphere to create photorealistic final imagery.
  • Blend CGI, matte paintings, and practical elements into cohesive visual compositions.

Keying & Extraction

  • Extract high-quality mattes from green screen and blue screen footage while preserving fine details such as hair, motion blur, transparency, and edge fidelity.
  • Refine keys and composites to achieve clean, production-ready results.

Digital Prep & Clean-Up

  • Perform advanced paint work including wire removal, rig removal, marker cleanup, clean plate generation, and image restoration.
  • Utilize tracking, cloning, and paint techniques to remove production artifacts while maintaining image integrity.

Tracking & Matchmoving

  • Apply 2D, planar, and 3D tracking techniques to accurately integrate digital assets into moving footage.
  • Utilize industry-standard tracking tools, including Mocha and Nuke's built-in tracking systems, to support stable and accurate composites.
  • Collaborate with tracking teams to resolve complex camera movement challenges.

Atmospheric & Visual Effects Enhancement

  • Enhance shots through the integration of atmospheric effects including dust, smoke, haze, depth cues, lens flares, light wraps, grain, and environmental effects.
  • Ensure all enhancements support the realism and creative direction of each project.

Color & Technical Consistency

  • Maintain strict adherence to color management pipelines, including ACES and OCIO workflows.
  • Match color, exposure, white balance, grain, and overall image characteristics across multiple sources.
  • Ensure technical consistency throughout production while delivering photorealistic imagery.

Cross-Department Collaboration

title: Freight Handler- Part Time
description:
The Forklift Operator is responsible for the safe, accurate, and efficient loading, unloading, staging, scanning, and movement of freight. As certified forklift operators within the operation, they provide safe, accurate, and efficient loading, unloading, movement, and documentation of cargo/freight within a multimodal transportation terminal, intermodal yard, warehouse, or dock environment, directly contributing to productivity, workflow coordination, and freight integrity. As the most experienced team members without direct reports, they often assist with mentoring, guiding, and onboarding new Material Handlers and solving complex operational problems on the floor.

Compensation: $19.60 per hour

Schedule: 25-30 hours weekly. Monday and Fridays 6am-12pm, Tuesday-Thursday 7am-11:30am, scheduled start times vary.

Responsibilities

  • Load and unload freight using sit-down/stand-up forklifts and reach trucks, along with other appropriate Material Handling Equipment (MHE), such as pallet jacks, carts, and dollies, and approved physical lifting techniques.

  • Move, stage, sort, and position freight between dock doors, trailers, and designated warehouse areas in accordance with operating procedures.

  • Pick, pack, and prepare items for shipping and delivery.

  • Assist drivers with loading and unloading activities following dock and safety procedures.

  • Label, scan, and track freight using handheld scanning devices and company systems to ensure accuracy and documentation integrity.

  • Identify damaged freight and promptly report issues, unsafe conditions, or equipment concerns to supervisory personnel.

  • Abide by all company safety policies, OSHA requirements, and PPE standards.

  • Maintain a clean, safe, and organized dock environment, including work areas, tools, and MHE.

  • Perform tasks under appropriate supervision while learning equipment operation, safety protocols, and job procedures (for developing roles).

  • Support dock productivity, workflow efficiency, and overall operational goals.

  • Work assigned schedules, including nights, weekends, holidays, and overtime based on business needs.

  • Safely and accurately handle oversized, high‑value, or complex freight.

  • Assist with dock coordination, workflow management, and problem resolution.

  • Prioritize freight and coordinate task assignments, sometimes acting in a lead capacity (without direct supervisory responsibility).

  • Serve as a subject‑matter expert on dock operations, equipment, and procedures.

  • Train, mentor, and support the development of other Material Handlers.

  • All other duties as assigned to meet evolving business needs.

Qualifications

  • Education: High School Diploma or General Education Development (GED)/equivalent preferred but not required.

  • Certification/Licensure: Valid forklift certification/licensure (or ability to obtain before operating equipment) required.

  • Experience: 3+ years of dock or warehouse experience required.

  • Communication: Ability to communicate effectively in English, verbally and in writing, to understand safety and operational instructions, work assignments, and freight documentation.

  • Ability to recognize numbers, labels, barcodes, and freight markings accurately, and to perform basic arithmetic to verify freight counts, quantities, and weights.

  • Basic arithmetic skills to verify freight counts, quantities, and weights.

  • Technology: Willingness and ability to learn and use basic computer systems, handheld scanners, and freight-tracking devices.

  • Equipment: Ability to safely operate material handling equipment (MHE) such as pallet jacks, dollies, hand trucks, order pickers, pallet riders, conveyors, dock plates, dock levelers, sit-down/stand-up forklifts and reach trucks (with company-assisted certification/training), and/or other specialized MHE as required by the site.

  • Ability to maintain regular and predictable attendance.

  • Physical Demands: Extensive standing, walking, bending, stooping, kneeling, crouching, reaching, and twisting for 8-12 hours per/shift, with the ability to lift, push, pull, and carry freight up to 50lbs without assistance, with occasional lifting of freight up to 75lbs with assistance or mechanical aids throughout each 8-12 hour shift, multiple times per/week.

  • Vision, hearing, and verbal communication skills sufficient to work safely in a noisy dock environment.

  • Environment: Ability to work safely around moving equipment, vehicles, and freight in a non-climate-controlled environment, including frequent exposure to temperature extremes (both hot and cold), occasional outdoor work and/or exposure to precipitation (rain, sleet, snow, etc.), regular exposure to moving equipment, vehicle traffic, exhaust, dust, and moderate to loud noise.

title: Senior Tooling Engineer
description:
Senior Tooling Engineer (Confidential Search)

Torrance, CA or Rio Rancho, NM | $140,000 to $230,000 base + equity

The Opportunity

Our client is a fast-growing, well-backed defense manufacturing startup building advanced propulsion and weapon systems. They apply a commercial, high-speed approach to hardware: short iterative design cycles, early and frequent real-world testing, and modern manufacturing methods, in a domain that has historically moved slowly. The team is small, fast, and execution-focused.

They are hiring a Senior Tooling Engineer to own the tooling that makes their hardware manufacturable at rate.

The Problem You Would Own

You will design and build tooling assemblies (jigs, fixtures, molds, dies, and assembly tooling) for aerospace and missile-class components. A key near-term challenge is scaling solid rocket motor propellant manufacturing: energetic material handled at production scale, in large batches with strict thermal and handling constraints. The tooling has to hit cost and throughput targets without compromising the safety and process requirements that energetic materials demand.

What You Would Do

  • Design complex tooling (jigs, fixtures, molds, dies, assembly tools) in CAD
  • Run tolerance stack-up and FEA to validate designs
  • Drive tooling efficiency and product-quality improvements
  • Lead projects from concept through production, owning timelines, budgets, and resources
  • Mentor junior engineers and technicians
  • Ensure compliance with aerospace standards (AS9100, NADCAP) and apply design-for-manufacturability
  • Partner with design, supply chain, and production on manufacturability and troubleshooting

What You Bring

  • Bachelor's in Mechanical, Electrical, or Manufacturing Engineering, or a related field
  • 5+ years of tooling design and development experience
  • Preferred: new product introduction / pilot / production-transition experience, complex-build troubleshooting, and a regulated or defense manufacturing background

Details

  • Location: two sites available (Southern California or New Mexico); relocation supported; some inter-site travel
  • Compensation: $140,000 to $230,000 base, plus long-term stock incentives, full medical, vision, and dental, and four weeks PTO
  • Eligibility: ITAR applies. Must be a US citizen

title: Electrical Engineering Team Lead
description:
Waabi, founded by AI visionary Raquel Urtasun, is the leader in Physical AI. With a world-class team, we're unlocking the next era of autonomous transportation with technology that's powering commercial autonomous trucks and robotaxis. Waabi is backed by and partners with world leaders in AI, automotive, logistics, and deep tech.

With offices in Toronto, San Francisco, Dallas, and Pittsburgh, Waabi is growing quickly and looking for diverse, innovative and collaborative candidates who want to impact the world in a positive way. To learn more visit:

Waabi builds generative AI for the physical world, starting with autonomous trucks. The hardware behind that intelligence has to be as rigorous as the software — road-ready, manufacturable at scale, and trusted by the OEMs whose trucks it lives in.

As our Electrical Engineering Team Lead, you'll own that bridge. You'll guide the team that designs Waabi's custom electronics and carries them from prototype to production, making sure every design is built for the assembly line and meets the exacting standards of our OEM partners and our own safety and functional requirements.

This position is open to candidates in both San Francisco & Pittsburgh with the expectations of 4 days onsite.

You Will…

  • Lead the team. Guide and mentor a group of electrical engineers working on high-performance embedded compute and robust power distribution. Set technical direction and help people do the best work of their careers.

  • Design for scale. Drive Design for Manufacturability (DFM) and Design for Testability (DFT) across every hardware iteration, moving from prototype toward zero-defect mass production.

  • Own the CM relationship. Serve as the primary technical interface with our contract manufacturers — running NPI (New Product Introduction) cycles, conducting line audits, and clearing production bottlenecks.

  • Partner with our OEMs. Be the technical face of Waabi to our OEM partners, translating their supplier requirements into engineering specifications and making sure our hardware integrates cleanly into their vehicle platforms.

  • Uphold functional safety and quality. Ensure electrical systems meet automotive standards such as ISO 26262 and AEC-Q100, and maintain a roadmap for long-term reliability in the field.

Qualifications

  • BS/MS in Electrical Engineering or a related field, or equivalent hands-on experience.

  • 10+ years in hardware development, including time leading or mentoring engineers. (Formal management experience is a plus, not a prerequisite — we care that you can grow a team.)

  • Deep experience with complex PCB design, high-speed signaling, and the thermal challenges of AV compute platforms.

  • A strong grasp of power distribution and DC-DC conversion for high-performance compute and sensor loads, plus a clear understanding of how that hardware interfaces with the vehicle's power architecture.

  • Fluency with the automotive production world — you know PPAP, APQP, and what automotive-grade reliability actually demands.

Nice-to-haves

  • Direct experience owning a CM or OEM technical relationship through an NPI cycle.

  • Hands-on functional-safety work under ISO 26262.

  • Comfort moving between the lab bench and the high-level roadmap — happy to debug hardware yourself, and able to step back and set direction.
