  • Interest in healthcare data and systems, including domains such as membership, claims, provider, or related healthcare data sets.
  • Ability to work with large or complex data sets and apply analytical thinking to solve business and technical problems.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and willingness to perform root cause analysis on data, processes, and outputs.
  • Clear communication skills, with the ability to collaborate with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and ability to manage work in a fast-moving environment.
  • Curiosity, humility, and a willingness to learn new tools, technologies, and healthcare data concepts.
  • Desire to contribute individually while also collaborating closely with others.

What we would like to see, but not required

  • Experience or coursework involving AWS, Azure, Databricks, Spark, or other cloud-based data platforms.
  • Experience or exposure to Snowflake or similar cloud data warehouse technologies.
  • Academic, internship, or project experience involving performance tuning, query optimization, ETL, or data pipeline development.

title: Associate Director, Assay and Process Development
description:
Position Summary:

Reporting to the Chief Science Officer, the Associate Director, Assay and Process Development works within a high-complexity, cellular, and molecular testing laboratory to develop processes, procedures, and products from conception to production for GLP level pre-clinical test products.


Responsibilities:

  • Lead team of scientists and engineers to plan and build processes for highly complex, high quality biochemistry and cell biology laboratory testing.
  • Work directly with Principal Investigators and R&D Laboratory team to implement and maintain quality control of test processes.
  • Develop new molecular assays for pre-clinical decision making, defining mechanisms of action in complex cell assay environment.
    • Develop test quality criteria and generate data quality reports.
    • Create assay/test performance specification documents in conjunction with CSO and Assoc/Director of R&D Laboratory
    • Develop and review Feasibility and later Development Phase Plans and Reports with CSO, performing all relevant statistical analyses, and making specific recommendations based upon acceptance criteria conclusions.
    • Create, lead, execute Definitive Screening Design, Design of Experiment statistical studies to identify controlling and interacting factors in high complexity live cell assays.
    • Create and maintain process and procedure plans from concept through validation phases.
    • Develop test/process scale up plans with CSO, Assoc/Director of R&D Laboratory, Oncology investigators.
    • Create pre-clinical documentation with CSO and Director Oncology
    • Participate in review and approval processes for each phase of assay development
  • Create and implement a stringent program for maintenance and calibration of laboratory equipment with lab systems and facilities manager.
  • Work with Director R&D Laboratory and Quality Manager to maintain a safe workplace.
  • Support the Quality Manager with compliance for HIPAA requirements and laboratory standard operating procedures.
  • Support lab quality assurance/quality control (QA/QC) programs.
  • Participate in staff reviews as needed.
  • Report to work as scheduled.

Additional Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Participate in set-up of and data generation for translational medicine clinical studies.
  • Plan with other Directors and participate in routine science meetings with team members from Research, Development, and Tissue Culture Areas


Qualifications:

  • PhD/MS in related (bio)engineering field
  • Extensive experience leading teams of scientists/engineers to solve complex problems and deliver results in a timely way.
  • Extensive experience developing processes and pre-clinical assay products, developing and applying appropriate high complexity metrics and statistical analyses.
  • Experience requiring a high percentage of hands-on time in the lab leading and working with teams to build processes and successful products.

Competencies:

  • Language Ability: Ability to read and interpret documents such as safety rules, governmental regulations, and science/engineering technical or professional journals. Ability to write reports, document data; and to speak effectively before small groups.
  • Math Ability: Ability to apply fractions, percentages, reliability and validity to work situations. Ability to work with logarithms and exponents. Ability to develop complex algorithms to analyze experimental data and apply those algorithms in an economical manner to process large data sets uniformly.
  • Reasoning Ability: Ability to apply principles of scientific thinking to a range of practical and intellectual issues. Consistent use of inductive and deductive reasoning.
  • Computer Ability: Proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel, and PowerPoint, Statistical analysis (egs. JMP, R), Design of Experiment software, MatLab or equivalent, SolidWorks or equivalent drafting software.
  • Analytical - Synthesizes complex or diverse information; Collects and researches data; Uses intuition and experience to complement data; Designs workflows and procedures. Applies complex statistical analyses.
  • Design - Generates creative solutions; Uses feedback to modify designs; Applies design principles; Demonstrates attention to detail.
  • Problem Solving - Identifies and resolves problems in a timely manner; Gathers and analyzes information skillfully; Develops alternative solutions.
  • Ethics - Works with integrity and ethically.
  • Innovation - Displays original thinking and creativity; Meets challenges with resourcefulness; Generates suggestions for improving work; Develops innovative approaches and ideas; Presents ideas and information in a manner that gets others' attention.
  • Judgment - Displays willingness to make decisions; Exhibits sound and accurate judgment; Supports and explains reasoning for decisions; Includes appropriate people in decision-making process; Makes timely decisions.
  • Planning/Organizing - Prioritizes and plans work activities; Uses time efficiently; Plans for additional resources; Sets goals and objectives; Develops realistic action plans.
  • Quality - Demonstrates accuracy and thoroughness; Looks for ways to improve and promote quality; Monitors own work to ensure quality.


    Other

    • Supervisory Responsibility: 1-5 persons as needed
    • Work Environment: This position requires the employee to work in a laboratory environment. Typically, standard business hours; flexibility required.


    About Celcuity:

    Celcuity is a commercial biotechnology company pursuing development of targeted therapies for treatment of multiple solid tumor indications. The company's first FDA-approved product is REVTORPYK (gedatolisib), a potent, pan-PI3K and mTORC1/2 inhibitor that comprehensively blockades the PAM pathway. REVTORPYK is approved to treat adults with HR+/HER2- advanced breast cancer that progressed on prior endocrine therapy in the metastatic setting.

    The Phase 3 VIKTORIA-2 trial is evaluating gedatolisib in combination with palbociclib and either fulvestrant or letrozole for the first-line treatment of HR+/HER2- locally advanced or metastatic breast cancer. A Phase 1/2 clinical trial evaluating gedatolisib in combination with darolutamide in patients with metastatic castration resistant prostate cancer, is ongoing.

For this role, the anticipated base pay range is $120,000 - $150,000 DOE. The exact base pay offered for this role will depend on various factors, including but not limited to the candidate’s geography, qualifications, skills, and experience.


    The successful candidate will be eligible for an annual performance incentive bonus and a new hire equity package. Celcuity also offers various benefits offerings, including, but not limited to, medical, dental, vision insurance, 401(k) match, PTO, and paid holidays.

title: Demand Planner (all genders)
description:
Your role

We’re looking for a strategic and highly analytical Demand Planner (all genders) to support our forecasting efforts. In this pivotal role, you'll be the force behind our demand planning, translating complex data into precise forecasts that optimize inventory, support strategic growth, and ensure our business runs smoothly. If you're a natural leader who thrives on turning insights into action and loves building collaborative, data-driven processes, you'll be a perfect fit.

What you'll do:

  • Business Acumen: Develop and maintain sophisticated demand forecasts, leveraging statistical models and market intelligence. This requires a deep understanding of market trends, competition, and how our business operates.

  • Collaboration: Partner across the organization with sales, marketing, and finance to gather critical business inputs for a unified forecast. You'll build and maintain effective working relationships with diverse teams to ensure all plans are aligned.

  • Decision Quality: Drive key improvements in forecast accuracy and process efficiency. You'll use rigorous analysis, wisdom, and judgment to make sound decisions that impact the business and its operational goals.

  • Process Management: Act as a key player in the Sales and Operations Planning (S&OP) process, ensuring alignment between demand, supply, and financial goals. You will be responsible for defining and optimizing the forecasting process itself.

  • Dealing with Ambiguity: Lead the demand planning process in a dynamic environment, making informed decisions and acting effectively even when you don't have all the information. You can comfortably handle risk and uncertainty and guide others through it.

  • Developing Others: Mentor and guide junior team members, sharing expertise and best practices. You'll be a resource for others, helping to improve their functional and technical skills.

Your profile

  • You have at least 2+ years of experience in demand planning or supply chain management, with a proven track record of improving forecast accuracy in a manufacturing or FMCG environment - this is a must-have for the role.

  • It's a big plus if you have worked in the supplement, aromatherapy, cosmetics, wellness, or a similar product-driven environment.

  • Functional/Technical Skills: You're an expert at translating forecasts into efficient operations, aligning with key stakeholders, and ensuring products are available at the right time without overstock or shortages.

  • You hold a bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, or a related field.

  • You're confident working with ERP systems like Odoo, SAP. Oracle and you're highly proficient with forecasting and inventory planning tools.

What we offer

  • An appealing discount on all of our products – from essential oils to vitamins & nutrients

  • We offer 28 days of paid time off per year plus up to 5 days off between Christmas and New Year

  • The Urban Sports Club membership and either Swapfiets bike rental or a subsidy for the Deutschlandticket

  • We believe great things happen when we meet in person, which is why we embrace a hybrid model with one home office day per week – up to two depending on the area you are working in – and up to two weeks per year working from abroad

  • Receive various discounts of up to more than 50 percent on attractive brands such as Flaconi, Bosch, Apple or Expedia

  • You will be given real ownership and plenty of room for new initiatives, as well as the opportunity to contribute your expertise and implement your great ideas

  • Inviting office spaces with access to plenty of organic teas and superfoods from around the world

  • We like to celebrate each other! Regular tea & office parties, Christmas and summer feasts and various influencer events such as Women's Day

Sunday Natural emerged from a long-standing passion and research in the fields of health, healing, and personal growth. The lack of natural, high-quality products on the market was the original motivation for founding Sunday Natural in 2013. We aim to produce the products we ourselves would love to buy – as natural as possible, absolutely pure, free from any additives, and of the highest quality. In a strategic partnership with CVC, Sunday Natural is now one of Germany's most renowned quality manufacturers, with its own research and development department in Berlin. For the continuous improvement of our products, we collaborate with selected research institutes, scientists, therapists, farmers, and professional associations.

We take our ecological responsibility very seriously: that’s why the majority of our product range is vegan. We also take an innovative approach to packaging: most of our products are packaged in glass, making them almost entirely recyclable.

Our diverse team in Berlin consists of over 350 employees from more than 45 nationalities and continues to grow – but at a sustainable pace. Our goal is to foster a collaborative, supportive, and inclusive work environment with a diverse group of motivated, talented, and visionary team members.

We highly value equality of opportunity and inclusivity, and we would like to particularly encourage women and candidates from under-represented backgrounds to apply, even if you don’t match with 100% of the requirements.

title: Director, Corporate Operations
description:
Position Summary

The Director, Corporate Operations & Executive Affairs is the operational right hand to the President & CEO and the connective tissue between the Executive Leadership Team (ELT), the corporate office, and SSI’s external community. This is not an administrative support role in the traditional sense. It is a senior, take-charge position accountable for making the CEO’s intent happen — converting direction into tracked commitments, closing loops across the ELT, running the corporate business rhythm, and owning corporate relations and community engagement, including SSI’s support to the Ventura Defense Industry Forum (VDIF).

The person in this seat is expected to identify what should come off the CEO’s plate, take it, and run it — then tell the CEO how the role should be structured and supported going forward. Success looks like an executive office where nothing is dropped, nothing waits on the CEO unnecessarily, and every commitment made in a meeting has an owner, a date, and a status.

Core Accountabilities

1. Executive Throughput & Decision Support
  • Own the CEO’s operating day: calendar strategy, meeting prioritization, travel, briefing packets, and pre-reads — gate-keeping with judgment, not just scheduling.
  • Prepare the CEO for every meeting that matters: agenda, background, prior commitments, open items, and the decision required.
  • Capture decisions and action items in real time; publish them; drive them to closure without further CEO involvement.
  • Draft, edit, and issue correspondence, memoranda, and internal communications on behalf of the CEO.
  • Screen and triage inbound requests, escalating only what genuinely requires the CEO, and resolving or reassigning the rest.
  • Proactively surface conflicts, risks, and slipping commitments before they become problems.
2. Deliverable & Commitment Tracking
  • Maintain the single authoritative tracker of executive-level commitments, action items, and deliverables across all ELT members and business units.
  • Run the follow-up cadence: chase owners, confirm status, verify completion, and report exceptions to the CEO with specifics — who, what, when, and how late.
  • Administer SSI’s recurring accountability structures (weekly plans and closeouts, monthly reviews, quarterly and semiannual executive reviews), including data calls, templates, consolidation, and distribution.
  • Build and maintain the corporate calendar of recurring obligations — reviews, board and leadership meetings, certification audits, reporting deadlines, and annual planning milestones.
  • Escalate with candor. This role is expected to hold senior leaders to their commitments on the CEO’s behalf and to do so professionally, persistently, and without needing permission each time.
3. Corporate Operations & Business Rhythm
  • Plan and execute corporate-level events and forums: ELT meetings, executive reviews, strategic planning sessions, all-hands meetings, leadership workshops, and company functions — end to end, including logistics, materials, facilitation support, and after-action follow-up.
  • Coordinate cross-functional corporate initiatives that do not sit cleanly inside one department, keeping owners aligned and schedules honest.
  • Serve as the corporate point of coordination for the Camarillo headquarters: executive-level visits, customer and government tours, VIP protocol, visitor coordination, and facility presentation standards.
  • Support governance and documentation discipline — corporate policies, organizational charts, position descriptions, meeting records, and executive-level document control — in coordination with People & Culture and Contracts.
  • Assist with the preparation and quality control of executive-facing deliverables and briefings, ensuring SSI’s work product is polished, on-brand, and on time.
4. Corporate Relations & External Engagement
  • Serve as a professional, senior-level point of contact for customers, government stakeholders, prime contractors, teaming partners, industry associations, and community organizations.
  • Manage relationship cadence on the CEO’s behalf: touchpoint tracking, follow-up correspondence, thank-yous, introductions, and scheduling of key stakeholder engagements.
  • Coordinate SSI’s presence at conferences, trade shows, industry days, and community events — registrations, booth logistics, materials, briefings, and attendee preparation.
  • Support corporate communications and brand consistency across external-facing materials, announcements, and community engagement.
  • Coordinate corporate sponsorships, charitable and veteran-focused community involvement, and executive-level customer hospitality.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in business administration, management, communications, or a related field; equivalent professional experience will be considered in lieu of a degree.
  • Minimum eight (8) years of progressively responsible experience supporting C-suite or general officer/flag-level executives, or in a business operations, program coordination, or executive operations role.
  • Demonstrated experience managing complex calendars, competing executive priorities, and multi-stakeholder coordination in a fast-moving environment.
  • Proven track record of independently owning and closing deliverables — not merely tracking them.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to draft executive-level correspondence and briefing material with minimal direction.
  • Advanced proficiency with Microsoft 365 (Outlook, Teams, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, SharePoint).
  • Absolute discretion with confidential and sensitive business, personnel, and financial information.
  • U.S. Citizenship; ability to obtain and maintain a DoD SECRET security clearance.
  • Ability to work on-site at SSI’s Camarillo, California headquarters.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in the defense industrial base, aerospace, or a government contracting environment.
  • Familiarity with DoD customer protocol, Navy organizations, or the Ventura County defense ecosystem (NBVC, NSWC Port Hueneme, NAWCWD).
  • Experience supporting a nonprofit board, industry association, or professional membership organization.
  • Event planning and management experience at the corporate or association level.
  • Prior military service or experience working alongside military organizations.
  • Active or previously held security clearance.

What Your Experience Working for Us Will Be Like

title: Used Car Technician
description:
Used Car Technician

Are you an experienced automotive technician looking for a stable career with a dealership that values quality and teamwork? Shawnee Mission Ford is looking for a Used Car Technician to inspect, diagnose, repair, and recondition pre-owned vehicles to meet our high standards before they reach our customers.

This position plays a critical role in ensuring every used vehicle is safe, reliable, and ready for sale. You'll perform mechanical repairs, maintenance, inspections, and reconditioning while working alongside a team committed to delivering exceptional vehicles and customer satisfaction.

By working at a Ford dealership, you'll be part of a brand that honors its heritage while investing in the future. Join the Ford family, where we value serving one another just as much as we value serving our customers.

title: Director, Product & Merchandise Analytics
description:
Vuori is looking for a Director, Merch & Product Analytics to lead one of three analytics pods in our Data & Analytics organization. This pod is the analytical engine behind how we plan, buy, allocate, and sell product. You will own the analytic products for merchandising, planning, allocation, assortment, inventory, and supply chain — partnering directly with the leaders of those functions and shaping how they make decisions.

This is a lead role, not a contributor role. You will own the roadmap for the pod, run the operating cadence, manage the people and consultants in the pod, and be accountable for outcomes across a portfolio of products and initiatives.

We need someone with deep apparel, footwear, or DTC retail experience who has supported merchandising, planning & supply chain functions and understands how these businesses run — pre-season, in-season, post-season — across wholesale, retail, and ecomm channels. You should be fluent in the analytical and technical side of the work, collaborating with functional leaders and their teams in driving best in class analytic solutions.

We want someone who leads through collaboration and builds teams people want to be part of. You listen first, ask sharp questions, and bring partners along rather than working around them. You invest in relationships across functions — earning trust with merchants, planners, and tech peers, so the work compounds over time.

What you'll get to do:

  • Own the analytics roadmap for the Merch & Product Analytics pod, including inventory, assortment, allocation, planning, product performance, and supply chain
  • Partner with functional leaders and business analytic leads to translate business priorities into a sequenced analytics roadmap
  • Lead and develop a team of product managers, analysts, and consultants (US and offshore), with direct people management responsibility for FTEs and quality oversight of consulting capacity
  • Run the steering committee, intake, prioritization, and delivery cadence for the pod; ensure the 'one list' of priorities stays current and credible with business leaders
  • Define and govern the metric framework for merch, planning, inventory, and supply chain analytics — including weighted in-stock, sell-through, margin, productivity, aged inventory, on-time delivery, and fill rate definitions
  • Ship analytics products that change how decisions are made. Examples - assortment dashboards, allocation analytics, MFP and OTB views, and inventory roll forward reporting
  • Build supply chain analytics that connect demand to supply — inbound visibility, DC and 3PL throughput, lead time and OTIF tracking, network flow, and inventory positioning across channels
  • Partner with Data Platform, Data Science & AI, and Enterprise Analytics peers to ensure shared data foundations, governance, and AI/ML capabilities serve the pod's roadmap
  • Identify and prioritize opportunities to apply AI and ML across merch, planning, and supply chain analytics — forecasting, clustering, allocation optimization, assortment recommendations, and network/inventory optimization — and partner with the DS&AI team to bring them to production
  • Use AI tools (Claude, Copilot, and others) in your own workflow to move faster and set the standard for the rest of the pod

Who you are:

  • 10+ years of experience in analytics, planning, or merchandising roles within apparel, footwear, or branded DTC consumer goods, with at least 3 years in a people leadership capacity
  • Deep domain expertise across two or more of: merchandise planning, demand forecasting, allocation, assortment planning, inventory management, OTB, supply chain and S&OP, and channel planning (retail, ecom, wholesale)
  • Track record of enbaling analytics products that business leaders adopt and rely on — not just one-off reports, but durable products with clear ownership and measurable impact
  • Experience leading mixed teams of FTEs and consultants, including offshore capacity, with the judgment to know when to insource vs. partner
  • Proven ability to operate with leadership — credible, composed, and able to push back when needed without losing the room
  • Working knowledge of supply chain operations end to end — sourcing, inbound logistics, DC and 3PL operations, and omni inventory flow — enough to ask the right questions of supply chain leaders and design analytics that match how the business actually runs
  • Fluency with the modern data stack: Snowflake, dbt or SQLMesh, a major BI platform (MicroStrategy, Looker, Tableau, or Power BI), and exposure to planning tools
  • Hands on experience scoping and applying AI or ML to merchandising or planning problems. You do not need to build models yourself, but you need to know what is feasible and how to partner technically.
  • Strong written and verbal communication. You can write a one page memo that lands with a leadership and run a working session with cross functional teams.
  • A teaching instinct and a track record of developing people. The team you leave should be stronger than the team you joined.
  • Comfort with AI productivity tools in your own workflow

Our investment in you:

At Vuori, we’re proud to offer the following to our employees:

  • Health Insurance
  • Savings and Retirement Plan
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • Generous Vuori Discount & Industry Perks
  • Paid Time Off
  • Wellness & Fitness benefits

The salary range for this role is $182,000 per year - $215,000 per year. This role is bonus eligible.

description:
The Major Gifts Officer is responsible for identifying, cultivating, soliciting, and stewarding individuals capable of making gifts of $5,000 or more. This position manages relationships with existing major-gift prospects while identifying and qualifying new prospective donors.

The Major Gifts Officer manages a portfolio of approximately 125–175 major-gift prospects and donors, developing personalized strategies that deepen relationships and inspire transformational philanthropy. The role is responsible for building meaningful donor relationships, maintaining comprehensive engagement strategies for assigned donors, increasing donor retention and average gift size, and consistently advancing donors through the donor pipeline.



Success in this role is measured by meaningful donor engagement, revenue growth, donor retention, successful solicitation of major gifts, and consistent achievement of established fundraising and activity goals. The Major Gifts Officer serves as an ambassador for the organization and works collaboratively across departments to connect donors with the SPCA of Wake County’s mission and impact.



This role requires exceptional relationship-building skills, strategic thinking, donor-centered communication, emotional intelligence, initiative, accountability, discretion, adaptability, attention to detail, and a results-oriented approach. The successful Major Gifts Officer will develop a strong understanding of organizational priorities and become a trusted philanthropic advisor who helps donors connect their interests with meaningful opportunities to support the organization.

Our Core Values:
1- Hell, Yeah!
2- Be Kind
3- Do What You Say
4- Forward Focused
5- Loose & Wiggly
6- Drop the Mic



Essential Duties and Responsibilities

Major Gift Fundraising

  • Manage a portfolio of approximately 125–175 major-gift prospects and donors.
  • Develop and execute individualized cultivation, solicitation, and stewardship plans.
  • Enter timely and accurate notes into the organization’s database following each donor interaction.
  • Meet established annual fundraising, solicitation, donor-engagement, and activity goals.
  • Ensure gifts receive timely acknowledgment and appropriate recognition.

Prospect Development

  • Identify new major-gift prospects through analytics, research and other development activities.
  • Qualify prospective donors for caseload management through discovery visits, telephone calls, virtual conversations, and other meaningful engagement.
  • Collaborate with the Development Officer responsible for data and gift processing to maintain accurate prospect and donor records within the donor database.
  • Work with the Development Officer responsible for stewardship to review new major-gift prospects identified through routine Development workflows.

Planned Giving

  • Engage donors in charitable gift-planning conversations when appropriate.
  • Support the administration and fulfillment of estate gifts.
  • Coordinate with other Development staff on new estate gift designation follow-up.
  • Collaborate with Development leadership and appropriate team members to ensure planned gifts are acknowledged, administered, documented, and stewarded appropriately.

Collaboration & Organizational Representation

  • Work closely with Department leadership to understand priorities and develop gift strategies.
  • Represent the organization professionally at donor meetings, fundraising events, community functions, tours, and other organizational activities.
  • Maintain discretion, confidentiality, professionalism, and sound judgment when handling donor information and organizational matters.
  • Perform additional duties as assigned to support Development and organizational priorities.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education and relevant professional experience.
  • Three or more years of successful nonprofit fundraising experience, including direct solicitation of gifts of $5,000 or more.
  • Demonstrated success securing gifts or closing significant financial commitments.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Strong organizational and project-management abilities.
  • Ability to independently manage multiple and competing priorities.
  • Ability to develop and manage individual donor strategies and follow-through.
  • Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to establish trusted relationships with donors, prospects, community members, and organizational stakeholders.
  • Demonstrated professionalism, discretion, sound judgment, and commitment to confidentiality.
  • Valid driver’s license and ability to meet SPCA of Wake County driving eligibility requirements.
  • Ability and willingness to travel throughout the organization’s service area for donor visits, meetings, events, and stewardship activities.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with moves management and donor-pipeline strategy.
  • Experience using Salesforce or a comparable donor database
  • Experience with planned giving, estate gifts, or charitable gift planning.
  • Experience supporting a capital campaign or other significant fundraising initiative.
  • Experience developing donor proposals and personalized donor communications.

Work Environment

This role operates primarily within a collaborative nonprofit development environment and involves frequent interaction with donors, prospects, staff, volunteers, organizational leaders, community partners, and other stakeholders.

Responsibilities are performed in office settings, donor homes and workplaces, community locations, event venues, SPCA facilities, and other approved locations throughout the organization’s service area. The position requires regular onsite presence as well as significant local travel to cultivate, solicit, and steward donor relationships.

The position requires professionalism, discretion, responsiveness, and flexibility while managing confidential donor information, competing priorities, time-sensitive opportunities, donor meetings, and fundraising activities. Responsibilities may occasionally involve working around and interacting with animals, including cats, dogs, and small pets.

Physical Requirements

  • Ability to remain stationary and work at a computer for extended periods.
  • Ability to communicate effectively in person, by telephone, virtually, and through electronic communication methods.
  • Ability to travel throughout the organization’s service area for donor visits, meetings, events, tours, and other Development activities.
  • Ability to safely operate a motor vehicle and travel locally on a regular basis.
  • Anticipated local travel may represent approximately 25%–50% of the workweek as the donor portfolio matures and relationship activity increases.
  • Ability to attend occasional evening and weekend events.
  • Ability to move, carry, and transport materials weighing up to 25 pounds for donor meetings, presentations, events, and other Development activities.
  • Ability to participate in onsite meetings, donor interactions, organizational tours, community activities, and fundraising events.
  • Ability to consistently perform the essential responsibilities of the position at SPCA facilities and other approved locations throughout the service area.

Benefits:

  • Medical and Dental: Employer pays 90% of employee coverage (full-time)
  • Insurance includes wellness, dental, vision, life, mental health care, prescriptions, emergency & urgent care, chiropractic care, and physical therapy
  • Telemedicine options, 24/7 access to virtual health & wellness care and virtual behavioral health care

PAID TIME OFF –

  • All part-time and full-time staff receive paid time off.
  • Paid Holidays - 9 paid holidays per year (full-time)
  • Vacation Time - 10 paid vacation days per year (full-time) with scheduled increases at milestone anniversaries of hire date
  • Sick Time - 6.5 paid sick days per year (full-time)

FINANCIAL –

  • Healthcare: Flexible Spending Account
  • 401k Plan
  • Coastal Federal Credit Union Membership
  • 20% discount on pet adoptions and in SPCA Wake retail store

OTHER –

  • Bereavement time off
  • Federal & State Leave of Absence options

title: Research Assistant/ Laboratory Technician
description:

Are you an experienced clinical research professional with a passion for advancing medicine? Join a leading, integrated clinical research network dedicated to high-quality data, patient-centered care, and innovation in clinical trials.

We’re seeking a Research Assistant/ Laboratory Technician for our clinical research site located in Brownsville, TX.

Type: Regular Full-time Employee
Schedule: Mondays through Fridays, 8:00am - 5:00pm
Location: Onsite in Brownsville, TX (no capabilities for remote or hybrid work)
Reports to: Site Director
Benefits: Our benefits package for full-time employees includes health insurance (medical, dental, and vision), Health Savings Accounts (HSA) and Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA), Paid Time Off (PTO), a variety of disability, accident, and life insurance options, as well as many more.

💼 What We Offer

  • Competitive pay + annual performance incentives
  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance
  • 401(k) plan with company match
  • Paid time off (PTO) and company holidays
  • A mission-driven culture focused on advancing medicine and improving patient outcomes

🚀 Why Join Us?

You’ll be part of a growing, mission-driven organization that values its people. At our core, we’re committed to bringing innovative medical treatments to patients faster—while creating an environment where employees thrive. If you’re passionate about clinical research and ready to make a difference, we’d love to hear from you.

Responsibilities:

  • Own the Lab Operations: Take the lead on day-to-day lab activities, ensuring everything runs smoothly, safely, and on schedule. Maintain a clean, organized, and inspection-ready lab environment. Manage lab inventory, supplies, and kit preparation across multiple studies.
  • Perform & Expand Clinical Skills: Perform phlebotomy, specimen collection, and processing (centrifuging, aliquoting, labeling). Conduct point-of-care testing (e.g., urine drug screens, pregnancy tests). Assist with patient visits, including vital signs, ECGs, and study-related procedures. Support more advanced clinical activities over time, including infusion monitoring under supervision.
  • Drive Accuracy & Compliance: Handle specimen shipping (IATA guidelines) and maintain detailed logs and documentation. Record lab data accurately in electronic systems (eCRFs, CRIO, etc.). Ensure compliance with GCP, OSHA, HIPAA, and study protocols. Support audit readiness and quality control efforts.
  • Be a Key Partner to the Research Team: Work closely with coordinators, investigators, and clinical staff to support study visits. Help ensure each patient visit runs efficiently and according to protocol. Step in to support broader research activities when needed.

Requirements:

  • Certified phlebotomist within the state of Texas required
  • Highly proficient in venipuncture with the ability to independently perform draws and effectively navigate challenging sticks
  • Experience working with diverse patient populations; geriatric experience [[a plus/required]]
  • Familiarity with medical terminology and basic laboratory procedures
  • Comfort working with lab equipment, documentation, and regulated processes
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple responsibilities at once
  • Proficiency with basic computer systems (Excel, Outlook, EMRs, or similar tools)
  • Comfortable using multiple electronic data entry systems
  • A team-first mindset with a willingness to jump in wherever needed
  • Strong attention to detail, time management, and ability to work in a fast-paced, regulated environment
  • Excellent interpersonal skills—you’ll be interacting with participants, providers, and sponsors
  • Passion for improving patient outcomes through research
  • Bonus points for:
    • Clinical research experience
    • Experience handling specimen processing, shipping, or lab inventory
    • Interest in growing into a Clinical Research Coordinator or lab leadership role

  • Collaborate closely with creative leads, strategists, and other team members to ensure the work is aligned to brief and client expectations

QUALITIES AND CHARACTERISTICS

  • A compelling portfolio demonstrating strong creative and design craft across digital advertising, social, and campaign work
  • Confident with both static and motion design, with a clear point of view on how animation elevates an idea rather than decorates it
  • A senior creative sensibility; you bring concept and craft in equal measure and know the difference between designing and producing
  • Comfortable working efficiently across a campaign system with multiple formats and asset variations
  • Excellent written and oral communication skills
  • Collaborative, receptive to feedback, and motivated by delivering work that performs as well as it looks

Location & Commitment

  • Remote (United States only); must be available during core business hours, U.S. Eastern Time
  • August 17, 2026 through October 16, 2026

  • Expected weekly compensation: $2,600 to $3,000

St. Margaret’s School is an International Baccalaureate (IB) School offering the Diploma Program.

St. Margaret’s School is seeking dedicated and caring individuals who are passionate about empowering girls. They will attend to the well-being of our boarding students, providing a supportive, nurturing, and inclusive environment.

Boarding House Parents engage boarding students in activities both academic and personal and ensure individual needs, strengths and talents are developed. They provide support for students and have empathy for the social and emotional issues adolescents may face in a boarding school setting.

Boarding House Parents work closely and collaborates with the Director of Boarding, Health Care Providers, Programs Coordinator, parents, and other boarding staff members to ensure continuity of care and support for students. Each of our boarding houses is home to approximately 30 students, ages 12 to 18. St. Margaret's Boarding is home to students from many countries.

  • Maintains professional accountability, responsibility and model appropriate behaviour

  • Ability to work collaboratively as part of a team.

English level

Intermediate English proficiency (B1+) or higher.

Work Type: Hybrid

title: Sr Lead Provider - Internal Only
description:
The PLH Senior Medical Lead position is responsible for being a clinical leader in the organization in terms of clinical mentorship, capacity to train new providers, and being the champion for PLH policy and procedures. A person in this position would exemplify a commitment to the PLH mission and values, an understanding of the importance of championing new and established policies and procedures working closely with the Director of Compliance to introduce new policies. The position requires a willingness to be collaborative, positive, and solutions-based as a leader to the Medical Leads and partner to the Medical Directors. The senior lead position includes being part of the PLH clinical pool which requires the provider to be accessible to fellow providers to discuss and process clinical issues that can arise through the day. The senior lead position can include leading the chart review committee and directing and participating in chart reviews for training and compliance, and the clinical championing of compliance with the EHR.


Responsibilities:

  • Meets all the above PLH medical provider expectations and PLH medical lead expectations.
  • Serves as an advanced clinical resource and mentor to PLH medical providers, providing guidance related to clinical care, documentation standards, workflows, and adherence to PLH expectations.
  • Facilitates the clinical championing and rollout of the EHR system, providing continuous education and developmental guidance for incoming clinical Providers regarding the PLHC.
  • Acts as a lead trainer and clinical support resource for new PLH medical providers, including clinical onboarding, orientation, workflow education, documentation expectations, and ongoing development support.
  • Provides coaching, mentorship, and constructive feedback to providers related to clinical practice, documentation quality, compliance expectations, and organizational standards.
  • Performs provider/chart reviews and co-signing responsibilities as assigned and appropriate.
  • Promotes adherence to PLH Clinical and Administrative Policies and assists in updating and communicating clinical pearls, best practices, and workflow improvements.
  • Assists with the development, review, and improvement of clinical protocols, policies, and procedures in collaboration with Medical Directors and the Director of Compliance.
  • Works closely with the Director of Compliance to support compliance initiatives, audit readiness, documentation standards, and quality improvement efforts.
  • Serves as a point of contact for clinical compliance needs and quality improvement efforts, supporting communication between patient care teams and administration.
  • Reviews clinical quality trends and assists in identifying opportunities for improvement on workflows.
  • Performs other duties as assigned by PLH Clinical Leadership.


Qualifications:

Must be an in-clinic provider and not solely virtual to support provider training, mentorship, and clinical development.

  • Must have served as a PLH Medical Lead for a minimum of one year.
  • Must consistently meet Medical Lead productivity and performance expectations.
  • Demonstrated excellence in clinical documentation, compliance standards, and quality patient care.
  • Demonstrated ability to provide clinical mentorship, coaching, and constructive feedback to other providers.
  • Strong communication, collaboration, and leadership skills with the ability to partner effectively with providers, Medical Directors, Compliance, and operational teams.
  • Demonstrated commitment to PLH mission, values, patient-centered care, and continuous improvement.
  • Ability to identify challenges, provide solutions, and support implementation of organizational initiatives.


Job Breakdown:

The Senior Medical Lead role includes maintaining clinical provider responsibilities and productivity expectations while dedicating designated administrative time to leadership responsibilities.


Administrative responsibilities may include provider mentorship, chart reviews, training support, compliance initiatives, clinical quality improvement projects, EHR support, and policy/procedure implementation.


Clinical hours will be scheduled based on organizational needs. Administrative hours will be a minimum of four (4) hours per month or additional time as approved by the Medical Director, Director of Compliance, and Executive Team based on clinical business needs.


The Senior Medical Lead role provides clinical leadership and support to the organization but does not replace or assume the responsibilities of the Medical Director or Director of compliance roles.

title: Systems Administrator
location: New York, New York, United States
description:
About Bonhams

Bonhams is a global auction house with an 18th century heritage poised for transformative change. Our global operations are based in London, Paris, New York, Los Angeles and Hong Kong where we sell in over 60 categories, including motor cars, paintings, jewelry, and entertainment memorabilia.

Our employees are passionate about their work, and we pride ourselves on a bespoke approach that aims to make every client feel important. It is an exciting time for our business and our global leadership team of art world professionals are building a people-focused team to help them develop their talent strategy, strengthen our people brand globally, build organizational capability and drive process improvement.

Bonhams is an Equal Opportunity Employer. As part of our commitment to fight for equality, we work to ensure a fair and consistent interview process. We celebrate diversity and we are committed to an inclusive work environment.



About the Role

Bonhams is seeking a Systems Administrator to join the Infrastructure & SysOps team in New York. This is a hands-on, mid-level infrastructure role within a small, collaborative global IT team, supporting approximately 1,250 users companywide across a modern hybrid enterprise environment. The role encompasses Microsoft 365 E5 services, Microsoft Intune, Azure infrastructure, Windows and macOS endpoints, enterprise networking, and the technology that underpins Bonhams’ live auction program.

The successful candidate will serve as the lead Systems Administrator for Bonhams’ New York operations, taking ownership of endpoint, identity and core infrastructure services while working closely with colleagues across North America, Europe and Asia to deliver secure, reliable and consistent IT services. The role offers the opportunity to influence infrastructure standards, contribute to global technology projects, and play a key role in supporting one of the world’s leading auction houses.

This position requires someone who is proactive, technically curious and comfortable taking ownership of technical issues from investigation through to resolution. The successful candidate will contribute to the continuous improvement of Bonhams’ global IT environment through automation, security hardening, documentation, monitoring, process improvement and the adoption of emerging technologies, including AI-enabled services.

A key part of the role is supporting Bonhams’ live auction events, both within the New York and other US salerooms and at external venues. These events are business-critical and require a calm, methodical approach to troubleshooting in time-sensitive situations where system availability directly impacts the business. Additional after-hours work associated with auction delivery and infrastructure changes will be required from time to time.

Key Tasks and Responsibilities

Endpoint & Device Support

  • Support and administer Windows 11, macOS and iOS devices within a modern enterprise environment
  • Assist with device management using Microsoft Intune / MDM tooling.
  • Support device provisioning, patching, and compliance monitoring.
  • Troubleshoot endpoint performance and security issues.
  • Develop and maintain automation using PowerShell and other scripting tools to improve operational efficiency and reduce manual administration.
  • Assist with Windows Autopilot, Apple Business Manager and modern endpoint lifecycle management.

Microsoft 365 & Identity

  • Support Microsoft 365 services including Exchange Online, Teams, SharePoint, OneDrive, Defender and Purview.
  • Support Mimecast services, email security and e-discovery exercises.
  • Assist with Entra ID (Azure AD), MFA, and Conditional Access administration.
  • Help maintain security and compliance configurations within the M365 environment.
  • Support user lifecycle management and access controls.
  • Assist with vulnerability remediation, endpoint compliance and security hardening in accordance with Bonhams security standards.
  • Support Zero Trust security initiatives including Conditional Access, device compliance and identity protection.

Infrastructure & Cloud

  • Assist with administration of Azure infrastructure including virtual machines, virtual networking, storage, backup and monitoring within hybrid environments.
  • Support Windows Server and core infrastructure services including Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, Group Policy and VPN technologies.
  • Manage and configure enterprise networking, switching, wireless networking, firewall policies and VPN connectivity, escalating major infrastructure changes where appropriate.
  • Monitor infrastructure health, endpoint compliance and system availability, proactively identifying and resolving issues before they impact users.
  • Participate in backup, disaster recovery testing and business continuity planning.

Auction & Event IT Support

  • Lead on-site technical setup and support for live auction events at the New York saleroom and off-site venues, typically 2-3 events per month.
  • Set up, test, and manage event networking, AV connectivity, bidding platform infrastructure, and live-streaming technology for hybrid in-room and online auction formats.
  • Troubleshoot time-sensitive technical issues during business-critical live auction events where service interruption directly impacts revenue, exercising calm decision-making under pressure.

Operational Support

  • Act as an escalation point for complex Service Desk issues, owning incidents through to resolution.
  • Participate in incident, problem and change management processes.
  • Perform root cause analysis following significant incidents and contribute to continuous service improvement initiatives.
  • Maintain accurate technical documentation, standard operating procedures and knowledge base articles.
  • Participate in infrastructure, security and automation projects.
  • Collaborate closely with Infrastructure, Cyber Security, Service Desk and Development teams across North America, Europe and Asia to deliver consistent global services.

Qualifications and Skills

  • Minimum of 5 years’ experience in a Systems Administrator, Infrastructure Engineer or similar enterprise IT role.
  • Strong experience administering Windows 11 in an enterprise environment, with experience supporting macOS and iOS devices.
  • Experience managing modern endpoint platforms including Microsoft Intune, Windows Autopilot and Apple Business Manager (or equivalent MDM solutions).
  • Strong working knowledge of Microsoft 365, including Exchange Online, Teams, SharePoint, OneDrive, Microsoft Defender, Purview and Entra ID (Azure AD).
  • Experience administering Microsoft Azure infrastructure and hybrid cloud environments.
  • Solid understanding of Windows Server technologies and core infrastructure services including Active Directory, Group Policy, DNS, DHCP and VPN technologies.
  • Good understanding of enterprise networking including TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, switching, wireless networking, firewalls and VPN technologies.
  • Experience developing and maintaining PowerShell scripts or other automation to improve operational efficiency.
  • Experience working with enterprise security technologies including Microsoft Defender for Endpoint, Mimecast, Conditional Access, Multi-Factor Authentication and endpoint compliance.
  • Experience using enterprise monitoring and IT Service Management (ITSM) platforms such as ServiceNow, Jira Service Management or equivalent.
  • Experience working within structured IT operational processes, including incident, problem and change management.
  • Excellent troubleshooting and analytical skills, with the ability to diagnose and resolve complex technical issues independently.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical colleagues.
  • A proactive, customer-focused approach with a strong sense of ownership, accountability and continuous improvement.
  • Ability to remain calm under pressure and provide effective support during business-critical live auction events.
  • Willingness to travel occasionally within the United States and internationally

Additional Desired Qualities

  • Exposure to Microsoft Sentinel, Microsoft Defender XDR or other enterprise SIEM and security monitoring platforms.
  • Experience supporting enterprise networking and security platforms such as Cisco Meraki, pfSense, Mimecast, Tenable or similar technologies.
  • Experience with infrastructure monitoring and observability platforms.
  • Experience supporting audio-visual (AV) systems, live event technology or broadcast environments.
  • Experience supporting Microsoft Copilot, AI-enabled Microsoft 365 services or other enterprise AI technologies.
  • Knowledge of backup, disaster recovery and business continuity solutions.
  • Familiarity with cloud networking, hybrid infrastructure and Zero Trust security principles.
  • Experience working in a global organization supporting geographically distributed users and infrastructure.
  • Experience supporting business-critical operational environments where service availability is essential.
  • Relevant Microsoft certifications (e.g. Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator Associate, Microsoft 365 Administrator Expert) or equivalent industry certifications.

What We Offer

In addition to an active and progressive work environment, Bonhams offers a competitive benefits package to encourage work/life balance, including:

  • Excellent medical, dental and vision insurance – HMO, EPO, PPO with FSA and HSA
  • 20 days paid time off (PTO)
  • 12 paid holidays and holiday break from Christmas to New Years Day
  • 16 weeks fully paid parental leave and flexible work arrangements
  • 401(k) retirement plan with company contribution
  • Life insurance with AD & D
  • Short- and long-term disability
  • Paid cellphone and data service
  • Tuition reimbursement
  • Commuter benefits (transit and parking)
  • Employee assistance program (EAP)
  • Professional development: free online training and expansive content library
  • Onboarding buddy: 90 day mentor to welcome and orient new joiners
  • Employee resource groups: social club, diversity committee, mentorship program
  • Sponsored socials: annual staff art exhibition, annual summer and holiday parties, monthly birthday treats, weekly breakfast

title: Elinstallatør eller målrettet elektriker med lyst til undervisning
description:
Du kan dit håndværk og ved, hvornår arbejdet er udført ordentligt. For dig handler det ikke kun om kabler, værktøj og diagrammer, men om faglig stolthed og kvalitet i en verden, hvor teknologi spiller en stadig større rolle.

EUC Lillebælt i Fredericia søger til grundforløbet på elektrikeruddannelsen, en dygtig elinstallatør eller målrettet elektriker med lyst til at undervise den nye generation af håndværkere, og opdatere dem med den nyeste viden. Du skal kunne lide at se lærings- og trivselsglimtet i øjnene på eleverne uanset alder og fagligt niveau.

Du bliver den primære underviser på elektrikeruddannelsens grundforløb. Derudover vil du kunne sparre med, og indgå som en aktiv del af lærerteamet indenfor el- og automatikområdet. Vores kerneopgave er, at eleverne gennemfører den ønskede uddannelse og bliver så dygtige, som de kan, gennem inspirerende undervisning, der binder den teoretiske og praktiske faglighed sammen.

Om dig

Du er en ildsjæl og teamplayer med lyst til at dele viden og erfaring. Din entusiasme og energi gør dig til en rollemodel og får alle til at yde deres bedste. Du er udadvendt og samarbejdsorienteret og ikke bange for at afprøve nye idéer og koncepter. Du har autoritet og kan skabe respekt, men du har samtidig en empatisk og tålmodig tilgang til elevernes udfordringer og læring.

Vores forventninger er, at du:

  • Er uddannet elektriker og gerne elinstallatør, med et højt fagligt håndværksmæssigt niveau og har lyst til at formidle dette videre
  • Har en teoretisk elteknisk viden, og kan omsætte denne til motiverende undervisning
  • Kan undervise praksisnær og har lyst til at styrke forståelsen for faget gennem konkrete og relevante eksempler
  • Kan udvikle og koordinere lærings- og uddannelsesforløb i samspil med eleverne og branchen
  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt og samtidig være en proaktiv teamplayer
  • Kan tage ansvar for egen læring for at sikre et "up-to-date" uddannelsesniveau, der fagligt og pædagogisk favner både bredt og højt
  • Er klar til at gennemføre en diplomuddannelse i erhvervspædagogik betalt af EUC Lillebælt (hvis du ikke har den i forvejen)

Løn og ansættelsesforhold

Løn, pension og ansættelse sker i henhold til gældende overenskomst med Uddannelsesforbundet.

Tiltrædelse

Stillingen ønskes besat hurtigst muligt, men vi venter gerne på den rette.

Yderligere information

Yderligere oplysninger om stillingen kan fås ved henvendelse til uddannelsesleder Benny Ziegler tlf. 79 20 11 90 eller mail bez@eucl.dk

Ansøgning

Ansøgningen skal foregå via skolens hjemmeside senest den 22. august 2026. Samtaler afholdes løbende.

title: Assembly Leadman – Modular Buildings
description:
The Assembly Leadman oversees the systematic physical erection of the modular building envelope, combining frames, insulation, panels, and custom trims. This role supervises the progression from bare structural frames to a completely weatherproofed, insulated utility structure. The Assembly Foreman is accountable for the physical erection of the modular buildings, including structural wall panels, interlocking roof skins, doors, and heavy HVAC framing. This role takes the components from the Structural and Sheet Metal teams and transforms them into a weatherproof building envelope within the workshop and construction yard.


Essential Duties/Responsibilities:

The following list of responsibilities is not all inclusive, additional projects and/or tasks may be assigned to meet operational needs. MCG retains the right to change or assign other duties to this position should operational needs warrant.

  • Crew Leadership: Supervise an erection crew led by an Assembly Leadman, coordinating the sequential hoisting, aligning, and fastening of the interlocking panel skin.
  • Envelope Integrity: Ensure all wall-to-base, panel-to-panel, and roof joints are properly sealed, insulated, and weatherproofed according to engineering specifications.
  • Component Integration: Coordinate the installation of sub-assemblies such as exterior doors, bulkhead penetration plates, and structural framing for wall-mounted HVAC units across the work shop and yard.
  • Field Redline Tracking: Log any tight-fit panel adjustments or fastening updates on the physical drawings, handing them over to the Design Support Specialist for as-built logging.

Required Knowledge/Experience:

  • High school diploma or GED
  • Regular working at heights utilizing scaffolding, ladders, or scissor-lift equipment.
  • Ability to work comfortably outdoors in the construction yard during final weatherproofing.
  • Continuous manual dexterity for handling structural fasteners, tools, and industrial caulking systems.

Preferred Experience

  • Expertise in commercial weatherproofing techniques, thermal insulation systems, and industrial sealants.
  • Certification in rigging and signal operations for moving large-scale wall panels via overhead crane.

Supervisory Requirements

  • Supervise a crew by coordinating the sequential hoisting, aligning, and fastening of the interlocking panel skin.

Physical Requirements

  • Regular working at heights utilizing scaffolding, ladders, or scissor-lift equipment.
  • Ability to work comfortably outdoors in the construction yard during final weatherproofing.
  • Continuous manual dexterity for handling structural fasteners, tools, and industrial caulking systems.

Success Measures

  • Zero water penetration failures during final building weather testing or customer spray checks.
  • Square, plumb, and aesthetically sound building panel lines across all exterior structures.
  • Accuracy and speed in delivering building envelopes to the downstream painting and electrical trades.

This is a founding engineering role at an early-stage healthtech SaaS company building the system of record for nursing excellence. The platform helps large health systems improve nurse retention and patient outcomes by centralizing professional governance, digital clinical ladder programs, clinical inquiry (EBP, QI, Research), and ANCC designation management — replacing fragmented spreadsheets and shared drives with a unified, enterprise-grade product.

You'll be the first or among the first engineers, working directly with the founding team to own architecture, set standards, and ship production features across four integrated products. This is a high-ownership, high-impact role in a massive and underserved healthcare vertical.

No visa sponsorship is available. Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States without company sponsorship.

What You'll Do

  • Own end-to-end architecture and ship production features across a suite of four integrated SaaS products

  • Design data models and backend services for complex multi-hospital, multi-unit organizational structures

  • Build AI workflows for exemplar writing, evidence organization, and document retrieval across large program datasets

  • Proven ability to own both architecture and implementation in an early-stage, fast-moving environment

  • Ability to engage directly with non-technical domain experts and customers, and translate feedback quickly into product

  • Clear written and verbal communicator who collaborates well across functions

Tech stack in use: Next.js, React, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, Supabase, Vercel, AWS S3

title: Senior Solutions Consultant
description:
About Planful:

Planful is the pioneer of financial performance management cloud software. The Planful platform, which helps businesses drive peak financial performance, is used around the globe to streamline business-wide planning, budgeting, consolidations, reporting, and analytics. Planful’s award-winning AI capabilities accelerate decision-making, helping Planful users in over 100 countries to close faster, accelerate cycle times, increase productivity, and improve accuracy. Planful is a private company with more than 1,500 customers, including Bose, Boston Red Sox, Five Guys, Grafton Plc, Gousto, and Specialized, and is backed by Vector Capital, a leading global private equity firm. Learn more at .

About the role:

As a Senior Solution Consultant, you will be a subject matter expert working with prospective Planful customers as they evaluate their current business challenges, finance transformation goals, and technology needs. You will bring deep experience in financial performance management and a strong understanding of how EPM solutions support planning, budgeting, forecasting, consolidations, reporting, and analytics.
Planful is looking for a dynamic, high-energy professional with prior hands-on experience working with EPM tools and at least 3+ years of experience selling EPM solutions. In this role, you will partner closely with Sales, Product, Customer Success, and other cross-functional teams to support prospective customers throughout the evaluation process and help demonstrate the value of the Planful platform.
You’ll work as part of an extended team from the earliest stages of customer engagement through the complete sales cycle, delivering tailored demonstrations, leading discovery conversations, supporting proofs of concept, and helping prospective customers understand how Planful can address their most critical finance and accounting needs.

Responsibilities


Support the sales cycle through solution-based activities, including customized product demonstrations, proofs of concept, discovery sessions, and hands-on workshops.
Lead consultative conversations with prospective customers to understand their FP&A, accounting, consolidation, reporting, and analytics challenges.
Confidently present industry and domain expertise to demonstrate a strong understanding of customer needs and EPM best practices.
Demonstrate the business benefits and value of Planful’s solutions in the context of each customer’s goals, processes, and pain points.
Partner with Account Executives to drive the initial evaluation and qualification of customer opportunities.
Translate business requirements into compelling solution narratives that show how Planful can improve planning, close, reporting, and decision-making processes.
Maintain strong product competence by staying current on new product enhancements, best practices, and market trends across the EPM space.
Bring a high level of energy, professionalism, and executive presence to customer and internal interactions.
Embrace an entrepreneurial spirit by contributing creative ideas, perspectives, and recommendations across sales cycles and internal initiatives.
Collaborate cross-functionally with Sales, Product, Customer Success, and Enablement teams to support customer outcomes and improve the sales process.

What you Bring to the Table

Prior experience working with EPM, CPM, FP&A, consolidation, planning, budgeting, forecasting, or financial reporting tools.
3+ years of experience selling EPM solutions, preferably in a pre-sales, solution consulting, sales engineering, related customer-facing role, or similar roles supporting finance and accounting buyers.
Strong working knowledge of FP&A and/or accounting standards, processes, and common challenges faced by finance teams and business stakeholders.
Ability to understand and explain both business and technical issues related to a customer’s proposed solution.
Proven ability to deliver compelling product demonstrations and presentations to finance, accounting, and executive audiences.
Strong executive presence with outstanding written, verbal, organizational, and time management skills.
Ability to execute against a plan, demonstrate ownership, and manage multiple opportunities and priorities effectively.
Experience with cloud-based finance, ERP, BI, or analytics solutions is a plus.
A collaborative mindset, strong curiosity, and passion for helping customers modernize financial performance management.

Why Planful

Planful exists to enrich the world by helping our customers and our people achieve peak performance. To foster the best in class work we’re so proud of, we’ve created a best in class culture, including:

  • 2 Volunteer days a year, Birthday PTO, and quarterly company Wellness Days.
  • 3 months supply of diapers and meal deliveries for the first month of your Maternity/Paternity leave.
  • Annual Planful Palooza, our in-person, company-wide culture kickoff held in cities like San Diego, Denver, and most recently - Austin, Texas!
  • Team-specific offsites in cities like New York, Sonoma, or our brand new HQ based in downtown San Francisco.
  • Remote first culture with benefits such as home office setup, and monthly wifi and cell phone reimbursements.
  • Company-wide Mentorship program with Executive sponsorship of CFO and Manager-specific monthly training programs.
  • Employee Resource Groups such as Women of Planful, Parents of Planful, and many more. We encourage our teammates to bring their authentic selves to the team, and have full support in creating new ERGs & communities along the way.

Pay Transparency Statement

At Planful our top priority is to support our employees and ensure each individual has access to equal growth opportunities. Pay decisions take into consideration the individual's skillset, experience, knowledge, qualifications for the role, and specific work location.

Our range OTE for this role is $200,000-240,000. As a part of this role, you are also eligible for commission, equity, benefits, and wellbeing resources. More details about our company benefits can be found here:

title: Agentic AI Engineer
description:
The Agentic AI initiative seeks an experienced Agentic AI Engineer to design and build an orchestration layer that shifts internal automation from workflow-based systems to agentic interactions. This role focuses on Google Agentic Orchestration, MCP-based integrations, and practical LLM integration to enable reliable agent-to-system interactions across Aon's internal applications.

This is a senior, hands-on engineering role working directly with Murali and the internal team to modernize automation for a workforce of ~60,000 employees. The position requires specialist-level experience implementing agentic orchestration and integrating agents with enterprise systems.

Responsibilities

  • Design and architect a Google-based Agentic Orchestration layer across existing internal applications.
  • Develop, integrate, and test agentic orchestration capabilities using Google Agentic Orchestration.
  • Implement MCP (Model Context Protocol) connectors to enable agent-to-system communication and data exchange.
  • Integrate general LLM capabilities to support agent decision-making and interaction flows.
  • Build reliable, auditable agent interactions to replace legacy workflow automation.
  • Collaborate directly with Murali and cross-functional stakeholders to align technical design with business needs.
  • Validate and troubleshoot agent behaviors and orchestration flows in production-like environments.
  • Support transition planning and handover from incumbent vendor solutions to the new agentic model.

Requirements

  • Specialist-level hands-on experience with Google Agentic Orchestration.
  • Demonstrated experience integrating agents with enterprise systems using MCP (Model Context Protocol).
  • Practical knowledge of general LLM integration for agent behavior and orchestration.
  • Azure awareness and ability to work within an Azure-informed environment.
  • Seniority at Level 3 (Advanced) or Level 4 (Senior/Lead) with a track record of delivering complex orchestration projects.
  • Experience designing and deploying solutions that replace workflow-based automation with agentic interactions.
  • Strong debugging, testing, and validation skills for agentic systems and integrations.
  • Effective collaborator with experience working directly with senior stakeholders and technical leads.

Engagement & Logistics

  • Engagement Length: Up to 6 months.
  • Time Zone: ET
  • Overtime Required: No
  • Equipment: BYOD (Bring Your Own Device)

    1. Meeting with Resilient Co. team.

    3. CV Review
    4. Client Interview

title: AI/ML Engineer (all genders)
description:
Your role

We are looking for an experienced AI/ML Engineer to join our Central Data Platform team and take ownership of the machine learning and GenAI infrastructure that powers advanced analytics and AI use cases across the organisation.

In this role, you will design, build, and maintain end to end ML pipelines in Vertex AI, ensuring that models move seamlessly from prototype to production ready, monitored, cost efficient, and compliant pipelines. You will also pioneer GenAI enablement, including retrieval augmented generation, embeddings, and AI driven applications, while embedding governance, reproducibility, and scalability from day one.

This is a pivotal position with high impact on how AI and machine learning capabilities are delivered, scaled, and governed at Sunday Natural. You will act as the bridge between Data Engineers, Senior Data Analysts, Data Scientists, and business stakeholders, ensuring AI/ML work has measurable, repeatable, and strategic business impact.

  • Design, build, and maintain modular, reusable ML pipelines in Vertex AI Pipelines covering training, evaluation, deployment, monitoring, and retraining.

  • Develop GenAI capabilities including embeddings, retrieval pipelines, vector databases, and RAG frameworks for chatbots, personalisation, and semantic search.

  • Build and manage feature stores and reusable datasets in collaboration with Data Engineers and Analysts.

  • Productionise workflows with Prefect orchestration and CI/CD pipelines in Bitbucket.

  • Implement continuous evaluation, drift detection, performance monitoring, rollback strategies, and retraining triggers for deployed models.

  • Embed GDPR compliance, RBAC, anonymisation, explainability, fairness, and auditability into every model and pipeline.

  • Document lineage of features, models, and inference workflows, and partner with the Data Governance Lead on ethical AI frameworks.

  • Translate technical capabilities into business friendly outcomes, communicating trade offs across accuracy, latency, and cost to non technical stakeholders.

  • Mentor Data Engineers in ML Ops and GenAI techniques, and contribute to internal AI/ML guilds and best practices.

Your profile

  • 5 to 7 years of experience in Data Engineering or ML Ops, with at least 3 years focused on productionising ML pipelines.

  • A degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, or a related field. PhD a plus.

  • Expert proficiency in Python and ML/DL libraries such as scikit-learn, TensorFlow, PyTorch, Hugging Face, and LangChain.

  • Strong with BigQuery, dbt, and SQL for feature and data preparation.

  • Hands-on experience with Vertex AI for pipeline orchestration, deployment, and monitoring (or AWS/GCP equivalents).

  • Experience with Prefect orchestration and CI/CD pipelines in Bitbucket.

  • Familiarity with ML Ops frameworks such as MLflow or TFX, and containerisation with Docker and Kubernetes.

  • Experience with vector databases such as Pinecone, FAISS, or Milvus.

  • Proven delivery of ML or GenAI use cases in production with measurable business impact.

  • Strong stakeholder communication and the ability to translate AI/ML into measurable business outcomes.

  • Systems thinker with strong ethical grounding in responsible AI; balances innovation with operational reliability and cost control.

What we offer

  • An appealing discount on all of our products – from essential oils to vitamins & nutrients

  • We offer 28 days of paid time off per year plus up to 5 days off between Christmas and New Year

  • The Urban Sports Club membership and either Swapfiets bike rental or a subsidy for the Deutschlandticket

  • We believe great things happen when we meet in person, which is why we embrace a hybrid model with one home office day per week – up to two depending on the area you are working in – and up to two weeks per year working from abroad

  • Receive various discounts of up to more than 50 percent on attractive brands such as Flaconi, Bosch, Apple or Expedia

  • You will be given real ownership and plenty of room for new initiatives, as well as the opportunity to contribute your expertise and implement your great ideas

  • Inviting office spaces with access to plenty of organic teas and superfoods from around the world

  • We like to celebrate each other! Regular tea & office parties, Christmas and summer feasts and various influencer events such as Women's Day

Apply with your CV.

Sunday Natural emerged from a long-standing passion and research in the fields of health, healing, and personal growth. The lack of natural, high-quality products on the market was the original motivation for founding Sunday Natural in 2013. We aim to produce the products we ourselves would love to buy – as natural as possible, absolutely pure, free from any additives, and of the highest quality. In a strategic partnership with CVC, Sunday Natural is now one of Germany's most renowned quality manufacturers, with its own research and development department in Berlin. For the continuous improvement of our products, we collaborate with selected research institutes, scientists, therapists, farmers, and professional associations.

We take our ecological responsibility very seriously: that’s why the majority of our product range is vegan. We also take an innovative approach to packaging: most of our products are packaged in glass, making them almost entirely recyclable.

Our diverse team in Berlin consists of over 350 employees from more than 45 nationalities and continues to grow – but at a sustainable pace. Our goal is to foster a collaborative, supportive, and inclusive work environment with a diverse group of motivated, talented, and visionary team members.

We highly value equality of opportunity and inclusivity, and we would like to particularly encourage women and candidates from under-represented backgrounds to apply, even if you don’t match with 100% of the requirements.
